002bb62441c16250.official: Conquer treacherous peaks, leap across icy chasms and swat snow-dwelling beasts – either solo or with a friend – in this NES classic. Use your hammer to bash blocks and defend yourself from wildlife as you head towards the summit. Make it through all eight floors to reach the bonus stage and grab as many vegetables as you can before hitching a lift on a friendly condor.
002bb62441c16250.overview:
Ascending vertical mountain slopes to reach the summit serves as the primary goal, across 32 mountains of increasing difficulty. The player directs Popo, armed with a hammer used to break through overhead ice blocks and strike hostile creatures. Each mountain features eight floors followed by a bonus round. Navigating the terrain requires timing jumps onto moving clouds and across breakable, unbreakable and conveyor-like moving floors. Along the way, creatures such as hole-filling Topis, flying Nitpickers, and a Polar Bear that pushes the screen down impede progress.

Reaching the top triggers a timed bonus stage filled with platforms and collectible vegetables, with a condor flying overhead; grabbing onto the condor earns bonus points and ends the round. A second participant can join the ascent controlling Nana. In this two-player option, participants either work cooperatively or play against each other.

005c48a5984e3b75.overview:
The Addams Family features side-scrolling platform action. The family has been evicted, and its members have gone to the house to reason with the family attorney, Tully Alford; when Gomez Addams arrives, Morticia, Lurch, Granny, Pugsley, and Wednesday are missing. Controlling Gomez, the player searches the house and its grounds, starting in the Garden at the base of the Big Tree and moving through areas such as the Crypt, the Kitchen, the Attic, and the Rooftop.

Gomez jumps, swims in the Pond, and paddles a gondola on the Secret River, and he defeats skulls, ghosts, and other enemies by jumping on them. Progress requires finding keys and objects and solving puzzles, such as finding the parts of a potion needed to shrink Pugsley. Once rescued, Thing can shield Gomez from enemies three times, and manuscripts from the library let Lurch play helpful music. To free Morticia, every family member must be rescued and one million dollars collected.

0115356b0791cc8d.overview:
Deadly Towers presents an action role-playing experience viewed from an oblique perspective. Prince Myer must restore peace to the Willner Kingdom by infiltrating the magic palace of Rubas. To access the final confrontation, the hero explores a palace and grounds hiding large underground dungeon mazes, each of about two hundred rooms, behind invisible entrances. The protagonist moves in eight directions and attacks hostile creatures by throwing his sword. Defeated monsters sometimes leave hearts or a currency called Ludder, which players spend at hidden shops that each sell different items.

Inside the palace, Prince Myer climbs seven bell towers, each guarded by a boss at the summit. Defeating a boss yields a bell that must be burned within the holy flame to destroy that tower. Once every bell is consumed, the passage to Rubas opens. Along the way, invisible entrances also lead to secret rooms and a parallel world, and the strongest gear lies in the dungeons. A password restores progress.

018f8a4f35d15af7.overview:
Bringing down Al Capone and ending his criminal regime forms the primary objective of the mission. Set within 1920s Chicago, the game spans seven distinct scenarios adapted from the film, putting the player in command of Eliot Ness and his squad of lawmen.

Play alternates across multiple formats throughout the investigation. Across various levels, the player ducks for cover while aiming gunsights down alleys, jumps across warehouse crates to retrieve dropped ledgers, and shoots contraband bottles along a border bridge. Later sequences require steering a baby carriage down steps while avoiding gunfire, stopping a hostage taker with a single precision shot to his hat, and pursuing hitman Frank Nitty during a rooftop shootout.

01b1bc93f72286a1.overview:
Players control Luke Skywalker as he fights enemies using a blaster pistol or a lightsaber. Set within the events of the film, the adventure tasks the player with multiple objectives throughout various environments. These goals include fighting through the ice caverns of Hoth, where Wampas lurk, to destroy an Imperial Probe Droid, and finding Yoda on Dagobah for training. On Hoth, Luke also pilots a snowspeeder against AT-AT Walkers and may board an abandoned AT-ST walker during the evacuation of Echo Base. Force Power icons found along the way let Luke jump higher, run faster, reflect enemy shots, levitate, or convert Force ability into health.

Later, Luke flies his X-wing to Bespin, fights through Cloud City to rescue his friends, and pursues Boba Fett's ship, the Slave I, to rescue Han. After returning to Cloud City to rescue Princess Leia, Luke must find and confront Darth Vader in a final battle.

0244b219abbde241.overview:
Accumulating the highest monetary score across three quiz stages is the primary goal in this television game show adaptation. One to three contestants compete directly or against computer opponents, selecting on-screen avatars and adjusting time limits through three skill levels. When an answer is revealed from six board categories, participants attempt to buzz in first. A successful buzzer permits a player to spell out the corresponding question on an alphanumeric board before time expires, earning the selected wager. Incorrect responses deduct money from the participant's total and allow remaining contenders an opportunity to respond.

Hidden Daily Double squares let individuals wager independently without buzzer competition. After the first board clears, Double Jeopardy! doubles the dollar values and introduces two Daily Doubles. Players who hold positive cash reserves advance to Final Jeopardy!, where each contestant wagers secretly on the displayed category and spells a response in turn.

025abe5ae4e1610f.official: Take control of the starship Caesar and defeat the evil Starbrain and its armies in this classic NES shoot 'em up. Star Soldier spawned Hudson Soft's long-running series of Soldier titles. Pilot your ship through 16 deadly stages across an enormous space station, collecting power capsules to increase your ship's firepower, speed and shields. Blast waves of enemies or fly under the space station to avoid incoming fire.
025abe5ae4e1610f.overview:
Piloting the starship Caesar, the player shoots down waves of hostile forces threatening the galactic empire. This vertically scrolling journey spans sixteen stages set across a massive space station. The craft moves across the screen and fires upward to strike both grounded targets and airborne enemies arriving from above. At certain points, the ship can enter a trap zone, slipping beneath the station structure to evade incoming fire. Each stage ends with a confrontation against a supercomputer boss called Starbrain, while a Big Starbrain variant appears at the end of stages 4, 8, 12, and 16.

Destroying special markers releases power capsules that bolster the starship's capabilities. Collecting capsules enhances speed, strengthens weapon output, and alters firing patterns. Gathering multiple items enables the craft to transform, fire behind itself, and eventually shoot in five directions. A third capsule grants a shield absorbing up to five hits, while a fourth upgrade eliminates flying enemies.

02caaf66cc43a4c5.overview:
Ridding Metro City of crime serves as the main goal after a villain named Sutekh unites the local gangs and overpowers the superhero Vortex. Taking on the role of Mark Gray, a vigilante known as Nightshade, the player confronts Sutekh alongside several other crime bosses, including King Rat, Lord Muck, Goliath, and Ninja Mistress.

Progressing through the game involves a mix of action sequences, point-and-click elements, and fighting segments that demand swift button inputs. A dedicated popularity meter tracks the character's reputation, rising or dropping based on how effectively Nightshade carries out good deeds. Earning higher popularity increases recognition from the local citizens and grants the player entry into additional areas across the city.

038f2241fd6e5860.overview:
Stages in this single-player adventure are organized into two overarching stories across multiple scenes. Gameplay transitions between traveling areas, mysterious secret rooms, conversational dialogue sequences, and side-view fighting scenes. The overarching mission requires Goku to journey across deserts and caves to recover seven crystal balls, which summons the Dragon Emperor to grant a wish at the conclusion of each story.

The player navigates Goku by jumping, squatting, and punching, as well as executing kicks and downward strikes during combat encounters. Goku begins with a power gauge of 100 points that gradually depletes over time or through enemy damage, ending the game if reduced to zero. Consuming drumsticks or cakes replenishes this energy, while exploding capsules reveal utility items including speed-boosting sandwiches, the projectile Wind Wave, and Magic Poles that provide enhanced reach and attack power.

03db3d003eaa91e1.overview:
Players control Rocky and Bullwinkle on a journey from Frostbite Falls, Minnesota, to Abominable Mansion in England, where Bullwinkle is to inherit the title of Earl of Moosechester. Boris Badenov and Natasha Fatale plan to stop the pair and impersonate Bullwinkle to collect his inheritance. Five game levels stand between the heroes and the mansion, and some stages require finding a key to unlock the door at the end.

The player can switch between Rocky and Bullwinkle while standing still, and both heroes share one energy supply. Bullwinkle can charge and Rocky can fly, though both moves burn energy. Either hero can throw bombs collected along the way, which are needed in the final level. Goof-Gas bombs reverse the left and right controls. Moose Juice restores lost energy, and hearts add a life and refill energy.

0417d7caec593852.overview:
Guiding Jay McCray through side-scrolling environments, the player runs and shoots to defeat the terrorist organization responsible for killing his father. The mission spans five stages, taking Jay through a deserted space colony, an underground concourse, the terrorist headquarters, the terrorists' spaceship, and a spaceship factory. Each area requires navigating past robotic adversaries and defense mechanisms to confront a boss at the end. After defeating the final encounter and viewing the credits, the adventure restarts at the first stage.

Jay can lie flat on the ground, though firearm aiming is limited to horizontal directions. Jay can use six weapons: a handgun and a shotgun from the start, plus a machine gun, homing missile, laser rifle, and grenade launcher found along the way. Using any weapon other than the handgun depletes an energy meter, reverting Jay to his default sidearm once depleted. Capsules found in every stage replenish health and weapon power.

04264565cf33f4bd.overview:
Controlling Ken, the player battles through eight scenes to rescue his people from the tyranny of the Emperor Heaven. Ken must defeat eight enemies, including generals of Gento and Gold Falco, whose attacks include Fireballs, White Light Bombs, and a deadly sliding kick. Ken punches, kicks, jumps, and crouches while exploring each stage left to right or up and down. At times he can enter the next room by pressing both attack buttons together and then right at an entrance. Knocking a boss down scores points, and finding and hitting its weakest point scores far more.

Knocking down certain enemies produces stars that multiply Ken's strength up to seven times. Twenty knockdowns earn a shooting attack. The flag of Hokuto restores lost energy, Yulia's silver necklace restores shooting power, and her gold necklace grants Gento Karate, which lets enemies and objects pass through Ken harmlessly. A VS mode offers practice against the enemies of the first four stages.

044015f2933671f2.overview:
Participants compete in baseball matches featuring rosters of athletes whose names and statistics parallel real professional players. The selection includes fourteen total clubs divided equally between an American league and a National league, representing cities such as Minnesota, Detroit, St. Louis, and San Francisco. Matches can be contested between individual teams, or through an all-star game gathering top performers from across the rosters.

In one-player play, winning six games takes the league pennant and leads to a series against the other league's winner, with passwords used to continue. Other options include a two-player format and a zero-player watch mode where the action unfolds automatically.

0512b4aa2220f74e.overview:
Commando is a vertically scrolling run and gun shooter. Controlling a soldier named Super Joe, the player is landed by helicopter to fight past waves of enemy forces, rescue hostages, and keep an enemy army from controlling the world. Joe moves in eight directions, firing a rifle with the B Button and throwing a limited supply of grenades with the A Button. Throughout the stages, the player can use grenades to uncover hidden underground shelters, where hostages are held and poisonous snakes lurk.

The game spans sixteen stages, formed by four campaigns of four stages each; later campaigns repeat the layouts with hidden shelters and items moved. Items include a Wireless Remote Radio that destroys every enemy on screen, a Medal of Honor that grants an extra life, Binoculars that reveal hidden shelters, and a Bullet Proof Jacket that absorbs ten enemy bullets. Other power-ups strengthen the rifle or grenades. In the two-player game, players take turns.

0516f35bf14eb5c0.overview:
Sinking the ball into each cup across eighteen holes serves as the primary goal. Participants play a single course assembled from eighteen championship holes drawn from real-world venues, including Pebble Beach, St. Andrews, Augusta, Baltusrol, Riviera, Muirfield, Oakmont, Merion and Royal Lytham. Players choose between Skins play, where each hole carries a prize and tied holes carry the money over, and Stroke play, where the lowest score over 18 holes wins.

Up to four individuals can take part in matches, mixing human and computer-controlled golfers. Single competitors can instead face off against a selection of computer-controlled opponents, which includes Nicklaus himself. Each shot uses a three-tap power bar that sets distance and hook or slice, while wind, rough, sand, water and the break of the greens affect play.

055fb73baaed0f3c.official: Firebrand the gargoyle returns in this NES prequel to the gothic Game Boy hit. As a young demon-in-training, Firebrand is entrusted to defeat an evil, dark light that threatens his home. Part platformer, part roleplaying game, Gargoyle's Quest II: The Demon Darkness features overhead map-style adventure elements and side-scrolling action elements. Increase Firebrand's abilities as you progress: improving your flying, jumping and magic power.
055fb73baaed0f3c.overview:
Gargoyle's Quest II combines overhead role-playing exploration with side-scrolling platform action. Players guide Firebrand, a young gargoyle warrior, across the Ghoul Realm to investigate a mysterious black light that drained the magic from his homeland. Movement across the realm takes place from a top-down view along four cardinal directions, allowing players to navigate between regions, visit villages, and converse with other characters.

Action areas switch the display to side-scrolling stages. Firebrand uses his wings for short flights, shoots magic weapon projectiles at adversaries, and clings to walls to scale vertical surfaces. Special items improve his jumping, flight endurance, stamina, and magic, while magic such as the Tornado creates temporary platforms to lift him upward. Progress involves defeating bosses, collecting items, and tracking advancement using a password system.

05684e63aa981006.official: There are three types of boxing action in World Champ: The Ranking Game, The VS Game, The Tournament Game.
05684e63aa981006.overview:
Three modes structure this boxing title: the Ranking Game, the VS Game, and the Tournament Game. Standard matches consist of five 60-second rounds, while Ranking Game sparring lasts three. Fights conclude through a ten-second knockout, a technical knockout after three knockdowns in a round, or a decision on points. In the Ranking Game, boxers challenge the top five contenders across four weight classes to dethrone each division champion.

Controlling a fighter involves movement, attack inputs, and defenses like blocking or swaying. Before each round, players distribute power points among straight punches, uppercuts, body blows, and hooks. The stamina gauge decreases from landed blows and time, while a spirit gauge fills with attacks and dodges to enable knockdown strikes. Passwords store improved boxer attributes from training and victories for use across two-player head-to-head bouts or tournaments accommodating up to eight participants.

059409954035963f.overview:
Wayne's World features platforming action where players guide Wayne and Garth to rescue Cassandra and reclaim the contract for their cable access show. A Chicago producer plans to buy out their broadcast and alter its format, sending the hosts on a journey through five main levels and a bonus area. Wayne attacks foes with karate strikes, whereas Garth defends himself using an electric taser.

Controlling the characters involves moving sideways, crouching, leaping, performing high flip jumps, and entering doors. A life starts with twenty-two worthiness units, which deplete whenever a protagonist sustains damage from enemies or falls a few yards. Each level includes a countdown timer, and dropping worthiness to zero or exhausting the clock costs one of four total lives. In the bonus doughnut shop, collecting every pastry before time runs out awards an additional life.

06fddd300a6d1cbe.overview:
Pirates One-Eye and Red Dog set out on a dangerous journey to rescue a kidnapped princess from an evil wizard. The game can be played alone or with two players working cooperatively or competitively across multiple playfields.

Controlling either pirate, players jump, climb ladders, and use a standard attack to battle hostile creatures, rival pirates, and powerful bosses such as Medusa or the Executioner. Defeating a set quota of foes triggers an arrow leading toward the area boss before the round timer expires. Players uncover hidden items simply by walking over crossbones scattered across the landscape. Along with health-restoring food, participants gather treasures such as goblets, money bags, and chests, which are traded between completed stages for additional swords, daggers, or firearms to bolster their offensive capabilities.

07bfd5bf6d3e5cea.overview:
Winning a basketball game by outscoring the opponent over four quarters serves as the central goal, with one-minute overtime quarters breaking ties. Participants take charge of either the Harlem Globetrotters or the Washington Generals, guiding their chosen roster across the court. Rookie play uses a 45-second shot clock and an opponent that does not steal as easily, while Pro play has a 24-second shot clock and a faster pace. Up to four people can play with an NES Satellite, two per team.

Controlling the Harlem Globetrotters adds trick shots and trick passes on command, with the specific trick chosen at random. Trick shots include a kick shot, behind-the-back shots, a bounce shot, a somersault slam dunk, a half-court hook shot and a piggyback shot. At the foul line, a shooter may use a ball on an elastic string that snaps back to him.

07dd16464d769429.official: Join Donkey Kong Jr. for a math lesson with a difference! In this educational NES game, swing and jump around the stage, collecting numbers and symbols to calculate the correct figure displayed by Donkey Kong. Put your mathematical skills to the test in single-player mode or challenge a friend to a two-player math race. You can even pester your opponent by grabbing numbers before they do!
07dd16464d769429.overview:
Controlling Donkey Kong Jr., the player walks, jumps, and climbs to solve mathematical problems presented by Donkey Kong. Stages feature chains holding digits and islands holding arithmetic symbols for the player to collect. By gathering these items in the Calculate modes, the objective is to build equations that match a target figure displayed by Donkey Kong on a placard.

Three game modes are offered: Calculate A, Calculate B, and the single-player Exercise. Calculate A and B can be played solo or by two competitors simultaneously. During a two-player contest, participants race against each other to produce the target value first and earn five apples, even hindering an opponent by taking numbers and symbols before the rival can reach them. Exercise presents ten arithmetic problems per game, where the player climbs chains under a Nitpicker to select missing numbers.

08615e9e339bd2df.overview:
The player controls miniature versions of either the Vampire or the Monster, jumping and attacking through six environmental stages to defeat Warlock and hostile minions. Movement includes walking, crouching, jumping, and executing a higher secondary leap at the apex of a jump. In combat, characters can strike directly or lift and throw everyday objects, such as keys and bolts, at oncoming adversaries.

Progress spans locations including a house interior, a kitchen, sewers, construction girders, an oriental garden, and Monster Mountain, each concluding with an encounter against an enemy leader. Characters possess an energy gauge and multiple lives, losing a life when health depletes. Defeated foes yield points, which grant extra lives at score thresholds. A second player can participate, and if one character runs out of lives, that player may take a remaining life from the surviving partner.

096b8ef672ff215e.overview:
Maid Marian is held captive inside Nottingham Castle, prompting the hero Robin Hood to mount a rescue. Controlling Robin, the player explores a labyrinthine stronghold spanning multiple floors connected by ladders. The goal is to traverse the fortification, gather the stolen treasures needed to open the way onward, and reach the final room where Marian awaits.

Robin can walk, jump, duck, and climb through the environment while engaging crossbow-wielding guards and bats using a bow and arrows. Defeating foes and acquiring items awards points. Along the way, players find keys, some of them invisible, that open secret passages or extend ladders, while collected hearts restore depleted health.

0a23312c8e07b9af.overview:
Guiding a snowboarder down various snowy slopes constitutes the central action of this title. The player begins the run with four lives, aiming to complete every event and win the World Cup trophy. Progress requires successfully clearing consecutive events, as each run must be completed before the subsequent one unlocks. Falling or failing to qualify deducts a life from the reserve.

Across the campaign, the game provides five distinct events spanning eighteen total levels: Downhill, Slalom, Half-pipe, Moguls and Backwoods. The first four have three levels of difficulty each, while Backwoods has six. Players turn while standing or tucked, duck under obstacles, jump, and perform four stunts, including the Hand-Plant required in the Half-pipe and the Mule-Kick used over mogul fields. Reaching the next trail awards a bonus life, supporting the player in advancing through all remaining courses to finish the game.

0a3459d0b8955bed.overview:
Scoring baskets in half-court basketball matchups forms the core goal for participants. Each basket counts one point, and games run to 10, 15, 20 or 25 points in either a one-on-one or two-on-two format. Players can choose losers-out or winners-out rules and an eastern or western city court, and eight neighborhood players with different strengths are available. Pushing, charging and traveling are called as fouls, and an offensive foul gives the ball to the other side. When an athlete attempts a slam dunk within range, the view switches to a close-up, and a defender in position can still block the attempt.

Aside from regular competition, the title provides an Around the World mode, in which players take turns shooting from eleven spots around the court. Two-on-two tournaments issue a password after each win, and winning 15 games brings a special ending sequence.

0a3f0c3795700df2.overview:
Controlling Bubby, the player creates rainbows to climb vertically and attack enemies. The primary objective is to reach the summit of each stage before rising water overwhelms the character. Rainbows serve multiple functions: they inflict damage upon impact, gather items, block enemy movement, and act as temporary platforms. Jumping onto a rainbow causes it to drop, crushing adversaries beneath. Power-ups increase character movement speed and the number of rainbows projected at once.

Each island holds seven small diamonds, each with its own color and letter. Collecting all seven hues spells out the word RAINBOW to reward a big diamond and grant an extra life. The campaign spans seven islands of four stages each and challenges players to rescue the islands by overcoming Krabo.

0a5ccea3fb83a670.overview:
Defeating every opposing club to earn a game against a secret super team serves as the primary goal when playing against the computer. Participants select a single squad to compete against all other available teams, with options including every major league club from the 1990 season, National and American all-star lineups, and division champions spanning from 1983 to 1989. Passwords let players continue their progress later.

On the field, controllable fielders can jump and dive for the ball. Each batter and pitcher is rated from real-life statistics, covering hitting ability, power and running speed for batters, and control, pitching speed and stamina for pitchers. Other options include two-player competition and a Watch mode in which the computer plays both sides.

0b3afd6b8e4fc12f.overview:
Professional basketball competition serves as the backdrop for Tecmo NBA Basketball. Players take to the court using authentic rosters that reflect the 1991–92 season, featuring every team from that era alongside individual athletes such as Michael Jordan, Larry Bird on the Boston Celtics, and Magic Johnson on the Los Angeles Lakers.

Matches incorporate cinema-style cutscenes that display during active play. In addition to standard competition, a dedicated all-star game mode allows users to challenge the Eastern or Western Conference rosters, with the option to customize each all-star squad's starting lineup and substitutions through the team data menus.

0b5d1465b23e31f2.overview:
Teenage troll twins Samantha and Norbert encounter an uncharted island containing hidden riches once explored by their grandfather. Using a magic spy glass, shovel, and treasure map, the trolls enter underground caverns across the island to gather treasures such as rubies, sapphires, diamonds, musical notes, and pirate coins. Trolls automatically scurry back and forth, allowing players to direct vertical movement. To collect gems or pass matching doors, trolls must apply colored hair dye, while gray doors open automatically once sufficient treasure is acquired. Navigational challenges include slippery ice, water, sand, hot embers, directional arrows, and aggressive island creatures, some of which can be mitigated using ice boots, boats, or healing red crosses.

Play spans thirty-two subterranean mazes leading toward castles and a pyramid. Available modes include single-player, two-player, and cooperative teamwork, alongside an editor allowing players to design up to four custom caverns using a palette of parts. Progress is maintained using name-linked passwords.

0ba5e69962f6576d.overview:
A martial artist named Thomas climbs the five floors of a castle to rescue Sylvia, who is held captive by a mysterious gang led by Mr. X. The player guides Thomas along side-scrolling floors, climbing the stairs to the next floor after clearing each area.

Controlling Thomas, players execute punches and kicks from standing, crouching, or jumping positions. Strikes fend off regular adversaries, such as Grippers, Knife Throwers, and Tom Toms, alongside hazards like objects dropping from the ceiling, snakes, and fire-breathing dragons. When enemies catch Thomas, his energy drains until the player breaks free with quick button presses. Each floor features a time limit and concludes with a duel against a boss, from the Stick Fighter up to Mr. X himself. Rescuing Sylvia on the top floor leads to the next round. Game A suits beginners and Game B experts, and a two-player option is included.

0bb401bbd0cae275.overview:
Infiltrator casts the player as Captain Johnny "Jimbo-Baby" McGibbits, sent to stop the Mad Leader. Each mission begins at Home Base, from which the player pilots a Gizmo DHX-3 attack helicopter through hostile airspace to reach one of the Mad Leader's installations, watching the cockpit instruments and drawing on supplies of missiles, flares and chaff along the way.

After a safe landing, the action switches to a ground mission inside the enemy compound, played against a time limit. Disguised as an enemy guard, the player relies on forged papers and other inventory items to avoid capture while completing the objective assigned in the briefing. Three increasingly difficult missions make up the campaign, and a password lets a later mission be started directly.

0bd29c5b583570e1.overview:
Players control Jake, an apprentice magician who navigates side-scrolling platform levels on an action-adventure quest. Edogy, a menace from the underground world with designs on taking over California above and below ground, kidnaps Jake's friend Allison to lure her father, a professor, and soon holds them both. With help from his teacher, the old magician Zebediah, Jake sets out to rescue them and confront Edogy.

Throughout the journey, the protagonist draws on twelve magic powers, including spells that damage every enemy on screen and transformations into a lion, an eagle, or a fish, all limited by a magic power gauge. Each of the five levels contains two or three stages and ends with a boss fight against one of Edogy's grotesque associates. Holding the fire button charges a stronger shot.

0c190a8a7bfb57d7.overview:
Directing one of four C-Force commandos, players run, jump, and shoot through hostile territory to free Neo City from the terrorist group D.N.M.E. Characters include the leader Burn, heavy weapons specialist Iron, marksman Smith, and demolitions expert Beans, each possessing distinct movement speeds, jumping attributes, and armaments. Across five missions, the objective requires navigating through enemy forces to confront a boss. The first, third, and fifth missions are side-scrolling, while the second and fourth use an overhead view.

Destroying enemies and objects reveals items that advance a power gauge. Players can select upgrades from this gauge, including character-specific weapons, Turbo Power that fires three times in a row, or a Rolling Attack that protects while jumping. Pausing brings up a sub-menu to swap characters, call in a computer-controlled partner for a few seconds through a Battle Plan, or add a second player. Each commando starts with three lives, and continuing is possible.

0cc334007d3eae69.official: Mario Bros. is a treasure trove of gaming history. The follow-up to the hit Donkey Kong, it was not only the first time our hero was known as Mario, it also introduced his brother Luigi, green pipes, coins and even more now-familiar elements of the Mario series. The gameplay is simple yet challenging: eliminate all the enemies in each level for a big score.
0cc334007d3eae69.overview:
Defeating all enemies emerging from the pipes of the underground setting serves as the primary goal across each level. Players control Mario alone or team up with Luigi when a second participant joins. Because jumping directly onto upright foes causes harm, characters must leap into the underside of platforms to stun creatures onto their backs before running into them to kick them away.

Targets include crabs, jumping fighter flies, and turtles that emerge from overhead pipes. Screen edges allow wraparound movement from one side of the play area to the other. Striking a central POW block flips grounded adversaries at once, though it disappears after three hits. Hazards like floating fireballs and floor-freezing Freezies cost a life on contact, while collecting coins increases the score across endless stages.

0cf2fc17a59a0932.overview:
Clearing blocks from the playfield serves as the central goal in this single-player puzzle game. Players slide shapes such as Diamonds, Cubes, Pyramids, and Spheres left or right while gravity pulls them down, and identical shapes that meet disappear. Each puzzle must be cleared before the timer reaches zero, and Elevator Blocks are the only way to carry a shape upward.

The main game has 16 levels of 10 puzzles each. Players can retry a puzzle twice, continue an unfinished puzzle at the cost of their score, and use passwords to return to the last level played. A second mode, Gravnic, offers 8 levels in which every movable shape shifts at once in a chosen direction of gravity, with a limited number of moves per puzzle.

0d1603daf31ec66c.overview:
Two educational games comprise this cartridge: Letter-Go-Round and Ernie's Big Splash. Letter-Go-Round features six levels of letter and word activities. Players adjust the speed of a spinning Ferris wheel and select letters that enter a matching zone at the bottom. Initial levels require matching uppercase or lowercase letters shown on a seesaw, with three matches building a strength-o-meter to complete a round. Higher levels prompt players to construct complete three-letter words, insert missing letters, or find hidden secret words.

Ernie's Big Splash is divided into three challenges containing multiple playfields. The objective is to build a connected pathway across a grid to lead Rubber Duckie from a soap dish to Ernie's bathtub. Players cycle through building pieces marked with entry and exit arrows, placing valid segments that allow forward movement. The second and third challenges introduce Muppet Fun Pals, special pathway tiles featuring four doorways that can be traversed twice.

0d895a031dd38f26.overview:
Gyromite features puzzle platform gameplay centered on Professor Hector. The primary objective is to gather the dynamite in each phase before a timer expires. Creatures called Smicks wander the area and bite the Professor, but Hector can pick up and put down turnips to attract and divert them. In the two-player version of Game A, players take turns, with Professor Vector also appearing.

Progress requires raising and lowering red and blue gates. Players send directional commands and arm movements to the R.O.B. accessory, which positions gyros onto colored trays. Setting a gyro onto a tray physically presses a button on the second controller, which sits in the tray unit, shifting the matching gate on the screen. The title offers Game A, Game B, and a Direct practice mode.

0dcd6d458d26cda8.official: Now, with over 1,000 new puzzles, you can enter consonants, buy vowels, and solve puzzles. Do it without going bankrupt and the chance to win "cash" and an exciting "dream prize" is yours! Television's number-one game show has an all-new Nintendo edition! Play familiar, favorite categories and challenging new ones as well. Get set to spin! Get set to win!
0dcd6d458d26cda8.overview:
Solving hidden word puzzles by guessing letters and accumulating cash represents the primary objective across each match. Based on the television game show, one to three participants compete, with computer players available across three skill levels. After picking an on-screen character, each participant acts before a timer expires by spinning the wheel, buying vowels for $250, or solving the board. Hostess Vanna White reveals correct letters, while wheel segments award cash values per consonant, grant a free spin, force a missed turn, or cause bankruptcy.

To solve, players input the remaining letters, but any mistake invalidates the attempt. The match winner advances to the final round, selecting one of the letters in WHEEL, under which a prize is hidden. The game provides the letters R, S, T, L, N, and E, after which the finalist chooses three consonants and one vowel before attempting the solution.

0de5af54fd433bc6.overview:
Contestants compete in a television game show format where two five-member teams try to guess responses given in surveys of one hundred people. Sessions accommodate a single family facing a computer opponent or two human families competing head-to-head. Each round opens with a toss-up question between opposing family members, who race to buzz in and enter an answer within forty-five seconds using an on-screen letter or number grid. The winner chooses whether their team will play or pass the question.

The active family attempts to reveal the remaining responses to bank points corresponding to survey counts. Making three incorrect guesses allows the opposing side to steal the banked points with one correct answer. Point values double in later rounds, and reaching 200 points sends that family to the Fast Money Round. There, two members sequentially answer five survey questions within two minutes to win additional prize money.

0df01b1d7b6efe38.overview:
R.B.I. Baseball 2 provides baseball gameplay featuring twenty-six professional teams with twenty-four players on each roster. Players are defined by attributes modeled after real-life performance statistics, including batting average, home run power, and running speed for hitters, as well as stamina, pitch speed, and control for pitchers. Participants select starting lineups and manage rosters, drawing from up to five available pitchers during a matchup.

Controlling the team on offense entails timing swings, bunting, and commanding base runners to advance, retreat, or attempt steals. When on defense, players choose between fastballs, sinkers, or breaking pitches while steering balls in flight, and fielders can jump, dive, and throw to particular bases. Modes include single-player contests, competitive two-player series, a television-style computer exhibition, and seven-game series or full league schedules supported by passwords.

0e58f270e7b11678.overview:
Reaching an exit door to complete each town serves as the primary objective across six worlds. Guiding a character named Rockford, the player digs through mud to gather a required quota of diamonds before an allotted time limit expires.

Various hazards complicate each area, including falling rocks that drop whenever the underlying mud gets cleared away. Creatures such as Pingping, Flapflap, Puffpuff, Piropiro, Tackytacky, and multiplying amoebas also inhabit the stages. Players solve puzzles by managing interactions among these elements, such as dropping rocks onto certain enemies to produce extra diamonds while preventing Rockford from being crushed.

0e862077f390348b.official: Brawl through the Louisiana Bayou all the way to New Orleans' famous Bourbon Street with former U.S. soldier Billy West, determined to save his homeland and his fiancée from local mobster Godfather Gordon and his crew.
0e862077f390348b.overview:
Rescuing Annabelle, Billy's kidnapped girlfriend, from the crime boss Godfather Gordon serves as the primary objective across nine stages spanning Louisiana swamplands, city streets, and an enemy estate. Controlling Bayou Billy, the player navigates side-scrolling beat-em-up segments using punches, kicks, and jump kicks to defeat humans and animals like crocodiles or guard dogs. Billy can collect and wield dropped melee weapons, fire a dropped Magnum, and acquire items such as health-restoring raw meat and damage-reducing bulletproof vests.

Gameplay shifts styles during specific stages. First-person rail shooting segments allow the player to eliminate gunmen and bosses using a standard controller or an NES Zapper while collecting ammunition, health kits, and temporary power-ups. Driving sections require steering Billy's jeep against a countdown, firing forward at enemy cars, and tossing dynamite at airborne threats while collecting gasoline cans. A practice mode provides condensed versions of select stages, awarding power-ups for the main adventure.

106a9cd2acc3373b.overview:
Stopping the villain Saddam Insane stands as the primary goal in Operation Secret Storm. The player assumes control of George, a top CIA agent sent to the Middle East during the Gulf War to save oil refineries and halt the production of chemical and biological weapons. The agent journeys through Iraq, from a pipeline and oilfields to Scud missile sites, an old palace and a desert airstrip.

Gameplay unfolds along a two-dimensional plane utilizing beat-'em-up fighting mechanics. George can punch, kick, jump and run at high speed, and while navigating through the hostile forces, the character gathers supplies consisting of ammunition, grenades and health hearts to assist throughout the battle.

10d7e7b387a8960c.overview:
Set at the Venice Beach Open tournament, four remaining pairs compete for the MEGA V-Ball Award. Players choose among teams composed of Bob and Howard, Lisa and Bambi, Steve and Jamile, or Kelly and Morica. Before hitting the sand, an options screen permits adjusting the difficulty across three tiers, choosing a victory threshold of 5, 10, or 15 points, setting match length to a single game or best two out of three, and switching between normal serve-only scoring and rally point rules.

Controlling the athletes involves moving across the court and aiming hits with the directional pad. An X marks where the ball will land. Participants execute flat or jump serves, pass and set to teammates, smash spikes downward at the net, or leap to block opposing hits. Available modes include single-player matches against the computer, two players facing off head-to-head, or two players teaming up simultaneously against computer opponents.

10e2091a1c5e3ff3.overview:
Defeating Shredder serves as the ultimate goal in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles - Tournament Fighters. The story begins as Leonardo, Raphael, Michaelangelo, and Donatello compete among themselves to determine which brother will confront their nemesis. The player selects one Turtle, faces the remaining three, and then battles Casey Jones and Hothead before reaching the final encounter against Shredder. In addition to this single-player campaign, options include a four-player tournament, a match against a computer opponent, and head-to-head play against another person.

Contenders engage in best-two-out-of-three combat, utilizing standard punches, kicks, and command-driven special moves. Same-character matches are supported for every fighter except Hothead. During bouts, a Fireball occasionally appears in the arena. Either participant can collect this power-up and throw it by entering a specific command.

1104d574711a1037.overview:
Thwarting Doctor Octopus and saving the world from the Sinister Six serves as the ultimate goal for the player. Guiding Spider-Man across six side-scrolling stages, the player confronts a distinct boss at the conclusion of each level, encountering Electro, Sandman, Mysterio, Vulture, Hobgoblin, and finally Doctor Octopus.

Throughout the journey, Spider-Man traverses environments by jumping, ducking, and scaling walls and other surfaces. For combat, the character can punch and kick opposing threats, swing from shot webs, and gather web fluid to fire web projectiles. Certain areas require locating specific objects, including keys or detonators, to progress. The player receives a single life alongside one continue, starting with four squares of energy. Although restorative items do not appear, earning every one thousand points replenishes Spider-Man with an extra energy square.

1152961edf8d484f.overview:
Mendel Palace presents puzzle action where Bon-Bon sets out to rescue his best friend Candy from her own dream. Players direct Bon-Bon across single-room stages arranged in a five-by-seven grid of floor tiles surrounded by walls. Roaming enemy dolls attempt to collide with the player, costing a life on contact. Flipping adjacent or occupied tiles pushes dolls away and exposes hidden items beneath. Hostile figures are eliminated by driving them into the walls, or by launching off attack panels into them. Clearing a stage requires destroying every doll, though some levels conclude if all tiles become unflippable in a stalemate.

Each world contains ten levels and ends with a boss encounter. Two players can join simultaneously in cooperative play, tracking lives separately until both players run out.

115fcca17cb77d7c.overview:
Touchdown Fever depicts the sport of American football across matches that support two players. Teams represent real-world football cities. Play encompasses standard running and passing maneuvers alongside special teams kicking.

On offense, human competitors choose from six formations: short passes, long passes, quarterback sneaks, hand-offs to backs, punts, and field goals. Even after choosing a kicking formation, the offense can still pass or run. Players can also opt to run a two-point conversion.

119f865684be58f3.overview:
Set across a series of stages, each containing an underground Barshop, this run-and-gun shooter casts players as Paul and Vince after a mysterious storm hurls them thousands of years into the future. A booming voice tells them that the villain Zang Zip has enslaved the people of Earth. Up to two players battle hostile alien forces in an effort to defeat the invaders.

Controlling their characters through the environment, players attack enemies using grenades and additional armaments to complete their objective. Power-up items appear throughout the environment and often rest inside rocks that can be shattered with grenades. Players can also collect armor that repels bullets, while each Barshop lets players fight a bounty hunter to earn Heart Marks for buying weapons and items.

1250a80faf865aa5.official: The only Kirby game ever made for NES, Kirby's Adventure was a groundbreaking platformer famous for introducing Kirby’s ability to copy the powers of his enemies. By sucking up foes, Kirby can fire lasers, burst into flames, use a giant mallet and more. Kirby can also combine powers with some unexpected results. With lots of minigames and secrets to discover, Kirby’s Adventure – like Kirby himself – is full of surprises!
1250a80faf865aa5.overview:
Seven Levels divide the side-scrolling stages, each with a map screen whose doors lead to stages, bonus games that award extra lives, Museums, and Arenas. Secret switches open warp stages for traveling between Levels. Players guide Kirby across Dream Land to retrieve the fragments of the broken Star Rod and defeat Nightmare. The primary objective requires reaching the end of each stage while preserving a health meter from hazards and adversaries.

Controlling Kirby involves running, jumping, crouching, sliding, and inhaling foes to spit them out as star projectiles. Kirby can also puff up to fly across gaps, releasing an air pellet to drop down and hit enemies. Consuming specific swallowed targets grants special abilities, including firing lasers, using hammers, or bursting into flames. These abilities can open hidden routes, be discarded, or become dislodged upon taking damage.

12d3119e25f7b40a.official: To rescue Lala, Lolo must make his way through the mazes by collecting the Jewel in each room. In order to succeed, he’ll have to push tiles, pick up Heart Framers, temporarily turn enemies into Eggs with his Magic Shots, and ward off enemy attacks by moving Emerald Framers.
12d3119e25f7b40a.overview:
Returning from the Haunted Castle, Lolo must mount another rescue after the King of Eggerland abducts Lala and dares him to make it through his Tower and Castle. To free her, the hero journeys across mazes within the antagonist's tower and castle. Players guide Lolo through these chambers with the goal of securing the jewel situated in each area.

Completing every stage requires navigating obstacle-filled layouts by collecting Heart Framers and sliding Emerald Framers into place to block attacks. Lolo can also fire Magic Shots to briefly transform adversaries into eggs. The journey comprises fifty individual puzzle chambers spread over ten floors, alongside four concealed Pro puzzle rooms.

13353e4e94633eba.overview:
Hostile aliens from Drakkon invade Earth in the year 2999, dispatching armies across four historical eras to manipulate history. Assuming the role of the Time Lord, the player must defeat these invaders before January 1, 3000 AD to avoid destruction. Starting at a research facility, the journey spans Medieval England, the American West, the Caribbean, World War II France, and a final battle against the Drakkon King upon returning to the present.

Controlling the protagonist across pseudo-3D terrain, the player punches, jumps, and attacks foes. Every historical stage requires collecting five golden orbs to energize the time machine, with four placed around the level and the last awarded by vanquishing a Drakkon Lord boss. Players start each era unarmed but find weapons hidden inside packages. A ticking countdown limits the entire quest, and no continues are provided.

1536b8418d0643ae.overview:
Driving a heavily armed, futuristic vehicle, the player takes part in a cross-country race of destruction from city to city. A timer runs at the top of the screen, and before it reaches zero the player must find every flag in the city to open the exit, then escape with the vehicle intact. Gremlins fight back with missiles and machine-gun fire, including attacks from helicopters and silos. Points and money come from destroying gremlins, silos and enemy vehicles and from collecting flags.

Between cities, a pit stop lets the player spend the bounty to repair damage or to buy and modify guns, tires, engines, chassis and missiles. Missile types include Shell, Armored, Nuclear and Fusion, with Fusion missiles the only heat seekers. The player selects a difficulty level before starting; higher levels start with less money and tougher opponents. One or two players can race at the same time, either as a team or head to head.

15685dee8bc1c588.overview:
This light gun shooter is based on paintball. Players take control of a competitor whose goal is to cross a scrolling environment, grab the opposing team's flag from their base at the far end of the course, and bring it back safely to home base. Progress requires managing both a time limit and a restricted supply of ammunition, which can be restocked by targeting ammo boxes on the ground or hitting opponents who carry them.

Controlling the action involves aiming and firing the light gun with one hand while simultaneously using a standard directional pad with the other to scroll left or right. The stages are Forest, Bronx, and Winter, where opponents hide behind and climb trees, fire through windows, or attack from behind a fort or log cabin. Three skill levels are available.

1568e77e6533087e.official: You are Rick Stalker, a kung-fu master who must defeat the Tusk Warriors – evil soldiers who want to resurrect the demon lord Demonyx! In the single-player game, battle through side-scrolling stages in Journey Mode, then fight enemies in the one-on-one Battle Mode. Transform into a Flying Warrior to use magic spells, or switch to an ally when the going gets tough.
1568e77e6533087e.overview:
Taking control of Rick, the player battles the Soldiers of the Dark Dimension, who have broken the seal holding the demon Demonyx and allowed him to return. The journey features scrolling platform stages where the protagonist fights enemies with punches and kicks and, once his K.O. Gauge is full, Cosmic Saucer shots. Progression leads to one-on-one duel battles against Tusk Soldiers and other fighters. During these duels, players strike target marks displayed on the opponent's body while defending marks that show up on Rick. Encounters with monsters transition into role-playing command battles.

Throughout these skirmishes, Rick can transform into a Flying Warrior to unleash Mystic Spells, or tag in an allied teammate when necessary; a mirror item repels enemy spells. Outside the primary journey, a dedicated tournament mode enables up to eight players to face off and test combat abilities.

163479e2b1571538.overview:
Players control the detective Dick Tracy as he drives through a city and fights criminals to solve several mysteries. Each level introduces a case accompanied by possible clues. The player maneuvers Tracy's vehicle through streets while avoiding other cars and snipers to reach specific destinations indicated by leads. Car chases against enemy vehicles also occur often.

Arriving at the correct location shifts the action to side-scrolling fighting sections. During these segments, players battle adversaries to locate clue icons or talk to characters who provide further information. Shooting an unarmed thug costs one energy badge, and the game ends if Tracy's energy empties. A game over also occurs if the player accumulates three false arrests across all five cases, such as interrogating an uninvolved individual or attempting to arrest a suspect without complete evidence.

167bc1a0125f12d9.overview:
A chosen team of superheroes is guided through Dynatron City to combat Dr. Mayhem and his robotic forces. The starting squad includes Toolbox, Buzzsaw Girl, and Monkey Kid, joined by a fourth member selected from Jet Headstrong, Ms. Megawatt, or Radium Dog. Each superhero features distinct offensive maneuvers, ranging from hurling blades or explosive bananas to launching head projectiles, biting, or throwing cars. Using a hero's secondary ability requires collecting specific power items, and performing special maneuvers consumes an energy gauge. A time counter tracks progress across each area, and defeated heroes are captured and trapped in the sewers.

Players explore interconnected chapters spanning city streets, Mega Mall, the sewers, and the Proto-Cola Factory before confronting Dr. Mayhem. Superchargers recovered throughout the journey provide offensive advantages during the final encounter.

16c7de15b7dc72c5.overview:
Controlling Mikey, the player traverses a non-linear network of zones to rescue six captured friends and a mermaid named Annie. Progress involves navigating side-scrolling platform sequences connected by ladders and doors, while evading pursuit from members of the Fratelli family who can be stunned but not eliminated. Entering rooms shifts the perspective to a first-person interface, where the player uses menu commands to search rooms, gather hidden items, receive clues, and locate the prisoners.

Equipping both primary and secondary gear aids survival and navigation. Offensive choices include armaments like a yo-yo, boomerang, slingshot, bombs, and Molotov cocktails. Specialized gear expands exploration across the hideout, including shoes that boost speed or jumping height, a diving suit enabling underwater travel, and tools that expose hidden passages and captives.

17da401495807145.overview:
Continuous driving down branching freeways forms the structure of this single-player game. Viewed from a top-down perspective, the player pilots the armed G-6155 Interceptor sportscar along roadways and waterways across diverse territories. The primary objective centers on accumulating points while preserving civilian traffic and eliminating hostile vehicles. Entering a boathouse converts the car into a speedboat, which carries over whatever armaments were already equipped.

The Interceptor comes standard with machine guns to disable opponents. Summoning an allied weapons van allows the driver to equip special tools including smoke screens, heat-seeking missiles, and rear-discharged oil slicks. Opposing agents utilize tire slashers, rear armor, limousines with shotguns, cruise boats, and bomb-dropping helicopters to crash the player or blast craters into the path. The mission concludes when all vehicle reserves are depleted.

181163b590a581b6.overview:
A global terrorist group known as Crime Ghost threatens worldwide stability after abducting Elise, the daughter of a national president. To stop their plot and save the hostage before she is executed, operatives Paul and Vince infiltrate the enemy stronghold to take down the faction and confront its supreme leader, Faust.

Players control the protagonists in a beat 'em up format centered primarily around unarmed physical combat, utilizing punches, kicks, jump attacks, and roundhouse kicks. Ten-round machine guns can be retrieved from defeated adversaries to supply temporary firepower. In addition to hand-to-hand combat stages, the action incorporates vehicular boss confrontations fought using machine guns with infinite ammunition, alongside an underwater scuba-diving stage where guns are the only means of attack. Up to two players are supported.

183ede1115b428b0.overview:
Players control the caped crusader in this run and gun platformer, traveling across seven stages to reach the Joker's hideaway after precious metals, one of them highly toxic, vanish from Gotham City mines. Equipped with a wrist projector, Batman fires at enemies and can perform a sliding maneuver that doubles as an offensive move against select adversaries. Gathering eight energy capsules grants temporary invincibility, while weapon icons swap projectile behaviors. These ammunition types include explosive crossbow bolts, tracking Batarangs, paired Batarangs fired in a criss-cross pattern, and shield darts that spread outward in three directions.

Progression spans areas such as a cathedral, snowy peaks, and the final Island of Ha-Hacienda, usually split into sub-levels alongside boss encounters. Standard stages measure health with incremental meters, which shift to numerical readouts during confrontations with bosses like the Ace Ranger or the Joker. Batman operates with three lives, supported by unlimited continues and a pause-menu password system.

1849bb687d038a43.overview:
Ghost Lion is a role-playing adventure viewed from above. Maria's parents set out to solve the mystery of the white Ghost Lion and have not been seen for days, so after visiting the village elders she goes forth to find them and unravel the legend. Progression relies on speaking with friendly characters, examining surroundings, and visiting Springs, where winged characters record the journey and replenish Maria's COURAGE and DREAMS.

Encountering foes leads to a choice to fight or run, and battles play out in turns through menus. Maria can fight with a weapon or tool she carries or call upon spirit companions such as Moja, the spirit of the spear, and Twana, who uses magic. Each call for help uses DREAMS, and the game ends when COURAGE reaches zero. Rubies come from treasure chests and defeated enemies and buy items, while fragments of hope raise Maria's HOPE and with it her capacity for COURAGE and DREAMS.

185e4adb2cbcb71e.overview:
Finding six silver keys to reach the Enchanted Castle allows the Disney parade to begin. Mickey Mouse enlists a custom-named protagonist to recover these keys by navigating a Disney park overworld map to select different attractions. Completing the mission requires conquering five ride-based levels and solving a trivia quest.

Two top-down stages involve racing Peg leg Pete around obstacles in Autopia and directing a train along the correct tracks on Big Thunder Mountain. Side-scrolling gameplay appears in the Haunted Mansion, where the player throws candles at ghosts, and Pirates of the Caribbean, which tasks the player with rescuing six villagers. Space Mountain switches to a first-person perspective to pilot a spaceship by following navigation signals and reacting to incoming meteors. Friends of Mickey Mouse scattered throughout the park present the trivia questions about Disney characters and events to award another key.

18ca062abee6bf3b.overview:
Conflict presents hex-based military strategy across 16 scenarios. The first participant commands blue forces, while either a computer opponent or a second participant controls red forces. Factories can produce one new air or ground unit per turn. Maneuverability, defense, and evasive action vary depending on hex terrain types, which include plains, woods, mountains, seas, bridges, and towns. The primary objective in every mission requires players to eliminate the opposing flag tank.

Commanders earn fame points by occupying towns and airports and by winning battles. Accumulating higher fame points permits factories to construct a wider range of unit types. Friendly forces also use towns and airports to repair, rearm, and refuel their ground or aerial combatants, while supply vehicles and cargo aircraft can refuel and rearm units in the field. The sixteenth map is reserved for one player and opens only after passwords are earned on the first fifteen.

19a0cae21557cb7f.overview:
Divided into twenty selectable titles, this multicart begins with an introductory sequence showing dancing shoes before presenting its main menu. The selection features Skate Boy, JP Ronny, Go-Benny, Tanks, Benico, and Dream Fighter alongside a mix of action, puzzle, and gambling experiences. Titles derived from an earlier gambling release include Bingo, Hi-Lo Poker, Puzzler, and Kentucky Derby.

Several entries are alternate versions or carryovers from another compilation, specifically Cosmos Cop, Balloon Monster, Adam & Eve, Porter, Bookyman, and Magic Carpet 1001. A variant called Turbo Magic Carpet 1001 grants the player an armaments power level that begins fully upgraded and never degrades. The compilation concludes with three light gun titles: Shooter Part1, Top Hunter, and Master Shooter, the last of which begins play on an advanced stage.

1a35607e218d6810.overview:
Controlling baseball rosters modeled after real-world professional athletes, players participate in simulated baseball matchups. The title includes twenty-six teams with fictional player names standing in for real Major League Baseball players, with Roger Clemens as the single named athlete.

Participants can choose between an exhibition match and a regular season schedule. Depending on divisional alignment, the season consists of 33 games for a National Division team or 39 games for an American Division club, featuring three contests against each divisional rival. Success leads to best-of-seven playoff rounds. Progress throughout the campaign is recorded through a password system, which requires entry to resume a scheduled run.

1bf92138500e24a4.official: After Dig Dug™’s hero decides to take a well-earned vacation, there’s soon trouble in paradise as his old enemies return to wreak havoc with his holiday. It’s up to you to get rid of these irritating intruders and bring some tranquility back to the idyllic island.
1bf92138500e24a4.overview:
Controlling the hero Dig Dug from an overhead view, the player eliminates hostile creatures across island settings. Two enemies pursue the protagonist: Pookas that defeat him on contact, and fire-breathing Fygars that attack through direct touch or flames. A round ends when all enemies are eliminated.

Two primary tools assist in clearing each area. An air pump inflates targets until they burst, while a drill connects stakes in the ground to crack the terrain. Connecting these cracks causes separated ground sections to sink into the ocean, drowning any creatures caught on them. Severing three pieces of an island causes a bonus vegetable to appear for extra points. The title supports up to two players.

1c3a2806b546230c.overview:
Taking the role of a space shuttle commander, the player prepares, launches, and operates a space shuttle across six missions. Each flight is structured as a sequence of distinct mini-games. Ground preparations require activating hydrogen and oxygen pumps, opening the orbiter hatch, and riding an elevator to escort crew members aboard before a timer expires. Launches rely on quick-time events tied to real-world ascent maneuvers, including the separation of booster rockets.

While in orbit, the player directs an astronaut in a Manned Maneuvering Unit outside the vessel, dodging hazards such as satellites and asteroids, managing air supplies, and carrying components to assemble a space station. Other objectives include launching and retrieving satellites and rescuing a Soviet cosmonaut. Flights conclude with another series of quick-time events to handle reentry maneuvers, ultimately guiding the shuttle to a runway touchdown. Security codes issued after each mission allow completed missions to be bypassed later.

1c598fe0b58811b1.overview:
Kyonshies, Chinese phantoms, are wreaking havoc in eight villages, and the player controls the Phantom Fighter, Kenchi, who is called in with his assistant to save them. Each village holds houses, temples, graveyards and a Kung Fu training school, and its boss Kyonshi lives in a house that opens only after Kenchi collects three Jades.

Entering a location starts one-on-one fights against Kyonshies using punches, kicks and jumps. Villagers provide information and items such as the Sacred Sword, the Talisman and the Tonten mirror. Giving scrolls to the Kung Fu master and answering a guard's questions earns new skills, while temples restore strength. A password lets play resume from the last village, and a baby Kyonshi called Conshi can be made to help Kenchi.

1c811b67d3e211f9.overview:
Controlling squads in five-on-five basketball matches, participants compete across a full-length court using a selection of eight fictional teams. The action is viewed from a top-down, vertical perspective that shows only one half of the playing surface at a time. Crossing over the midcourt boundary triggers a brief black screen that transitions the view to the opposite end. Attempting a slam dunk temporarily stops normal play to display an animated sequence depicting the shot.

Four separate play modes are available. One-player mode sets an individual user against an artificial intelligence opponent, while two-player mode lets two participants cooperate against the computer. In versus mode, two competitors face each other directly. A watch mode also allows users to observe a match entirely controlled by the computer.

1ca05fb702996a11.overview:
Leading a band of outlaws in ancient China during Emperor Hui Zhong's reign, the player manages forces to confront the Minister of War, Gao Qiu. Across forty-nine prefectures, gameplay involves balancing taxes, loyalty, weapon upkeep, and natural hazards while governed by attributes like wisdom, strength, and dexterity. The ultimate goal requires securing imperial permission through high popularity to storm the minister's stronghold before the northern barbarians invade in January 1127.

Turn-based combat unfolds across hexagonal battlefields featuring distinct terrain. Armies clash using magic, arrows, melee attacks, or duels, and fighters can ignite map tiles. Attackers face a thirty-day limit to eliminate opposing units or apprehend the rival commander. Following a victory, captured enemy personnel can be recruited, exiled, locked away, or put to death.

1df64e9554fb9997.overview:
Featuring two distinct game modes, this top-down racing title offers both the Micro Machines Challenge and head-to-head competitions. Participants select a character and steer miniature toy craft, including formula one cars, helicopters, powerboats, and tanks capable of firing at opponents. Tracks weave across household environments like desks and breakfast tables, featuring hazards like gaps between desks, spilled cereal and sticky maple syrup. Competitors must adhere to a designated route, as straying off course resets the vehicle back onto the path.

Micro Machines Challenge tasks a driver with finishing first or second against three computer racers across progressive rounds. Players start with three chances, and every three race wins earn a time trial that can provide an extra life. In the two-player head-to-head game, drivers strive to pull a full screen ahead to claim point lights.

1e538078c3c92587.overview:
Metal Fighter presents side-scrolling shooter gameplay. The player guides a robot named MCS-920 on a mission to liberate planet H17 from alien invaders.

Progressing through the game involves combating extraterrestrial forces and facing a giant alien tyrant at the end of each world. Shooting weapon capsules reveals squares that enhance the player's robot. Collecting these upgrades boosts the machine's speed and improves its weapons. In addition to these standard enhancements, a special power-up confers the ability to fly.

1e588d435e75d80c.official: Regarded as one of the greatest action games of all time, Mega Man 2 improves upon its already superb predecessor. With even more stages and Robot Masters, its sheer size and scope are enough to get gamers' hearts palpitating! The year is 200X. Dr. Light’s super-robot, Mega Man, has succeeded in defeating the nefarious Dr. Wily, and peace reigns over the planet.
1e588d435e75d80c.overview:
Set in the year 200X, the story follows the super-robot Mega Man, sent by his creator Dr. Light to protect the world after the villainous Dr. Wily returns with a fresh army of robotic henchmen. The player controls Mega Man through eight themed stages, each guarded by a distinct Robot Master. Defeating each boss awards their signature weapon, which can exploit the specific weaknesses of other leaders. Certain victories also grant special platform-generating items to reach inaccessible areas, making stage selection order an important strategic choice.

After clearing the initial levels, the player tackles a series of linear stages inside Dr. Wily's fortress. A room with teleportation pods requires rematches against all eight Robot Masters before facing Dr. Wily. Collectible energy crystals restore health at any point, while a password system records progress and stored crystals.

1e60a181e1f89f22.overview:
Maze levels structure the progression, advancing whenever the player clears every dot from the enclosed corridors. The main objective requires navigating Pac-Man through each stage while avoiding four pursuing colored ghosts. Colliding with a ghost costs a life, and losing all available lives ends the session. A warp tunnel at the sides of the maze permits passage directly across to the opposite side, and Pac-Man moves faster than the ghosts while inside it.

Flashing power pellets located near the maze corners temporarily turn the ghosts blue and vulnerable. Pac-Man can consume these weakened spirits for bonus points, though an eaten ghost soon returns to haunt the maze. Consuming consecutive blue ghosts raises their point values, and collecting fruit bonus items provides extra points. Two players can compete by taking alternating turns.

1e8966fd8c9baf57.overview:
The player commands the Avatar to explore Britannia, gather companions, and defeat the Shadowlords following the disappearance of Lord British. Traveling across the world from an overhead perspective, the party visits towns and dungeons, collects equipment, and battles monsters. Characters attack using close-range weapons or ranged arms like bows. Casting magic requires sufficient experience, magic points, and specific spell reagents from an eight-page spellbook. A day-and-night cycle severely limits vision after dark.

The party holds up to four members, including the Avatar, sharing a communal inventory of gear and gold. Unwanted members can be dismissed to make room for new recruits. At night, magical Moongates open near towns, teleporting the group to different destinations based on the phase of the moon. Progress is saved by pitching a tent or resting at an inn.

1ea36ebd81692d3a.overview:
Defeating Vigo, the Scourge of Carpathia, in the final level serves as the ultimate objective in this side-scrolling action title based on the 1989 film. Players progress through various stages that present different tasks and control schemes throughout the campaign.

Controlling a Ghostbuster in one underground tunnel stage, the player must avoid ghosts and a pursuing spider. Other levels introduce vehicular segments where the player navigates the Ecto-1A, maneuvering around hazards and firing shots at approaching spirits. Gameplay additionally features a sequence where the player takes control of the Statue of Liberty before advancing toward the final confrontation.

1f368ff0f1d03bfd.overview:
Leon Franco, an ambitious young man hailing from a fallen Portuguese noble family, serves as the protagonist steered by the player through global sea voyages. Guided by the overarching objective to restore prestige to his household and fulfill his personal ambitions, he navigates a world featuring Portugal, Spain, and the Ottoman Empire.

Progress relies on building fame through multiple avenues, including discovering previously unvisited ports and fighting Spanish and Turkish fleets during naval encounters. The player can also allocate funds into distant ports, bringing those harbors into the sphere of Portuguese influence. Accumulating fame allows Leon to undertake missions for the King of Portugal, steadily earning elevated noble ranks.

2037babe50fed7a1.official: The first Annual Robot Tournament was going well – until the mysterious Mr. X took the top eight robots to conquer the world. Enter Mega Man to save the day! Mega Man 6 was the last of the series to be released on NES, and it goes out with a bang! Battle through eight new stages and defeat the boss in each, to take its power for yourself.
2037babe50fed7a1.overview:
Thwarting a global takeover by the mysterious Mr. X and his reprogrammed tournament robots serves as the central mission in this side-scrolling platformer. The player controls the robotic protagonist Mega Man across eight initial stages, which can be tackled in any order. Armed with a chargeable arm cannon, Mega Man navigates past smaller enemies and mini-bosses before confronting a Robot Master at the end of each level. Overcoming a boss awards that adversary's specific weapon, which functions as a weakness against other bosses.

Levels contain energy pellets for replenishing health, weapon capsules for weapon power, storable Energy Tanks, and extra lives. Certain stages feature alternate branching paths that require transforming Mega Man with Rush's power adaptors. Combining with the canine companion Rush creates Jet Mega Man for brief flight, or Power Mega Man for heavy short-range punches. Completing secondary routes provides components to assemble the helper bird Beat.

203dc9486ba58e65.overview:
Destroying an ancient dragon entrapped in an underground labyrinth requires locating a magical sword protected by four hidden crowns. The player guides members of the Drasle household, including the father, mother, son, daughter, and family pet, one at a time into a sprawling dungeon. Each adventurer possesses distinct physical traits and restrictions, such as jumping height, attack strength, and the exclusive ability to handle specific magical tools. Explorers frequently return to the home on the surface to switch individuals and collect passwords.

The underground maze features five major sections, and four large monsters guard the required crowns. Navigating these areas involves shooting monsters, solving puzzles, and evading hazards. Defeated creatures drop currency alongside items that restore health, replenish magic power, or inflict damage. Shops and inns accept collected money, while chests provide magical gear granting airborne flight or the power to displace blocks.

20de11cda85d7e4b.overview:
Three areas make up the maze, each containing numbered rooms. Set in outer space during the year 2005, the premise casts the player as a shuttle commander trapped in a drifting maze and searching for a way out. Seen from a first-person viewpoint, the player controls a robotic glove with a power charge meter. Energy balls bounce off walls covered in rectangular tiles. By punching, hitting, and throwing these spheres, the player breaks the tiles. Losing all of the balls expends one of the glove's power charges.

Clearing every tile on a wall opens a passage into another room, with an arrow indicating a direction to take. The glove also fires limited Robo-Bullets to attack enemies. Striking question mark tiles provides power-ups such as health refills, extra lives, additional balls, row elimination, and effects that damage or slow opponents.

2137d1621d29df50.overview:
The player controls Athena, the Goddess of Wisdom, who has grown weary of her dull life in the castle and sets out into the Fantasy World beyond its walls, where strange creatures attack at every turn. The adventure is for a single player, and a countdown timer costs a life when it runs out.

Initially unarmed, Athena defends herself with kicks. Destroying enemies or breaking rock and brick walls makes weapons appear, including a billy club, an iron ball and chain, a hammer, a bow and arrow and a sword, along with helmets, shields and armor that raise her defense. Hidden objects include the Pegasus Wing, which lets her fly, the Shell Necklace, which turns her into a mermaid, and the Magic Lamp, which opens the way to the next world from a hidden room. Life Flowers release Life Hearts that refill her Life Gauge.

219c94a1f0801ee2.overview:
Controlling a child named Mark, the player wields a baseball bat to strike adversaries and deflect incoming projectiles. Mark traverses the Dark World after magically fusing with a winged monster named Bert. Defeated foes leave behind hearts to restore health or capsules that temporarily transform Mark into Bert. In this altered state, the character can fly and fire energy beams that inflict more damage than the bat.

Across eight side-scrolling stages, the goal requires finding and overcoming designated bosses behind doorways to collect a key. Mystery items can award points, extra life, or a weapon increase, though some cause damage instead. Passwords enable progress to be resumed at specific stages, concluding after a final encounter with the Dark World Master.

21a7f7a5a043ddc2.overview:
Twelve levels structure this adventure, where players guide a flying, cupid-like protagonist on a mission to rescue kidnapped friends from burglars. Hostile dogs patrol the path and bark at the character, which can cause death upon contact. To defend against them, the cherub fires hearts at the animals. Sustaining flight requires consuming food items found along the route. If the power meter drops too low, the cherub can no longer fly and must walk, and running out of power entirely costs a life.

Falling through open gaps leads directly to a dark underworld area where floors remain invisible and flight is disabled. Reaching the exit allows the hero to leave this area. Conversely, touching a smoke ring from beneath transports the protagonist to a heaven stage filled with cakes granting points. Under certain conditions this bonus area scrolls, carrying the player past much of the stage below.
