21c51dc47a458a7d.official: In this sequel to the original NES Ninja Gaiden, return to the role of Ryu Hayabusa and embark on a mission to vanquish a deadly new enemy, Ashtar, and destroy the Sword of Chaos. Use speed, agility and Ninjutsu fighting techniques to progress through multiple stages, battling enemies and defeating bosses. Increase Ryu’s powers and recover strength by finding items along the way.
21c51dc47a458a7d.overview:
Destroying the Dark Sword of Chaos and stopping the evil lord Ashtar drives the player forward. Taking control of Ryu Hayabusa, the player navigates platforming stages called Acts to battle enemies and defeat bosses. Ryu can jump, climb up and down walls, and latch onto ladders. A life is lost if Ryu's strength meter empties, if he falls off the screen, or if the timer expires. Losing all lives ends the game, but continues are available from the current level.

Ryu strikes foes with his Dragon Sword or uses special items obtained from crystal balls. These techniques consume ninja power and include shurikens, boomerang-like stars, directional fireballs, and protective flames. Additional pickups restore strength, grant extra lives, expand ninja power, or summon shadow clones that follow Ryu and copy his moves.

227e789fef94eabc.overview:
Controlling space explorer Dash Galaxy, the player traverses a hostile extraterrestrial facility to return to his ship. Dash begins the mission with four lives and a restricted oxygen supply. The structure alternates perspectives between overhead floors and side-scrolling puzzle rooms, alongside hidden and bonus chambers. On the overhead floors, the explorer must push blocks to clear paths to the doorways.

Inside each room, every switch must be turned off before the door reopens, while keys allow passage through force fields. While exploring side-scrolling areas, Dash encounters wandering hostiles and must use ladders, trampolines, and running long jumps. For defense and obstacle clearance, the character carries a finite supply of bombs and remote detonators. Collecting ten orange stars grants temporary invincibility.

227e8a900206d0f8.overview:
Players direct Tom Sawyer through platforming challenges across a sequence of six dream stages to rescue Becky from Injun Joe. The opening stage takes place aboard a pirate ship, leading into other environments that include a rafting sequence along the Mississippi River and a haunted house.

Throughout the journey, Tom encounters multiple adversaries such as a giant octopus, a large alligator, ghosts, skeletons, and a dragon. Completing the final challenge allows Tom to reach Becky and awaken from his dream.

22e92af92aed2d8d.overview:
Freeing the continent of Ansalon from the dragonarmies is the goal in this shooting game, in which the player guides one of the good dragons through a series of missions toward a final battle at Neraka. A 2 player game is also available. At the start, the player chooses a Bronze, Silver, or Gold dragon, each with its own speed, armor, health, and pair of breath weapons: lightning and repulsion gas, cone of cold and paralyzing gas, or cone of fire and chlorine gas. The chosen game level sets the dragon's starting health and mission.

During a mission, the dragon dives and climbs to avoid obstacles such as trees, walls, and buildings, and attacks enemy forces with its breath weapons. Breath weapons weaken as the dragon loses health. Destroyed enemy dragons and army bases sometimes leave items that raise speed, armor, or health or give temporary protection. A password is shown after each completed mission.

22ea833fd9466795.overview:
The player guides Harris, the law enforcer of Cool World, through animated environments while defeating hostile cartoon Doodles and collecting items. The main objective requires gathering five map pieces showing the tunnels between the real world and the cartoon dimension called Cool World. Harris attempts to stop Holli Would from seizing the Golden Spike of Power, the balancer between the two worlds, while also contending with her henchmen and the Poppers, the local police.

The adventure spans five areas: Cool World's Main Street, the highway to Sweet Place, Sweet Place's Main Street, and the nearby countryside, followed by the Ocean Hotel in Las Vegas. A map screen lets players cycle through the areas, but the map pieces from the first four must be obtained in the correct order. Completing all four leads to the fifth area, where Harris scales the Ocean Hotel to protect the Spike and defeat Holli Would.

231701f8c463184d.overview:
Set in the 24th century, the game depicts an era where baseball team owners, frustrated by exorbitant player salaries, replace human athletes with armed mechanical competitors. Teams field four distinct robot types, each with different attributes.

Contests follow traditional baseball play with combat elements. When force plays occur, the opposing runners and fielders engage in direct battle to secure the base. Incremental damage sustained during these clashes can lead to destruction, and losing three robots results in a team forfeit. Outside of individual matches, players can participate in a pennant race of up to ten games, which allows upgrades to robotic attributes between fixtures. Pennant race progress can be saved, and both play modes support either one or two participants.

234c2f62cbc3c72e.overview:
The player guides Mario or Donkey Kong Jr. across platforms and vertical obstacles to complete rescue missions in a cartridge containing two titles. Donkey Kong puts the player in control of Mario, who scales construction ramps, climbs ladders, leaps over rolling barrels, and dodges fireballs to reach Pauline. Its final round requires removing girder bolts to defeat the ape. An invincible hammer lets Mario smash barrels and fireballs, while fallen items yield points before the descending bonus timer expires.

Donkey Kong Jr. reverses the roles, tasking the player with controlling Junior as he climbs vines and chains, leaps from a springboard, and dodges creatures such as snapjaws, nitpickers, and electrical sparks. Junior drops fruit to strike foes and advances through rounds to insert keys that unlock Donkey Kong's cage. Both selections offer beginner and expert difficulty settings for one or two players using separate controllers.

2366af9fc0512d39.overview:
Best of the Best - Championship Karate focuses on the sport of kickboxing. The player starts as the sixteenth-ranked kickboxer in the world and climbs the rankings by winning bouts, collecting trophies and raising the fighter's cash value along the way.

Before a match, the player picks eight blows from more than 32 available strikes, and a training mode raises strength, reflexes, and resistance. One player can face the computer, or two players can fight each other, and passwords save progress. Winning enough bouts earns an invitation to the Kumate, a no-holds-barred fight with no referee.

2395a8a102bfc403.official: Get ready for furious side-scrolling, platforming ninja action! The mad emperor Garuda holds the city trapped in his diabolical claws. Only two brave ninja warriors dare to stand against him. They move as silently as shadows in the snow, swift and graceful as the wind, and strike with the explosive fury of razor-clawed tigers!
2395a8a102bfc403.overview:
Set in the year 2029, the story follows two Iga clan ninja, Hayate and Lady Kaede, on a mission to infiltrate a futuristic metropolis stronghold and defeat the tyrannical Emperor Garuda. Players guide either warrior alone or cooperatively with a second player in simultaneous action. Both ninjas share identical abilities, navigating side-scrolling environments by running, crouching, jumping, climbing onto overhangs, and hanging beneath them. Across five levels, characters battle hostile soldiers, opposing ninjas, robots, and bosses.

Combat relies on a standard katana or a long-range kusarigama, with additional temporary armaments such as shurikens and bombs found inside item boxes. Collecting power-up items strengthens the current weapon in stages, though sustaining heavy damage lowers weapon strength. Players can also trigger a screen-clearing thunderstorm attack at the expense of vitality.

23bf669afb3125d7.overview:
Eight areas structure the journey, which begins in the Witches' Forest outside the Kingdom of Lowrel and ends at the evil wizard Belzed's Haunted Tower. After Belzed's army attacks Lowrel, the King and Queen are assassinated and Princess Silphee is kidnapped. When his badly wounded brother Macren brings the news, martial artist Thonolan sets out to rescue the captive princess.

Players control Thonolan as he engages hostile creatures using physical kicks alongside magical spells. Slain adversaries yield three items that produce beneficial or harmful effects upon collection. Character progression incorporates leveling up, which expands Thonolan's maximum hit points and magic points and unlocks additional kicks. A password is given after each completed area.

24b117a0830fcb91.official: Mario and Yoshi are filling in at the cookie factory, and they need your help! As freshly baked cookies roll out of the ovens, you must sort and stack them before they pile too high. In this fast-paced puzzle classic, line up rows of matching cookies horizontally or vertically to make them vanish. Clear the screen and you’ll move on to a new level of cookie chaos.
24b117a0830fcb91.overview:
Divided into a single-player game and a split-screen competitive VS. game for two players, the game features Mario and Yoshi. Players confront a rectangular grid populated with multiple varieties of baked treats. Using an on-screen cursor, the player shifts entire rows or columns horizontally and vertically to align identical items.

The primary objective across each single-player stage is to eliminate every cookie from the playing field. When an entire line consists of matching treats, those pieces vanish. Additional cookies enter steadily from the top and right edges, expanding the grid until an overflow triggers a game over. In the single-player game, a special piece shaped like Yoshi's head periodically appears to serve as a wild card, standing in for any standard treat to help clear lines. In the VS. game, clearing lines fills a point meter, and the first player to fill it wins the game.

24f7bb802a0ddce0.overview:
Guiding the characters Lolo and Lala, the player tackles puzzle-solving challenges across an overarching journey. The son and heir of the Great Devil, the new King of Eggerland, launches a capsule filled with a strange potion that turns the inhabitants of their small kingdom to stone. Spared while resting at the edge of a lake, the pair sets out to defeat the King and break his spell.

The player can switch between Lolo and Lala on the main map. The first two levels can be played in either order, and the Rainbow Egg and Rainbow Key found at their ends open the way into the tower. In each room, taking all the Heart Framers opens the Jewel Box, and all 100 Jewels must be collected to break the spell. Magic Shots turn enemies into eggs, Emerald Framers can be pushed to block attacks, and Grandpa's Learning Tree teaches techniques. A password lets play resume from the current puzzle.

2503f943a82c59c9.overview:
Players engage in five-card draw strip poker against a computer-controlled opponent, chosen from three women named Full House Francine, Double Dealing Debbie, and Pok-er Penny, following standard five-card draw rules.

The main objective involves accumulating money throughout the card matches. Starting with 500 dollars, the player aims to reach 5,000 dollars against the chosen opponent, and each 1,000 dollars won rewards the player with a new adult picture of her.

2508e4eada73f233.overview:
Goruza, a mechanic fortress from outer space, has conquered the five islands of Xexyz, imprisoned their queens and murdered the king, whose daughter Maria Star has been missing ever since. Freeing the queens and destroying Goruza drive the battle-soldier Apollo across alternating play styles. Odd-numbered levels emphasize platforming, where the hero explores outdoor terrain, collects money or life recovery items from defeated enemies, and locates a hidden Force Star to enter a mechanic castle. These indoor mazes feature brief flight sequences, looping doors, and end-stage boss encounters waged atop a floating platform. Rooms behind doorways offer hints, minigames, and items in exchange for collected currency.

Even-numbered stages switch to auto-scrolling side-view shoot-em-up action. Apollo pilots a distinct vehicle across each flight round, gathering pickups that boost speed and weapon power before battling a boss. The final encounter, viewed from behind the ship, requires precise shots into an eye at the center of Goruza's castle.

25506ac6d6413a73.overview:
Navigating an enclosed maze, the player directs Pac-Man to consume every dot while evading four colored ghosts that give chase. Each ghost exhibits distinct pursuit behaviors. Coming into contact with any ghost causes Pac-Man to lose a life, and the game ends once every life is depleted. Clearing the board of dots allows the player to advance to the subsequent stage.

Four flashing energizers situated near the corners of the maze briefly turn the ghosts blue and vulnerable, permitting Pac-Man to eat them for extra points. Additional bonus items periodically appear beneath the central enclosure for supplementary scoring. Warp tunnels through openings at the sides of the maze offer an escape route in which Pac-Man moves faster than the ghosts.

2596cf1e1a9b09da.overview:
Based on the film Rambo: First Blood Part II, the game begins at a prison where Colonel Trautman offers Rambo the opportunity to undertake a mission. Players must agree to this assignment to proceed through the camp, speaking with individuals until receiving full mission details from Trautman. Following these discussions, Rambo drops into a forest environment to start his objective.

While exploring the wilderness, the player contends with creatures such as spiders before confronting larger bosses, including giant arachnids and helicopters. Progressing further allows Rambo to gather an arsenal of weapons to combat hostile soldiers. The experience meter tracks advancement throughout the adventure, leading up to a finale back at the base where the player casts a massive kanji character at Murdock, transforming him into a frog.

26977a6c51a6f1e1.overview:
Rescuing Princess Toadstool from Bowser, shooting moving targets, and winning athletic competitions form the goals across the three titles included in this collection. In the platforming adventure, players control Mario or Luigi across side-scrolling stages in the Mushroom Kingdom. Characters head rightward toward a flagpole while dodging pits and adversaries, striking blocks to acquire coins and power-ups like Magic Mushrooms that grant extra size and damage resistance. A second player can participate by taking turns controlling Luigi.

The shooting title challenges participants to target ducks or clay pigeons across rounds using a light gun pointed at the screen. Missing too many targets ends the game, whereas hitting targets yields points, with an option for another person to steer duck flight using a controller. The athletic title features four running and jumping events, including dashes, hurdles, and distance jumps, operated by stepping on a specialized floor mat accessory.

26ff208f2b133e66.overview:
Videomation provides an art creation environment focused on freestyle drawing and video animation. Using a standard controller rather than a mouse or external peripheral, the player creates pictures beneath a menu bar at the top of the screen. Drawing tools comprise seven options, such as an eraser, a pencil, a paint bucket, and various geometric shapes. Users also select from thirteen palettes, lettered A through M, mixing basic and patterned special colors, some with moving colors. Stamps such as suns, hearts, dogs, and letters can be added as well.

After composing a static background image, the user can add animated figures, which include choices such as a rabbit, a car, and a child. These animatable objects can be steered with the Control Pad, travel along a preset path, or wander randomly across the screen. Because the application lacks built-in data saving or export functionality, preserving finished pictures and animations requires recording the television output to a VCR.

270a759c64b56e72.overview:
Palamedes features puzzle gameplay centered on matching dice. The player alters the number on a held die with the B button and hurls it toward the top of the display using the A button. Hitting a matching die removes that target from the board. The lines of dice descend faster as the player progresses through the stages. The session concludes if the dice reach the bottom of the play area.

Eliminated dice collect in a window at the bottom of the screen, where they can form hands such as three or more of a kind, runs of consecutive numbers, three pairs or a total of 21. Pressing down with a hand wipes out one to five descending lines, depending on its rank. Play options include a 1-Player mode of 20 stages, a 2-Players match against another person in which cleared lines are sent to the opponent's screen, and a tournament against four computer opponents.

281ad7bdb4f94e23.overview:
Commanding the Desert Command Force in a desert war, players maneuver units on a map to confront an opposing army in turn-based combat. The primary objective entails either seizing the hostile headquarters or eliminating every opposing unit. Ground and aerial forces operate with distinct mobility and firing ranges, selected through a command window interface. Terrain affects how far ground units can move and how well they can defend, while unit matchups feature inherent strengths and vulnerabilities. Units that fight gain experience, which raises their offensive capability.

Supply trucks deliver fuel and ammunition to neighboring units, ground units can also resupply in towns, and aircraft refuel and rearm at airstrips. Troop transports carry infantry farther each turn. Five scenarios of increasing difficulty can be played against the computer or against a second player. Before each battle, players can keep the default force or change its mix of unit types without raising the total number of units.

28210e19699c118f.overview:
Conquering territories to unite Japan under the leadership of Takeda Shingen and his heir Katsuyori serves as the central goal. The experience alternates between a domestic administration mode and a battle mode, with game turns advancing by month. During domestic administration, players issue commands across occupied territories to manage parameters such as crop yields, wealth, disaster readiness, and gold mines, and to form alliances. Resources like rice and money fund further operations, while merchants supply specialized weaponry to modify basic infantry units.

Invading adjacent enemy territories requires rice supplies to deploy corps into combat. To successfully capture a territory, the player must achieve victory in both an open-air field conflict and a subsequent castle siege. Battles are resolved manually or through an automatic option. In manual combat lasting up to twenty turns, players maneuver soldier types including infantry, cavalry, headquarters, and ranged units across grid-based terrain to capture the enemy headquarters.

28b3f1dde1488dd8.overview:
A small paddle controlled by the player moves back and forth between five positions to intercept colored tiles sliding down a conveyor. These tiles can be gathered up to five at a time and then flipped into a bin situated underneath the paddle. The main objective involves lining up three or more tiles of the same color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally, forming a KLAX that scores points.

Throwing a tile back up the conveyor or speeding up the slide gives additional control over incoming items. Uncaught tiles raise the drop meter, and the session ends once the limit of missed drops is reached. Each wave challenges the player to meet a specific requirement, such as making a certain number of KLAXes, diagonals, or horizontals, reaching a score threshold, or catching a set number of tiles. A flashing wild tile substitutes for any color, and two players can play simultaneously.

28ce7c337755f30a.official: Sports don’t come much faster and more intense than dodge ball, and this classic NES simulation brings you all the fun without the bruises! In World Mode, take charge of Team USA and face off against rival teams around the world to become number one. But beware: certain teams’ courts have obstacles like slippery ice or swamps.
28ce7c337755f30a.overview:
Super Dodge Ball simulates the sport of dodge ball across competitive matches. Players aim to eliminate opposing squads by striking rival athletes with the ball. Every individual team member possesses distinct statistics, individual names, and a depleted life gauge upon taking hits. When energy runs low, a character enters a tired state, granting the opposition a temporary advantage before being fully removed once vitality drops to zero. Athletes can also execute two distinct power throws, triggered either while running or during a running leap.

World Cup Play tasks the player with guiding Team USA past international competitors on playing surfaces that include obstacles like mud or slick ice. Two competitors can face each other in Versus Play. Additionally, a Bean Ball mode offers a rule-free brawl for one or two participants, where the six members of Team USA battle until only one remains standing.

28f0444e178830ed.overview:
Seven waves and a final confrontation structure the campaign, with players fighting through hostile forces to reach the base of MHC2, a rogue artificial brain. Players operate either an interceptor jeep equipped with a jumping mechanism and directional cannon, or an attack helicopter outfitted with forward- and downward-firing weaponry. Two participants can engage in simultaneous cooperative play, splitting control between the ground and aerial vehicles to combat enemy waves.

Opposition includes antiaircraft cannons and shielded silos that withstand more hits while closed, as well as multi-vehicle targets like the MH Snakehead helicopter. Capturing a Twin Sphere augments weapon strength by doubling firepower. In addition, collecting a shield from destroyed land mines grants temporary invulnerability, or the energy field can be detonated through gunfire or contact to eliminate every on-screen foe.

2967746c2a434c97.overview:
Bomberman features maze action where the player guides a bomb-making robot trying to escape an underground facility and reach the surface. Viewed from an overhead perspective, each of the fifty stages requires eliminating every hostile creature and uncovering an exit door concealed beneath destructible obstacles. The character drops explosives that detonate after a brief delay, projecting flames in four directions to clear paths and destroy adversaries across eight distinct enemy behaviors. Bonus stages also appear between regular levels to provide extra points.

Demolishing blocks reveals power-up panels that grant benefits, including persistent upgrades to blast range and bomb capacity as well as abilities that are lost along with a life, such as walking through bricks or detonating bombs by remote control. Touching foes or bomb blasts costs a life. If the stage timer expires or an explosion hits the exit, extra enemies appear. Passwords allow progress to be resumed.

299910cc0ddbaa77.overview:
Spot - The Video Game presents board-based puzzle gameplay featuring the animated mascot. Matches take place on a square grid, where players can alter the layout or choose from preset options. One to four human or computer participants alternate turns clockwise, each managing tokens of an assigned color.

During a turn, a participant picks one of their tokens and targets an open square either one or two spaces away. Selecting an adjacent space clones the token onto that tile, while choosing a spot two spaces away jumps the piece to that new position. Upon landing, every neighboring opposing piece converts to the current player's color. Play supports up to four players using two alternating standard controllers or four individual controllers with an NES Satellite.

2a16f9ebf40db89e.overview:
Players navigate an on-screen menu to select from a collection of fifteen titles housed on a single cartridge. The selection includes F-15 City War, Puzzle, Blackjack, Tiles of Fate, Krazy Kreatures, Death Race, Dudes With Attitude, Venice Beach Volleyball, Stakk'm, Deathbots, Rad Racket Deluxe Tennis II, Chiller, Solitaire, Menace Beach, and Shock Wave.

Individual entries feature varied formats and rules across different genres. In F-15 City War, the player pilots a fighter jet across five stages to destroy enemy tanks, helicopters, and robots using guns and missiles. Puzzle requires unscrambling randomized tiles within a time limit, with an option to challenge the computer to minigames to swap pieces. Blackjack simulates standard casino play against a dealer for up to two players. Tiles of Fate entails connecting matching pairs under movement path restrictions before time runs out, while Krazy Kreatures tasks the player with aligning rows of encroaching creatures.

2a2f75c2be5f6952.overview:
Divided into two scenarios, this turn-based strategy title allows participants to oversee a realm on the Eurasian continent. Players direct a leader, such as Temujin or one of his historical adversaries, working to conquer territories spanning from England to Japan. Domestic responsibilities involve maintaining a stable economy, organizing marriages, raising offspring, and designating relatives to government positions to strengthen the realm.

Gameplay progresses in turns, one for each season of the year. On a player's turn, up to three orders can be issued from the home country, including conscripting soldiers, training troops, trading with merchants, proposing treaties, or declaring war. Up to four players can participate in the World Conquest scenario.

2a92f666ce73177e.overview:
Completing a full 18-hole round on a seaside Pebble Beach course serves as the central objective for one or two players in Bandai Golf: Challenge Pebble Beach. Each player enters an individual handicap and chooses between the regular tee and the back tee. Each hole appears in both a bird's-eye view and a cross-sectional view, with close-ups of the green and its surroundings.

Before each shot, the player picks a club and a direction, then a shot shape such as a hook, slice, draw or fade, and uses a swing gauge to start the backswing, set the swing size and strike the ball. Wind conditions vary from hole to hole, and the course includes slopes, rises, bunkers, trees and water hazards, among them the ocean. A hole's score counts no higher than three times par.

2ae0a99b457a6d00.overview:
Stopping a constantly mutating virus that has invaded the defense computer protecting the entire planet serves as the central mission in Kabuki - Quantum Fighter. Set on Earth in the future, the narrative follows Colonel Scott O'Connor, who is converted to raw data by the untested Image Transfer System and sent into the computer's circuits. Inside the system, his digital form takes on the appearance of his kabuki actor ancestor while battling enemies that keep mutating.

Players guide O'Connor across generally side-scrolling platforming environments spread over six levels. To defeat hostile threats throughout the computer system, the character attacks using his long hair alongside memory chips fired as weapons. Finishing a stage adds a new weapon, such as a Fusion Gun, Quantum Bombs, Dynamite, or a Remote Control Bolo. Each level concludes with a boss encounter, during which memory chips can be traded for energy.

2ae5fb18a1bf8410.overview:
Achieving high scores or clearing a set quota of lines serves as the central objective in this puzzle title. The player arranges randomly selected falling shapes known as tetrominoes within a vertical playfield. Completing full horizontal rows eliminates those lines from the board, with simultaneous four-line clears awarding the largest point bonuses. An adjacent window displays an upcoming piece preview, while a side panel tallies the frequency of each fallen shape.

Two primary modes structure the experience. In A-Type mode, every ten cleared lines advances the level, which alters block palettes, boosts score values, and accelerates falling speeds until reaching maximum velocity at level 29. B-Type mode tasks players with clearing twenty-five lines on a field pre-populated with randomized obstacle blocks at a chosen height. Substantial scores reward players with varied animated sequences showing rocket launches or performing characters.

2b77da430b08e6a9.overview:
Set inside a building overrun by creatures, the adventure tasks Gizmo with reaching the building's Control Center. There, in the fifth stage, he wages his last battles against the creatures attempting to take over the Center's control system.

Controlling Gizmo across several distinct levels, the player navigates the building using diverse armaments. Available offensive equipment includes a genetically altered Tomato found in the Genetics Lab, alongside separate weaponry such as matches, paper clips, and a bow and arrow assembled from a paper clip, a rubber band and a pencil. Crystal Balls won by beating enemies can be traded for items at Mr. Wing's Shop.

2b85e6411f42597c.overview:
Rescuing kidnapped children of the world's leaders from a terrorist group called the Ring of Five forms the primary objective of this single-player game. Controlling a master ninja across five missions, the player navigates through levels while locating and freeing hostages guarded by enemy forces, culminating in battles against five Ninja Assassins.

The ninja relies on punches and kicks at close quarters along with distance weapons such as thrown shuriken. Liberating specific hostages provides weapon upgrades such as knives or pistols, life meter restoration, or access to a shooting gallery bonus round. Completing this bonus round earns Ninja Magic spells, up to four of which can be stored and used after defeating ten subsequent foes. Touching adversaries or sustaining attacks depletes a life meter, causing the loss of a life only when fully emptied; the ninja starts with three lives.

2bd31df34f925d03.overview:
Players control flippers to guide a ball across various pinball tables featuring bumpers and targets. Participants choose from six fictional human characters, comprising four male and two female options, each using the flippers in a different way. A rock and roll styled regular pinball mode accommodates up to four players.

Additional modes provide varied play mechanics. Nineball tasks players with betting chips and knocking balls into a Bingo pattern, while Sports Pinball adapts the playfield to resemble a soccer field or hockey rink. Battle Flipper shifts toward head-to-head goal scoring against a second player or the computer, with Bomber, Thunder, and Attack variations. In Bomber, hitting a switch changes special panel images, and a bomb panel makes the ball explode after a fixed time, whereas Attack uses three switches that make a sideways-moving block, Help, or a stopper appear.

2bd744ff0d76653b.overview:
Set in 1955, the adventure follows Marty McFly as he attempts to bring his parents together before his future existence fades away. Players guide Marty through the streets of Hill Valley to collect clock icons, preventing a photograph at the bottom of the screen from disappearing. Allowing the picture to fully fade costs a life, while gathering one hundred clocks restores it entirely. During these sections, players can pick up bowling balls to defeat enemies or grab a skateboard to increase speed.

The streets lead to buildings that each hold a minigame, such as deflecting cafe bullies with milk shakes, blocking Lorraine's heart-shaped kisses at school, or keeping up with the band on guitar at the Enchantment Under the Sea dance until George and Lorraine kiss. In the final stage, the player drives the time machine through Hill Valley, dodging lightning bolts and reaching exactly eighty-eight miles per hour as the big bolt strikes.

2be0bd6e64cf2cb4.overview:
Code Name - Viper presents platform action featuring special operative Mr. Smith, code-named the Viper, on a mission against a South American drug cartel. The player maneuvers the Viper across eight stages, leaping or dropping between floor levels while firing a handgun or a more powerful machine gun. The Viper can fire during leaps and shift direction midair. Going into doorways lets players evade hostile troops or gather items such as ammunition and time boosts. Adversaries include soldiers, snipers, frogmen, napalm soldiers, and maniacs.

Across the opening seven hideouts, the operative must free captured civilians and find a captured soldier hidden behind doors. Each rescued soldier supplies the bomb needed to leave the stage, and at the end of each level an agent delivers a confidential message that becomes more complete as more levels are conquered.

2d0b789f04621e4a.overview:
Professional basketball stars Michael Jordan of the Chicago Bulls and Larry Bird of the Boston Celtics face off on the court. Users take control of either athlete to compete directly in a head-to-head, one-on-one match against a human opponent or the computer.

Apart from standard one-on-one play, separate contests highlight the signature strengths of each featured athlete. A slam dunk contest built around Jordan offers ten distinct dunks, while a three-point shooting contest is built around Bird's long-range shooting. Depending on the mode selected, the basketball title accommodates one to four players.

2d62114f3f139e8d.overview:
Stranded on a deserted island, Wolverine enters a structure filled with traps that his arch enemy Sabretooth has built to do away with him. The player guides the hero through nine levels, including trials by air, water, and fire, a confrontation with Magneto, and a final battle. A two-player mode can be selected at the start.

Controlling Wolverine involves moving, crawling, jumping, and punching, and he swims through underwater sections while watching an air gauge. Pressing the select button extends his claws, which make him invincible but quickly drain energy; when energy runs low, the same button calls Havok, once found, to take over while Wolverine regenerates. Burgers restore life energy, while Power Potions build strength and the Berzerker gauge, which also rises as he strikes enemies. One-Ups add to his three starting lives, and Free Game power-ups add continues. Fellow X-Men Jubilee and Psylocke also join the action.

2e14f4481b5b762b.overview:
Completing eight driving stages across a cross-country race serves as the primary goal in Rad Racer. Viewed from behind the vehicle, players navigate settings such as Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Athens. Before beginning, drivers select either a 328 Twin Turbo or an F1 Machine, both of which share identical performance. Success requires reaching checkered-flag checkpoints within a time limit to earn extra seconds. If the timer expires, the car decelerates to a stop, providing a brief opportunity to coast across the checkpoint before the run concludes.

Driving controls permit steering, braking, and triggering a turbo boost up to 255 km/h. Collisions with obstacles or rival cars can flip and crash the vehicle. The dashboard display presents a speedometer, tachometer, score, remaining time, and course progress bar. Players can also press the Select button to enable an optional 3D mode designed for 3D glasses.

2e312fc327c1e569.official: Volleyball is one of the fastest team games around, and this NES classic recreates the speedy sport in a way that anyone can play! Start by selecting a team for a fast-paced practice round, and then take on the world at the international level. Attacks, lobs and daring dives are all at your disposal, whether playing solo or against a human opponent.
2e312fc327c1e569.overview:
Modes in this simulation include a practice round alongside international competition. Participants pick from eight countries across separate men's and women's divisions, with selectable nations consisting of the United States, Japan, China, Korea, Brazil, the Soviet Union, Cuba, and Tunisia.

Following the standard rules of the sport, the title puts the user in command of a six-player squad featuring three individuals positioned near the net and three situated in the back court. A serve is sent across the net by pressing the identical button two times. During matches, available athletic maneuvers include diving saves, spikes, feints, and blocks. Matches accommodate single-player participation as well as contests against another person.

2ebab487204c42b0.overview:
Young boxer Little Mac strives to rise through the ranks of the World Video Boxing Association, competing across three circuits to reach a final Dream Fight against Mike Tyson. The player directs Mac in the ring as he throws jabs, body blows, and high-damage uppercuts. Opponents can also be avoided or deflected using ducks, side dodges, and blocks. Landing effective punches awards up to three stars, which fuel Mac's uppercuts, though taking damage removes them. An on-screen heart counter drops whenever Mac is punched or has his strikes blocked or dodged; reaching zero hearts tires him out and prevents offense until incoming attacks are dodged.

Contests span up to three rounds and conclude via knockout, technical knockout, or a referee's decision based on accumulated points. Losing bouts lowers Mac's standing or triggers rematches, while a third defeat or a loss during the Dream Fight ends the game.

2f07815e80fcf807.overview:
Matches proceed across two main rounds and a final round styled after a television trivia contest. Three contestants compete on stage, supporting either a solo player against two computer opponents or two human players alongside one computer contestant. In the first round, the contestant in control selects one of nine television channels displayed on the screen, presenting a television, music, or celebrity trivia question with three multiple choice options. Contestants buzz in to supply the answer, with points and channel selection control awarded for a correct response. Channels change color as questions are exhausted, and surprise channels occasionally appear.

Round two reloads the screen with new categories and doubles all question point values. An elimination mechanic removes a contestant before the Think Real Fast Round. In this final stage, the two remaining contestants race to identify correct answers from ten on-screen choices as rapid questions appear, earning points to secure victory.

2fa3ee5f9ef17dcd.overview:
Three separate realms comprise the open structure of this adventure: the city of Piedup, the UnderWorld, and the Palace. Players direct the warrior Kuros, who arrives stripped of his memory, armor, and weapons after a lightning attack by the evil wizard Malkil. To defeat Malkil and restore the throne to King James, Kuros explores these interconnected areas, buying keys, food, drink, and gossip from shopkeepers with collected money. Players start with three lives, and the journey ends if all are lost.

Progression requires finding the lost statues of the knight, thief, and wizard guilds. Returning a statue to its guild triggers a test that ends in a boss battle; passing it grants a disguise along with new weapons and powers, such as a crowbar, fireballs, or levitation. Malkil has stationed Guardians in front of important areas, and the secret passage to the King's Throne Room cannot be entered without the Four Gems.

2fbbc465fc239b48.overview:
Six stages divided into two acts each lead into a final seventh stage centered on a boss rush. Set in the year 2501, the campaign tasks the player with piloting the M-308 Gunner mech into an outpost on Pluto. The objective involves reaching and activating the malfunctioning defense station's self-destruct mechanism before a rogue laser cannon destroys Earth.

Controlling the mech centers on the ability to invert gravitational polarity at will, quickly shifting between the floor and ceiling to evade hazards, dodge enemy fire, and overcome obstacles. Certain zones also feature screen-wrapping where moving off one edge causes the mech to re-emerge on the opposite side. Available single-item power-ups include a Power Beam, a protective Shield Force, and a Gravity Fireball granting brief invulnerability while flipping orientation. Completing the main adventure unlocks an expert mode, an alternate run with tougher, more numerous enemies, altered boss patterns, and fewer power-ups.

3036a59bb7bf16a3.overview:
The Flintstones: The Rescue of Dino & Hoppy presents platforming action based on the animated cartoon series. Dr. Turner, a time traveler from the 30th Century who collects dinosaurs, arrives in Bedrock, nabs the pets Dino and Hoppy, and takes them back to a zoo in his own time. To rescue them, Fred must help his alien friend Gazoo rebuild Gazoo's time machine.

Players direct Fred through areas laid out on a map, searching for the missing time machine parts. Fred swings his club at animals and criminals, grabs and hangs from ledges, and collects coins to use special weapons such as a slingshot, an axe, and boomasaurus eggs. Beating Hard-Head Harry in basketball duels wins prizes such as wings, a Hoppasaurus for long jumps, and a skin-diving suit, which Gazoo keeps until Fred calls him. Along his journey, Fred encounters Wilma, Barney, and Betty, and he later gets help from citizens of the 30th Century.

31523322db8f94e7.official: Bubble Bobble is a puzzle-action game featuring the two Bubble Dragons, Bub and Bob. When it hit arcades in 1986 it introduced brand-new play mechanics, with players defeating enemies by trapping them in bubbles they blew and then popping them.
31523322db8f94e7.overview:
Bubble Bobble features platform action where players guide Bub and Bob, two bubble-blowing dinosaurs, through single-screen stages to rescue two friends kidnapped by Baron von Blubba. Characters run, jump across platforms, and fall through bottom gaps to reappear at the top of the screen. Clearing a stage requires blowing bubbles to trap adversaries and then popping them, which turns foes into collectible items. Floating bubbles follow unseen air currents and can be bounced on to access higher areas.

Magic items provide advantages, while special bubbles release attacks such as lightning, fire, or water. Touching an untrapped enemy or projectile costs a life, and lingering too long causes foes to move faster or summons invincible pursuers. Up to two players can participate, progressing through two worlds of 113 levels each, with progression preserved via passwords and continue options.

322d6be47ed539c3.overview:
Restoring the planetary computer network across several worlds drives the journey of Rad Gravity. Players navigate between planets from a spaceship bridge, using an overarching system view to select destinations with marked teleport coordinates. Each location involves side-scrolling exploration where uncovering new landing coordinates and hidden items allows access to further regions across space.

On each planet, Rad moves, ducks, and jumps across varied terrain, with jump height shifting according to the local gravity. The inventory menu lets players equip protective suits and select offensive weapons, ranging from laser blades to several types of projectile guns and thrown explosive crystals. Utility tools, including a teleport beacon and an energy disk for floating over dangerous areas, provide navigation assistance. A communicator allows an immediate return to the ship to completely refill health points, while passwords allow players to resume previous journeys.

323d330cb50e0a4c.official: Kung-Fu Heroes is a comical action game starring Jacky and Lee, two martial arts masters who must save a princess, and retrieve treasure when monsters attack their land. Battle your way through eight castles, each with four stages, packed with traps, enemies and obstacles. Search the stones and rocks within the levels to reveal bonus stages and maybe even shortcuts to other castles.
323d330cb50e0a4c.overview:
Controlling the martial arts master Jacky or Lee, players fight through rooms filled with enemy warriors to rescue Princess Min-Min and retrieve ten stolen treasures. Defeating a sufficient number of foes opens the exit door at the top of the room, permitting advancement to the next area. Enemies utilize varying attacks and weaponry throughout the journey.

The game spans eight castles composed of four stages each, featuring diverse obstacles, hazards, and monsters. Players can smash rocks and stones found in the levels to uncover bonus stages or discover shortcuts leading toward other castles, with support for up to two players.

3249d267ca170980.overview:
The King of Kings: The Early Years offers three separate adventures based on biblical events. Players select between the journey of the wise men to visit the infant Jesus, the flight of Joseph and Mary to Egypt, and the search for young Jesus in Jerusalem. Across each game, running into most creatures or obstacles costs the player half a scroll, and scrolls serve as health. Collecting a scroll and correctly answering a multiple-choice or true-or-false Bible trivia question replenishes the scroll counter, whereas losing every scroll ends the game.

In the first adventure, the player steers wise men riding camels, shooting water balls or gathered fruit projectiles at hazards while collecting frankincense, myrrh, and gold. The second scenario involves steering a donkey across terrains with falling rocks, logs, and hostile wildlife. The third scenario tasks Joseph and Mary with traversing stages before a timer expires.

32aeef6bae170d26.overview:
Eight levels form the Gamma Base complex, descending from the ground floor to a subterranean central control area on the eighth floor. A player directs an operative in an armored battlesuit through the corridors to locate and eliminate a mobile Gamma Bomb guarded by hostile robots. Advancing between floors requires defeating large Sentinel robots stationed at elevator entrances. Along the way, the player navigates hallways containing hidden door pads, explosive mines, and colored transport platforms that warp the operative to different areas.

Robots attack immediately upon encounter, draining an energy meter divided into six segments. When energy is exhausted, a recharge unit is spent; players begin with five recharges and can continue up to three times. Survival requires accessing computer wall terminals to gather armaments into a fifteen-item backpack. Weapons and support items include handguns, laser rifles, blaster weapons, grenades, temporary shield belts, and restorative power packs.

32fa00d52f39b053.overview:
Operating the Bigfoot monster truck, players compete in a championship that runs cross-country from Los Angeles to New York. Cross Country races between cities are filled with jumps, water slicks and mud hills; the driver collects cash, nitro and pick-ups such as a circular saw, a protective shield and a wrench that repairs damage, and crushes cars for bonus points.

At each stop, a side-by-side Championship Event is decided best two out of three, with contests such as car crushing, mud racing, hill climbing and tractor pulling, leading to drag races that combine several challenges. Between races, cash buys engine, tire, transmission and suspension upgrades at the Auto Parts Shop, though the title goes to the driver with the most points. Rivals include The Growler and The Charger, and a second player can compete head to head.

3387595598af933f.overview:
Athletes compete in two-on-two volleyball matches across multiple tournament challenges. Players choose from pairs with distinct skill balances, ranging from powerful but slow attackers to agile or defensively focused duos, including George and Murphy, Al and John, Billy and Jimmy, or Ed and Michael.

Tournament play pits participants against computer-controlled teams on three courses: Exercise, a practice game; the American Circuit; and the World Cup Circuit against the masters of the game. Tournaments support solo play or two cooperative participants, while head-to-head modes accommodate up to four players with a four-player adapter. Games can be set to 5, 10, 15 or 20 points with rally-point or normal scoring, and a jumping Super Spike can be charged with extra button presses.

345fe1e466b3e8d7.overview:
M.U.L.E. provides a strategy experience simulating supply and demand economics. Four colonists settle the planet Irata, with computer opponents taking the place of absent human participants. Colonists choose from several species, some of which start with more or less money. Competitors aim to accumulate the highest net worth while jointly maintaining the survival of the settlement. Beginner, Standard, and Tournament versions use slightly different rules.

Play centers on deploying Multiple Use Labor Elements to work land plots and gather food, energy, and smithore, with crystite added in the Tournament game. Colonists trade these goods with each other or with the store in timed auctions to overcome supply shortages and manipulate marketplace values. Unplanned incidents, such as planetquakes, acid rain, pest attacks, and pirate raids, continually influence operations.

3493f7621d964af7.overview:
Set across castles located in different parts of the world, 8 Eyes tasks the player with clearing eight levels ruled by dukes to recover the 8 Eyes jewels. The player picks which of the first seven castles to enter, but they must be cleared in a certain order. Finishing a level awards Orin a new sword, and every castle boss has a vulnerability to a specific blade. Seven scrolls hidden in those stages hold hints for placing the jewels. Once those seven areas are beaten, the Castle of Ruth unlocks as the final stage, leading to the return of the recovered jewels to the Altar of Peace in a specific sequence.

Controlling both Orin and Cutrus simultaneously is required in single-player mode, with limited commands available for the companion. Alternatively, two participants can join in a cooperative mode where one person directs Orin and the second operates Cutrus.

35ac08a055cbaa13.overview:
Taking custom teams of fictional athletes through a championship run forms the heart of this softball competition. Before taking the field, players assemble a roster of ten participants selected from sixty distinct characters, each possessing traits such as floating during defense or swinging broomsticks. Participants also select a team moniker from twenty-six alphabetical options, choose between fast-pitch and slow-pitch rules, and pick a venue. Matches adhere to baseball-style regulations spanning seven innings, extending only to resolve ties, while a ten-run mercy rule terminates lopsided contests early.

Solo participants aim to win five elimination matches before challenging last year's champions, the Amazons, for the championship. Overcoming that final opponent concludes the primary campaign. Two competitors can also face off in a standalone exhibition match.

3616e10dac2c7e0d.overview:
Keeping the play area clear and earning cash serves as the primary objective for the player. Pairs of hats in six styles, from top hats and baseball caps to derbies and crowns, descend from the top of the display onto a row of heads at the base of the screen.

The player moves the falling pairs left and right and can swap their positions. To eliminate hats from the playfield, five pieces of the exact same style must be stacked together; selling two stacks in the same turn counts as a Hatris and doubles the cash. The helpers Alexey and Vladimir, earned by selling stacks, can pull hats from the bottom of a pile or move whole piles. Play runs through six Shops of ten Stages each, and the game ends when the hats pile up past the top of the play field. This puzzle title supports a single player.

3626bb5ce3035b39.overview:
Four narrative stages and a standalone halfpipe ramp make up the adventure. Guiding an unnamed skateboarder through side-scrolling environments, the player seeks to build a new ramp after the original is demolished. The hero skates through city streets, works a timed delivery route in a mall, gathers scattered blueprint pages on a beach, and fights through a warehouse to recover a building permit and rescue his girlfriend, CJ, from the villain Icepick. The player can backtrack through areas, jump, and reprogram the action controls.

Combat and bartering drive progress. Armed with a paint gun alongside throwable eggs and M-80s, the skater battles rival skaters, animals, and gang members. Trade goods such as CDs, cassette tapes, chili fries, and tacos turn up along the way, and skilled weapon use yields more of them. These collected items can be bartered with Rodney and Lester to unlock new moves or obtain skateboards with different combinations of speed and jumping height.

36666e3314ee9e0a.official: In this NES action game, a port of the hit arcade original, you play a crack Special Forces soldier tasked with parachuting into the South American jungle on a dangerous mission to rescue hostages. Playing from a first-person perspective, you control a gunsight and use your machine gun and grenades to take out enemies. Each of the six missions has a unique objective, with your performance in each mission affecting the ending.
36666e3314ee9e0a.overview:
Arriving by helicopter in a South American jungle, a Special Forces operative undertakes a mission to rescue hostages held in hostile territory. Viewed from a first-person perspective, the game puts a single player in control of a gunsight, using the controller or a light gun, to eliminate incoming hostile forces across four levels of six missions each.

Players defend themselves against enemy soldiers and vehicles such as helicopters, gunboats, and armored cars using a machine gun alongside explosive grenades. Defeating required targets while protecting friendly captives is essential, as the number of prisoners rescued changes the president's speech that follows each airport escape. Hostile attacks fill a damage gauge that players must manage to survive each stage.

3668454e1904ada7.overview:
Set within the Castle of Deceit atop Mount Althus, a gateway to six other universes, this side-scrolling platform adventure follows a magician apprentice named Eebo. The narrative centers on Phylax, who guarded six magical stones called the Runes of Guarding. After centuries of dwelling within the stones' energies, Phylax lost his sanity, and the stones gave life to his hallucinations, creating six deadly beings that stole the Runes. Eebo must venture through the castle to recover them amid illusions, traps, and monsters.

Eebo jumps and casts an attack spell that fires spheres of magical energy. Some doors require magic keys, while others are guarded by Phylax's specter. The journey spans ten levels with bosses such as O'Donna, Skult, and Combustra, ending with Phylax in the Ante Room.

368d7ea3a066d4dc.overview:
Ten levels of action span locations such as Times Square, the SoHo Sewer System, and Snowy Central Park, each concluding with an encounter against a lethal boss. Players select either Leonardo, Raphael, Michaelangelo, or Donatello, each outfitted with their signature weapons such as katana blades, sai daggers, nunchakus, or a bo staff. The mission involves fighting through hordes of Foot Soldiers and assorted enemy machines to rescue April and confront Shredder in the Technodrome.

Turtles can walk in eight directions, jump, attack with their weapons, or combine movements to deliver jumping kicks. Wounds deplete a turtle's life meter, though consuming pizzas restores energy. Each turtle begins with three lives, with a bonus life earned for every two hundred opponents knocked out. The game supports single-player action or two-player cooperative play. If a player exhausts their supply of lives during two-player mode, an extra life can be borrowed from their partner. Up to three continues are available.

3775c1184419c078.overview:
Vertically scrolling gameplay directs commandos from the bottom of the screen to invade a hostile nation on secret orders. Players take control of warriors Paul and Vince as they advance upward while fighting through relentless forces, which include enemy soldiers, helicopters, and tanks. Various power-ups appear throughout the mission to assist them, providing ammunition supplies, extended weapon range, faster firing rates, grenade enhancements, or full-screen enemy destruction.

Characters wield a machine gun alongside hand grenades to defeat adversaries. Players can commandeer tanks and helicopters. Tanks deflect standard bullets but depend on a limited fuel supply, exploding if depleted or caught in blasts unless evacuated in time. Helicopters cross over water and fire both a triple shot and missiles. Up to two players can participate cooperatively.

37b5a1c9d9bc1747.overview:
Eliminating all invading giant monsters across twelve independent scenarios is the primary goal of the Allied Defense Forces. Players can select any scenario, each providing distinct maps, enemy threats, and military units to command against threats such as Godzilla.

Gameplay alternates between map and battle modes across turn-based rounds. During the Allied turn, the player moves individual military units across the grid, launches new units from bases or the laboratory, and consults scientists for tactical guidance. Moving onto an enemy square and choosing to attack initiates battle mode, where combat plays out with animated sequences. In battle, weapons are selected while a three-reel slot machine can be stopped to adjust offensive power, defense, or hit accuracy based on matching symbols. The scenario ends in failure if the defense forces lose all military units, allow critical structures like power plants to fall, or fail to eliminate the monsters within 99 turns.

381fcbe2b714c38f.overview:
A fantasy kingdom inhabited by Elves is cast into darkness after the villainous Shogun steals the magic ring of Arkista. Christine, a courageous little elf, sets out to recover the stolen ring along with the Elven Treasures, the Elf Mirror and the Wealth Amulet.

Players control Christine as she journeys across the realm, starting with only a bow and arrow. Defeating enough enemies in each area makes a key appear that opens the barrier doors to the next stage, and the quest leads to a battle with the Shogun in the Ninja Dungeon. Along the way she can collect armor, stronger bows, larger bags and special items such as wands and cure potions. The first adventure ends at stage 32, while 125 stages await skilled players.

382699d54308423c.overview:
Bubble Bobble Part 2 provides platforming action where players control bubble-blowing dinosaurs on a quest to rescue Judy, their friend, who has been kidnapped by the Skull Brothers. Bubby and Bobby set out to save her, with a two-player option available in which two players take turns on the rescue mission. The adventure passes through themed areas, each with its own kinds of enemies, hazards and bosses.

Controlling the characters, players can float upward by holding the B button and blow Super Bubbles that can capture multiple enemies at once. Defeating boss encounters or traveling through designated doors grants access to three bonus minigames. Collectible items aid the heroes, including clocks that freeze foes in place and wind bottles that generate wind bubbles.

38e5253131d26439.overview:
Set in the Forgotten Realms port city of Phlan, the story begins as the city council recruits adventurers to reclaim the surrounding ruins from invading monsters and an evil force. A single player assembles a party of up to five characters, selecting each member's race, class, gender, alignment, and attributes, or uses ready-made characters, and can hire one non-player character.

Gameplay involves moving from area to area to clear out hostile creatures and earn experience points. In town, characters trade gear, hire non-player characters, visit temples for healing, and accept commissions. Battles feature round-based tactical encounters in which more agile characters tend to act first, with commands including casting spells and bandaging dying comrades, culminating in an encounter with the evil leader.

3910ae7495a71e6a.overview:
Professional ice hockey competition unfolds across twenty-four authentic league teams featuring two hundred eighty-eight real athletes from the 1992–93 season. Roster lineups group squads into six equal groups of four teams.

On the ice, players execute offensive and defensive maneuvers while adhering to standard hockey regulations. Referees can call icing and offside violations, along with hooking, tripping, elbowing and charging penalties, and each of these calls can be switched off in the options. Ties occurring in exhibition matchups or the championship finals are resolved through either sudden-death overtime or a five-attempt shootout depending on the chosen settings.

3950d679fd6bbd5b.overview:
Controlling the Black Manta, the player attacks enemies with thrown darts, a short sword, and special techniques called Ninpo Arts across a side-scrolling adventure. With crime and kidnapping gripping New York City, the mission tasks the ninja with confronting DRAT, a gang of drug runners and terrorists, defeating the drug lord, and rescuing his prisoner.

Five levels comprise the journey, moving from New York City to Tokyo and Rio de Janeiro, back to New York, and finally to DRAT headquarters. Along the way, the player can rescue kidnapped children hidden in heavily guarded rooms, grab informants, and read letters for clues. Successfully clearing a stage grants new Ninpo Arts, such as a ring of fire, invisibility, or teleportation, which the player chooses on the Ninpo Arts screen and unleashes once the POW indicator is charged. Only four particular arts can defeat the final villain.

3991a761116131dc.overview:
Three levels structure this single-player platformer, sending cat burglar Hawkins to steal two priceless Leonardo da Vinci works and the key component of an alchemy machine.

Controlling Hawk, the player runs, jumps, and crawls through tight passages while taking care to avoid electric eyes and pressure-sensitive floor panels that set off alarms. Enemies and enemy devices hinder progress across each area. To deal with hostile threats, the protagonist relies on his fists for close-range punches and can throw softballs to stun or knock foes off the screen. Softballs also trigger switches that momentarily disable electrical hazards, aiding Hawk as he searches for designated targets and navigates elevators, ropes, and platforms.

3a7726a787a6d8ea.overview:
Twelve levels called waves structure the adventure, beginning as Indiana Jones enters Pankot Palace to free enslaved children, recover Sankara Stones, and defeat Mola Ram. The player guides Jones through caves and mines while monitoring a timer counting down from 99 to zero. Letting the clock expire summons Mola Ram, costing a life and any items collected on that wave. Many stages include mine cart rooms where Jones rides rails across hazards. Jones can also jump downward or from ledge to ledge to help navigate environments.

Rescuing children provides weapons and supplies, including guns and swords, alongside jewels for extra time and hats granting extra lives. After crossing a lava river and seizing the Sankara Stones in Wave 9, the player locates a secret exit to reach subsequent stages, culminating in a final duel against Mola Ram on a rope bridge.

3addebdec132929e.overview:
Facing the hostile fleet of the Seven Stars Alliance, Earth relies on the SYD fighter for its defense. After a war in the galaxy of Tetranova laid waste to their own planets, the seven stars formed an alliance to seek a new home where they could rebuild, and they have chosen Earth.

Controlling the craft from an overhead perspective, a single player fights through oncoming waves of enemy units. The vessel utilizes separate weapon systems, firing laser attacks against airborne targets and launching missiles to eliminate ground-based forces. Collecting power-ups scattered through the stages strengthens the ship's armaments. Each level concludes with a boss encounter. Picking up the K mark keeps the craft's power level for the next ship if the current one is destroyed.

3b5627bc1ebaa7a8.overview:
Managing baseball rosters and competing on the diamond forms the core of the game. When batting, players swing, bunt, direct base runners, and substitute pinch-hitters. In the field, players position the pitcher along the rubber, deliver fastballs or slow pitches, and steer flying balls left or right into curves. As pitching endurance declines, throws lose speed and curving ability, prompting the use of relief pitchers. Fielders can be guided toward batted balls to make jumping or diving catches before throwing or carrying the ball to a chosen base, while pitchers can attempt pick-offs against opposing baserunners.

Games take place on either an old-time baseball diamond or a modern facility, where animated indicators represent weather, grass moisture, and wind conditions. Available options include an Official Game mode against chosen opponents and an eight-team Tournament Mode, with passwords provided after victories to record progress. Matches support one participant against the computer or two players competing directly.

3b687bf0a8ccd237.overview:
Controlling the young boy Chad Finletter, the player jumps onto mutant tomatoes to eliminate them. Chad sets out through the tomato-infested streets of San Zucchini, the city's sewers, and an abandoned tomato packing factory to stop the evil scientist Dr. Gangrene from unleashing the Doomsday Tomato.

Throughout the journey, Chad fights hostile tomato legions primarily by landing atop them. Squashing these adversaries either destroys them or causes them to break into smaller tomato foes. Along the way, Lunch Boxes grant extra lives, Lunch Bags restore energy, and Fertilizer Sacks award points. The adventure also requires facing several bosses along the way, including Zoltan, Beefsteak, Mummato, Fang, Ketchuk, and Tomacho.

3bcce1ff03b55c20.overview:
Players direct groups of bubbles that ascend toward the upper portion of the screen, aiming to connect matching colors. When an adequate quantity of identical bubbles link together, those pieces disappear from the playfield. The remaining adjacent bubbles then drift higher, which can produce chain reactions.

The game concludes if the gathering bubbles accumulate and touch the lower boundary of the screen. Clearing a stage yields an erotic reward for the player.

3c4ef00443a1675e.overview:
Matching the motions of an on-screen instructor serves as the primary objective while stepping on the correct buttons of the Power Pad accessory. The main Dance Aerobics mode offers eight classes, from introductory to advanced, and passing a class earns a Pass Stamp number that lets players resume at the next level. Each mistake in timing or placement costs a coin, and once all coins are gone, a further error ends the class. Certain routines also require players to use their hands.

Two other modes provide alternative ways to play. Aerobic Studios offers 5, 10, 15, or 20 minute workouts scored from 100 points, with the score falling after mistakes and recovering when the next routine is completed correctly. Pad Antics Mode contains three separate minigames: composing melodies in Tune Up, playing along with a tune by following on-screen markers in Mat Melodies, and hitting pads with designated hands or feet in Ditto.

3c74b191d7d4cb6c.overview:
Set across a city threatened by the ultimate source of evil, the game places the player in control of a Christian traversing a top-down overworld. The mission requires gathering six pieces of the Armor of God guarded by bosses to deliver the settlement from demonic influence. Journeying through diverse locations such as a park, downtown, airport, warehouse district, residential area, shipyard, junkyard, beach, and woods, the protagonist eventually reaches a prison and the final demon stronghold.

Two types of attacks are available to convert unsaved souls: Vials of the Wrath of God alongside projectiles representing the Fruit of the Spirit. The fruits are pears, pomegranates, apples, grapes, and bananas, and holding up to four of each allows more throws at once. Converted foes yield dove symbols, which serve as currency to purchase additional fruit weaponry. Guardian angels ask Bible questions that reward Spirit Points and health, while biblical items like Samson's Jawbone and Anointing Oil can also be collected.

3d725939dfc50523.overview:
Players control baseball teams as both manager and athletes on the field, directing pitches, swings, base running, and defensive throws. At the plate, hitters position inside the batter's box to deliver full swings or bunts, while base runners can be directed to advance, steal, or return to base. In the field, pitchers alter their mound position and deliver pitches with varying speeds and curves, or attempt pick-off throws. Defenders pursue batted balls, running toward designated bases or throwing directly to them.

Matches follow standard baseball rules with pinch-hitter and relief substitutions, where starting pitchers require a full game of rest between starts. Available modes include single matches against the computer, a full nine-game season against every league squad, a watch mode, and competitive two-player action played as single games or a best-of-seven series.

3ec56ffa686a0e45.overview:
Ms. Pac-Man centers on navigating enclosed mazes while gathering items. The player guides the title character through corridors to consume all of the pellets spread across the area, all while steering clear of four colored ghosts. Touching any ghost costs a life. Points accumulate as pellets are cleared, and bouncing bonus fruits appear from time to time to provide additional scoring opportunities.

Consuming larger power pellets, also known as energizers, temporarily turns the ghosts blue. During this brief window, the protagonist can chase down and eat the vulnerable ghosts for extra points. This release offers four maze sets of different sizes and layouts, a Pac-Booster speed option, and two-player games played in alternating turns or simultaneously, either cooperatively or competitively.

3edd803db1cc8815.official: Alien warmonger Red Falcon is back! Thought to have been defeated by the heroic warriors Mad Dog and Scorpion, he’s assembled a force of evil minions to attack Earth. Based on the hit arcade game, Super C is the sequel to the classic Contra™. Battle through intense side-scrolling and top-down viewpoint shooter action, and save the planet.
3edd803db1cc8815.overview:
Defending Earth against an invasion led by the returning alien warmonger Red Falcon is the primary goal. Taking control of commando soldiers, players confront hostile alien forces and possessed military troops across a campaign that mixes side-scrolling action with top-down viewpoints. The combat loop requires traversing varied battlegrounds while fighting through enemy defenses and the large bosses waiting at the end of each area.

Firepower can be enhanced by collecting weapon upgrades, including a revised projectile weapon that can be charged to fire high-impact explosive blasts. Additional support items provide temporary invincibility, rapid fire, and a blast that destroys every enemy on the screen. Up to two players can participate in the mission simultaneously.

3f5ed8b5207ff10e.overview:
Restoring democracy and peace to the Lafian Islands serves as the primary objective after local drug barons threaten the republic. Following an appeal from the Lafian government, the American Congress dispatches a task force, and the player is called upon by their regiment to pilot an armed helicopter gunship. Flying seven combat missions that begin and end aboard an aircraft carrier, the pilot must defeat enemy forces and rescue ground reconnaissance paratroopers.

Controlling the gunship involves maneuvering in all directions while managing limited fuel, shields, bullets, and bombs. Sights can be toggled to point toward stranded paratroopers or back to the carrier. Hovering over a paratrooper triggers a rescue sequence where the player must shoot down approaching hostile aircraft from twin cannons until the soldier climbs aboard. Certain destroyed enemy installations release power-up icons that replenish ammunition, restore shields, or enhance firepower.

3f761f529d40cf42.overview:
Separated from his family, Kevin McCallister must make his way through New York City alone. The journey takes him across various environments, such as the Plaza Hotel, Central Park, his uncle's townhouse, the streets of New York, and finally the Christmas tree at Rockefeller Center.

While exploring these locations, the player defends Kevin against enemies with a Slide and with weapons such as the Flying Fist and the Super Flying Fist. Kevin also uses a Dart to temporarily stun human foes. A Necklace item can also be triggered, causing most walking opponents to slip off the screen. Along the route, players can collect different power-ups, including Pizza Slices, Whole Pies, Cookies, Candy Canes, Bells, and After Shave.

3f8a65278efb20df.overview:
Set inside a dream, the adventure tasks Barbie with traveling through Mall, Underwater, and Soda Shop worlds to gather pieces of an enchanted ball gown ensemble for the Fantasy Ball. Barbie moves through platforming stages, evading hazards such as tennis rackets that drain her supply of Zs. Losing every Z ends the dream; the player can return Barbie to the level where she left off, up to twice in a row, or let her wake up and start over.

Throughout the journey, Barbie collects Dream-Ups like coins, pearls, and gold records to replenish her Zs or score bonus points, while one piece of the ensemble awaits at the end of each world. Charms from her Charm Bracelet direct friends such as her pet dog and bird to stop, move, or do something special. Tossed charms also let these companions assist Barbie in the boss confrontations that close each section.

3f9e3d3b48a897d9.overview:
R.C. Pro-Am features vehicular combat racing viewed from an overhead isometric perspective. The player steers a radio-controlled vehicle against three opponents across a series of tracks, using directional controls to turn while other buttons manage acceleration and weapon fire. Advancing to the next course requires finishing among the top three racers; placing fourth results in a game over, though two continues are available. The game spans thirty-two tracks.

Driving over track items provides tune-up improvements such as higher engine speeds, turbo acceleration, and increased tire traction. Offensive pickups like missiles and bombs temporarily disable rivals, and roll cages prevent crashes. Track hazards include oil slicks, puddles, rain squalls, pop-up barriers, and ammunition-reducing skulls. Collecting letters to spell NINTENDO awards points and upgrades the player's standard truck into a 4-Wheeler and ultimately an Off-Roader.

3fd39ba2cdd6e220.overview:
F-15 City War puts the player in control of a jet to defend a city across five combat stages. Piloting an F-15 aircraft supplied with infinite ammunition, the player battles hostile forces in diverse environments such as city streets, open water, trenches, and a dark cave.

Enemies include choppers, jets, gun boats, tanks, missile silos, and large robots. The aircraft can fire both machine guns and missiles to defeat targets, concluding each stage with an assault against an enemy command vessel. A session begins with five aircraft in reserve, and the total score tallies the quantity of targets shot down at the close of every stage.

403fe1c4454dc1e2.overview:
Piloting the Tiger-Heli attack helicopter, the player navigates vertically scrolling battlefields to destroy enemy forces. Opposing targets include ground and air units such as tanks, aircraft, gunboats, and artillery, alongside installations like fuel depots and buildings. The craft defends itself with short-range missiles capable of striking air and ground targets, as well as bombs that damage everything across a wide area.

Shooting color-changing crosses produces items that replenish bomb stocks or recruit up to two support helicopters that provide supplemental forward or sideways firepower. A hidden continue option allows players to resume play after a game over.

41dd396fbd9b0883.overview:
Players pilot the Planeteers' ships and guide superhero Captain Planet through five environmental missions based on the animated series. Each level splits into two distinct segments. During the outside portion, the player steers the Geo-Cruiser, Eco-Copter, or Eco-Sub toward an enemy stronghold, using elemental powers such as fireballs, waves, dropped rocks, and a defensive wind to beat enemy ships and help animals.

Upon reaching the hostile base, control switches directly to Captain Planet for the following phase. In these sections, the hero punches and changes into elemental powers to fight forward against an ecovillain adapted from the television show, such as Hoggish Greedly, Dr. Blight, Looten Plunder, or Duke Nukem. The game takes players to locations including Yellowstone National Park, an ocean, a desert, and Antarctica.

41f949cfedf71679.overview:
Daydreams during a school day structure the adventure, taking Davey to Ancient Greece, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West, alongside stopovers in areas such as quicksand, Winterland, and Cloud City. Viewed from a top-down perspective, levels feature dead-ends and mazes. The player guides Davey up, down, left, and right to navigate stages and battle mythical adversaries such as the Cyclops and the Dragon of the Castle.

Combat utilizes a main weapon alongside secondary armaments and shields. Jumping requires pressing both action buttons simultaneously, allowing Davey to clear obstacles. Characters such as the White Knights give clues, and some foes are hard to defeat without special weapons. Players carry multiple weapons, using a menu screen opened with the select button to swap equipment and inspect collected items. Potions and apples found along the way can either help or harm Davey, and passwords allow progress to continue.

427876021e6c0774.overview:
Winning the game requires players to guide a token across multiple board levels by solving picture puzzles. Each participant is assigned a marker shaped like shoes, a trumpet, a teddy, or an ice cream. While a picture slowly forms, a die counts down from six. The first person to buzz in gets 25 seconds to spell out the answer. Submitting more than one error lets rivals attempt a guess before the die reaches zero. Entering a correct solution awards the puzzle color and advances the piece across the board.

Collecting all four colors raises the token to the next tier. Up to four competitors take part, with players doubling up on two controllers if more than two humans compete.
