Higher boards and harder difficulty settings show fewer hint dots in each picture. Certain boards add Feature Squares, and the highest difficulty adds Drop-Out Squares.

43221ae8a386e8dd.overview:
Rising psychokinetic energy threatens New York City, prompting the player to establish and operate a paranormal extermination franchise. Starting with a loaned cash balance, the player visits a shop to purchase ghost-catching gear, including beams and capture traps, before monitoring an overhead street map for signs of supernatural disturbance. The player drives toward active locations along city streets, collecting fuel and vacuuming stray roaming spirits along the way.

Upon arriving at an infested building, two operatives must maneuver into position to lure ghosts into an active trap for cash rewards. When prompted, the player enters the Temple of Zuul, where the team climbs twenty-two floors of stairs while avoiding lethal ghosts. On the top floor, operatives launch a beam to destroy Gozer before the Marshmallow Man finishes scaling the building.

433f6bcbd59a9d59.overview:
Taking control of vice officer Quinn Hart, the player battles adversaries across a series of stages to investigate an alien conspiracy involving a corporation and an illicit substance. Most levels feature side-scrolling platforming where Hart jumps, crouches, crawls while running, climbs ladders, and uses weapons. Hart switches among an unlimited short-range laser whip, a revolver, and grenades. Collectible items include ammunition refills, health-restoring items like meat, and coins that yield an extra life for every one hundred collected.

Two other gameplay formats appear throughout the mission. Overhead driving segments require steering an automobile across roads, shifting between three gears, and firing a mounted gun at enemy vehicles. In first-person shooting sections, the player aims a crosshair across moving backgrounds to shoot and throw grenades. Story sequences introduce each stage, and unlimited continues are available once Hart expends his limited stock of lives.

44569cef71a0b859.overview:
To the Earth is a light gun shooter in which the player uses the NES Zapper to fight the Raggosians, who have struck the Earth with a bacteriological attack. In the year 2050, the player pilots the spaceship The Tempest to deliver an antibacterial agent that will save humanity from extinction. To formulate the agent, the ship must obtain mineral components at four locations, Uranus, Saturn, Jupiter, and Earth, while the player shoots down enemy spacecraft, missiles, laser bombs, and asteroids and avoids hitting friendly ships.

Target accuracy remains vital because missing a shot drains the ship's energy. Assisting the player are special items, including screen-clearing Smart Bombs earned by downing enough enemies in a row at full energy, comets that grant a Barrier Shield absorbing several missile shots, and energy refills offered when friendly ships cross the screen. Each location ends with a boss fight, the last against Nemesis, leader of the Raggosian forces.

44cd6b2aa05286c3.overview:
Destination Earthstar combines first-person cockpit flight with horizontal side-scrolling space combat. The plot follows a lone pilot seeking to return to Earth by traveling through eight star systems. From the cockpit perspective, players navigate an on-screen grid to locate and destroy hostile forces. Landing on certain planets restores ship energy and replenishes weapon reserves. The ship begins equipped with a Ruby Laser that can overheat from rapid firing and limited Neutron Torpedoes. Two additional armaments, the acid-firing Argon Blaster and a tracking Heat Seeker, can be acquired across the journey.

Destroying every enemy ship in a star system reveals the enemy Base Station on the grid. Reaching a base switches play to a side-scrolling perspective where the craft can fire projectiles forward and backward.

45067f85328eabb3.overview:
Based on the 1990 film of the same name, the game casts the player as Douglas Quaid, a construction worker whose memories have been tampered with. Most of the adventure is played on foot through streets, subways, and interplanetary flight terminals, where Quaid punches or shoots thugs and special agents, jumps, crouches, and enters doors. Weapons such as a hand gun, machine gun, and lasers become available along the way, and energy canisters restore his five energy blocks. Quaid starts with three lives, and extra lives are hidden throughout.

After accepting a free ride to Mars, Quaid takes the wheel in the Martian Transit Hub, a driving section where he drives forward and backward, turns, fires weapons, and drops land mines while avoiding Richter's car. Throughout the game, Richter is to be avoided rather than fought, and the final target is his boss, Cohaagen.

45a0fd35f3141c14.overview:
Solar Jetman - Hunt for the Golden Warpship places the player in control of a Jetpod exploring alien environments in a multidirectional shooter. The quest requires Solar Jetman to navigate hostile planets to retrieve the scattered parts of the stolen Golden Warpship. The pod can rotate clockwise or counterclockwise and is affected by varying gravitational pulls and inertia across different planets. Maintaining sufficient fuel is necessary to travel between destinations.

Players launch from a stationary mothership across twelve planets and one hidden world. A tractor beam allows the craft to tow items back to the mothership, though towing reduces its thrusting power. Collected valuables and defeated enemies grant points, which are traded at a trading post for weapons and equipment. Destructive damage ejects the pilot into a fragile spacesuit, giving the opportunity to return to the mothership for a replacement vessel before losing a life.

4628f32db9b826d1.overview:
Rescuing detective Mr. Stevenson's kidnapped daughter, Jennifer, requires gathering five Black Panther Diamonds. The protagonist, a former FBI agent, has received a ransom note and must deliver the diamonds to the hide-out of King Dom. The course is divided into City, Sky, Sea and Jungle phases, and a countdown clock costs a life if it reaches zero.

Throughout the adventure, Mr. Stevenson continuously runs forward toward obstacles, holes, and hostile creatures. Players guide his progress using the Zapper light gun, aiming directly at him to force him to jump over obstacles. The light gun is also used to target and eliminate incoming adversaries. Bullets are limited, and making Mr. Stevenson pop balloons provides additional bullets to the supply.

46361c5b4007e6ef.overview:
Set in a future where survival is the only law, the journey puts the player behind the wheel of an armored car traversing fifty rally stages. The vehicle features an artillery gun to shoot enemy vehicles and roadside gun turrets, increasing a score multiplier with accurate hits. Navigating the road requires steering around land mines and avoiding enemy collisions, while toxic spills cause the automobile to spin completely around. A support jet periodically drops packs containing limited-use special weapons such as cannons, shields, nitro boosts, and cruise missiles.

Fuel management drives single-player progression across the courses. The car draws from a main tank backed by reserve fuel. Players collect colored globes along the route to replenish supply, with additional fuel awarded at mid-level checkpoints and rally points. Running completely out of fuel costs one of three attempts provided to finish all fifty rallies.

467a2e53c7af4c60.overview:
Defeating every opposing team stands as the ultimate objective in this baseball simulation. In the primary single-player campaign, participants challenge the other eleven fictional teams in any desired sequence until every opponent has been conquered. While losses go uncounted, pitchers gradually drain a stamina meter that only partly recovers after each match. Play progresses through standard baseball actions, including choosing from four pitch styles, attempting stolen bases, and substituting pinch hitters or runners, with contests concluding in ties after twelve innings. Passwords provided after matches preserve defeated rivals and current pitching fatigue.

Available options include single-player and two-player matches, a spectator mode, and customizable All-Star games across two distinct leagues. Competitors arrange batting orders, field positions, and starting pitchers among rosters featuring varying individual ratings. A hidden girls' mode also replaces the players on every club with female players.

46a38baf9067869e.overview:
Surviving the continuous pursuit of Wile E. Coyote across desert roads, mazes, and cliffs is the player's primary goal. Guiding the Road Runner, the player runs and jumps in any direction while gathering piles of birdseed scattered along the route. Missing any birdseed causes the top Seed Meter to decrease, eventually leaving the runner too weak to evade capture. The coyote pursues using gadgets such as jet skates, pogo sticks, and rockets, while other dangers include dynamite, falling boulders, landmines, and oncoming trucks.

This single-player game provides three lives, losing one each time Wile E. catches the runner. Higher stages introduce lemonade that supplies additional energy, and invisible paint can conceal either character. Successfully completing the first stage opens a shortcut that grants an extra life and lets players resume from their last completed level.

46fb05f80167bd18.overview:
Jake and Elwood Blues must find their own way to their concert after Sheriff McGraw sabotages every route to the stage. Across five chapters, passing through a department store, a warehouse, a prison, the sewers and a building site, players navigate platforming stages and must reach the exit of each level to move on. Musical notes restore energy, hearts add extra lives, and springs push the brothers upward.

To deal with threats along the way, the characters eliminate adversaries by kicking eggs laid by birds and spiders. Landing on the back of a dog or snake lets a brother ride it. Two players can take part in the adventure simultaneously, with the camera remaining focused on only one participant as the view scrolls across the environment.

475c35c18b5e9581.overview:
An international Championship Series tournament and exhibition matches are both available, and either mode can be played by one or two players. Participants select from sixteen Little League teams representing regions such as Texas, Puerto Rico, and Chinese Taipei. Before taking the field, users can view a power analysis screen that rates each squad across running, defense, pitching, and batting. Individual athletes carry numeric skill ratings.

Matches standardly last for six innings, though extra innings can occur if necessary. A mercy rule concludes a contest prematurely whenever one side establishes a lead of ten or more runs. During play, managers may send in pinch hitters and pinch runners or change pitchers. On the field, batters enjoy broad movement within the batter's box, while pitchers have similar mobility across the pitching mound.

47dfae941b3c660b.overview:
Cabal features shooting gallery gameplay where participants take control of an unnamed commando attempting to wipe out the D.R.A.T. terrorist camp. The title supports both one-player and two-player options, and a second player can join for simultaneous play. Viewed from behind, the commando starts with an assault rifle and ten grenades. Surviving incoming fire requires running horizontally, kneeling, or rolling while jumping or ducking. While firing, the character remains stationary as the crosshair moves.

Progression spans five stages divided into four screens each, concluding with boss encounters. Defeating terrorists and destroying enemy vehicles depletes a meter located at the screen base, and emptying this gauge completes the screen. Destroying buildings, supplies, and landmarks earns extra points. Bonus pickups provide machine guns with rapid fire, extra grenades, and stars worth bonus points.

48aaef58dee3ad37.overview:
Ghoul School features side-scrolling action-adventure play set within Cool School High. The story begins after high school senior Spike O'Hara recovers a glowing skull from a cemetery, inadvertently allowing ghouls to invade the campus. These hostile spirits take over the school while abducting Samantha Pompom, the head cheerleader.

Controlling Spike, the player attempts to stop the paranormal invasion and rescue Samantha. The mission requires navigating the many rooms of the overrun school and defeating numerous enemy forces. Players can locate various weapons and items scattered throughout the building to assist in combat, although many of these tools remain hidden.

494aa7d49d3f4d66.overview:
Rescuing a required number of creatures within a time limit is the primary goal across each stage. The creatures enter from overhead trapdoors and march continuously forward, turning around only when blocked or falling from ledges. Hazardous terrain threatens their path, including steep drops, blocking walls, and assorted traps. To shepherd the group safely to the exit, the player assigns specialized roles to select individuals.

Eight skills alter creature behavior or reshape the environment. Builders construct staircases, while Bashers, Miners, and Diggers tunnel through terrain at different angles. Climbers scale walls, Floaters descend safely from great heights, and Blockers halt the line of walkers. Bombers detonate after a countdown from five, carving away surroundings. The player can accelerate the entrance rate, pause the action, or trigger an explosion that eliminates all remaining creatures.

4986c3862a04fcf5.overview:
Guiding a security officer named Nova, the player navigates two-dimensional environments while hurling a boomerang in nearly every direction to destroy an army of mechanized foes. The setting places Nova on New Earth in 2191, tasked with recovering six Tape Units to restore the Master Computer after alien terrorists take it off-line. Players can tackle the first six sector levels in any desired sequence via a stage select screen.

Within each sector, the objective involves tracking down an agent to acquire an I.D. card for database access, followed by defeating a guard in the security room to claim that sector's Tape Unit. Upgrades scattered across the stages increase the range, power, and number of boomerangs Nova can throw, while a Metal Suit lets him take three hits and makes his attacks slice through walls. After clearing all six sectors, access opens to the Master Computer Control Center to battle its most dangerous guards.

49fe0c49cd0a2841.overview:
Guiding Dr. Alan Grant from an overhead perspective, the player shoots hostile creatures and navigates a dinosaur park after a system failure frees its animals. The overarching goal involves rescuing the children Tim and Lex, restoring the park's computer systems, clearing out Velociraptor nests with time bombs, and reaching an extraction point. Across six levels composed of multiple stages, the player gathers dinosaur eggs and access cards needed to progress, using gun magazines found in each area to eliminate prehistoric threats such as Compsognathus and Dilophosaurus.

Some encounters involve guiding Tim through a Triceratops stampede or firing upon a Tyrannosaurus rex whose stamina is tracked with a power meter. Scattered mystery boxes impart various outcomes, such as providing extra lives, invincibility, or health replenishment, though some containers deplete energy or remove a life. Grant operates with three lives alongside four continues. A two-player option allows two participants to cooperate by alternating turns whenever a life is lost.

4a2c4a082e0b735e.overview:
Ending the match with the majority of the board displaying their chosen color is the primary goal for players. Based on the strategy board game, matches take place on an eight-by-eight grid using double-sided chips that feature black on one face and white on the other. Participants select which color they wish to control, taking turns placing pieces onto the board. By trapping an opponent's discs between two pieces of their own color, players flip those sandwiched counters to match their own side.

Matches can be contested by a single participant competing against an artificial opponent, or by two human players facing each other. When challenging the computer, four skill levels are available. In addition, matches can incorporate time limits, giving each player a total of twenty, thirty, or forty minutes for all of their moves.

4a9544bb41869e88.overview:
Players control the hero Kickle, using his special freezing breath to overcome environmental hazards and enemies across frozen islands. After the Wicked Wizard King covers the Fantasy Kingdom in ice and imprisons its residents, Kickle ventures forth to rescue them. The single-player objective in each stage centers on navigating the layout to collect all the red Dream Bags while avoiding harmful adversaries.

Kickle can breathe cold air to transform certain foes into blocks of ice. These frozen enemies serve multiple functions, allowing players to build walkways across water or push them to defeat opposing hostiles. Kickle can also manifest an ice pillar directly ahead of himself to block paths.

4a991ac38eb235b6.overview:
Creating custom animated shorts serves as the primary objective for players in Tiny Toon Adventures - Cartoon Workshop. The title provides tools to design scenes, construct scenarios, choose musical tracks and sound effects, and direct character behaviors. Finished productions can run for up to about eight minutes, though the software includes no native saving mechanism to store the completed projects.

Directors can position up to two figures on screen simultaneously, choosing from a cast consisting of Buster, Babs, Plucky, Furrball, Calamity Coyote, and Little Beeper. Characters can be placed into various poses and circumstances against numerous available backgrounds. In addition to staging, the graphical interface supplies options to incorporate sound clips, insert musical cues, add text captions, and adjust scene editing parameters.

4ab711a804e0cfd0.overview:
Ultimate League Soccer simulates eleven-a-side association football. Tournament options include the Gold Cup play-offs featuring eight international squads or the Ultimate League finals contested among four teams. Match types allow a single player to compete against the computer, two participants to engage head-to-head, or two computer teams to face each other. Each national team has distinct ratings for offense, defense, speed, skill, accuracy, and experience. Pre-match options allow players to set uniform colors, half lengths of 15, 30, or 45 minutes, and formations such as 4-2-4, 4-3-3, or 4-4-2.

On the pitch, the player maneuvers the athlete designated by an overhead number and can switch control to different teammates. Holding the kick button increases shot distance, automatically unleashing a power kick after about two seconds. An overhead radar view displays athlete positions across the field alongside the match timer and scoreboard.

4b088e1e78981308.overview:
Levels filled with balloons, telephones, and other surreal items form the structure of this single-player platformer. The player guides a chicken named Alfred who navigates each stage to locate and peck every balloon. While on the ground, Alfred can walk, jump, peck balloons, and hit floor switches. Airborne dive-bomb attacks allow him to eliminate enemies or strike springs to reach high platforms.

Collecting the final balloon on a level floats Alfred up to Mr. Peckles' Space Lab to receive points and extra lives based on bonuses. Available power-ups include a Can O Worms, which creates a rotating shield that defeats adversaries. Answering telephones in secret areas summons Mr. Peckles, a giant flower providing jam that enables Alfred to launch bouncing bombs to damage foes and collect items.

4b11689be770a7dd.overview:
Hostile alien life forms called Xenos are infesting derelict space stations and moon bases, and the player, as an Exterminator, beams aboard each one to destroy as many Xenos as fast as possible before the station self-destructs. Clearing enough of them earns a bonus and restores some Health; otherwise the station is declared overrun. The eight stations have one to four floors connected by elevators, and wall buttons warp the Exterminator to other rooms.

Xenos include the Critter, which latches on and must be thrown off, the Laser Ball, the Giant Slime Amoeba, the bomb-dropping Spiderion and a slime-spitting lizard-like creature. Destroying certain Xenos earns stronger weapons such as the Laser Pistol, Lightning Gun, Smoke Gun and bombs, and pick-up objects include medicine and other items that restore Health. One or two players can play at the same time on a split screen. When all Health is gone, the game ends with no continue.

4b382baa70cbc529.overview:
Winning football matches by scoring more points than the opposing squad serves as the primary goal. Participants select from eight distinct city-based teams: Los Angeles, Denver, San Francisco, Washington, Miami, New York, Chicago, and Houston. Each squad provides depth charts populated with player numbers and statistics. Action unfolds on the field from an angled perspective. Digitized audio clips trigger across various game states, calling out line commands alongside achievements like first downs and touchdowns. At the conclusion of a contest, commentator Nester arrives to declare the winning and losing sides.

Matches can involve up to four participants via multi-controller adapters. Teammates hide planned tactical setups from adversaries by pointing to a physical play card, agreeing on plays silently before entering them into the game. A one-player playoff mode pits the chosen team against the other seven for the Power Bowl championship, with passwords to continue.

4c95afeda9a92842.overview:
Drivers take the wheel of a formula race car, shifting through three manual gears and engaging a turbo boost to compete across sixteen worldwide circuits. Players steer, accelerate, and brake while watching an instrument panel that displays velocity, lap times, gear, remaining turbo, current placement, and fuel alerts. Cars can be customized across six attributes, including speed, acceleration, durability, suspension, pit crew speed, and turbo strength.

Available modes include solo or multi-car practice sessions, which support recorded times for up to four participants, and the full World Grand Prix Series. In the championship series, players can review advice from Al Unser Jr., run practice laps, and complete a single qualifying lap to secure a starting grid position. Races run between six and eleven laps, requiring players to steer into pit lane to repair crash damage and refuel before depletion forces retirement.

4cbf1c1d0be22712.overview:
Drivers take the wheel of Indy cars to compete across nine tracks against Danny Sullivan, who always drives the yellow car. Competitors drive through closed-course competitions with the objective of securing top finishes throughout the racing season, which concludes at the Tradewest Speed Bowl.

Finishing positions determine the amount of prize money awarded to participants after each contest. Players invest these earnings directly into vehicle upgrades to improve performance in subsequent events. The competition supports up to four participants racing simultaneously on the track.

4cfc55e1521e5803.official: This direct sequel to the original The Legend of Zelda is famed for taking the series in a new direction, while also introducing elements that would become standard in future Zelda games. In Zelda II: The Adventure of Link, Link must seek the Triforce of Courage and awaken Princess Zelda from a sleeping spell. Meanwhile, Ganon’s minions are trying to resurrect their master.
4cfc55e1521e5803.overview:
A top-down overworld map and side-scrolling areas structure this adventure. The player controls Link, who must place crystals into statues across six palaces to unlock the Great Palace, recover the Triforce of Courage, and awaken Princess Zelda from an enchanted sleep. Ganon's minions simultaneously seek to defeat Link to resurrect their fallen master.

While traversing the world, the player interacts with non-player characters and engages in strategic combat. Defeating foes grants experience points to upgrade Link's Attack, Magic, and Life statistics up to eight levels. These improvements strengthen sword strikes, lessen magic spell costs, and reduce incoming damage. Link begins with four Heart Containers and four Magic Containers, with four more obtainable for each meter. Players manage limited lives, earning extra lives once an attribute reaches its cap.

4d16627301ff5def.overview:
Sunday Funday - The Ride is a multi-game collection that offers three distinct selectable options from a main menu. The title segment places players in control of a youth on a skateboard attempting to navigate past various distractors and hazards to reach Sunday school. The protagonist can jump, spin, and collect or hurl items such as newspapers. Stages present obstacles like water balloons, banana peels, and stalactites, alongside supportive items such as time-extending hearts, spring boards, and floating helium balloons.

Fish Fall challenges players to control a hand that catches falling fish. Captured fish, held up to fifteen at once, must be thrown upward into a constantly moving basket before time runs out. Hazards include a critter that hops by and takes fish, and, after the first few levels, Mr. Lobster, who throws squid. The third menu choice presents a karaoke activity that displays the lyrics line by line for the song The Ride of Life.

4d2b5339703d2300.overview:
An Explorer First Class travels to a remote sector of the universe to investigate the disappearance of space stations, cruisers, and entire solar systems. These anomalies stem from an evil wizard named Krohn, who wields an expanding Black Hole. Operating the Millennium Orb, the only ship capable of withstanding the energy hazards, the player must navigate through thirty Enigma Chambers to reach and defeat the wizard.

Gameplay involves controlling force shields on the borders of each chamber to keep the craft in position. The player alters the orb's orbital trajectory by diving into and out of the center plane to strike targets and resolve puzzles. Precious fuel depletes if the craft slips past the shields or if space pirate Chasers drain the tanks, requiring visits to a trapped service station to replenish resources.

4da0d4900b297274.overview:
Barker Bill's Trick Shooting tasks the player with shooting carnival targets with a light gun. Players begin with ten credits and score points by hitting targets, with many scores depending on a target's height or how quickly it is hit. Each mistake, such as letting a target escape or shooting an animal, costs a credit. Shooting the diamonds that sometimes appear adds credits, and running out ends the session.

Play spans four carnival formats. In Balloon Saloon, rising balloons are targeted without shooting a dog. Flying Saucers involves hitting saucers thrown by a man and his assistant before they reach the ground, while avoiding a bird. Window Pains requires shooting falling items through open windows. Fun Follies cycles through these challenges and adds stages: Trixie's Shot, where coins held out or thrown by a dancing woman are hit; a diamond-enhanced slot machine for extra credits; and Bill's Thrills, where items a man throws toward the woman's head are shot down.

4ddb728c3a007f1a.official: Proto Man – once the trusted brother of Mega Man – has mysteriously gone berserk, kidnapping Dr. Light and forcing Mega Man to go on the offensive. Assisted by his new sidekick Beat, a robotic bird, and his faithful robo-dog Rush, Mega Man must battle through eight thrilling levels and defeat the Robot Masters lurking within.
4ddb728c3a007f1a.overview:
Rescuing the kidnapped Dr. Light and freeing the city from Protoman's robots serves as the primary objective. The player controls Mega Man across stages where running, jumping, and shooting are needed to overcome enemy machines. Mega Man attacks using an arm cannon with unlimited ammunition, which can also be charged to unleash wider blasts that cancel if damage is taken during charging. Defeated foes and stage pickups restore lost health, while Energy Tanks, Mega Tanks, and extra lives provide additional support.

Advancement involves conquering eight initial stages and defeating their Robot Masters. Overcoming each boss yields a special weapon powered by finite ammunition. Specific levels include distinct features such as reversed gravity or operating a water craft. Completing certain areas unlocks traversal abilities via Rush, while collecting eight hidden letters that spell MEGAMANV grants access to Beat, a robotic bird that attacks enemies.

4ec881462687e084.overview:
Athletes representing chosen nations are controlled by players as they engage in rapid button-mashing actions across various athletic events. The World Tournament covers track events such as dashes, a relay, the 110 meter hurdles, and a marathon; field events such as the long jump, javelin throw, triple jump, shot put, and high jump; weightlifting; the vaulting horse; and swimming races. In the marathon, players instead set their runner's speed for each of the course's six legs.

Up to eight human participants can take part in the tournament, each choosing a country to represent. A Training option lets one player practice any event except the marathon, and battery-backed memory saves records to one of two files.

4ece74fde0b86ece.overview:
Recovering the Lost Treasure of Babylon from the evil dragon Ryu serves as the goal for Karnov. The player directs the fire-breathing protagonist across nine stages filled with obstacles and bizarre enemies, such as the knife-throwing Lion Keeper, the swooping Chicken Bone, and the boulder-hurling Rock Man. Each environment demands careful navigation to overcome end-stage bosses and reach the final confrontation atop a mountain in the deep forest.

A solo player can run, jump, swim, and project fire against hostile creatures. Gathering special items enhances offensive abilities, allowing Karnov to release double or triple fireballs. Players can also collect and store utility items, including jumping boots, bombs, climbing ladders, and wings, to surmount terrain challenges and survive perilous encounters.

4f67a81cc978e5aa.overview:
Seven levels structure this beat 'em up crossover, which sends the heroes to the giant spaceship Colossus to thwart an alliance between the Dark Queen and the Shadow Boss. Players choose from five characters, consisting of martial artists Billy and Jimmy Lee alongside humanoid amphibians Zitz, Pimple, and Rash. Progression shifts across environments, beginning on the exterior of the spacecraft, moving through interior corridors and the bowels of the ship, and transitioning to a space craft shooting sequence and a race along a missile headed for Earth before concluding with boss confrontations.

Two buttons control attacks and jumping. Combat maneuvers include specialized strikes, slams, throws, attacks from hanging ropes or ledges, and moves executed while riding speeder bikes. Play options provide single-player action along with two-player setups, offering settings with or without friendly fire. Each hero has a limited number of lives, and bonus pods can hold extra lives, energy, or weapons.

4fb6c5c8359dcbab.overview:
A password feature allows play to resume at a later level. The storyline involves aliens seizing control of a robot-manufacturing planet and reprogramming its robots for war. Players control Low-G-Man, whose jump grows higher as anti-gravity material capsules are collected, from about three-quarters of a screen at the start to about one and three-quarter screens with three capsules. Defeating enemies without freezing them first yields items far more often.

Standard combat relies on the Electro-Magnetic Disruptor Pistol, which freezes targets. Once adversaries are immobilized, the player attacks them from above or below using an extending spear. Additional available weapons comprise fireballs, boomerangs, waves, and bombs. Some enemy vehicles, the Walker, Spider, and Hover, can be captured by freezing them and stabbing the robot driver.

501e921616931e47.official: Oh, hi kids! I'm so excited about my new invention - the Gametron 5000 Moneymaker. It pays you money for playing video games - the more you play, the more you make.
501e921616931e47.overview:
Stimpy creates the Gametron 5000 Moneymaker, a machine that pays money for playing video games and offers three games. In Space Madness, Space Cadet Stimpy escorts a delirious Commander Ren to Sick Bay while deploying tools like litterboxes, beavers, and socks to navigate hazards and prevent Ren from sabotaging the ship. Certain segments transition into a spaceship shooting sequence. Out West follows the duo attempting to steal a sheriff's horse, allowing players to swap characters using wanted posters to launch spitball attacks. In Robin Hoëk of Logwood Forest, Ren, armed with a bow, crosses a village and castle to rescue Maid Moron.

Throughout these side-scrolling stages, the player runs, jumps, ducks, and attacks using weapons or stage-specific items. A thermometer monitors current health, which can be replenished by collecting hams, while barbells and powdered toast grant temporary invulnerability. The player begins with three lives and three continues, with additional lives awarded by accumulating money bags.

509f04b745d11b8d.overview:
Players control the prehistoric caveman Joe, running, jumping, and fighting across wilderness territories to rescue cavewomen captured by rival Neanderthals. Joe begins armed with a stone axe, but defeating certain foes reveals alternative weapons including boomerangs, flints, rolling stone wheels, and fireballs. Charging a weapon enhances attacks, though overcharging leaves Joe briefly defenseless. Destroying hostile creatures yields food items that restore Joe's health gauge.

Five levels span ten locations, with each zone culminating in mid-level or end-of-level boss encounters. Joe starts with sixteen energy units and three lives, earning bonus lives as score thresholds are met. A two-player option is available, allowing two players to take turns alternating control of Joe.

50b6f1f87fb14c8f.overview:
Levels in this side-scroller span suburban streets, subway train cars, a parking structure, and sewers. The player controls Wally Bear, who rides his skateboard across the city to reach a party at the home of his uncle, Gary Grizzly, helping friends he finds along the way while racing a time limit.

Along his route, Wally encounters various members of his group to talk about the hazards of drug and alcohol consumption, while Ricky Rat and his rat pack make trouble. The game teaches players to refuse substances such as tobacco and alcohol and to resist negative peer pressure. Extra skateboards boost speed and jumping, flying discs can be thrown at enemies, and each collected item lets Wally absorb one extra hit. The journey ends when Wally finds his friends and reaches the party.

50badb618accf0ca.official: Little Ninja Brothers is the second in a series. Join Jack and Ryu on an adventure with action and role-playing elements, as you defeat the Yoma Clan and bring peace to Chinaland. Journey across the land, exploring cities and building up your items and weapons by visiting shops, and battle any enemies you encounter with hand-to-hand combat.
50badb618accf0ca.overview:
Chinaland faces an invasion by the Yoma Clan, prompting two young brothers named Jack and Ryu to embark on an adventure to defeat the clan and restore peace to the realm. Players guide the protagonists across the land as they investigate the ongoing crisis.

Gameplay blends role-playing components with action elements. While exploring the land and its cities, players acquire weapons and items at local shops to enhance their inventory. Confrontations with encountered adversaries are resolved mainly through punches and kicks, with swords and throwing stars also available. A two-player mode lets a second participant control Ryu, and a separate Field Meeting mode offers competitive events aside from the main quest.

51958d12a19e7c57.overview:
Sky Kid provides horizontally scrolling shooter gameplay featuring up to two players. Participants operate biplanes piloted by Baron, in red, and Max, in blue, flying through levels filled with hostile air and ground units. Missions challenge pilots to locate and bomb specific targets, which include battleships, aircraft carriers, factories, and headquarters. Because the aircraft do not begin with explosives, players must collect a bomb along the flight path before reaching the objective, then land back at base.

Pilots use a machine gun to fire upon enemy forces and can execute a loop maneuver to evade hazards or reveal secrets. Reaching mission objectives requires flying through enemy defenses. Points are awarded for destroying opposing units and successfully bombing targets, with bonus points granted at the end of a mission for completely demolishing targets.

527faba646cd9e95.overview:
The protagonist, an amnesic descendant of a magician, moves across overhead environments to rescue Princess Scheherazade and save Arabia from the wizard Sabaron. Players begin by selecting a class—Fighter, Magician, or Saint—which determines equipment proficiencies, such as swords, rods, and protective footwear. Characters explore various terrains, including deserts, wintry lands, towns, mazes, and palaces, while utilizing the Time Door to shift between past, present, and future. Towns provide locations to replenish health and magic points, gather information, hire troopers, switch classes, and receive passwords.

Progress spans five chapters across multiple worlds. Combat occurs through real-time overworld skirmishes using close-range blades, projectile rods, and spells, alongside random turn-based encounters. During turn-based fights, players battle with up to two companions, picking commands to strike, cast magic, bribe foes, or flee. Defeating opponents yields experience points to elevate levels, increasing health and magic maximums while unlocking upgraded spells and weapon power.

52812b55986f96fa.overview:
Venturing into the fantasy world of McDonaldland, two children named Mack and Mick embark on a quest to recover Ronald McDonald's magical bag after the Hamburglar steals it. Players select either Mick or Mack, who share identical abilities, to navigate through six lands. Supporting an alternating two-player mode, the characters can walk, duck, jump, and collect blocks to throw at enemies encountered throughout their adventure.

Advancing through each world involves visiting local characters and gathering required puzzle cards rather than simply reaching stage exits. Stages incorporate items such as Golden Arches, which open a bonus level when enough are collected, and extra-life icons. Traversing the levels involves riding or carrying a boat, unzipping pathways to warp across the stage, and activating a spin device that inverts gravity to flip the character upside down.

528d501320ed0276.overview:
Stages revolve around selecting and pursuing individual wanted outlaws known as the Scorpions. The adventure supports one or two players, casting the first player as Sheriff Sam and the second as his deputy Little Chief. Heroes begin unarmed and must enter doorways to obtain basic weapons and receive guidance. Traversing town environments involves jumping, conversing with non-player characters, and attacking hostile minions. Broken barrels and chests yield gold coins, food that restores lost health, defensive armor, stars that extend maximum vitality, or skulls that drop health.

Progress requires defeating specific villains such as Slash Joe, Billy Morgan, and the group's leader, the Scorpion Master. Collected maps and ladders, used from the pause screen, show the current town or lead out of lower levels. Towns also feature optional mini-games, including blackjack betting, a target-shooting gallery, and a striker strength trial.

5305f0d6d38893ee.overview:
Players select from four complete athletic titles contained on a single cartridge: Baseball Pro's, Soccer Simulator, BMX Simulator, and Pro Tennis. Baseball Pro's features sixteen teams with distinct player statistics, where participants alternate between batting, base stealing, pitching, and fielding across multiple innings.

Soccer Simulator shifts active control to the athlete closest to the ball, tasking players with running, kicking, and executing sliding tackles against international squads. BMX Simulator pits three cyclists against each other across dirt, desert, and quarry tracks with terrain effects such as berms, rough ground, and slopes. Pro Tennis provides competitive matches using standard scoring rules, featuring adjustable lengths for two-player matches and a dedicated practice option. Depending on the selected sport, the cartridge accommodates solo play or multiple participants.

5314ad0c40616119.official: As a super-robot created by the genius Dr. Light, it's up to Mega Man to traverse ten unique stages and beat the devious Robot Masters designed by the evil Dr. Wily. Beating each stage's boss allows Mega Man to use its trademark weapon, giving you an advantage in other stages – a technique still used in the series today.
5314ad0c40616119.overview:
Controlling the humanoid robot Mega Man, the player navigates side-scrolling platform levels to defeat the villainous Dr. Wily and his rogue creations. Players begin by selecting from six initial stages in any preferred order. Each environment presents distinct hazards, adversaries, and a climactic encounter with one of Dr. Wily's empire leaders. Conquering these bosses grants their special abilities, expanding the hero's standard blaster arsenal. Fallen foes can drop energy capsules that restore health and replenish limited weapon ammunition. Players can also obtain the Magnet Beam item in Elecman's stage to produce temporary platforms.

Completing the original set of levels unlocks Dr. Wily's seventh and final stage. Points accumulate by defeating enemies, gathering dropped power-ups, and completing stages.

5327792d8b5392cd.overview:
Piloting a Soviet MiG-29 combat aircraft, the player engages in shoot 'em up flight combat across multiple missions. The primary objective centers on confronting and defeating the World Terrorist Army led by Colonel Crackov.

Flight segments alternate between aerial engagements and close combat ground attacks, alongside midair refueling and landing sequences. Aircraft can cycle between weapons such as double missiles, spiral missiles, cluster spreads, and optimum combinations. The title offers both a single-player mode and an alternating two-player share mode where participants take turns on four shared lives.

53477d979c71429a.overview:
The game tasks players with collecting the hidden crystals in each maze while racing against a clock. Deadly FireStars act as hazards throughout the areas. A password system allows players to resume their progress, with codes that depend on an entered name.

To navigate the mazes, the spaceman wields a shock wave pistol capable of destroying broken blocks. The shock wave does not move the block it hits but pushes the blocks next to it, and when a block cannot move, the wave travels on until the last block in the line is affected. Helpful bonus pickups include extra lives, hourglasses that add time, and items that temporarily freeze the FireStars. One or two players can take part.

5348f7f88695867d.overview:
The story follows Indiana Jones in a quest to find the true Holy Grail, while enemies pursue his father's Grail diary. Controlling Jones through levels adapted from the film, the player picks the order of destinations from a list shown after each short movie, and the movies hold useful clues. Boarding the ship to win the Cross of Coronado requires defeating sailors and then the Captain, while Venice features a timed sliding puzzle that yields a sketch of the true Holy Grail.

Later objectives include rescuing Indy's father from a maze inside Castle Brunwald and defeating enemy soldiers atop a moving tank in Iskenderun to free Marcus before the tank reaches a cliff. Losing a sequence costs the diary, which is recovered in a motorcycle sequence in Berlin. Finally, the player traverses lettered floor tiles spelling Jehovah in the Lost Temple, ultimately using the sketch to select the authentic Grail from several options.

53bfc94fce46a251.official: You must venture through eight perilous areas, each filled with enemies determined to stop you. As if that wasn't tough enough, Master Higgins loses vitality over time, so he must grab fruit, milk and whatever other goodies he can as he races towards his goal. Smash eggs to find useful items like the axe and skateboard to help you progress.
53bfc94fce46a251.overview:
Thirty-two stages comprise the journey, split into eight distinct areas made up of four rounds each. The player directs Master Higgins across an island to save Princess Leilani from the Evil Witch Doctor. Progression relies on clearing rounds divided by checkpoints while avoiding hazards like pitfalls, water, and opposing creatures. Higgins possesses a health meter that constantly depletes over time or when tripping on rocks. To prevent fatal depletion, players gather milk bottles and various fruits, while some hidden eggs hold extra lives.

Higgins begins each life unable to attack until securing a stone axe from an egg. Fireballs, a stronger weapon found in hidden eggs, can also break rocks. Eggs also yield skateboards, score bonuses, invincibility fairies, or health-draining eggplants, with hidden eggs revealed by jumping and some bonus stages reached by standing still at certain spots. Every fourth round culminates in a battle against the Evil Witch Doctor.

54112120e3a5d0a1.overview:
Winning events and earning the tournament trophy is the primary objective in this athletic competition. Controlled via the floor-mat Power Pad peripheral, on-screen participants run in place, jump over hazards, and perform specialized maneuvers according to sensor presses. Competitions include the multi-stage Super Obstacle Course, Obstacle Course A, Obstacle Course B, Skateboard Race, 6 Legged Race, Tug of War, and Relay Race. Individual obstacle segments feature hopping over logs, ramming large balls, leaping over water hazards, crab-walking across tracks, clearing high walls, and navigating inside inflatable bubbles.

The game offers single-player competitions against computer rivals named Ollie, Jimmy, or Jack, as well as head-to-head two-player matches. Larger groups can participate in two-team play or bracketed tournaments where registered squads advance toward a championship. Competitors run simultaneously in designated white and red lanes, while on-screen displays track each side's time and position on a course map.

5431ed49f22ee818.overview:
Robo Warrior centers on action gameplay featuring shooting and demolition. Controlling a cyborg named ZED, the player fights across the artificial world of Altile to defeat the invading Xantho Empire. The campaign consists of eight levels called Periods, each divided into one or more stages. Reaching each stage exit requires clearing obstacles and adversaries to find a hidden key, with certain areas also requiring a chalice to prevent the stage from looping. Along the way, players can explore hidden underground passages holding special powers or bomb statues in Rooms of Idols for rewards.

Combat relies on a laser gun alongside deployable bombs that eliminate hostiles and break blocks. Explosions can harm ZED, and limited bomb counts must be replenished from enemy drops and hidden bomb symbols. Because ZED's energy meter drains over time, players must gather Life Pods and Energy Capsules to survive.

54a1949ea7d609bd.overview:
Proving that planet Earth truly exists requires returning there with photographic evidence. Players control Linus, an alien from Linoleum who must explore his world without money to secure a camera, fuel from a space station, and a vehicle. His quest involves using a fake identity to enter a bumper car event and getting past hostile robots in a factory on Detroitica.

Progress relies on guiding the character through point-and-click adventure screens with written commands and an on-screen cursor to gather and utilize items. Teleporters accessed with keys yield side effects needed to solve puzzles. Short arcade platforming levels connect these destinations, requiring Linus to dodge enemies and avoid falling while crossing to the exit. Collecting ten Cosmic candies awards an extra life, and pausing the game before pressing Select and Start together in any adventure area generates a password.

54c70628739c9cfa.overview:
After the children discover a fragment of Great, Great Uncle Fergus McDuck's treasure map in the basement, Scrooge McDuck embarks on a worldwide expedition to find the missing fragments before his rival Flintheart Glomgold. Players guide Scrooge across five selectable levels set in Egypt, Scotland, Mu, Niagara Falls, and a pirate ship within the Bermuda Triangle. Stages can be tackled in any sequence, with each environment culminating in a guardian boss battle.

Scrooge traverses stages using a cane jump, hangs from hooks, crosses water aboard rafts, and uses his cane to pull switches, fire a cannon, and spring off a flower. Previously cleared stages can be reentered to gather additional money and items. Accumulated money buys recovery supplies and extra lives at a store, while cane enhancements from Gyro unlock hidden sections. Locating map pieces tucked inside chests across each stage opens an optional sixth level containing the lost treasure of McDuck.

54cdc8b6fab80433.official: Street Gangs is the Western version of the acclaimed Japanese hit Downtown Nekketsu Monogatari, a unique mix of beat ‘em up and RPG. Friends Alex and Ryan must save River City from the evil Slick and his gang who have also kidnapped Ryan's girlfriend Cyndi. Fight your way through gang members and bosses, raise your stats by eating the right foods, and gain new techniques by reading special books.
54cdc8b6fab80433.overview:
High school students Alex and Ryan journey across River City to confront the villain Slick, who has seized River City High and holds its students captive, including Ryan's girlfriend Cyndi. Reaching River City High requires battling through nine student gangs and a series of bosses. Characters move freely around an open sandbox environment, attacking rivals with punches, kicks, jumps, or improvised weapons like trash cans, lead pipes, and brass knuckles that can be swung or thrown.

Defeating opponents yields money that players spend at local shops on food and sauna visits to replenish health and permanently boost combat attributes. Players also purchase instructional books to learn advanced techniques like Grand Slam, Stone Hands, and Dragon Feet. Progress, including acquired skills, currency, statistics, and beaten bosses, is preserved through a password system. The adventure supports both solo play and a simultaneous two-player cooperative mode.

54dd62754f48e39a.overview:
Piloting a GunStar ship, the player flies over fifteen hostile Command Ships to eliminate their defenses across planets under attack. Action scrolls horizontally in both directions. The craft encounters attacking waves of hostile fighters as well as indestructible homing mines launched from flashing surface ports, which must be evaded until they expire. Navigating each vessel requires flying past various barriers, with some sections featuring narrow gaps that necessitate turning the vessel sideways to slip through.

Destroying enough surface targets triggers a landing signal. The player must then guide the craft onto the Command Ship runway. Once landed, a bonus minigame takes place inside the fuel rod chamber before the Death Blossom explosive device activates, vaporizing the enemy ship as the GunStar zooms away to the next planet.

54fb22e081d95b80.overview:
Contestants decide whether to agree or disagree with statements made by fictitious celebrities. Successful answers claim squares on the board, with the primary goal being to form a tic-tac-toe. A host presides over the board, and each celebrity delivers a humorous quip before giving an answer. One player can face a computer opponent, or two players can compete.

Play progresses across a series of rounds that award cash amounts. Securing a win in either of the initial two rounds yields $500, with the second contest designated as the Secret Square game. Achieving victory in the third game provides $1,000. The ultimate winner advances to a bonus phase, where the participant chooses one key among five options, then picks a car and wins it if the key fits.

55375474cdebdb05.overview:
Piloting an F-14 Tomcat, the player is deployed on a three-stage military operation against a hostile armada. The opening mission tasks the pilot with destroying enemy nuclear attack submarines and then a cruise-missile-carrying Black Jack bomber. Subsequent assignments involve fighting through a tank-infested forest to destroy a Hind-Alpha helicopter, as well as maneuvering through lightning and satellite-based laser beams to take down an opposing space shuttle.

Offensive capabilities include an auto-cannon equipped with infinite ammunition, alongside a selectable missile payload consisting of Sidewinder, Sparrow, or Phoenix missiles. These missiles lock onto and eliminate aerial and ground targets, with higher-tier options granting broader target lock-on zones. In addition to the main campaign, a separate one-on-one dogfight mode allows competitive duels against seven computer-controlled aces or a second human participant.

553d6db3959c8ae3.overview:
Rescuing Princess Aria and vanquishing the wicked Fire Mage and his ally, Vishok the Serpent god, drives the quest in Sword Master. Set in the medieval fantasy kingdom of Eledar, the story centers on a knight called back to the realm who marches across lands that include a forest, a village under Vishok's rule, and the captured castle. Progressing through the seven side-scrolling levels requires tactical combat against opposing forces.

The player controls the knight, swinging a sword to attack while using a shield for defense. Throughout the journey, the protagonist confronts adversaries such as wolves, giant bats, gargoyles, barbarians, lizard men, wizards, and skeleton warriors. Defeating certain enemies yields a magic staff and other symbols of power, letting the hero don the Cloak of Might and unleash offensive magical spells.

554c74ff0b7ce3c1.overview:
Winter Games features competition across various athletic events based on winter sports. Players represent selected countries while participating in a multi-sport carnival centered on snow and ice disciplines. The four events are Hot Dog Aerials, Speed Skating, Figure Skating and the Bobsled, which can be contested in sequence, one at a time, or as practice.

Contenders complete each event aiming for the Gold Medal, which goes to the highest score. Up to two players can participate in the contest as they strive for top placements in the available events. Record results appear on a World Records screen.

5564e54943deddc6.overview:
Dirk the Daring journeys through a castle to defeat Singe the Dragon and rescue Princess Daphne. Guiding the protagonist through two-dimensional, side-scrolling stages, the player can make Dirk walk, crawl, or jump forward while finding and utilizing diverse weapons to eliminate hostile creatures. Dirk maintains two resource meters, one permitting him to generate light and another tracking the damage he can sustain.

After the Drawbridge and the Entrance Hall, an Elevator Shaft hub leads to stages such as the Gold Mines, the Hall of the Grim Reaper, and Singe's Cavern, alongside the Treasury, where gold can be reclaimed from the Lizard King. Multiplayer allows participants to alternate turns controlling Dirk in a competitive pursuit of high scores, which are recorded on a top-scores screen.

55c2d10ae1b034b3.overview:
Commanding either the Union or Confederate forces, players direct armies across a strategic map of the United States divided into states. Moving forces allows expansion into unoccupied states or the takeover of opposing land. States containing one of the five railway towns must be won by completing a fort assault. Holding two connected towns and the rail route between them collects taxes that pay for new armies, and capturing a state on the enemy's route allows an attempt to rob the opponent's train. An optional setting provides European reinforcements to whichever side holds North Carolina.

Opposing armies that collide trigger a real-time battle in which the player switches between cannon, cavalry and infantry. Other optional factors add Indian and Mexican attacks and a storm cloud that halts movement. Supported for up to two players, campaigns can begin in any year from 1861 to 1864, altering starting state distributions and army deployments.

55efed163edb02ab.official: Tee off with Mario (and Luigi in two-player mode) in this classic sporting simulation. In NES Open Tournament Golf, choose from three international courses – UK, US and Japan – and three different game types: Stroke Play, Match Play and Tournament. Set up your shot on the overhead map screen by choosing the correct club and adjusting for wind speed and direction, then switch to the action screen and make your shot using careful timing!
55efed163edb02ab.overview:
Mario tees off across international courses in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Japan, competing to complete each hole using the lowest number of strokes. Princess Toadstool serves as his caddie, offering helpful tips and information throughout the match. In multiplayer modes, a second player takes control of Luigi, who receives guidance from Princess Daisy.

Before taking a swing, players consult an overhead map to select a club, gauge distance, and adjust for wind speed and direction. Shifting to a third-person perspective, the player sets the shot's power and type using timed button presses on a meter. Putting is handled from a top-down view. Available gameplay formats include Stroke Play, Match Play, and Tournament modes.

56382fac9104b267.overview:
A kidnapping crisis erupts after the Dragon Ninja abducts the President. Two tough brawlers named Blade and Striker set out across the city to rescue the chief executive from the Dragon Ninja and his henchmen.

Controlling a brawler, the player punches, kicks, and jumps to fend off hostile forces. Ninjas, lady ninjas, samurai, attack dogs, and flaming ninjas attack, some with throwing stars. Players can pick up nunchakus, knives, health items, and time extensions while advancing through locales including city streets, a truck, sewers, a forest, a train, and a cave. Levels conclude with super warrior bosses who must be defeated before a final helicopter confrontation. Multiplayer allows two participants to play by alternating turns.

56a169bb3a610105.official: Mario & Yoshi is a fast-paced NES puzzle game in which you must mix and match falling characters and piece together eggshells to free the Yoshi trapped inside. Simply move Mario back and forth to catch the falling Little Goombas, Boo Buddies, Bloopers and Piranha Plants. Capture creatures between two eggshell halves and you’ll release a Yoshi; the more creatures you capture, the larger the Yoshi and the bigger the bonus!
56a169bb3a610105.overview:
Players control Mario as falling enemies drop into four vertical columns to piece together eggshells and free trapped Yoshis. Operating beneath the play field, Mario swaps pairs of adjacent columns to align incoming creatures with matching monsters atop existing stacks, clearing them from the board. Each column holds up to eight items before surpassing the boundary line, which causes a game over. Catching enemies between the lower and upper halves of an eggshell encases the creatures and hatches a Yoshi, yielding larger bonuses based on the amount enclosed.

Two single-player options provide distinct goals: A-Type continues indefinitely until a loss occurs, while B-Type tasks players with clearing the entire screen across rounds featuring larger starting piles. A competitive two-player mode features simultaneous play on separate fields, with a second participant controlling Luigi. Each round ends when one contestant empties their field or the opponent tops out, and the first player to win three rounds takes the match.

56cb5897c539b687.overview:
Matches are structured into two trivia rounds followed by an obstacle course round. Competitors select team names and choose character avatars before starting. Up to two players can participate, with solo participants facing a computer opponent across three available difficulty settings. Toss-up tasks open the game by having contestants throw objects at targets using adjustable angles and speeds to gain initial control. Participants then select trivia answers using directional inputs, and physical challenges employ similar throwing mechanics.

The team with the highest cash total after the second round advances to the final obstacle course. The contestant moves along the course with the control pad and must be in the correct position in front of an obstacle to jump into it. Each flag must be grabbed and passed off to a partner before the contestant can continue to the next obstacle.

56d25e05dde2048c.overview:
Across a sequence of distinct stages, players control the humanoid warrior toads Rash and Zitz on a mission to defeat the Dark Queen and rescue their captured companions, Pimple and Princess Angelica. Levels incorporate varied formats, including beat 'em up brawling, platforming, descents along suspended cables, obstacle courses, and vehicle rides on the Speed Bike, Jet Turbo and Space Board, as well as a unicycle. Players have a limited number of lives and an energy meter that is replenished by eating flies.

Progression requires defeating enemies and maneuvering through hazards. Standard offensive moves include punches, kicks and a running head-butt, and double-tapping the control pad with the B button gives access to powerful Smash Hits such as the Battletoad Butt and Big Bad Boot. Certain objects, such as the legs of defeated walker enemies, can also be picked up and wielded. Some moves suit particular hazards; the BT Bashing Ball, for example, uproots Saturn Toadtraps and short-circuits the wall-mounted Retro-Blasters.

581851e22e8d499a.overview:
Piloting a starship known as the Final Star, the player engages in combat by firing upon diverse enemy forces and demolishing opposing installations to accumulate points. This single-player, vertically scrolling shooter arms the craft with one weapon, the Star Beam Gun, fired with either button; there are no secondary munitions such as bombs or missiles.

The mission is an attack on the mysterious planet Gordess, which is divided into 24 areas. A command ship called the Alpha Target appears at the end of each area, and the area cannot be cleared without destroying it. Hidden objects, bonus targets and a combining floating fortress offer extra points, and a mysterious picture holds clues to finding a hidden target named Cleopatra.

5860e217030f9da9.overview:
Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde presents side-scrolling action centered on reaching a wedding at a church. The player directs Dr. Jekyll as he walks to the right across six stages consisting of towns, cemeteries, a park, and a street. Rather than confronting most townspeople, animals, and hazards directly, Dr. Jekyll avoids them, though his cane can strike bees. Taking damage reduces his life meter and pushes his stress meter toward Hyde. Should his life run out entirely, the protagonist dies and play terminates.

Filling the stress meter transforms the character into Mr. Hyde, shifting the scene into an autoscrolling World of Demons. Moving from right to left, Mr. Hyde attacks monsters using a projectile called the Psycho-Wave. Each hit moves the meter back toward Jekyll, eventually reverting him to Dr. Jekyll. If Mr. Hyde advances to the location where Dr. Jekyll stood, lightning instantly destroys him.

588a31fdcdefcef9.overview:
Piloting an experimental Thrasher Hawk-7 aircraft, the player embarks on an aerial mission across nine South Pacific islands invaded by a hostile militant organization. The primary objective entails neutralizing enemy fortresses located on each island. The game starts with five available fighter craft, allowing solo play or a two-player option.

Flight movement is directed with the directional pad across the screen. Players possess unlimited firepower, utilizing button A to fire wing cannons forward and button B to drop bombs onto ground-based targets below. Opposing threats include bombers, tanks, and submarines. Destroying red enemies releases one of six available power-ups, upgrading the craft's firepower as players advance deeper into enemy territory.

58be6a811ee33708.overview:
Disposing of Freddy Krueger's bones in a high school furnace is the primary objective in this horizontal side-scrolling action game set around Elm Street. The player controls a teenager; two players can take part, or up to four with an NES four-player accessory. Navigating the environment requires acquiring keys to unlock blocked areas and surviving attacks from hostile creatures. Players search buildings to gather all scattered bones, which triggers a confrontation with Freddy. Defeating him rewards a key and allows exit from the building.

A Sleep Meter tracks how near the teenagers are to falling asleep, dropping steadily unless slowed by movement or replenished with coffee pickups. If any character falls asleep, everyone is sent to the Dream World, where Freddy becomes more dangerous. Finding a boombox returns players to the waking world, while special icons grant abilities to throw javelins, shurikens, or magic projectiles.

58d0f0e504b8450e.overview:
Set in prehistoric times, this adventure follows the young man Dino-Riki as he fights his way through deserts filled with quicksand, sinking lotus swamps, dark caverns, and deep canyons. The player moves Dino-Riki up, down, left, and right through vertically scrolling environments filled with dinosaurs and other hazards, jumping when needed and shooting enemies. Major foes include a Pteranodon, a Tyrannosaurus, a Triceratops, a Monster Fly, and a Giant Cobra.

The player attacks with thrown weapons, starting with rocks that upgrade into axes, boomerangs, and finally torches, which fire in every direction except behind. Hidden items add a level to the energy gauge, increase speed, upgrade the weapon, grow wings for flight, or turn the character into Macho-Riki, the ancient warrior. Collecting six diamonds in a row without being hit earns an extra Dino-Riki, and a star destroys every enemy on the screen. Taking hits downgrades the weapon.

58d2f6abe4445dad.overview:
Treasure Master is a single-player platform game where the player controls a youth named Skooter. After discovering an old gold coin that induces strange dreams, Skooter embarks on a quest through surreal landscapes to find hidden treasure. The character runs, jumps, crouches, climbs, and operates vehicles while avoiding hazardous obstacles and hostile creatures such as mutant dragonflies, cosmic caterpillars, and solar road hogs.

Progress requires navigating five distinct worlds, such as islands, microchip circuits, and the interior of the moon, without any shortcuts. An optional sixth prize world unlocks if a secret password was entered at the start. Players gather specialized tools including boots, rayguns, keys, and potions, cycling through an inventory screen to activate the correct accessory for each situation. Failing to complete the quest forces players to restart from the beginning.

58f2ba801354a8e5.official: This action-RPG brings a unique twist to the world of classic fantasy! You are an adventurer who has just returned to his home town, the Elf town of Eolis, at the base of the World Tree. You find the village in peril - the Elven water supply has dried up, monsters are causing chaos and the Tree itself, once proud, is slowly wilting.
58f2ba801354a8e5.overview:
Faxanadu combines side-scrolling platforming with action role-playing gameplay. The hero sets out from the Elf town of Eolis at the base of the World Tree, where meteorites are raining down, crazed monsters run amuck, and the wells are drying up. His mission is to penetrate the giant World Tree and overthrow the Evil One, who lives in the fortress of Zenis in the Evil Place. The journey passes through towns on the tree's trunk and branches, and reaching the fortress requires solving a number of mysteries.

The character walks, jumps, climbs ladders, strikes foes with bladed weapons, and casts offensive magic. Some defeated adversaries leave behind money or food that partially restores energy. Experience raises the hero's rank through Gurus, who also provide password mantras to resume play. Players speak with villagers for information, spend collected gold in shops on usable gear or armor, and monitor status meters for health, magic power, items, and experience.

590535e8cda84cb4.official: NES classic City Connection is a driving action game which sees you race across all the highways of the world! After breaking into a New York paint store you get behind the wheel of a customized automobile. You must avoid pesky cats and the ever-present police who will stop at nothing to bring your journey to a screeching halt!
590535e8cda84cb4.overview:
Side-scrolling stages set across global locations structure this driving action game. The player drives an automobile over elevated highways with the objective of coloring every road surface. Jumping allows the vehicle to leap across large gaps and reach higher tiers of the roadway.

Police vehicles pursue the player throughout each area, while cats dart in front of the car as hazards that cost a life on contact. Players can collect and launch oil cans to stun pursuing patrol cars before colliding with them to knock them away. Driving on a single level for too long causes roadblocks to appear, which results in the loss of a life.

5aaa8382ec79c170.overview:
Across side-scrolling areas set throughout San Francisco, players guide Inspector Harry Callahan on a mission to dismantle a powerful drug ring. A drug kingpin called The Anaconda has united the city gangs into a smuggling syndicate, prompting Callahan to pursue the criminal forces across the city. The search leads from the streets and sewers to the waterfront, and the ultimate objective entails confronting the drug lord directly within a hidden hideout located on Alcatraz.

Players control Callahan as he walks, climbs ladders and poles, crosses rooftops, punches, kicks and fires his .44 magnum, which carries a limited supply of bullets. Other items include a harpoon gun, a LAWS missile launcher, a grappling gun for swinging across dangerous terrain, plastic explosives for opening safes, and crowbars for locked doors. Chili dogs restore lost health. Harry has five lives, and completing a level gives a password for starting at the next one.

5ad644d368f70b61.overview:
Stopping the magician Draygon, who rules a growing empire from a floating, fortified tower, serves as the central mission in a world rebuilt after a great war. Awakening after being frozen in a cave, with no memory, the protagonist journeys across an overhead world to defeat Draygon. Controlled in eight directions, the character slashes with equipped blades, wears protective armor and shields, and triggers assigned magic spells or inventory items. Defeated creatures yield experience points that increase character levels, boosting maximum health, magic capacity, defense, and offensive strength.

Progress relies heavily on four distinct elemental swords imbued with wind, fire, water, and thunder powers, which ultimately unite into a fifth blade. Alongside normal slashes, each weapon can launch charged projectiles to overcome elemental immunities and bypass environmental obstacles, including freezing waterways. Foes and bosses require sufficient character levels before attacks can inflict harm.

5b0b097beb19f220.overview:
Neutralizing ancient tiles by pairing them together is the primary goal in order to restore balance to the land. Players direct an on-screen cursor to select and match identical tiles, removing them from the board before the timeline at the bottom of the screen runs out. The connection between two matching pieces cannot cross through obstacles or turn across more than two right angles. Certain pieces, such as season tiles, can pair with any other tile of their category, while some tiles can extend the remaining time.

Tokens hidden beneath tiles charge three special abilities known as the Forces of Fate. These abilities allow players to pair surrounded tiles, break obstructing brick walls, or reveal valid matches. A skull icon signals that special powers are required to finish the round. In addition to standard play for one or two players, an edit mode lets players place tiles to create custom board layouts.

5b85c1ff632c6ac3.official: Has Mega Man’s nemesis Dr Wily finally changed his ways? Only time will tell, as Mega Man must deal with a new threat: eight fiendish robot masters lurking in eight new challenging stages of platform-shooter perfection! This NES classic expanded upon the hit formula with two game-changing additions. Mega Man can now slide as well as run, giving him unprecedented maneuverability.
5b85c1ff632c6ac3.overview:
Controlling the hero Mega Man, the player runs, slides, and fires a blaster to defeat hostile creatures across several stages. The protagonist must retrieve energy crystals from the mining worlds by vanquishing eight berserk Robot Masters. Stages can be tackled in any order chosen by the player. Defeating a boss yields a specialized weapon that can be selected at will, allowing players to target the specific vulnerabilities of other bosses. Pickups found throughout each level replenish health, weapon energy, and extra lives, while stored tanks restore life energy completely.

Sliding allows players to slip under barriers and enemy fire. Mega Man is also assisted by Rush, a canine companion who transforms into a springboard, jet, or submarine to aid traversal. Periodic duels against the mini-boss Break Man open passageways. After defeating the initial Robot Masters, the player revisits four sites to battle Doc Robots before infiltrating a final fortress.

5ca7cb3c4168bb02.overview:
Piloting Stinger jet fighters through seven stages to defeat the alien Attackons and rescue the kidnapped Professor Cinnamon forms the primary focus. Control alternates between vertically scrolling areas and side-scrolling levels. In vertical sections, pressing the action button drops bombs downward onto ground targets, whereas in horizontal sections, the ship launches hearts overhead that turn enemies into bells; keeping bells in the air longer changes their color.

Captured bells grant various enhancements. Blue bells increase flight speed, white bells grant dual cannons, and red bells add laser fire. Combined red and white bells triple firepower, blue and white bells provide a force field barrier, while yellow bells award bonus points. Bombing ground defenses reveals power symbols, including a Half Moon and a Star of Hope that grant three-way and five-way shots in one-player games. Two simultaneous players can also team up to unleash a shared ripple laser.

5cb8d03a90732d01.overview:
Reaching Los Angeles from Boston stands as the primary goal in Alex DeMeo's Race America. Players drive across the United States over nine legs, in a car with a top speed of 192 miles per hour. Each leg opens with a drag race, in which the player shifts up through six gears while avoiding oil slicks, and continues as a road race on the open highway with traffic, curves and hills. Crashes and high RPMs waste fuel, and the tank is refilled by driving over roadside gas cans.

In the single-player mode, the driver faces one of eight fictional computer opponents in each leg. Winning a leg moves the player up to a tougher rival and losing drops back to an easier one, with A.J. Turbo as the toughest. In the two-player mode, participants compete directly against each other, one as the red racer and the other as the blue racer.

5d84d61e7e4c2b7d.overview:
Winning a baseball game is only part of the task for the player; the ultimate objective is playing a perfect game rather than competing for a pennant. The game has no season play. Instead it offers one-player games against the computer, two-player head-to-head games, and a mode for watching the computer play.

In one-player games, play is rated in thirteen categories, such as errors, strikeouts and getting picked off. The rating starts at 100 points, with deductions for mistakes and additions for great plays and bonuses. After a win, the rating decides the level, from 1 to 5, of the next opponent, while any loss drops the player back to a Level 1 team. The final goal is to defeat a Level 5 team with a perfect rating of 100.

5dde385041aa7364.overview:
King Bowser and his turtle-like Koopa army invade the Mushroom Kingdom, transforming its inhabitants into inanimate objects and kidnapping Princess Toadstool. Players control Mario, or his brother Luigi in multiplayer mode, through right-scrolling stages to reach a flagpole at each area end. Mario avoids pits, hits question mark bricks for coins or items, and encounters power-ups including the Magic Mushroom, Fire Flower, and Starman. Collecting a Magic Mushroom doubles the character in size and allows him to break overhead bricks. Reaching the final stronghold permits players to defeat Bowser with an axe or fireballs.

Target shooting provides an alternate mode utilizing a light gun aimed at the television screen. Across three selectable game variations, players shoot at airborne ducks, one or two at a time and ten per round, or at clay pigeons launched in pairs, with three shots per appearance. In one mode, a second participant can control the duck targets using a standard controller.

5e2aac273c63b389.overview:
Jeopardy! Junior Edition simulates a television trivia contest. One to three participants can enter alone, against one another, or against computer rivals, using up to two controllers. Each human contestant spells out a name and selects a character portrait. Matches feature three skill levels that set the time limit for responding to questions.

Contestants choose among six categories and cash wagers. Once a clue appears, players race to buzz in and spell out the matching question on an alphabet and number grid. Successful responses add the wager to a player's earnings, whereas mistakes deduct funds and permit rivals to buzz. Play spans a primary round with one hidden Daily Double, a Double Jeopardy! round with doubled cash values and two Daily Doubles, and Final Jeopardy!, where qualifying participants wager their earnings on one closing clue.
