The top earner wins.

5ee479ef04d80366.official: That Evil Witch Doctor never gives up! Not content with kidnapping Princess Leilani in the first Adventure Island, now he’s swiped her sister Tina! Eight islands of perilous platform action stand between you and your sweetheart. Prepare to battle dinosaurs, survive avalanches and outwit the Witch Doctor’s minions. Higgins is helped by four dinosaurs with abilities on land, sea and even in the air.
5ee479ef04d80366.overview:
Rescuing Tina from the Evil Witch Doctor requires Master Higgins to travel across eight perilous islands. Players direct Higgins through standard, underwater, and vertical-scrolling stages, facing monster minions and avalanches. An inventory system lets players choose whether to bring accumulated stone axes or friendly dinosaurs into upcoming levels. Striking concealed eggs reveals bonus rooms, shortcuts to subsequent islands, or keys. At the conclusion of a stage, players pick one of eight circling eggs, which decides the next stage.

Four rideable dinosaurs provide varied traits across different environments. A blue camptosaurus attacks with its tail and walks securely on ice, a red camptosaurus breathes fire and withstands lava, a pteranodon flies and drops stones, and an elasmosaurus increases swimming speed underwater. Each island ends with a boss battle, though defeat causes the boss to move elsewhere.

5f8807999205f380.overview:
Players take to the baseball diamond to compete in full sporting matches. When managing a lineup, participants can substitute active pitchers or batters, view roster ratings during a contest, and shift defensive field formations. Batters can change position at the plate, swing high or low, and bunt, while base runners can lead off and steal bases.

Team management permits hiring and releasing athletes alongside an upgrade system that uses earned money to assign skill points. Up to two players can compete, with options to establish full league schedules and track statistical leaderboards.

5f981ab1988614a9.overview:
Krusty's Fun House centers on puzzle-solving gameplay based on the animated series The Simpsons. Players control Krusty the Clown as he navigates the maze-like environments of his Fun House. The objective across each stage involves guiding groups of small rats toward an extermination device. To accomplish this, the clown manipulates various objects and obstacles to construct a clear route that the creatures follow to reach the trap.

Hostile animals and entities wander the areas to obstruct the player's progress and cause injury, including birds, flying pigs, aliens, and snakes. Krusty defends himself by tossing pies to defeat these enemy threats. Across the levels, different characters operate the destination extermination machines, featuring appearances by Homer and Bart, among others.

5fa346174b6b5a9d.overview:
Guiding the character Q*bert, the player hops diagonally across a pyramid of cubes to turn every square into a designated target color. Progression to subsequent stages requires altering each block, either through a single landing or multiple hits depending on the stage. In later stages, landing on a square a third time changes it back to its original color. Leaping beyond the structure causes the protagonist to fall to his death.

Various adversaries complicate navigation, including Ugg, Wrong-Way, Slick, Sam and a snake named Coily. Slick and Sam revert converted squares to their original color, and falling Whammy Balls eliminate a life upon contact. Collecting small green balls briefly freezes opponents, while Whirly-Discs along the pyramid edges transport the character back to the summit. Up to two players can participate, working through nine levels of four stages each.

60061c0042741f7c.overview:
A single adventurer wanders the fantasy town of Hillsfar, undertaking quests and navigating mini-games. The player begins by generating a custom character or selecting a pre-made hero, choosing attributes like race, alignment, and class from cleric, fighter, magic-user, or thief. Attributes receive randomized values during creation.

Gameplay alternates between quest-based adventure and action challenges. The hero visits the guild of their class to find assignments. Outside of assigned missions, the player explores freely, traveling across landscapes and hunting for treasure. The story unfolds differently for each of the four classes, offering a distinct adventure with each one.

60667bc0ed1c0c63.overview:
A stockbroker seeks to claim a six-hundred-billion-dollar inheritance from the extremely wealthy Benedict family. To prove worthy of this fortune, the protagonist starts with $500,000 in seed money and must increase that sum to $1,000,000 to afford the first required purchase, a house, within a game spanning four months.

Players navigate the stock market by trading shares in fictional businesses, with paid advice from Stanley and hot tips from Connie. Earning profits allows the stockbroker to shop on weekends, purchase costly items including a house, and spoil his girlfriend, Prisila. He must also keep up his health and love life, though time spent on either is time away from the market. The game terminates in failure if the player cannot accumulate adequate funds to secure essential items such as a boat or a house, resulting in the family disowning the broker.

60a7d102deac7491.overview:
Players search across visual scenes to locate Waldo as well as various target objects. Directional inputs guide a magnifying glass around the panoramic landscapes to survey each expansive environment and pinpoint the requested items. Waldo is helping his friend, the wizard Whitebeard, recover five lost magic scrolls, and each level is cleared by finding both Waldo and a scroll before the clock runs out.

Levels featured throughout the quest include Land of the Gargantuas, Kingdom of the Carpet Flyers, Water Monks vs. Fire Druids, The Enchanted Underground, and the Land of the Waldos. Finding Waldo's dog, Woof, in a stage leads to a bonus round where players navigate the dog on a flying carpet to accumulate extra points.

61bab3612f96371b.overview:
Set during the Stone Age, prehistoric athletes compete in an Olympic-themed sporting contest. Using combinations of inputs on the controller, players choose a competitor and take part in six prehistoric events against opponents or hazards.

Events include foot racing against a rival while evading obstacles and a pursuing saber-toothed tiger, competing to create a full-burning fire, and riding a dinosaur across an obstacle course. Other challenges involve spinning and throwing a mate for maximum distance, using a pole to vault over a dinosaur, and dueling with clubs to batter an opponent or knock them off a cliff. One to six players can participate in individual practice sessions or full tournament play.

61cb18d11771cffa.overview:
Four Mystery Castles structure the journey, each containing underground passages and complicated mazes. The player controls the apprentice Hao, who must explore above and below ground to recover four magical talismans representing wealth, wisdom, happiness, and peace. Hao must navigate through block-based structures, avoid environmental hazards like deep water, spikes, and skulls, and reach castle exits.

Controlling Hao involves jumping, ducking, and firing projectiles at enemies and breakable blocks. Defeating larger monsters yields keys needed to open locked doors. Hao can discover power-up equipment, including boots and helmets that allow him to shatter blocks by jumping or headbutting, as well as protective cloaks and lamps. Vitality items like dolls and moons restore or increase his health, while items like the SOS raft grant temporary survival in water.

61e4e0a38f23eec3.overview:
Presented across vertically scrolling action sequences, the game places the player in command of a rapid, potent helicopter. Flying through waves of opposing aircraft, the primary objective centers on destroying the enemy motherships. Either a single participant can undertake the mission, or two players may join together in cooperative play.

Aircraft status relies on an energy meter, which begins at 66 and represents both fuel and health. Normal flight steadily depletes this reserve, and taking enemy fire causes it to drop significantly. Destroyed enemy vehicles drop power-ups, some of which restore this meter. Should the counter run down completely from flying, normal consumption stops and the helicopter keeps flying.

622c62d48aa244fb.overview:
Ninja Kid pairs action stages with an overhead map of Demon Island. Gates on the map lead into four kinds of fighting fields, each with its own goal: defeating 10 demons in Guerilla Warfare, collecting 10 demon spirits in the Poison Fields, beating 10 demons from a kite in the Dog Fight, and lighting 10 candles in the Blazing Inferno. A Mystery Field can hold any of the four. Clearing a field reveals two doors: one returns to the map, the other leads into Demon Hell, a vertically scrolling stage ruled by a giant demon.

Special weapons such as the Iron Star, Boomerang, Feather and Fireflame appear as objectives are met. After finding the special scroll and receiving the chanting spell at the old witch's house, the player can enter the Demon Castle. Whistles let Ninja Kid call up to three friends, Pegasus, Big Eagle and the Old Witch, by moving to the left side of the screen and squatting.

622ef597b328a204.overview:
Eight distinct areas structure the adventure, each requiring specific tasks to clear before advancing. Players control the Lone Ranger on a mission to rescue the President from Butch Cavendish. Starting on an overhead map with advice from Tonto, the player navigates to towns, caves, and abandoned railroad cars while fending off roving bandits. In some areas, a Sheriff's Badge appears to reveal a secret location once enough information has been gathered. Top-down settlements allow interactions with residents for clues, medical healing, and purchases of better guns, ammunition, or explosives using cash gathered from defeated outlaws. Completing each area grants a password.

Gameplay switches across three perspectives: top-down, side-scrolling, and first-person corridors. Combat incorporates fists, dynamite, and a revolver loaded with standard or piercing silver ammunition. Side-scrolling sequences add platform jumping, stair climbing, and crouching. First-person segments focus on maze exploration where outlaws ambush from four directions, guided by an onscreen radar.

6280ffb211b03ccc.overview:
Hitting all targets with tomatoes within a limited amount of time to reveal and collect a key serves as the central objective in Fun House. Presented from a basic top-down perspective, the action tasks the player with guiding a rollerblader across seventy-two named rooms to find a way out. Along the way, the skater must throw tomatoes at numbered or generic targets while contending with environmental hazards such as icy floors and slime-covered ramps. The name of each room often gives a clue about it.

Players start with three rollerbladers, and each room must be cleared before its timer runs out to move on to the next. Television host J. D. Roth also appears. Collecting twenty-five silver coins provides an extra chance, glop clocks add extra seconds, and finding warp cubes enables access to later rooms.

628d6696c7ac84c3.overview:
Five levels make up the adventure, with boss encounters along the way. Players control martial arts stunt master Jackie Chan on a quest to rescue his twin sister Josephine, fighting past numerous hostile minions and creatures. Defeated targets generally drop Bonus Jade, and gathering 30 of these items restores life points along with psycho wave charges. Jackie can execute special attacks, including limited-use psycho waves. Frogs carrying energy bowls or technique items appear throughout the stages, requiring a punch or kick to surrender their contents. Eating energy bowls restores health, while items provide limited-use special moves like spin kicks.

A single life is provided, though the game can be continued. Reaching a bell transports the character to bonus areas with tasks such as hopping across clouds. Points tallied after these challenges automatically go toward replenishing life points, psycho waves, or extra continues.

62a3551ce546fa7d.overview:
Stopping the hooligans wrecking New York City, and the Noid look-alike Mr. Green who seems to be behind the antics, serves as the main goal. The player guides the Noid, who uses a yo-yo to strike enemies and open large scrolls containing symbols for magic spells that attack the hooligans. Magic power gathered by jumping through smaller scrolls fuels these spells. Because the protagonist lacks a life meter, touching an adversary or running out of time causes the loss of a life, and each round starts with 140 units of time.

Most stages require traversal on foot across areas such as the Wharf, Central Park and the rooftops, but certain sections place the character on the HyperBoard skateboard, inside the Ornithopter flying machine or atop the bouncing Pizza Crusher. After every odd-numbered round, the Noid competes in a pizza-eating duel that serves as the boss battle.

62aec65696ecf24a.official: Do you have what it takes to be the fastest gun in the West? Wild Gunman pits you against quick-drawing outlaws to see if you can beat them with speed and accuracy. Three game modes let you take on one outlaw, or two at the same time, or a whole gang of them. Keep a cool head and a steady trigger finger, and show those outlaws who’s the quickest on the draw.
62aec65696ecf24a.overview:
Defeating quick-drawing outlaws by demonstrating superior speed and accuracy serves as the primary goal. Set in the West, this single-player game requires the player to operate the Zapper light gun to take aim and eliminate opponents before they can shoot.

Duels require careful timing, as the player must wait for an adversary's eyes to flash alongside an on-screen prompt reading FIRE before discharging their weapon. Pulling the trigger prematurely results in a foul and counts as a loss, with the game concluding after three losses. Three distinct game modes are offered, allowing the player to confront a single enemy, two adversaries simultaneously, or an entire gang that appears in windows and doorways.

62fa1b7ec8e92638.overview:
Play proceeds across turns as participants oversee different territories. The game centers on strategic management, requiring rulers to administer Chinese provinces.

Throughout the experience, players make administrative choices to govern these regional domains. Up to eight players can take part in this strategic simulation of provincial control.

635271fe654636ec.official: What rookie boxer Little Mac lacks in size, he makes up for in determination. And with trainer Doc Louis by his side, Little Mac is ready to win big! NES classic Punch-Out!! pits your pint-sized pugilist against such diverse rivals as the fragile-jawed Frenchman Glass Joe, sucker-punching Russian Soda Popinski and the Hollywood heavyweight Super Macho Man. Use jabs, body blows, hooks and uppercuts to discover your opponent's weak spot and make the knockout blow.
635271fe654636ec.overview:
Rookie boxer Little Mac strives to rise through the ranks of the World Video Boxing Association alongside trainer Doc Louis. Supervised by referee Mario, bouts take place across three circuits before leading to a final Dream Fight. Matches can end through a knockout when an opponent fails to rise within ten seconds, a technical knockout after three knockdowns in one round, or a decision on match points if time runs out in the third round.

Controlling Mac, the player dodges, ducks, blocks, and delivers left or right punches to the face and body to expose opponent weaknesses. Landing effective punches awards stars that enable a powerful uppercut, up to a maximum of three. Sustaining hits or having thrown strikes blocked or dodged depletes Mac's hearts, leaving him temporarily exhausted and incapable of punching until incoming blows are avoided. Experiencing three total losses terminates the game.

63e867e7ea89b5bf.overview:
Sesame Street - Big Bird's Hide & Speak is an educational game designed around memory, letter recognition, and spelling exercises. Players navigate through six different activities selected from a main menu featuring six windows. In each activity, players move Little Bird across window ledges with the directional pad and make choices using the action buttons. Spoken voice clips from Big Bird provide directions, hints, and confirmations throughout the exercises.

The activities feature Sesame Street characters including Ernie, Bert, Elmo, Grover, and The Count appearing in the windows of a house. In the first four games, rounds consist of four questions focusing on locating spoken characters, recalling which window hidden friends entered, finding spoken letters, and remembering hidden letter locations. The final two games challenge players to assemble three-letter words prompted by Big Bird or create as many three-letter words as possible before the sunset timer expires.

644291444ae16a02.overview:
Roundball: 2-on-2 Challenge presents half-court basketball matches featuring two-on-two competitions. Action takes place inside an arena equipped with a scoreboard and spectators. Players can select athletes from a roster of twenty-four, each possessing distinct personal statistics. During play on the court, an officiating referee enforces rules by calling fouls.

Contests offer multiple setup options, including a one-on-one match variant alongside the standard two-on-two format. Game modes include exhibition play and a two-on-two tournament in which the chosen team plays through three rounds: Semi-Final, Final, and Championship. Quarters can be configured to last four, eight, twelve, or sixteen minutes. Up to four people can play with an optional four-player adapter.

6449c6d072fd1df1.overview:
World Games features international athletic competitions across several events. Up to eight players enter their names and select countries to represent before competing. Modes allow participation in all events, a selected subset, or a single practice event where scores are not recorded. Gold, silver, and bronze medals go to the top three competitors in each discipline, while the overall leader across all events receives the title of Grand Champion.

Events test distinct physical skills through specialized timing and directional inputs. Contests include weight lifting with snatch and clean-and-jerk techniques, barrel jumping on ice skates, cliff diving, slalom skiing around gates, spinning log rolling against an opponent, bull riding, and the Scottish caber toss. Successful performances produce higher scores or faster times, and top achievements are saved on a world records screen during the play session.

648f68ae58f34200.overview:
Directing cue shots around a pool table, the player aims to sink balls and accumulate points. Scoring relies on successfully sinking targets and clearing them in sequential numerical order. Hitting targets into pockets marked by flashing stars grants special bonuses, which provide additional points or an extra ball. Cue actions support distinct techniques, allowing the player to apply various spins and execute masse shots.

Play progresses through a series of classes while operating under a limited supply of cue balls. Missing two shots or scratching costs a ball, and maintaining a sufficient score is required to proceed. After all balls are pocketed, a trick shot must also be performed to advance. Other modes include lesson and practice training, a two-player Pocket Game over five sets, and two-player 9 Ball.

649db8035018f251.official: Metroids - the most dangerous creatures in the galaxy - have fallen into the hands of Space Pirates! As bounty hunter Samus Aran, battle through the depths of planet Zebes to take out the pirates’ leader Mother Brain and restore peace to the galaxy. The original NES classic Metroid introduced gamers to a unique mix of action and exploration that has become the series’ trademark.
649db8035018f251.overview:
Destroying the Mother Brain and stopping the space pirates' plan to multiply the stolen Metroid are the ultimate goals of bounty hunter Samus Aran. Players direct Samus through the cavernous subterranean landscape of planet Zebes, navigating two-dimensional interconnected environments connected by doors and elevators. She starts the mission equipped with only a standard jump and a weak, short-range beam. Exploring the world reveals hidden upgrades, while vanquished foes sometimes drop energy or ammunition.

Progress relies on acquiring equipment that grants new mobility and combat capabilities to access sealed regions. Samus can collect the Maru Mari to roll through narrow passageways, lay bombs to uncover concealed paths, and perform a somersaulting Screw Attack to destroy adversaries. Other collectible gear includes the Ice Beam, Varia, missiles, and capacity-expanding tanks. Players must also locate and defeat two Mini-Bosses, Kraid and Ridley, before unlocking the route to the final confrontation.

667bcf3ca1ebcf6f.overview:
A devil named Mandora and his monster forces have driven humanity into the ocean depths. Taking control of a fighter craft, the player flies into vertical combat to eliminate opposing aerial forces and ground targets in an effort to reclaim the Earth.

Destroying hangars releases numbered fighter parts that dock directly with the craft. Up to four attachments add weaponry such as double shots, backward shots and a rear barrier, while also shielding the vessel from incoming strikes. Pressing the A button separates the docked parts into a battle formation whose pattern depends on how many parts are attached, and an on-screen counter limits how often formations can be used. When fully assembled with every component, the craft temporarily changes into an invincible Fire Bird. A design mode lets players arrange their own formations by setting part positions and beam directions.

66cb74efa264a285.overview:
An alien civilization has placed a gigantic dormant spacecraft on the moon, programmed to harvest the elements of the solar system in a process that would destroy the Earth. As Moon Ranger, the player must locate the four pieces of the Gamma Bomb and then destroy the Element Converter on the moon's surface.

The eight levels alternate between space levels, flown in the MRATV (Moon Ranger All Terrain Vehicle), and levels inside asteroid bases, on the lunar surface, and in the moonbase. Both the vehicle and Moon Ranger can jump using compressed gas jets. Each new life starts with a basic plasma bolt, and five other weapon systems can be picked up along the way. Energy Cores recharge the MRATV's shields in space, while Health Potions restore suit armor in the bases.

66d4beb992a64632.overview:
Directing an on-screen hand, the player selects and moves chess pieces across the board to play chess. The game supports special rules including castling, en passant pawn captures, and pawn promotions to other pieces when reaching the far row. Standard chess matches can be played against the computer opponent, viewed with the computer playing itself, or played between two human participants who alternate turns using either controller when Black moves.

A dedicated menu offers sixteen difficulty settings ranging from newcomer tiers to time-regulated levels and an infinite thought option. Additional gameplay features include a setup mode to custom-position pieces, a replay mode to take back or review prior moves, and an option to solve for checkmates within five turns. Matches can be viewed as a full board or in a War Room display that tracks captured units, recent moves, and computer calculations.

678565338a9efa2d.overview:
Completing a global scavenger hunt while surviving encounters with Mr. Burns' relatives and agents is the primary objective. Guiding Bart Simpson through four major territories—China, the North Pole, Egypt, and Hollywood—the single-player side-scrolling platformer features several stages per zone. Bart can withstand five strikes before perishing, but Squishees restore his health, and firecracker balls provide protection against enemies. Finding a cape briefly transforms him into Bartman, allowing flight. Family members appear throughout the journey, providing or revealing rare Krusty merchandise when Bart touches them or when they perform specific actions.

Securing each souvenir unlocks a bonus Hollywood stage alongside the top ending sequence. Concluding stages within every territory require confronting a boss related to Mr. Burns, including Fu Manchu Burns, The Abominable Snow Burns, Ramses Burns, and Eric von Burns. Each territory also incorporates single-screen mini-games, such as card matching, sliding puzzles, and Simpsons trivia.

6799437d4122b81c.official: Experience the original adventure of Ryu Hayabusa, the shadow warrior, in this acclaimed and challenging action-platformer from the NES era! Ninja Gaiden sees Ryu travel to America to seek vengeance for his father’s murder and uncover a plot that threatens the world, as told through unique anime-style cutscenes.
6799437d4122b81c.overview:
Six acts containing twenty side-scrolling levels structure the adventure. Players direct the ninja Ryu Hayabusa on a journey to America to avenge his murdered father and stop an antagonist calling himself Jaquio from taking over the world. Ryu can run, crouch, jump, climb ladders, and spring off walls to ascend vertical spaces, though he cannot attack while on ladders. Animated cinematic cutscenes present the narrative between areas.

Ryu primarily strikes foes using his Dragon Sword katana. Found inside street lights, lamps and other holders along the way, collectible items provide bonus points, health restoration, extra lives, five-second enemy freezes, temporary invincibility, or spiritual strength. Gathering spiritual strength fuels secondary weapons such as throwing stars, returning windmill stars, the fire wheel technique, and mid-air jump slashes. Ryu loses a life if his physical health depletes or the timer expires. Each act concludes with a boss battle.

67b8a39744807dd7.overview:
Reaching the exit in each top-down labyrinth while defeating monsters and gathering treasure serves as the primary goal, on a quest to recover the Sacred Orb from Morak the Evil One. Navigating through successive mazes, participants combat various fantasy creatures that emerge from destructible monster generators. Thor the warrior, Merlin the wizard, Thyra the valkyrie, or Questor the elf can be chosen, each possessing individual strengths such as superior physical strikes, magic potency, defensive armor, or movement speed. Contact with adversaries reduces character power, and the game ends when it runs out.

Survival depends on locating special pick-ups scattered throughout the corridors. These items unlock locked doorways, wipe out on-screen foes, or restore depleted vitality, while magic potions grant lasting extra abilities. Foes range from ghosts and sorcerers to demons, lobbers, grunts, and Death, an adversary immune to shots that drains a large amount of power before vanishing. Up to two players can explore the dungeons together.

67e2a8ab48af329e.overview:
This cartridge collects six games: Cosmos Cop, Magic Carpet, Balloon Monster, Adam and Eve, Porter, and Bookyman.

Cosmos Cop is a space shooter in which the hero fires an unlimited cannon and a limited supply of Neutron Missiles across six missions against the Beta Star invaders. In Magic Carpet, Prince Aladdin rides a magic carpet and shoots arrows at goblins and monsters through four levels to rescue the princess of Baghdad. Balloon Monster has the player shoot bouncing balloons that split into four smaller ones when hit, across 50 levels.

In Adam and Eve, for one or two players, the characters float on balloons, puncture the balloons on the monsters' heads, and kick the monsters away. Porter is a box-pushing puzzle with five timed levels, and in Bookyman a beetle cleans the streets while avoiding two lizards, using a Bulldozer Brush to chase them off.

682a0629d25275a9.overview:
Frankenstein - The Monster Returns is an action game with side-scrolling beat-'em-up elements. Following the resurrection of the monster Frankenstein and the abduction of the village elder's daughter, Emily, the player sets out across four levels to rescue her. Progress requires moving through each stage while defeating opposing creatures with punches and kicks. Within the stages, the player engages boss monsters requiring multiple hits to overcome, which yield rewards such as increased life and special weapons upon defeat.

Items appear inside treasure chests, drop from defeated enemies, or come from characters encountered during the journey. Available weapons include clubs, swords, and maces, though sustaining enemy hits lowers weapon strength. Projectile options include fire, bombs, slings, and red balls. Hearts restore health, stored life items can be consumed later, and blue potions replenish energy and raise the maximum energy level.

683c49e4ea3f4b17.overview:
Rockin' Kats presents side-scrolling platform gameplay centered on an anthropomorphic cat named Willy. When a canine crime boss named Mugsy abducts Willy's girlfriend, Willy sets out across New York City to defeat the criminal gang. Armed with an extendable punch gun, the protagonist can attack enemies, pick up and hurl objects, and latch onto surfaces to swing across obstacles. Players choose from the first four television channels in any order before unlocking the fifth stage, traversing settings such as city streets, an amusement park, the wild west, and the exterior of a moving aircraft.

Throughout the journey, players collect cash to purchase upgrades, including jet sneakers, bombs, additional lives, and weapon enhancements from a shopping screen. A bonus channel offers minigames to earn extra funds and lives. Passwords allow players to resume progress. After the main credits, an additional stage becomes available that removes saved items and restricts lives.

687963e7fd128345.overview:
Sqoon tasks the player with piloting a submarine in a side-scrolling shooter. Following an invasion by the Neptunians, who melted Earth's polar ice caps to submerge the continents and capture humans for food, the Earth Defense Army recruits a pirate named Narikeen to fight back. Players navigate the underwater setting to destroy enemy aliens and free human survivors.

The submarine defends itself using missiles against hostile targets and a downward-firing ice ball gun to demolish factories and the domes holding captives. Up to nine survivors can be carried inside the vessel at once. Unloading these rescued humans onto a small motorized island grants power-ups and restores fuel. The craft carries a sixty-second fuel supply that depletes continuously, and running out of fuel or touching enemies costs the player a life.

687e4129be3b8e22.overview:
Multiple gameplay modes structure the adventure, beginning with Robin Hood escaping an Arab prison alongside Azeem and Peter Dubois. Upon returning to England, Robin discovers his father was killed and that the Sheriff of Nottingham governs unjustly. Robin seeks out outlaw allies hiding in Sherwood Forest, establishing a home base where he continually receives and completes missions, culminating in a final confrontation to remove the Sheriff.

Standard exploration occurs from an overhead perspective, directing Robin through environments while fighting hostile soldiers. Other sequences shift mechanics: side-view duels allow Robin to jump, flip, and strike single opponents; high-angle overhead views manage large clashes between rival armies; and horseback sequences have Robin leaping over obstacles during high-speed rides. An equipment system lets players place items in either of Robin's hands, with each hand tied to its own action button.

6887230077d8eefa.overview:
Guiding Geraden, Duke of Menlary, the player battles hostile legions across platforming environments to rescue Princess Amoreena from the Dragon Cub and the Dragon Master Darklarza. Crouch maneuvers allow the Duke to protect himself using his shield as he confronts threats.

The quest leads to Darklarza Castle, where Geraden must face the Dragon Master himself. Geraden starts with only a basic sword. Defeating certain bosses yields armor and new weapons such as throwing knives, a mace, the Sonic Sword, which emits a deadly sound wave, and the Lightning Sword; the two special swords last only a limited time. Fairies, the souls of Darklarza's escaped victims, bring the gift of life, and the Dragon Slayer is the only weapon strong enough to pierce the Dragon Master's flesh.

68a6f5ef79892e49.official: Play the game of your dreams! You can become Ivan Lendl or Chris Evert, and you'll feel all the action of the courts as you face world-class opponents on your way to the "Grand Slam". But first you have to play the Asmik Open to qualify to play in the four following major tournaments: The Australian Open, The French Open, Wimbledon, and The U.S. Open.
68a6f5ef79892e49.overview:
Athletes take the court in Chris Evert & Ivan Lendl in Top Players' Tennis, where competitors serve, rally, and volley across three-set matches. Participants can select Chris Evert, Ivan Lendl, or build a custom male or female athlete. On the court, button inputs determine whether serves are fast or slow, while groundstroke distance increases by holding a button down. Players hit lobs with a separate button, add topspin, slice, or side spin with the directional pad, and spend miracle points to execute miracle shots such as spiral, split, speed, return, or lob variations.

Singles mode tasks players with earning qualification through the Asmik Open before entering the Australian Open, French Open, Wimbledon, and U.S. Open tournaments. Custom athletes start with attributes distributed among eight statistics, which increase through bonus points awarded for victories, with progress recorded using passwords. Doubles supports up to four simultaneous participants with selectable tournament venues, while two-player versus matches offer hard, clay, and grass court surfaces.

68e98b1b8dc5da61.overview:
Five stages structure the underwater adventure as Ariel journeys toward Ursula's Castle. The stages begin in the Sea of Coral and continue through the Sunken Ship, Sea of Ice, and Undersea Volcano, concluding at the castle, where Ariel must defeat the sea witch Ursula.

The player controls Ariel, who navigates the depths and swishes her tail to trap swimming foes in bubbles and push them into other enemies. Ariel uncovers hidden treasure by digging through sandy patches and uses collected sea shells to crack open chests. Inside chests and scattered across the environments, collectible icons grant extra lives, replenish health, or boost the power and firing distance of her bubble attacks.

690ec2de233486d9.overview:
Set within the artificial Spondylus Solar System, the story follows Professor Proteus attempting to halt a destructive computer virus deployed by his former associate, Dr. Brainius. Across seven distinct worlds, this single-player adventure alternates between outdoor planetary combat and indoor exploratory missions, ending once the infected life support computers on all seven planets are shut down.

Outdoor surface levels put the player in command of the Cyborasaurus, a mechanical dinosaur that can jump and gain a protective barrier shield. These segments focus on battling giant enemy Robosaurs using an array of armaments, such as a Launch Fist, Bombs, Lazer Beams, and Fire Balls. Upon entering a planet's Artificial Intelligence Compound, gameplay shifts to Man Mode. In these platforming segments, players guide Proteus on foot through interior corridors, employing a vaporizing gun to negotiate hazards and shut down life support computers.

6918d7cbb81bfcd2.official: The planet Gradius is doomed. Only you – at the helm of the prototype Vic Viper fighter – can first save Gradius and then the galaxy from the evil Bacterions. The first in the classic series, Gradius introduced the now familiar system of collecting capsules to boost your ship's abilities; missiles, increased speed, laser beam, force field and more.
6918d7cbb81bfcd2.overview:
Defending the planet Gradius and destroying the Bacterion superfortress Xaerous serves as the primary objective for the player. Piloting the Warp Rattler starship, the player flies through horizontally scrolling environments filled with hostile alien formations. Combat involves dodging enemy projectiles while targeting waves of attackers and massive bosses, whose vulnerable cores or biological weak points must be shot and destroyed.

Collecting red power capsules allows the pilot to advance selections on a power boost meter displayed at the bottom of the screen. Activating highlighted choices enhances the ship with boosted engine speed, air-to-surface missiles, a laser beam, trailing options, or protective force fields. Two players can take turns competing in alternating play.

691ef0807cacd703.overview:
Seven stages structure this journey, taking the feline protagonist through the West, the ocean, Arabia, the skies of Space Wars, London, Liberty, and finally New York. The player guides Pero, the cat known as Puss N' Boots, whom Count Gruemon and the wolf scientist Dr. Gari-gari sent on a time-travel journey into the past after he helped a mouse escape. To get home, Pero must defeat both villains and use their Time Machine, while Killers from the Cat Kingdom pursue him.

Navigating these locales requires the player to walk on foot as well as pilot various vehicles, including a ship, a submarine, a car, an airplane, and a balloon. Pero can switch between weapons such as a gun, bombs, and a boomerang, while items include Boots for temporary invincibility, Hamburgers that restore energy, and Pero Marks that award extra lives.

6928e8c589d6d9cc.overview:
Four elite soldiers known as the Jackals must infiltrate hostile enemy territory inside armed jeeps to locate and rescue captured prisoners of war. The mission crosses six enemy territories and ends when the players destroy the enemy's main fortress at the end of the sixth.

Players maneuver an armed jeep equipped with an upward-firing machine gun and directional grenades to eliminate opposing forces, artillery, and buildings. Prisoners freed from destroyed barracks ride in the jeep to a heliport, where helicopters pick them up. Rescuing prisoners and powering up replaces the hand grenades with a bazooka. The player starts with three jeeps and earns an extra one after rescuing a set number of prisoners. Two players can play simultaneously.

69300586af39342f.overview:
Completing all 23 stages of aerial combat, collecting plans from trucks at two landing fields, and returning safely to the aircraft carrier form the objective of this single-player shooter. The mission begins as an F-14 Thunder Cat fighter aircraft launches from an aircraft carrier into combat.

Viewed from a third-person perspective behind the aircraft, combat requires piloting the jet to shoot down hostile targets. The plane uses a Vulcan cannon alongside a limited quantity of guided missiles to eliminate opposition. In bonus stages at designated refueling sites, a Navy fuel tanker flies overhead or a landing base appears so the jet can reload fuel and missiles.

69399633df5ea1ba.overview:
Defeating a deadly extraterrestrial force that has commandeered Earth's military provides the primary goal for the player. Casting the user as the sole human immune to alien domination, the game tasks the protagonist with eliminating controlled hostile forces across eight diverse stages. Settings range from a besieged city with a munitions factory and nuclear reactor to a scorching desert and a dark forest, and bosses stand in the way.

Throughout the journey, flying objects carry additional weapons, such as a shotgun and a machine gun, which the character can shoot down and jump to collect. Defeated enemies occasionally leave hearts that replenish the player's health meter. This life gauge consists of three shields positioned in the top-left area of the screen, with each strike from an enemy or enemy shot depleting half a shield. The operative begins each run with three lives to expend.

69bc9f0a2f0cd50d.overview:
F-117A Stealth Fighter simulates aerial combat flight. Piloting a stealth aircraft, the player undertakes a succession of combat sorties aimed at destroying designated ground targets while engaging hostile aircraft in flight. Before flying, the player picks from predefined weapons packages that combine air-to-air and air-to-ground missiles, and a second player can join as the Weapons System Officer, handling the cannon, missiles and decoys.

The game structures its stages around theaters of operations: Libya 1986, Middle East 1989, Gulf War 1991, Cuba 1995, Korea 1996 and North Cape 1998. Libya comes first, and each success opens further theaters. The later theaters are hypothetical conflicts, such as renegade generals of the former Soviet military armed with nuclear weapons, and pilots who succeed in all six may be selected for classified secret missions.

69cf1773c23606cd.overview:
Jimmy Connors Tennis depicts tennis matches featuring the name and likeness of Jimmy Connors. Participants can engage in standard tournament competition or simply practice hitting tennis balls on the court.

In the tournament season, players compete in the finals of sixteen tournaments around the world, including Wimbledon and the Australian, French and US Opens, earning prize money for each victory; the richest player wins. Matches last one, three or five sets, and a single player chooses a Beginner, Intermediate or Advanced opponent. Two players can face one another in tournament matches, and a password shown after each tournament allows play to resume later. In practice, a machine feeds 100, 200 or 300 balls at a chosen level, or two players alternate serves.

69d26e6e849a103c.overview:
Contestants guide a flying star cursor across a game board to uncover numbered doors and solve hidden rebus puzzles. On each turn, the active player chooses two doors to reveal hidden prizes. Finding a pair opens both doors, unveils sections of the rebus beneath, and awards the player an opportunity to solve the puzzle or take bonus door selections. Wild cards provide automatic matches that uncover extra puzzle spaces. When guessing the solution, players spell words using an alphabet selection screen.

Matches can be played either solo against a computer rival or between two human contestants taking turns. Claiming two rounds advances the winner to a timed final round featuring fifteen doors and hidden car names. Finding seven car matches within thirty-five seconds awards the vehicle. Players can also record and input four-letter codes to cycle through puzzles without encountering repeats.

69de2c7552fa81ca.official: Mike Jones is an ordinary kid on an extraordinary adventure. When his archaeologist uncle goes missing on a tropical island, Mike sets off to uncover the dark secrets lurking in paradise. StarTropics boasts two styles of gameplay: explore the island on foot or in your uncle’s submarine, and battle monsters using a variety of weapons and items.
69de2c7552fa81ca.overview:
Rescuing an abducted archaeologist uncle from alien captors is the primary mission driving the journey across tropical islands. Taking control of teenager Mike Jones from a top-down view, the player travels on foot through island settlements or navigates open waters inside a submarine. Exploring towns allows the protagonist to converse with islanders, gathering clues to advance the storyline across multiple chapters.

Entering a tunnel or cave starts a battle stage filled with hostile creatures and hidden weapons and items. Players confront monsters and overcome environmental obstacles primarily utilizing a yo-yo, while later uncovering other tools and baseball-themed armaments. Certain points require referencing an external physical letter included with the game to expose a secret code needed to proceed.

6a0c8be0f6445d9d.official: Experience the first ever football game for the NES! Soccer offers a choice between seven teams (Brazil, Germany, Spain, France, England, Japan and the USA) and five difficulty levels. Play solo against the computer or compete against a friend in the two-player mode. Soccer was one of the first games to include penalty shootouts at the end of regulation time, and features an entertaining half-time show, too!
6a0c8be0f6445d9d.overview:
Matches are played across two halves selectable at lengths of fifteen, thirty, or forty-five minutes. Players can compete solo against a computer-controlled opponent across five difficulty settings, or two players can compete against one another. Before play begins, a selection is made from seven national teams, and regulation play can conclude with a penalty kick session if the score ends tied. A half-time show with cheerleaders is displayed between the halves.

Controlling the active team member, the player moves across a horizontally scrolling field to shoot the ball into the opposing goal. Dedicated buttons execute passes and shots. An overhead marker highlights the designated teammate positioned to receive a pass, while a shot arrow in front of the opposing goal determines shot direction. On defense, players can manually position teammates or steer the goalkeeper within the penalty area.

6b04b87ab30e8859.overview:
A terrorist organization called the Sinister Seven has abducted both a prominent scientist and IMF operative Shannon Reed. Tasked with solving this kidnapping case, the IMF team tracks their targets from the canals of Venice to the Swiss Alps, working through six areas to rescue the captives.

From a top-down view, the player directs three IMF operatives named Max, Grant, and Nicholas. Because each operative possesses different skills required to finish the mission, the player can pause and swap between them in the normal scrolling areas. Discretion remains critical throughout the mission. Harming civilians on the street gets the agent detained by a police helicopter, while being spotted by surveillance cameras inside enemy hideouts gets the agent locked up.

6b2004f30e7de67d.overview:
Collecting all of the eggs in the player's color on each island and then running home is the primary objective while evading pursuers. Taking control of one of two Dino-Mites, Spike or Bloop, the player navigates maze-like territory while avoiding one-eyed cavemen called Trogs that try to capture and eat the character. The Dino-Mite can punch enemies directly, though steep cliffs dropping into the sea, sticky tar pits, giant stone wheels, and fires pose constant hazards.

Assorted power-ups appear across the map to assist survival. Red flowers grant increased movement speed, ice cubes freeze the Trogs, lucky horseshoes provide a protective magic ring, hot tamales provide the ability to shoot fireballs, and pineapples transform the Dino-Mite into a giant Tyrannosaurus Rex capable of consuming the pursuing Trogs. Two players can compete simultaneously on the same screen, racing to be the first Dino-Mite home.

6c17c7bf2f7466eb.official: Lode Runner is an action-puzzle game that has spawned many sequels. Simple action blends with deviously designed stages, as you collect gold while avoiding enemy robots by digging holes in the floor. Use your brain and your reflexes to complete each puzzling stage and escape to the next. In addition to normal play, the game also features an edit mode that allows you to design your own stages, adding a new level of enjoyment.
6c17c7bf2f7466eb.overview:
Spanning 50 stages, this action-puzzle platformer presents multi-story brick environments filled with ladders, suspended hand-to-hand bars, and trapdoors. Players control a Galactic Commando tasked with collecting every piece of gold in each level and reaching the top of the screen to advance. While running through the stage, the commando must avoid enemy robots or guards that pursue the character and can also pick up gold bars. The character can drop from any height unharmed.

Defense relies on digging holes into brick surfaces to the character's sides, temporarily trapping pursuing guards and causing them to drop carried gold. Holes eventually refill, consuming trapped enemies and bringing new guards in at the top of the screen, but solid surfaces cannot be dug. A life is lost when an enemy catches the commando or the commando is trapped in a pit. Alongside the primary mode, an included edit mode allows players to create customized stages.

6c462c3fa07aab70.overview:
Four initial stages can be tackled in any sequence before a fifth stage opens. The narrative follows Nova, sent from SP Headquarters on the President's orders to put the Delta Foundation out of business after it builds a line of near-perfect fighting cyborgs and threatens to sell them to an unfriendly neighbor. Near the middle of each stage the player faces a dragon machine boss, and a final boss waits at the end of the stage.

Nova maneuvers through levels using a slide move and an assortment of weapons, including boomerangs and the Power Blade. Defeating the mid-stage bosses rewards players with collectible power suits that provide specialized abilities. The Newt Suit enables walking on walls and ceilings, the Wet Suit permits swimming, the Rocket Suit grants flight, and the Patriot Suit provides defensive benefits.

6c47c73eb510fb0f.overview:
A chef named Cookie attempts to reclaim his restaurant after a mad chef named Ohdove seizes it and mutant food takes over. To overcome this threat, Cookie must journey through his own establishment while confronting evil food monsters that inhabit the building.

Controlling Cookie, the player navigates through six levels of action while using kitchen utensils as weapons against the hostile food enemies. After fighting through these areas, the player faces Ohdove in a final battle.

6c705f7980a08b7a.overview:
Shooting red and white pinwheel targets attached to characters while keeping track of energy levels serves as the primary objective for players. Stages include a Western desert, a Monster Town filled with creatures such as witches, vampires, and ghosts, and outer space on the moon, followed by a bonus stage. Players operate the NES Zapper light gun to aim and fire across the various stages.

Missed shots drain energy, and running out of energy or time ends the game, though the Normal game offers a continue from the last stage. In the bonus stage, players shoot glass bottles while they flash white. A separate Party game lets one to four players take turns shooting moving pinwheels for the highest score.

6cc3a973288a4c3c.overview:
Venture environments spanning sunken ships, expansive oceans, and Atlantis form the setting of the journey. Players control King Neptune on a quest to restore harmony beneath the waves. Over the years, eight of his treasures have been stolen, and now even the magical Orb of Peace, the most powerful of them all, has been taken. Reclaiming this powerful relic and bringing it back to his royal castle serves as the primary objective of the excursion.

Defense relies on two offensive options: Bubble Bombs and projectiles termed Bolts of Goodness. The bolts free sea creatures that dark magic has turned into enemies, returning them to their normal form, while collected Bubble Bombs neutralize dark magic. Tear Drops increase the king's power, collecting 12 Sea Horses earns an extra life, and Dolphin Kings share secrets to help with the quest. Some doorways between the undersea realms require a Magic Key.

6ce321d32e524eae.overview:
Players navigate an on-screen menu using a control pad to select and launch any of fifteen different titles. The compilation gathers together Baby Boomer, Captain Comic, Challenge of the Dragon, Crystal Mines, Galactic Crusader, King Neptune's Adventure, Master Chu, and Menace Beach.

Also available to choose from the menu are Moon Ranger, Operation Secret Storm, Pesterminator: The Western Exterminator, The P'radikus Conflict, Raid 2020, Robodemons, and Secret Scout. Because the system provides no light gun hardware, Baby Boomer restricts play to its single-player mode operated entirely with the control pad.

6d0215929f2dfeee.overview:
Divided into progressive Air Fortresses, the mission requires navigating through structures composed of two distinct levels: an Air Base followed by the interior of the fortress itself.

Controlling Hal Bailman, the player responds to an invasion threatening the planet Farmel. Eight huge space fortresses, living entities that feed on defenseless civilizations, are on a collision course with Farmel after overpowering a defense armada sent by the Federation of Intergalactic Governments. Hal crosses each Air Base in a Light Blaster, collecting power items that set his starting energy, then enters the fortress, where flying drains energy, to destroy its Central Reactor and find the hidden escape hatch. A password shown on the Game Over screen allows play to resume from the same Air Base.

6d082c801942ce67.overview:
Set in second-century China, the story follows Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei, who raise armies to restore order against the Yellow Scarves bandits before taking on rival warlords across the land. Players travel the countryside, talk with townspeople, buy equipment and items, and stay at inns, which restore each Warlord's following of soldiers to full strength.

Battles are fought in rounds. Each Warlord can attack, use tactics, defend or use an item, and the leader can also order an All-Out attack that plays out the fight automatically, attempt a retreat, or get a spy report. Up to five Warlords fight at once; with six or seven in the party, the designated Strategist stays back and lends his magic-like tactics to the fighters. Captured enemy Warlords can be persuaded to join, for example with a Steed, and extra Warlords can wait in reserve at headquarters. A battery-backed save holds up to three games.

6d10e95fcbf4cd11.overview:
Flying the Mini Sea-Duck, Baloo picks up cargo for his customers, but Don Karnage and his gang of air pirates try to stop his deliveries. The player pilots the plane through eight rounds, from Over the Sea to The Snowy Alps, maneuvering through scrolling levels while dodging obstacles and shooting at hostile forces.

Throughout each stage, items can be picked up to restore strength, gain extra lives, collect money, and earn bonus points. The aircraft can also flip upside down to face and fly the other way. Every level concludes with a boss encounter, the last being the Iron Vulture, a huge flying fortress. After completing a stage, players can spend their collected earnings at Wildcat's hangar on upgrades for the Mini Sea-Duck before continuing forward. Bonus rounds put the player in control of Kit riding an airfoil, aiming to pop balloons for extra score.

6d694349435603c0.overview:
Stages across a map of American cities structure an adventure where Captain America and Hawkeye set out to defeat the Red Skull, who has captured Iron Man and Vision. Along with standard enemies, the heroes confront villains such as Ultron, Crossbones, and Mandarin while searching for hidden Key Crystals to exit each stage.

In the single-player quest, the player controls Captain America or Hawkeye, with the ability to switch between them. Characters engage in hand-to-hand combat and utilize signature ranged weapons like Captain America's shield and Hawkeye's arrows to crack open item pods or tackle adversaries. A competitive two-player Battle Mode is also featured, pitting a hero controlled by Player One against Wizard, Ultron, or Crossbones selected by Player Two in a best three-out-of-five match.

6d7b7315fe0aee27.overview:
Leading the Israelites to the Promised Land, the biblical figure Moses must navigate a labyrinthine journey. The player guides Moses through each stage, speaking the Word of God to eliminate obstacles and defeat adversaries such as magicians, and dropping staffs that burst to clear other objects. Completing a stage requires gathering a specified quantity of manna along with five question marks while dodging hostile forces.

Following each cleared area, the player answers five multiple-choice questions about the book of Exodus. Each correct answer earns a Bible, and collecting ten Bibles awards an extra life. The title contains 100 stages in total, and they become progressively more difficult. At the start of the game, players have the option to advance in increments of five stages, up to stage 81.

6dde1137253e7e41.overview:
Set in a dystopian 1999 television game show, contestants fight for survival while battling waves of attackers. Players navigate a series of single-screen arenas, eliminating hordes of enemies that enter through doorways on the perimeter walls. While surviving these assaults, contestants gather weapons, temporary power-ups, money, and luxury prizes.

Moving from room to room across each round's map eventually leads contestants to an encounter with an end-of-round boss, and the show spans four rounds. Two contestants can participate cooperatively to eliminate hostiles and advance through the rounds, while also competing for cash and prizes, since the amount of money each one walks away with decides the grand champion.

6e017c8619f900c0.overview:
Winning games by managing a roster and executing on the field is the primary goal in Major League Baseball. Participants select from twenty-six squads represented by their real rosters, though athletes are identified by uniform numbers and statistics rather than by name. As a manager, the player builds the lineup, assigns fielding positions, picks a designated hitter, and substitutes pinch hitters or relief pitchers during play.

On the field, action involves batting, bunting, pitching, throwing out runners, and stealing bases. Batters move only vertically within the box, while pitchers control the speed and course of each pitch and can curve the ball after release. Available modes include regular season matchups within either league, All-Star games, and World Series games featuring clubs from both leagues, for one player against the computer or for two players.

6e5bdfe7ee4cc4d9.overview:
Set during the historical conflict of the Vietnam War, military aviators launch combat sorties from the aircraft carrier USS Constellation. A single player flies both an A-6 Intruder strike bomber and an F-4 Phantom interceptor against hostile forces in North Vietnam, with each waypoint determining which aircraft is used. The primary objective centers on executing twelve military assignments while confronting enemy fighter jets, anti-aircraft artillery, and defensive missile installations.

Assignments are divided into predefined waypoints, ranging from bombing runs to air-to-air combat against MiG jets, and some waypoints can be skipped from the map screen. In flight, the pilot monitors cockpit instruments, radar screens, and targeting mechanisms to engage targets using guns, missiles, rockets, or bombs. Missions begin with a catapult launch and conclude by deploying gear and catching an arrestor wire back on the carrier deck.

6e8d289635ac3947.official: Fight back against Dracula in the third exciting installment of the Castlevania franchise! As with the original Castlevania, the goal is to work your way through deviously challenging levels, but this time there's a difference – when the level ends, you can choose one of two paths to take for a completely different experience! The most innovative feature of this game lies with the spirit companions the player will meet through the journey.
6e8d289635ac3947.overview:
Defeating Count Dracula and his army of monsters is the primary objective of this platforming adventure. Controlling the vampire hunter Trevor Belmont, the player fights through Terror Levels, each with a time limit and a boss; there are seventeen in all, though the route chosen determines which are played. Trevor combats threats using the Mystic Whip alongside various items. At several points the road forks, and the player chooses which path to take toward the castle. Different endings can be reached depending on the companion who travels with Trevor.

Trevor can also team up with a single spirit companion encountered along the way. Available allies include Sypha, the Mystic Warlord, who attacks with flames, frozen crystals, and lightning bolts; Grant DaNasty, a ghost pirate able to cling to walls and ceilings and jump high; and Alucard, Dracula's son, who fires a Ball of Destruction and transforms into a bat. Partnering with a new companion requires leaving the previous ally behind.

6eea421f6c0738ff.official: In a world where music is language, an evil warlord imprisons the queen and steals all the musical instruments. The heroic Milon mounts a rescue mission, armed with only magic bubbles to help him reveal hidden items and defeat enemies. This cult platform classic is packed with musical references – look out for music boxes that transport Milon to a bonus stage where you must collect notes to turn them into cash.
6eea421f6c0738ff.overview:
Milon's Secret Castle features platform gameplay where the player guides a boy named Milon through Hudson's Secret Castle. The evil warlord has seized the realm's musical instruments and imprisoned Queen Eliza. Milon navigates through the fortress by running, jumping, and shooting magic bubbles. These bubbles damage monsters and shatter soft blocks, revealing hidden paths, shops, and items. Locating music boxes transports Milon into bonus stages to gather musical notes for cash.

The fortress contains multiple floors, side towers, and a well, requiring the defeat of seven bosses and the Evil Warlord to finish the game. Slain bosses drop crystal balls that augment bubble abilities and unlock access to higher levels. Honeycombs located in rooms replenish health and extend the life meter. A single life is provided, though players can continue by holding left and pressing Start after securing the initial crystal ball.

6f23f245b9edc5af.overview:
Directing a sword-wielding warrior from a faraway land, the player journeys across the Kingdom of Faria to defeat an evil Wizard and rescue the realm's kidnapped princess. The adventure leads through settlements, across an overworld, and into towers, caves, and the Sky World. Visiting towns allows the protagonist to speak with non-player characters to gather clues, medicine, and key objects such as the Crystal of Truth.

Progression alternates between wilderness travel and dungeon exploration. Traversing the overworld triggers battles fought on a separate screen, while towers and caves are explored as mazes. Combat involves maneuvering the character across the area to strike adversaries with an equipped sword or wield auxiliary armaments, which include bombs and a bow with arrows. Navigating dungeon mazes enables the warrior to conquer Boss Monsters and finally face a Dragon possessed by the Wizard's spirit in the Final Tower.

6f58c6fb427cf18b.official: The underground pyramid awaits! Grab your oxygen tank, bombs and flares and explore uncharted caves in search of the legendary pyramid and its vast treasures. Swing from ropes and ladders, make use of mining carts and boats, collect jewels, sacks of money and more as you navigate the hazardous terrain. You must keep your wits about you, as the caves hold many dangers.
6f58c6fb427cf18b.overview:
An expedition into uncharted subterranean caverns sends an explorer in search of an underground pyramid and its hidden riches. Starting at the cave entrance at the top, the player aims to reach the treasure located at the bottom of the labyrinth. Navigation involves walking, jumping, climbing ropes and ladders, and operating vehicles such as elevators, boats, and mine cars.

Throughout the journey, the explorer must monitor a depleting energy gauge and recharge it with energy items. Falling off cliffs, into pits, or depleting energy results in losing a life. Hazards include bats, scalding steam vents, and haunting ghosts, which can be dispelled by firing a Phantom Blaster from solid ground. Along the route, the player gathers flares, dynamite to destroy boulders, color-coded keys to open doors, and treasures like jewels and sacks of money.

6f66d14e5f17ca24.overview:
Terminator 2 - Judgment Day features side-scrolling action alongside overhead vehicular combat across five stages inspired by the film. The player controls a T-800 Terminator who begins at a truck stop, fighting bikers to obtain a motorcycle and a firearm. During the subsequent chase sequence, viewed from a diagonal overhead perspective, the protagonist rides through a drainage canal, avoiding obstacles and firing backward to hold off a pursuing big-rig tow truck driven by the T-1000.

Subsequent objectives take the protagonist into a mental hospital to locate Sarah Connor while avoiding lethal harm to the staff. Under orders from John Connor, the T-800 must slow hospital personnel down without killing them. After this rescue, the T-800 proceeds to plant explosives throughout Cyberdyne Systems to demolish the complex before facing the T-1000 in a steel mill.

6fac8ea87f7eea5e.overview:
Staged around the events of World War II, this top-view action shooting title portrays the invasion of Normandy, beginning on June 5, 1944. The campaign centers on Paul, a combat veteran from a secret unit known as "Iron Snake."

Controlling the Iron Tank, the player must establish a beachhead, break through the front lines, and infiltrate and destroy the enemy headquarters. The tank's turret can be aimed in a different direction from its movement, and it carries both a main gun and a machine gun. Several routes lead to the headquarters, and Morse Code radio messages and information from rescued captives help plan the way. Power-up items add rapid, armor-piercing, explosive and long-range shots, while energy items refuel the tank. One or two players can play at the same time, and a password resumes an earlier game.

700264cfa786a6be.overview:
Moe, Larry, and Curly must raise enough money within thirty days to rescue Ma's Orphanage from the banker I. Fleecem. The player directs the trio across diverse minigames, including hospital races, pie-throwing contests, boxing matches, cracker-eating competitions, and trivia questions. Events are chosen through a board game style map of Stoogeville, where players time a button press to stop Moe's hand as it moves along symbols representing challenges, random cash rewards, or meetings with Fleecem.

Most map spaces advance the calendar, though the slapping game and the glove square, which lets Moe choose again, do not cost any days. Over time, Moe's hand accelerates across the board, but pummeling Larry and Curly slows it back down. Players must avoid mousetrap spaces, which snap Moe's fingers and end the run after four injuries. The final ending depends on total funds accumulated.

700ebc3c2dd27420.overview:
Divided into an overhead map screen and side-view areas, this action-adventure spans four sections of 1940s Los Angeles: the city, the park, the warehouse district, and Toontown. Players control private detective Eddie Valiant, accompanied by Roger Rabbit, to locate four scattered pieces of Marvin's missing will and defeat Judge Doom. The overhead view is used to walk the streets, ride with Benny, and reach buildings while avoiding speeding cars and the Weasels. When the Weasels catch Roger, the player must choose the right punchline to a joke to free him.

Side-view sections allow exploration of building exteriors, hallways, rooms, and caves. Eddie searches drawers and cabinets for clues and items, and asks passersby questions. Players defend against foes using wound-up punches, bricks, a six shooter, and exploding cigars. A thrown crowbar breaks door locks, a whistle calls Benny, and randomized item placements require thorough exploration. Passwords let a new game start with the objects collected earlier.

7026334a7e8742b6.official: Originally released as a launch title for the NES, Duck Hunt will really test your reflexes. Ready, aim...pow! If the ducks go down, you win. If the shots go wide, you’ll suffer your hunting dog’s sniggering! Game A and Game B modes offer different difficulty levels - and a second player can even control the duck! - while Game C ups the challenge further with fast, small clay pigeons.
7026334a7e8742b6.overview:
Shooting down appearing targets to advance through increasingly demanding rounds represents the primary goal in this light gun title. Operating the NES Zapper pointed at the television, players aim at moving marks with three shots permitted for each appearance. Every round presents ten total targets. Advancing requires hitting a designated minimum quota, with missed quotas ending the session. Hitting targets awards points, while downing all ten in a single round yields bonus points. Reaching past round ninety-nine leads to an erratic kill screen.

Three selectable game modes structure the action. Game A features a single duck at a time, whereas Game B deploys pairs of ducks. Game C replaces waterfowl with clay pigeons launched away into the distance. In Game A, a second participant can use the standard controller to maneuver the duck.

7032a94d140339f9.overview:
ImageFight represents a vertically scrolling shooter in which Earth faces conquest by extraterrestrial invaders from the Boondoggle Galaxy. Set in the year 20xx after an assault shatters the moon, the premise tasks pilots with repelling enemy forces using the advanced OF-1 Fightership. Up to two players can participate in this conflict.

The player navigates a red combat craft through vertically advancing environments filled with hostile targets. Action commences across combat simulation levels that evaluate performance based on destroyed targets, judging whether the final score meets passing requirements. Maintaining an average destruction rate of at least ninety percent grants direct access to real combat missions, while falling below that threshold triggers supplementary training. The ensuing combat phases progress sequentially upon clearing each area.

710e907230bbd821.overview:
Action takes place on a vertically scrolling main table alongside specialized bonus stages. The display splits so the flippers stay visible at all times while the screen follows ball movement across the rest of the board. Players aim to Run the Red by completing the stoplight targets, three greens, three yellows and three reds, to turn the traffic light red. Speeding up the ramp twice then starts Multi-Ball, the police chase and the getaway, and if the escape up the ramp fails, a shot into the flashing Hide-out offers a second chance at Multi-Ball.

Hazards complicate the main table, such as water that slows the ball, acid that dissolves it, tumbleweeds that try to drain it, and heli-bombs or rust balls that damage flippers. Lightning Bombs can destroy these enemies. Collecting three safes opens a pachinko bonus level. Gathering three helicopters brings players to a race bonus level, where first- or second-place finishes earn progress toward special features.

711dd795f6e24699.overview:
Rescue: The Embassy Mission presents a tactical simulation where players control a counterterrorist squad responding to an embassy crisis. The mission begins with a side-scrolling sequence as individual operatives navigate across the street to reach designated vantage points. Players must evade scanning searchlights by crawling, diving, rolling, and hiding behind cover to prevent terrorists from opening fire.

From those vantage points, the perspective shifts to scoped shooting gallery views, allowing players to target terrorist silhouettes inside windows. Players also direct rappelling team members who descend from the roof to enter through specific windows. Inside the embassy, gameplay switches to interior exploration from a first-person perspective to locate hostages and eliminate the remaining hostiles. Mission performance is ultimately summarized on a results screen showing hostages saved and team members lost, along with a media headline.

711eee6690af76a5.overview:
Piloting a Cobra attack helicopter, the player navigates through side-scrolling combat zones on a rescue mission behind enemy lines. Missions take the player to areas such as Sumatra, Java, Borneo, the South China Sea, Siam, and an opposing military headquarters.

In this single-player game, most stages hold a set number of hostages, who climb aboard by a lowered rope or ladder, while the helicopter fights off enemy choppers, jet fighters, soldiers, tanks and cannons, along with naval threats like gunboats, destroyers and submarines. Securing enemy fortresses and depots refuels the helicopter and adds new guns, missiles, armor and engines, which are chosen from a sub-screen. Losing four helicopters ends the game, though play can be continued.

7157801d42484e58.overview:
Wheel of Fortune adapts the television word-puzzle competition for up to three participants. Across four rounds, contestants attempt to reveal a hidden phrase categorized by subjects such as people, places, or things. On their turn, a player spins the wheel to set a cash value for guessing a consonant, purchases vowels using earned round winnings, or attempts to solve the board. Landing on bankrupt forfeits that round's cash, landing on miss a turn skips the next turn, and free spins can be banked for later use. Decisions, letter choices and solutions all run against a countdown timer.

Round three features an automatic spin setting a fixed consonant value before participants alternate calling letters. The highest earner advances to round four, selects a featured prize, and calls five consonants plus one vowel before trying to type the complete answer. Matches accommodate solo play, two humans, or three participants, with options to substitute computer opponents across three difficulty tiers.

718dce0398dba4f8.overview:
Taking control of the comic book hero Silver Surfer, the player journeys through stages chosen in any desired sequence. Levels switch between side-scrolling and top-down viewpoints. Galactus sends the Surfer to stop five fiends from assembling a six-part device that would let the hordes of the Magik Domain invade the universe, and each world leads to the lair of a villain: Reptyl, Mephisto, Skrull Emperor, Possessor, or Firelord. A final stage remains once these worlds are cleared.

The character attacks hostile forces by firing shots. Power-ups include orbs that attach to the surfboard and fire supplemental projectiles forward, backward, or to the sides. Players can also collect items marked with an F to raise shot strength through five power levels, alongside B icons that store up to five screen-clearing bombs. Defeat causes all accumulated enhancements and stored bombs to disappear.

721c464598519132.overview:
Digging through a series of caverns, the miner Digger T. Rock searches for the mythical Lost City. Each cavern holds its own dangers, including falling boulders, long falls and hostile creatures. Players begin the journey with three lives and defend themselves using a shovel, which also functions as a tool for excavating stone; rocks dug from the walls can be thrown at distant enemies.

Progressing through each cavern requires finding a secret pillar and pushing it down, which opens the exit door for 60 seconds; the player must reach the door before it closes or return to the pillar. Supplies include rope ladders for climbing down from drop-offs and dynamite for blasting tougher enemies and obstacles, and power-up mushrooms grant brief invincibility. Bonus Rooms between caverns offer treasure cups for points and an extra life, and jewels can be traded for supplies at hidden Trading Stations in towns.

7255ab27932f7c07.official: In Urban Champion, prove you're the toughest guy on the streets. Block, punch and dodge your way through opponents to force them back – and down the open manholes! Plus, you'll have to contend with angry neighbors dropping flower pots and avoid the attentions of the cops, too. Battle solo against computer controlled foes or face off against a friend in the two-player mode.
7255ab27932f7c07.overview:
Set during sidewalk brawls where fighters compete to prove who is the toughest on the streets, players engage in one-on-one street fights to shove rivals off the pavement. Each combatant can shift guard between high and low stances, block, retreat, and deliver either quick weak punches or slower heavy strikes. Fighters start with 200 stamina points. Rounds also feature hazards, including flower pots thrown from windows, which drain stamina and stun the victim, and a patrol car that occasionally passes by. If the 99-count timer runs out, the police take away whichever combatant stands closer to the screen edge, and that fighter loses the round.

Pushing an opponent off the edge of the screen wins a round. Eventually a manhole at the screen edge opens, and the fighter knocked into it loses the game. The single-player mode against the computer ends after three lost rounds, while in the two-player mode the first to win three rounds wins.

728d0ca6751b0c03.official: Join Mario and company on a journey to save the world of Subcon from the foul frog tyrant, Wart. Super Mario Bros. 2 offered freedom to explore levels not only horizontally but also vertically, while collecting power-ups, uprooting veggies to throw at enemies and seeking out hidden ‘Sub-space’ rooms. It was the first Mario title to let players control characters with unique skills, like Princess Toadstool (Peach) and Toad.
728d0ca6751b0c03.overview:
Players control one of four selectable protagonists—Mario, Luigi, Toad, or Princess Toadstool—running, jumping, and climbing while lifting and throwing objects or foes to navigate the dream world of Subcon. Rather than eliminating adversaries by landing atop them, the characters stand on, pick up, and hurl opponents, mushroom blocks, or uprooted vegetables. Each hero provides distinct physical traits, such as Luigi's high jump, Toad's quick lifting and undiminished jumping and running while carrying items, Princess Toadstool's temporary floating ability, and Mario's balanced attributes.

Progress spans twenty levels distributed across seven themed worlds featuring vertical and horizontal scrolling. Stages contain rooms connected through doors, ladders, and jars, alongside hidden Sub-space areas opened with magic potions to obtain coins and health-increasing mushrooms. Items include screen-clearing POW blocks, stopwatches, cherries that yield stars, and extra lives. Overcoming stage hazards and boss encounters leads to a final confrontation against the tyrant Wart.

730399227c156663.overview:
R.C. Pro-Am II provides vehicle racing across twenty-four courses divided into standard racetracks, cityscape settings, and offroad paths. Drivers steer with the directional pad, accelerate using one button, and fire weapons with another. Every race awards championship points and cash prizes according to finishing position, and extra continues can be collected on the track or bought between races.
