Courses feature hazards such as water, mud, logs, oil, ice, and bomb-dropping aircraft. Scattered letters spelling PRO-AM II reward the collector with an upgraded vehicle.

Between events, earned money funds ammunition, performance parts such as motors and tires, and weapons like bombs, missiles, buckshot, and the Freeze, which puts opponents on ice. Drivers also earn cash and points in the Tug O' Truck Challenge and Drag Race bonus games. Up to four competitors can race simultaneously.

7328b2eb1c9fe06b.official: Go up, up and away with this NES classic from the 1980s. In Balloon Fight you have one simple mission: pop or be popped! Burst enemies' balloons from above, and hit them again before they have time to re-inflate. Danger comes from the sky or sea, too; watch out for lightning strikes and a very hungry fish.
7328b2eb1c9fe06b.overview:
Flapping through the air with two balloons, the balloonist rises whenever the player repeatedly presses the A button or holds down the B button. Flotation decreases if one balloon pops, making ascent harder. The objective centers on bursting enemy balloons from above, then striking those foes again before they can re-inflate. A life is lost if both balloons pop, if lightning strikes, if the character sinks into the water, or if a fish snatches the character when flying too close to the surface.

Two modes provide different play options. The standard mode tasks one or two participants with clearing each screen of adversaries, supporting cooperative and competitive two-player action. The alternative option, Balloon Trip, is a single-life survival mode in which the player drifts across a scrolling stage, popping balloons while avoiding lightning.

741fbfeeec83073c.overview:
Rescuing a kidnapped girlfriend named Bunny drives the central journey of Menace Beach. Demon Dan abducted her just before an afternoon meeting at the malt shop. To save her, the player takes control of a skateboarding hero named Scooter, who navigates through levels to reach an ultimate confrontation with Demon Dan.

Scooter defends himself with punches and spinkicks along with various items scattered throughout the areas, including frogs, bottles, balloons, and bombs. These tools help him eliminate opposing ninjas, clowns, and disgruntled dockworkers. Between the stages, Bunny's garments steadily deteriorate until she is reduced to her underwear.

745050dec23a692e.overview:
Players maneuver a marker along the borders of a large, enclosed rectangular playfield to capture territory. The primary objective requires drawing lines, known as Stix, into unclaimed space to section off and fill portions of the screen until a target percentage is reached. Drawing can be performed at fast or slow speeds, with slower lines awarding double points upon completing a shape.

Danger comes from the Qix, a wandering computer virus that costs a life if it touches an incomplete line or the marker, and from Spritz viruses, which do the same. Lingering while drawing sparks a fuse that travels toward the marker, costing a life upon contact. In addition, hazards called Sparx appear whenever a timer bar runs out and hunt the marker, and on higher levels they can pursue the player along unfinished Stix lines once an alarm sounds.

751d3bf4722ce117.overview:
Opposing Light and Dark forces clash across a battlefield of light and dark squares, including color-shifting Lumina spaces. Victory is achieved by capturing all five power points or defeating every enemy unit, and a game can also end in a draw.

Controlling distinct units with varying movement, lifeline length, and weaponry, players engage in real-time combat whenever two opposing pieces occupy the same space. These encounters shift the action to a battle arena where combatants fight for control of the contested tile. A unit receives a health boost when engaging on a square matching its own color. Available units range from rapidly striking Knights and Goblins fighting hand to hand to a slow Golem hurling boulders and a Dragon scorching foes with fiery breath.

758ea7bee928136a.overview:
Entering a racing name allows the player to begin a career mode with a "D" license rating. Winnings from the U.S. circuit's thirty courses, spread across ten cities, buy better parts or new cars, and a higher license ranking unlocks more races, parts, and vehicles. Play progresses through models such as the Mini Cooper, the Vector W2, the Ferrari F40, and ultimately a Formula 1 race car. Some cities also offer a shop for selling parts or a slot-machine casino.

Winning the last U.S. race, the Final Road, earns a Formula One license and entry to a sixteen-race international circuit, where players can power up the car's engine, acceleration, grip, and nitrous, run practice laps, and qualify before each race. The F-1 Championship goes to the driver with the most points. A nitro boost is available while racing, up to three drivers' careers can be saved, and a free mode offers time-trial practice.

764b80a6291f138f.overview:
Four missions make up the campaign, which combines three separate play styles across its stages. The narrative places the player as a commando tasked with stopping the Sheik from deploying a new weapon, the TechnoScorch Missile. A briefing before every mission establishes the current target. Stages involve piloting the Laser Invasion Helijet against enemy aircraft, landing at an enemy base, fighting through it on foot, and exploring a 3-D maze where underground allies offer clues.

Actions inside base installations feature shooting segments compatible with the standard controller, the Zapper light gun, or the voice-activated LaserScope accessory. An options screen allows configuration of audio, controls, and starting lives before gameplay begins. Reaching designated score thresholds awards extra lives, while losing all reserves permits up to five continues to resume progress.

768867bd0dc79c85.overview:
Operating as an Acme Detective Agency agent headquartered in San Francisco, the player investigates across historical eras to apprehend Carmen Sandiego and her henchmen. Equipped with a device called the Chronoskimmer, the agent journeys through fifteen centuries of human history spanning from 400 AD to the 1950s. Each case involves tracking a thief, one of sixteen possible suspects, to a hideout somewhere in time.

Investigations involve questioning witnesses and scanning areas to gather evidence: hints indicating the suspect's following destination and details regarding their physical traits or interests. Reaching the correct destination reveals a suspicious person or occurrence on the location panel. Searching and traveling consume portions of an authorized time limit. Successful cases require securing a proper arrest warrant and closing in on the criminal's hideout before time runs out. Advancing through cases earns promotions from Time Cadet through multiple ranks up to Super Time Sleuth.

76cdd991b85e4a15.overview:
Controlling the protagonist across side-scrolling action environments, the player navigates the setting based on the film Predator. Initial stages leave the player completely unarmed.

Progressing further requires finding and gathering weapons that appear throughout the journey. The player relies on these acquired armaments to advance through the side-scrolling areas.

770abf58074764db.overview:
Peace in the kingdom of Fairyland shatters after an intruder steals one of three sacred jewels, neutralizing their protective magic. This breach releases Boralis, a fierce demon; after the remaining jewels are also stolen, he turns Princess Ann into three fairies hidden somewhere in the kingdom and unleashes monstrous hordes to conquer the realm.

Controlling the armored knight Jim, a single player ventures into the monster-infested wilderness. The overarching objective requires battling across the invaded territory to overcome the demonic threat, rescue the transformed princess, and restore harmony to Fairyland.

77c9100f4d3f291d.overview:
Michael Andretti's World GP puts players behind the wheel in a simulation-style Formula One competition. Across a circuit of sixteen international tracks, drivers aim to negotiate courses filled with sharp and wide turns. Successful navigation requires regulating speed for corners and manually shifting gears on three of the four selectable vehicles. Tires degrade over distance, so drivers can pull into a pylon-marked pit area during an event to swap them out.

Competitors are based on actual drivers who appear under pseudonyms, except for Andretti himself. Across Grand Prix mode's nine competition levels of up to sixteen rounds each, available automobiles differ in horsepower and torque, with the Chevy Lola offering the most horsepower.

7806ee6afcdf88ef.overview:
Set in the year 2525, an international terrorist known as X nears completion of an ultimate war weapon. After the C.I.A.'s best agents fail to halt the criminal scheme and rookie agent Rachel does not return, an unofficial agent code-named Super Spy Hunter is called in. The player pilots an armed vehicle across car, boat, and plane stages over six missions, such as Aquapolis, Desert of Doom, and Collapsible Canyon, battling bosses such as the Armored Transport, Turret Terminator, and Turbo-Prop Space Cruiser.

Destroying weapon vehicles yields capsules containing offensive tools and enhancements. In car stages, blue capsules supply special devices such as oil slicks, tire slashers, super bombs, and extra lives. Red items activate automatically, expanding and refilling the life gauge, increasing shot speed, and powering up the vehicle. Planes feature red power items along with super and homing missiles, while boat stages restrict the player to bullets. The game ends when all five starting lives are lost.

7882e99e08deb1c2.overview:
The Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle features puzzle platform gameplay. Bugs Bunny ventures through sixty levels to rescue Honey Bunny, who has been kidnapped by Wile E. Coyote, Yosemite Sam, Daffy Duck, and Sylvester. To complete each stage, players must gather all of the carrots scattered throughout the area. Bugs cannot jump, requiring players to take alternate pathways to navigate floors and steer clear of wandering foes.

Stairs, doorways and pipes connect the floors, and Bugs can safely pass the rascals by going through doorways and pipes. Levels contain tools to counter enemies, including boxing gloves, magic carrot juice that briefly makes Bugs invisible, and objects such as safes, wooden crates, buckets, and ten-ton weights that can be pushed into foes or dropped on them. Clearing a level grants an additional life. Passwords allow players to resume progress at specific stages.

7911375ab98da4ac.overview:
Participants compete on the soccer field by selecting a national squad from twenty-four different countries. Before taking the pitch, players configure their strategy by selecting team formations and determining the eleven active starters from a roster containing fifteen athletes. Options also set the length of each half and whether offside and foul calls are enforced.

Contests take place across two primary play types: the seven-game Super Cup tournament, which uses passwords to continue a series, and standalone exhibition games. The Super Cup is played by one participant against the computer, while exhibition games let two participants compete against one another or collaborate together cooperatively against the computer.

798888ffa76d0e52.overview:
Organized as a sequence of repeated tarot readings rather than traditional stages, this simulation functions without conventional action sequences. The process begins by prompting the participant to enter personal information, including a name, date of birth, and gender. The user must then submit a specific inquiry before the full seventy-eight-card deck is shuffled, with the control pad used to influence the shuffle. This deck incorporates both the Minor Arcana and the Major Arcana.

Following the shuffle, the program displays a layout based on the Celtic cross. Once the layout concludes, the participant can select a United States state, prompting the software to generate corresponding lucky numbers.

79969ab6741823e5.overview:
Cliffhanger functions as a beat 'em up platformer. Players control mountain rescuer Gabe Walker, who sets out with his friend Hal in search of a stranded party of hikers. The two fall into the hands of Qualen, the leader of a band of fugitives hunting for three cases holding $100 million lost in a plane wreck. Gabe escapes and searches for the money in an effort to ransom Hal and save his life.

Progressing through the adventure requires navigating past hostile forces. The player avoids adversaries by jumping past them or neutralizes them using attacks with weapons such as a knife or a gun. Campfires restore energy at the cost of collected money. Each of the six levels ends in a boss encounter, concluding in a final confrontation against Qualen himself.

79c03fec3f459ac6.overview:
Indiana Jones sets out to find the Holy Grail and his missing father, Professor Henry Jones, in a one-player side-scrolling action game based on the film. Indy runs, jumps and climbs ropes and ladders, fighting with his fists, a whip that grows stronger with each one collected, and a gun loaded with three bullets. Each level has a time limit; hourglasses add time and hearts restore energy.

The six levels begin in caves, where torches light the way and the Cross of Coronado must be found, followed by an escape on a circus train. In the catacombs, Indy seeks four pieces forming an X and a shield, then scales the walls of Brunwald Castle for the missing pieces of Professor Jones' notebook and escapes from a Zeppelin. The final level holds three trials: jumping over blades, stepping on the letters of Jehova and making the leap of faith, followed by a choice among cups, all but one of them poisoned.

7a26c62a9b1605cb.official: Blaster Master tells the story of Jason, an ordinary boy who becomes an extraordinary warrior on a quest to save the Earth. One of the most innovative games of the NES era, Blaster Master combines side-scrolling and top-down perspective sections, as Jason battles radioactive monsters both on foot and behind the wheel of Sophia The 3rd, a heavily-armed multi-purpose vehicle.
7a26c62a9b1605cb.overview:
Eight large subterranean areas form the structure of the campaign, which requires backtracking to previously visited sections to proceed. The narrative follows Jason as he descends underground to search for his mutated pet frog, Fred. To rescue his pet and defeat the mutant leader known as the Plutonium Boss, Jason pilots a multi-purpose combat vehicle named SOPHIA the 3rd.

Action alternates between side-scrolling platforming and top-down exploration. In side-scrolling sections, the player operates the tank, which uses a cannon alongside special munitions like homing missiles, multi-warhead rockets, and a lightning attack. Jason can disembark on foot to enter narrow doorways leading to overhead labyrinths. During these top-down stages, Jason fights monsters using a gun and hand grenades. Defeating subterranean bosses grants vehicle enhancements that allow the tank to scale walls, hover, and travel underwater.

7b0899bfde9661d1.overview:
Prince of Persia presents platforming gameplay set in Persia. A single player guides an unnamed protagonist out of the Sultan's dungeons and through the palace to defeat the Grand Vizier Jaffar and reach an imprisoned princess before sixty minutes elapse. Progress requires stepping on pressure plates that raise gates, leaping over deep pits, and avoiding lethal spike traps and slicers. Two-story falls cause damage, and dying returns the protagonist to the start of the current level while the timer continues running.

Duels against enemy guards require a sword acquired during the escape. The protagonist advances, retreats, slashes, and parries attacks, and a guard is defeated by draining all of his health indicators. Three initial health units can be depleted by combat or hazards. Potions found throughout the areas heal injuries, raise maximum health capacity, slow the protagonist's falls, or inflict poison.

7b7ccdcda705c2c3.overview:
Segments in this scrolling shooter feature both horizontally and vertically moving perspectives. The player pilots a starship through each section while facing hostile targets.

Two distinct firing options are available to the vessel. One weapon targets airborne foes, while the second addresses adversaries stationed on the ground.

7d07d335a8732059.official: Mappy-Land is the NES-exclusive sequel to the classic arcade game, starring Mappy the mouse, who this time must gather gifts for his new family, while avoiding the Mewkies who are out to stop him. Mappy must traverse eight themed worlds – from Wild West to Ghost Town – collecting gifts like rings for his fiancée Mapico, or baseballs for his son Junior.
7d07d335a8732059.overview:
Controlling the mouse Mappy, the player gathers gifts scattered across themed environments while evading antagonistic cats. Progression requires navigating through eight areas, such as Railroad Town and Ghost Town, using ladders and trampolines to move between floors. Each stage requires finding the required target items—such as cheese, wedding rings, Christmas trees, or baseballs—before reaching the right-hand exit. If an exit is closed, a hidden entrance must be found to explore a sub-area for a necessary item to proceed.

Defense relies on portable protection weapons like toys, gold coins, pots, and fish to divert or incapacitate pursuers. Stages also contain fighting weapons such as bowling balls and flashlights to defeat enemies temporarily. The game spans four stories, culminating in Muky Town before delivering the collected presents to the castle.

7ddc56bf2b8d8f3f.overview:
Guiding a roller skater through side-scrolling stages, the player battles hostile goons to rescue the kidnapped commissioner. Before each stage begins, the player selects one of three star skaters: Ice Box from the Thunderbirds, Rolling Thunder from Hot Flash, or California Kid from the Rockers. Odd-numbered stages require navigating across courses and fighting off opposing team members before facing an enemy leader in a boss encounter under a time limit.

The first two even-numbered stages feature transitional auto-scrolling obstacle courses without time limits, requiring skaters to dodge barrels and bombs dropped from overhead helicopters while jumping gaps in the road. The sixth stage returns to a time limit, concluding with a final boss fight. Lives are lost whenever a skater runs out of energy, falls into a pit, or fails to complete a timed stage before the countdown expires.

7e59dcd2576d2e83.overview:
Bo Jackson Baseball simulates the sport of baseball featuring professional athlete Bo Jackson. Matches can be set to last between five and nine innings. During play, participants are able to deliver five varieties of pitches at slow, normal, or fast speeds. Players can customize their starting pitcher, substitute roster members, adjust the batting order, and reassign defensive positions. Three difficulty levels run from Little League to All Star League, and the view can stay behind the batter or switch to the pitcher's view on defense.

Game modes include exhibition matches and playoff tournaments, which support one or two players. Automated options let the computer compete against itself in standard or accelerated formats, letting players skip to the final scoreboard and conclude tournaments rapidly.

7e8a3accbd57c9fe.overview:
Thwarting an alien takeover requires gathering or destroying the specific items invaders need to assemble their ultimate weapon. Controlling Bart Simpson across five side-scrolling stages, the player travels on foot or by skateboard through town streets, a mall, an amusement park, a museum, and a power plant. Each stage tasks the player with clearing quotas of designated items, including purple objects, hats, balloons, exit signs, and nuclear rods.

Bart identifies possessed humans using X-ray glasses and jumps on their heads to force out the invaders, who leave behind proof that adds a letter to a relative's name. Coins purchase equipment such as rockets and cherry bombs. Assembling the name of a relative brings that family member to assist during boss battles that conclude the first four stages. Minigames also appear during the single-player adventure.

7e94b4fe8c334397.overview:
Guiding one of six camp counselors across Crystal Lake in a side-scrolling perspective, the player works to track down and eliminate Jason. Each counselor has different strengths, with some faster or stronger than others, and all begin with stones as their only weapon. Navigating paths, caves, woods, and the lake involves fighting zombies, crows, and wolves while seeking upgraded weapons. Warning alarms alert players that Jason is attacking children or another counselor, requiring navigation across the map or switching counselors to intervene.

Inside cabins, the view changes to an interior screen where Jason can be fought, and the fireplaces in the larger cabins must be lit before the torch can be found. Players search for clues leading to items, explore hidden rooms, and may encounter the ghostly head of Jason's mother inside a cave. Survival entails lasting three days and nights and finally defeating Jason with the pitchfork before all counselors or children are killed.

7eba1637cd2fdbc4.official: Castlevania marked the beginning of Konami’s acclaimed series, one that is still going strong today! As vampire hunter Simon Belmont, you must fight your way through Dracula's castle teeming with ghosts, goblins, demons and other supernatural creatures. Six challenging levels await before you finally confront the Count himself. You'll need your wits and weapons to survive because when you finally meet Dracula, you know he’ll be going for the jugular.
7eba1637cd2fdbc4.overview:
Castlevania presents platform gameplay where players control vampire hunter Simon Belmont as he enters Count Dracula's castle. The journey spans six monstrous floors before reaching the master of the house in his tower. Simon can walk, crouch, jump, climb staircases, and strike with a whip. Enemies, projectiles, spiked ceilings, and bottomless pits drain health or cost lives, while hidden food replenishes Simon's life bar. Stages must be completed before a timer expires. At the conclusion of every section, players must vanquish a boss monster and collect a Magic Crystal before moving forward to the final confrontation against Dracula.

Secondary weapons like throwing daggers, axes, fire bombs, boomerangs, and a time-stopping watch consume hearts acquired from extinguished candles or defeated foes. Simon can carry one secondary weapon at a time. Other items provide point bonuses, momentary invulnerability, screen-clearing effects, or whip enhancements.

7ecff2d3e6d34171.overview:
Skating across the ice, players guide hockey athletes from an overhead perspective in a game played under professional hockey rules, with penalties such as tripping, hooking, and slashing sending offenders off the ice. The game carries the name of ice hockey center Wayne Gretzky. Players can skate and pass in any direction, check opponents, demand passes from teammates, and switch control to another skater at any time. Penalties, frozen pucks, and goals cut to an arena scoreboard screen that shows the referee and the call.

Four player options structure participation: One Player against the computer, Two Players against each other, Two Players Team with both on the same side against the computer, and Computer Only, an exhibition. Periods can last 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes at three game speeds, and Practice, Normal, and Playoff game types differ in roster size and overtime rules.

7ee2b81ef8ab8e9c.overview:
Separated from his troops while trying to return to civilization, Scout discovers that his supposed rescuers belong to Dr. Demise's organization. To free the jungle from the villain's control, Scout must explore ancient temple ruins to locate and eliminate Demise and his henchmen. The player maneuvers Scout through the temple by moving left and right, kicking adversaries, and jumping at varying heights determined by how long the jump button is held.

Players collect and manage status bar tools to navigate the ruins. Essential equipment includes keys for opening metal gates, torches that provide light for sixty seconds, brass knuckles that boost strength, and suction cups for scaling canyon walls. For offense and defense, Scout can throw a boomerang that must be caught to be reused, deploy temporary invulnerability shields, or use dynamite to attack enemies and propel himself straight upward into the air.

7f28fa007f219e4e.overview:
Jeopardy! is a trivia quiz game based on the television show. Up to three participants take part, either as human competitors or against computer opponents, across three skill levels that govern the allotted response time. Players select a category and money value from the game board, after which an answer appears on the screen. Participants rush to buzz in before a countdown timer expires, giving the fastest contestant exclusive control to spell out the corresponding question letter by letter on an on-screen character grid.

Correct solutions add the chosen wager to the player's bank, while mistakes subtract that amount and give remaining opponents an opportunity to answer. The contest progresses through three stages: the standard round, Double Jeopardy! with doubled dollar figures and two hidden Daily Double bonus questions, and Final Jeopardy! where qualifiers wager their accumulated cash on a single prompt. The player with the highest total at the end wins.

80757aa85fe40011.overview:
Driving across a post-apocalyptic desert wasteland, the player battles enemy gang cars, road barricades, and gang fortresses using a limited supply of dynamite. Each road stage requires gathering fuel, ammunition, food, and water to survive. Service stations allow food and water to be traded for repairs, extra fuel, ammunition, dynamite, and the arena pass needed to advance.

Players also can explore abandoned mine shafts on foot, using a shotgun against post-nuclear mutants while scavenging for supplies, first aid kits, and keys. Once an arena pass is secured, the player enters a cave-like opening to the Arena, where enemy cars try to push the player off the edge or through trap doors into a bottomless pit, and the exit opens only after enough enemy cars are destroyed. Each completed level yields a password, and the last level ends with a crossbow battle against the Ultimate Warrior.

8093144834f1153e.overview:
Taking down enemy aircraft that attempt to destroy the player's stealth fighter forms the primary objective in Stealth ATF. Piloting the Stealth Advanced Tactical Fighter, the player manages every phase of flight across missions set in theaters around the world, such as the Middle East, Alaska, and the Pacific. Two players can take turns, and a second player can also take control of an enemy plane for a dogfight.

Gameplay spans launching from a runway, aerial combat, and returning to touch down safely once the engagement concludes. Levels present distinct environments and runway styles, ranging from expansive land strips to compact aircraft carrier decks at sea. While engaging opposing bogeys with onboard cannons and missiles, the pilot must monitor current flight altitude to prevent fatal crashes, while also tracking craft damage levels and remaining munitions. Once per mission, a stealth mode hides the fighter from enemy radar to evade missile attacks.

80f6f2b9cb2669e8.overview:
Muppet characters navigate a sequence of carnival rides under the direction of a single player. Through these various attractions, the central objective involves collecting four keys to access Dr. Grump's cave and successfully rescue Miss Piggy.

The featured attractions present distinct challenges: Gonzo's Lost in Space Ride, Fozzie Bear's Amazing Ice Cream Maze, Animal's Crash Car Course, and Kermit's Raging River Ride. After completing each ride and acquiring all four keys, Kermit enters the Grumpasaurus Cave to confront the Grumpasaurus and face Dr. Grump in a final battle.

8104dc7acdaea42b.overview:
One or two players drive Vindicators battle tanks against an attacking force of alien space stations, with 14 stations to wipe out. Inside each multi-level station, the goal is to locate and destroy its control center while fending off turrets, mines, enemy tanks such as the Aggressor and Darter, and flying saucers. Fuel must be constantly replenished by picking up fuel canisters, and keys let a tank leave one level and enter the next.

The control center doubles as the Bonus Room: players grab as many objects as possible before the clock runs down and the room blows up, and failing to exit in time cuts the fuel level in half. Battle Stars collected along the way buy tank speed and fuel, improved shots, Force Shields, and two special weapons, homing Smart Shots and powerful Bomb Cannons. Bosses such as the Sentry Robot, GunGun, and Mega-Brain call for heavy use of these special weapons.

81311ff2507c6522.overview:
Stopping a destructive alien invasion of the planet Pan serves as the ultimate goal for the protagonist, army captain Max Maverick. Confronting the threat alone after the military and populace evacuate, Maverick battles hostile extraterrestrial forces that consume living creatures, machinery, and structures. The action unfolds from an overhead oblique viewpoint as the player steers Maverick through the campaign, occasionally piloting a motorcycle or hovercraft for transit.

Progressing through each level requires gathering weapon upgrades, fighting alien enemies, and avoiding hazards including pitfalls, damage zones and crushing walls. Large bosses must be defeated along the way. Story sequences appear between stages. Six stages make up the campaign, with a special seventh stage for players who finish all six before the game ends. A password feature is provided to record and restore game progress.

818c7648979f86af.overview:
Players control a cursor across an alphabet board to select letters and solve word puzzles illustrated on screen. Modeled after the television game show, the game tasks teams of male or female characters with guessing words or phrases represented by drawings before time expires. Puzzles appear either automatically drawn by the system or sketched by a participant using the controller to manipulate a pen tool on an easel. Correct letters fill into matching spaces, while incorrect choices penalize five points. Completing an answer awards base points plus bonus points for remaining seconds. If a team fails, the opposing side receives forty seconds to steal the solution.

Matches consist of three drawings per team followed by a timed Speed Round where participants solve as many puzzles as possible. Three difficulty settings govern the time allotted, answer lengths, and letter dashes. A Practice mode offers untimed freehand drawing and typing.

81a77623adf819f1.overview:
Divided into seven rounds, each section of the adventure concludes with a battle against an end-round boss. Players guide the ninja hero Kid Niki on a rescue quest after the villainous Stone Wizard kidnaps Princess Margo. Each round must be cleared within a time limit. Up to two players can participate.

Throughout the journey, the protagonist defends himself using the Spinning Sword, jumping while spinning it to strike flying enemies. Players can also pick up bonus items along the way. A Golden Bell lets the character kill enemies far away, while a Silver Bell circles around him and knocks out enemies. Coins earn bonus points, and a Mini Princess lets him survive an extra death.

8271542561a71830.overview:
Advancing through Starfleet ranks to eventually become Captain forms the primary goal in this spaceship simulation. Players step into the role of a Starfleet Academy cadet taking Captain Jean-Luc Picard's place in command of the U.S.S. Enterprise during an Advanced Holodeck Tutorial. Beginning as a novice cadet with no ranking, the player accepts a series of mission-oriented objectives, earning rankings that range from Ensign to Captain as missions are completed. Each ranking comes with a password, allowing progress to be resumed at the achieved rank.

Fulfilling these assignments requires the operator to direct crew members such as Worf, Data, La Forge, O'Brien and Riker, whose duties are presented as mini-games. Tasks include routing energy to shields, managing transporter systems, steering navigation, and directing tactical functions. Combat assignments challenge the player to battle enemy starships with phasers and photon torpedoes, while random Red Alert scenarios such as temporal rifts, intruders and life support failures add further dangers.

836a6df9f6885b2b.overview:
Directing pinball play, the participant experiences a combination of table-based action and role-playing game mechanics. Action unfolds across four pinball games, headlined by a story-driven role-playing mode. In this one-player adventure, the silver ball travels through six levels of graveyards, dungeons and rivers to rescue Princess Bali from Beezelbub, dark lord of the machine, earning gold to buy more powerful flippers and ball stoppers.

Three other modes provide varied themes and setups, each for one to four players. Circus features a bonus game and a built-in slot machine that awards extra scoring features, Viva Golf uses a golf-course-shaped table with sand traps, water hazards and gophers, and Pop Pop offers a sports theme.

83cb47fda376900e.overview:
Escaping from prison serves as the primary goal after Bomberman's evil twin frames the titular hero for a bank heist. Controlling Bomberman, the player drops explosive charges inside maze-like rooms to demolish obstructing blocks and eliminate foes. Hidden beneath certain destroyed blocks are items that alter bomb attributes, such as expanding blast radii or allowing bombs to be detonated by remote control. Each stage also conceals an exit door within one of its destructible blocks, granting passage to the following level. Upon receiving a game over, players receive a password that allows a later return to the last level reached.

Multiplayer modes allow participants to compete directly against one another by placing explosives to defeat opposing Bombermen. Two competitors can face off in VS Mode, whereas Battle Mode accommodates three simultaneous participants through the NES Four Score accessory.

842478f0d9f01c6c.official: To save his world from demons, Dana the Wizard goes on a dangerous quest to find Solomon's Key and seal the monsters away. An audacious mix of action game and puzzler, Solomon's Key was one of the toughest challenges on the NES, but also one of its most endearing adventures. Combine logic and reflexes to unravel the mysteries of each room.
842478f0d9f01c6c.overview:
Dana the wizard runs, jumps, and manipulates brown stone blocks to navigate rooms and seal away released demons. The sorcerer can conjure or shatter adjacent blocks, headbutt blocks from beneath to destroy them, and cast fireballs to defeat monsters. Direct physical contact with enemies results in instant loss of a life. Each room requires obtaining a key and reaching the exit door before a countdown timer expires.

Throughout the journey, items can be revealed by creating and breaking blocks. These items grant bonus points, extra lives, firepower enhancements, or access to secret areas. The game spans 64 rooms, including hidden chambers and a final room, with different endings depending on which secrets are uncovered. A Game Deviation Value score displays upon game over to evaluate overall performance.

8471a6b7c7c7d6c7.overview:
Joust features action platforming where participants control lance-bearing knights mounted on ostriches. Flapping the bird's wings enables flight across single-screen stages containing floating ledges and lava pits; one button flaps at normal speed and the other flaps faster.

The goal involves eliminating waves of Buzzard Riders, known as Bounders, Hunters and Shadow Lords, by colliding with them from higher elevations. Defeated opponents leave eggs that must be collected before they hatch into fresh foes. After the second wave, the Troll of the Lava Pits can capture knights, and a pterodactyl that cannot be beaten appears from time to time. The player begins with five lives. Game A is meant for beginners and Game B for experts, and a two-player game is also available.

84e3a018cbaaf231.overview:
Matches span four rounds of word puzzles categorized by people, phrases, places, events, and other subjects. One to three players compete, taking turns alone, against human opponents, or facing computer-controlled participants across three selectable skill levels. When three play, the first and third players share one controller.

In the opening two rounds, players choose to spin the wheel for cash values, purchase vowels with accumulated round earnings, or solve the puzzle before a timer expires. Spinning can award monetary amounts, grant a free spin, or cause a turn loss or round bankruptcy. Round three sets a fixed consonant value through an automatic spin, letting participants select letters without manually spinning. Solving requires entering the missing letters within the time limit. Cumulative totals carry over after each stage, and the top-scoring participant reaches the fourth round. There, the finalist selects a featured prize, names five consonants and one vowel, and attempts to guess the remaining letters under a final countdown.

84f5377980d2fd44.overview:
Guiding a party of three teenagers using a point-and-click interface forms the core action, directing their movement and actions by choosing commands from an onscreen menu. Players control Dave Miller alongside two companions selected from a group of six friends. Each friend contributes individual abilities, such as repairing equipment or playing musical instruments. The non-linear adventure sends the team exploring a two-dimensional estate to rescue Dave's kidnapped girlfriend from a mad scientist whose family has acted strangely since a meteor crashed near the mansion.

Completing the quest involves navigating rooms, solving puzzles, and dodging the mansion's hostile occupants, who will lock spotted intruders in the dungeon. Cutscenes periodically interrupt the action to reveal offscreen story events. Depending on the squad members chosen, who survives, and their accomplishments, the journey concludes with one of five distinct endings.

8589b1dc55e04d23.overview:
Wacky Races presents platform gameplay based on the animated series featuring Dick Dastardly and Muttley.

The player directs Muttley through three courses, A, B, and C, selected from an overarching map screen and ranging from easiest to toughest. Across the ten total stages, the character jumps and begins with a close-range bite. Collecting bones advances a cursor through an items window, letting players claim enhancements such as extra energy, wings that keep Muttley in the air longer, a bomb, or a Sonic Bark. Gathering 100 diamonds earns an extra life. Each stage concludes with a boss confrontation against a rival racer. The courses can be tackled in any order, though the stages within each must be played in sequence, and all three courses must be finished to view the conclusion.

85d1b9bcfa9e0ffc.overview:
Guiding various protagonists through their distinct journeys forms the core objective across four platform adventure games.

Players navigate Linus, an extraterrestrial stranded on Earth, as he collects dispersed radio components to send an SOS signal. Another adventure follows Robin Hood through the Sheriff of Nottingham's castle to rescue Maid Marian while evading hazards and battling opposition. A third quest tasks Boomerang Kid with recovering the boomerangs raided from the tribe that raised him, across the Outback, the Castles and the Caves. Finally, Dizzy must navigate an island where he is stranded and discover a way to return home.

85de365c6e538bc7.overview:
Participants compete across a fictitious baseball league composed of twelve selectable teams. Matches utilize a television-style perspective to frame the contest between the pitcher and the batter. Play revolves around standard baseball action, presenting both individual single games and an extended full season, with a password recording wins and losses against the computer.

Two players can join in single matches. During games, some pitchers can hit certain batters with a pitch, which sometimes sets off a bench-clearing fight.

85e29454e42aecf1.overview:
Defending a fortified territory from a top-down view, the player places cannons and maintains protective walls around castles. Play rotates between distinct timed stages of combat and construction. During combat, the player aims and fires cannons to repel incoming ships that blast holes into the defenses.

Once the attack ends, the player maneuvers puzzle-shaped wall pieces to repair structural breaches and enclose castles within a continuous perimeter. Completely surrounded castles award extra cannons for subsequent defense rounds, while cannons left outside complete enclosures cannot be used in the next battle. Up to two players can participate.

85f7be325689329e.overview: BMX Simulator is a BMX racing game in which every race has three riders: one or two players choose how many riders they control, and the computer rides the rest. Races take place on three terrains: Dirt Biking, a beginner event over three courses suited to practice; Desert Riding, an intermediate event over five courses; and Quarry Racing, an expert event over seven courses. Each race opens with the call "Riders ready, pedals ready, go"; accelerating too early means pressing the button again, while starting late loses time. Berms turn the bike, rough ground slows it, and hills and slopes affect the rider. Left and Right rotate the bike, and the A button accelerates, with releasing it acting as the brake. Riders can enter their names in a high score table.

87850226dc6c4c52.overview:
Players direct private investigator Ace Harding through a point-and-click mystery to clear his name and recover his lost memories. Awakening with amnesia in a Chicago bar bathroom stall, Ace discovers a corpse upstairs and realizes he is being framed for murder. A puncture in his arm points to an injection, and the player must find a medicine that cures his memory loss before the drug's effects overwhelm him. Repeated doses gradually restore his memory.

Progressing through the investigation involves traveling by taxi to several destinations, including the detective's office. Players confront various obstacles, such as muggers and police, sometimes relying on Ace's boxing skills or standard detective methods to overcome them. Gathering addresses and clues enables the detective to piece together his involvement in a kidnapping scheme and solve the mystery.

87b9c94b5e9144eb.overview:
Guiding a caveman named Bignose atop a newly invented wheel, the player rolls through prehistoric terrain to recover stolen bone savings from Leroy the Lizardman. Hostile creatures harm Bignose on contact. A club serves to strike adversaries, and collecting rock icons enables launching projectiles that can increase in quantity, speed, and piercing power. Gathering twenty-five bones awards an extra life, while bouncing on mushrooms can produce bonuses, hazards, or higher jumps.

The game spans five sections containing four levels each, and every section ends with an encounter with Leroy, who usually brings a monster; an energy bar appears during boss fights. Hidden levels are found by bouncing on mushrooms or falling in the right place, and completing a bonus stage earns a continue. Two alternating multiplayer modes are included: Tag Mode, which alternates control when a player loses a life, and a timed competition where participants take turns gathering bones across five stages.

87e479b14421fc4b.overview:
Matches are selected from a world map screen where players view opponents from various nations, examining each rival's face, name, and skill level before issuing a challenge. As the Casino Kid, the player starts with two hundred dollars and must defeat these international gamblers across Roulette, Blackjack, and Draw Poker before confronting the final rival, the Mystery Man. Progress can be resumed from the title screen using passwords awarded after beating opponents.

In each gambling event, the ultimate objective is to win all of the opposing player's money. Roulette allows up to five bets per spin across single numbers, lines, colors, and number groupings. Blackjack involves drawing cards to approach 21 without busting, featuring options to hit, stand, double-down, split pairs, buy insurance, or surrender. Draw Poker centers on five-card hands with ante wagers, betting rounds, raises, and card exchanges.

884765e5df860422.overview:
Rescuing enslaved children, recovering the missing Sankara Stones, and defeating the antagonist Mola Ram form the primary mission. Guiding Indiana Jones through Pankot Palace, the player tackles twelve levels known as waves. The initial nine stages focus on retrieving the sacred stones, culminating in a crossing of a lava river, while subsequent areas demand deciphering an escape route inside a map room using collected fragments and confronting Mola Ram on a precarious rope bridge. Mine cart tracks offer rides across hazards, and every stage has a countdown timer; letting the clock run out prompts an ambush that drains a life and strips gathered gear.

Movement mechanics include jumping, while freed children bestow items upon the protagonist. Defense relies on a whip, swords, firearms, and TNT to fend off Thuggee guards, bats, rats, snakes, and spiders. Collecting hats yields extra lives, and jewels extend available time.

884b46ad4eb5160a.overview:
Spanning nine distinct areas, the adventure tasks the player with rescuing Kitty from the evil Professor. Controlling Felix the Cat, the player navigates through multiple rounds per area while confronting eight bosses alongside enemies such as birds and fish. Many regular foes pace back and forth, and Felix can attack them using offensive maneuvers supplied by his magic bag.

Controlling the character involves jumping, swimming, or flying, while another button triggers attacks that depend on the active magic item. Taking damage reduces magic power by one tier, and sustaining a hit without an extra magic item costs a life. Lives are also lost if the timer expires or Felix drops off the screen. Collecting scattered items replenishes magic hearts before current items expire.

885cfd4396e0ade5.official: Ken from the Street Fighter™ series becomes a bionic warrior, out to avenge the death of his friend, in this spin-off, side-scrolling shooter. Aliens have stolen a superhuman serum so, with his newly enhanced abilities, Ken must battle across the planets to stop them. Use your weaponry and athletic skills to liberate each planet, and seek out specific target enemies to clear the stage.
885cfd4396e0ade5.overview:
Set in 2010, after mankind has perfected travel to the frontier of other worlds, the narrative follows former martial arts champion Ken. Following the theft of a strength-enhancing substance called Cyboplasm and the murder of his partner Troy, Ken becomes a bionically enhanced warrior to hunt down the culprit across different worlds.

Players direct Ken through side-scrolling stages, navigating environments by climbing walls, columns, and ledges. Ken attacks by firing energy projectiles from his fists and kicks in multiple directions, including diagonal and vertical trajectories. Each level requires destroying designated target enemies to gather enough energy to unlock a transdimensional portal. The player must enter this exit before a timer expires or lose a life. Collected power units fill a five-square power bar and extend attack range, though upgrades are lost along with a life. Other pickups restore health, add an orb that follows Ken and damages attackers, or turn his backflips into a slash kick attack.

88ebfd7a124182cc.overview:
Players slide square tiles within a confined frame to restore a scrambled picture while racing against a clock. At the start of a round, an image appears briefly before its pieces are shuffled into a random configuration. Tiles can only be moved into an adjacent empty space. If needed, players can view the solved target image via a help screen up to five times per puzzle.

Contenders advance across eight numbered stages, with two additional hidden expert rounds unlocked after solving every initial stage. Higher levels feature more detailed pictures and fewer open slots. Players can also spend sixty seconds of clock time to play a mini-game of chance against the computer, choosing either Rock Paper Scissor or Roll the Dice. Winning this challenge rewards a bonus move capable of swapping any two selected tiles on the board.

892468d05a109776.overview:
Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles puts a single participant in control of four brothers across action-platform missions. Players navigate five adventure levels from an overhead perspective, entering sewers and buildings that transition to side-scrolling navigation. Guiding Leonardo, Michaelangelo, Donatello, or Raphael, the player can swap members through an information screen. Each character utilizes a signature primary weapon with distinct reach, speed, and attack power to combat the Foot Clan. A turtle whose life runs out is captured until rescued, and the game ends if all four are captured.

Throughout the journey, players collect pizza to recover life and acquire secondary armaments such as shurikens, boomerangs, and Kiai scrolls. Side-scrolling areas involve jumping, ducking, and fighting adversaries, alongside completing goals such as disarming underwater bombs. Later rooftops require ropes to cross gaps. Boss confrontations conclude most levels, culminating in an assault on the Technodrome and a final battle against Shredder.

8951dccb6640b48c.overview:
Modes across this sports cartridge divide action into volleyball tournaments and soccer competitions. In volleyball, players choose between four two-person pairs, each characterized by balanced attributes, strong spiking, fast movement, or defensive specialization. Available modes include an Exercise match, the American Circuit, the World Cup, and competitive matches. Action supports solo participants, two-player cooperative play against the computer, and competitive play for up to four people.

Soccer matches feature six-player teams, each including a goalkeeper. The player directs one team member directly while issuing pass and shoot commands to the rest of the squad. The sport omits fouls, enabling players to incapacitate opponents through repeated tackles. Players can execute up to five Super Kicks per half by pressing both action buttons simultaneously, alongside step-activated High Power Kicks that remain available afterward. Contests take place in tournament or versus modes across varying surfaces.

89df74e7b275929c.overview:
Professional wrestling bouts take place in an isometric ring viewed from a high angle. Players select from a roster of nine competitors, which includes eight real-world performers and a generic wrestler with no real-world identity. Each competitor possesses an individual moveset, including power moves and attacks from the top of the cornerpost. During contests, meters displayed on the ring apron track each wrestler's stamina. Depleting this stamina bar leaves a wrestler susceptible to being pinned for a loss.

Contest formats include singles bouts, tag team matches, and three-on-three Survivor Series elimination events, with tagging done from the team's corner. Wrestlers can leave the ring to rest but risk a count-out. An eight-man tournament for one player pits the player against all eight stars in succession, starting with Brutus "The Barber" Beefcake. Two players can wrestle each other or join forces as a team against four computer-controlled duos.

8a604198ba3e2437.official: Explore Wonderland with Dizzy and for the first time ever - Daisy!
8a604198ba3e2437.overview:
Rescuing the Yolkfolk from Wonderland serves as the player's primary goal after the evil wizard Zaks places a curse upon the forest of Keldor. The heroes journey down the Rabbit Hole into this themed setting to locate and save their trapped friends.

Controlling Dizzy, Daisy, or both characters as a pair shapes the adventure, which centers on platforming, solving puzzles, and aiding witches. When using both protagonists together, the player controls one at a time, and a Cheshire cat appears upon the death of the active character to pass all carried items over to the surviving partner. The game also provides an option featuring infinite lives.

8aa5c70100080adf.overview:
Guiding the karate student Daniel-san, the player moves through side-scrolling areas and engages in single-combat battles against opponents. The game spans four regular stages and three bonus stages.

The first stage is a karate tournament with four one-on-one rounds that must be won to advance. The following stages scroll through Okinawa, a typhoon and a summer festival, with many enemy fighters and confrontations with Chozen, who holds Kumiko hostage in the last stage. Bonus stages, entered through dark doorways, include catching flies with chopsticks, breaking ice blocks and dodging a swinging hammer, and award Crane Kicks and Drum Punches. Besides one- and two-player games, a One-on-One mode lets two players fight each other as Daniel-san and Chozen.

8ae9b624c08b86f6.overview:
The player controls the barbarian Conan, fighting across dangerous lands to recover the four burial urns of the Early Kings of Aquilonia and claim the kingdom's throne. Gameplay involves running, jumping, ducking, and battling hostile creatures with punches, kicks, jump kicks, and acquired weaponry. Along the way, the player can pick up items from the ground, including shields, swords, axes, and magic fireballs. Defeating flying creatures yields fireballs and extra health points.

The quest progresses through various regions, beginning in the Catacombs of Belveras and continuing through ruins in Brythunia, Kordavo, the Forests of Asgard, the Sky Castle of Vanaheim, and the Tombs of Zamboula before reaching the Crypt of Cahalla. Confrontations include skeletons, specters, wraiths, dragons, and tomb keepers. A dedicated weapon selection screen allows players to view collected armaments and switch weapons to counter specific enemy types.

8b7363e037883aaa.overview:
Taking control of Batman, the player engages in side-scrolling hand-to-hand combat against enemy groups to protect Gotham City from the Penguin and Catwoman. The main character confronts members of the Red Triangle Circus Gang across six distinct stages based on events from the film. Progress requires defeating a boss opponent at the conclusion of every stage.

Throughout the adventure, Batman utilizes several maneuvers alongside specialized weapons such as the Batarang. The hero operates with a single life bar; hidden hearts restore sections of it, and hidden life boxes act as extra lives that refill it when it runs out. Beyond standard fighting areas, the quest incorporates sections in which the player drives the Batmobile and the Batskiboat. A password system allows progress to be recorded.

8ba8baed01a9fbaf.overview:
DuckTales features platforming gameplay centered on Uncle Scrooge as he searches for five lost treasures. Players guide Scrooge across five destinations located on Earth and in outer space. His cane serves as an all-purpose tool that strikes enemies, uncovers items, and propels him upward like a pogo stick to cross dangerous surfaces or reach high platforms. Scattered throughout stages are diamonds that boost Scrooge's wealth and ice cream that replenishes health. Familiar characters appear to provide clues, supply useful items, grant passage to new places, or hinder progress.

Levels can be tackled in any order, though certain locations require return visits to collect necessary items. A boss defends the treasure at the end of every destination. Once these five main valuables are acquired, players enter a final encounter, which leads to a confrontation for the ultimate prize. The concluding sequence varies based on total earnings.

8bb20791eb3f4fd2.overview:
Modes of play include exhibition matchups, a regular season, and a team edit option where players can build customized rosters. The game features four separate leagues: two composed of standard clubs, one populated by ultra squads, and a custom league that can mix both types. A regular season can span 5, 30, 60, or 165 games among six selected teams out of eighteen available. Rather than holding regular playoffs, the club finishing first in the league becomes champion, with a displayed magic number tracking how close the leader is to clinching the title; a play-off is held only when the top teams finish tied.

Participants can direct ordinary athletes or ultra teams equipped with enhanced pitching, batting, and defensive maneuvers. Super skills consume a finite pool of ultra points during games, and the pool is fully restored at the start of each game.

8bc6a252778c2909.overview:
Deep within a perilous subterranean labyrinth, a wizard searches for his long-lost mentor, Mordamir. Designed for a single player, the adventure spans seven levels filled with deadly traps, environmental puzzles, and hostile monsters such as slimes, flying lizards, and giant worms. Navigating the isometric terrain, the wizard uncovers gold, loots chests or bodies, and acquires helpful items, some of them from a merchant.

Players must solve hazards while casting spells or deploying collected artifacts, taking care to use each item in the right place, since some cause harm when used at the wrong time. When a monster attacks, action switches to a dedicated combat screen where the wizard jabs, slashes, and ducks incoming blows. Specialized sections introduce mechanics such as paddling across water and riding a magic carpet.

8d21e1e256f82579.overview:
Matches take place between two squads, the blue team and the red team, starting from a locker room selection screen and running continuously until the contest concludes. The game supports single-player competition against the computer or simultaneous head-to-head play for two participants using separate controllers.

Before each down, participants select offensive or defensive plays from an on-screen menu. On offense, the participant steers the quarterback and can run with the ball or initiate a pass behind the line of scrimmage. Pressing the throw button shifts directional control to an aiming cursor, sending the football toward the chosen point upon release. Kicking maneuvers, such as kickoffs, punts, field goals, and extra points, also rely on cursor placement. While moving, athletes can dive forward to execute lunging tackles, or jump vertically while stationary to intercept passes. In two-player games, the defending participant controls the middle linebacker, though control can switch to the defender closest to the ball carrier.

8da7129bba8c61a5.official: Tennis was the first game to bring the sport to the NES, and includes singles or doubles matches against five different levels of competition. While the controls are simple, it takes time to master the techniques and defeat the toughest opponents. Practice your volleys and smashes if you want to succeed! You may also recognize a familiar mustachioed mascot making a guest appearance in the umpire's chair...
8da7129bba8c61a5.overview:
Matches take place on a tennis court watched over by Mario serving as the umpire. Players compete in tennis matches, executing shots such as volleys and smashes to score against their rivals. Computerized opponents feature artificial intelligence that can be adjusted across five different difficulty levels.

Available game types consist of singles and doubles matches. In the single-player singles format, one participant faces off against a computer-controlled opponent. The doubles mode allows two human participants to team up cooperatively to take on a pair of computerized adversaries. Both game types are played against the computer, and a match goes to the winner of two out of three sets.

8da82a28be164453.overview:
Fred and Barney notice that Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm are missing and find them playing at the foot of a volcano, but a lava flow separates the fathers from the children. Only a greedy Pterodactyl can take them to the kids, and it demands five gemstones as payment for a flight to Dinosaur Peak. Fred and Barney must travel through twelve levels of prehistoric challenges to gain the gems.

The player controls Fred and his friend Barney, switching between these two characters at any point. Fred swings a club, while Barney carries a slingshot. Fred can grab cliff ledges and scale cliff faces, while Barney can climb hand over hand on vines, balance on poles, and attack while hanging. Advancing past certain hazards requires swapping between the two figures to employ their respective traits. Special items, including a bowling ball and throwable stone hammers, can also be collected. The levels have no time limit, and continues are unlimited.

8db2cb94dc9caec6.overview:
Jaws combines overhead navigation with side-scrolling underwater action. The player navigates a vessel across an ocean map and enters side-view stages upon contacting undersea hazards. In these sequences, a diver fights rays, jellyfish, and small sharks. Colliding with the giant shark Jaws starts a fight in which the boat drops bombs; if other sea creatures attack the boat, the diver takes over. After a random number of side-view stages, an airplane bonus sequence begins where dropping bombs on jellyfish yields conch shells and bonus points.

Collected shells serve as currency traded at two ports for a stronger power level, a transmitter that tracks Jaws, and extra strobe lights. Crabs boost diver speed, and players can locate a fragile submarine equipped with torpedoes and bombs. Once Jaws loses sufficient health, perspective shifts to a forward-facing boat view where strobe flashes compel the creature to breach so the vessel can ram it.

8dda0b6bcb5d66fd.overview:
Missions are grouped into levels of four, played in any order the player chooses. The player assumes the role of an elite military aviator dispatched to neutralize critical assets belonging to Don Gwano, a dictator gathering a vast arsenal to seize neighboring oil fields. Operating aircraft equipped with sophisticated weapon systems, the pilot undertakes a series of surgical air strikes.

Every assignment divides into two gameplay phases. Flying toward the objective takes place from a cockpit perspective, where a co-pilot offers advice and on-screen messages warn of stalls, incoming missiles and low fuel. Destroying all enemy planes in this phase shifts the action to an isometric view focused on destroying designated targets. Aircraft fuel is finite, and bonus balloons can add fuel, missiles or bombs, or repair damage. Three planes are available, the F14 Tomcat, AV-8 Harrier and F18 Hornet; a destroyed plane is lost for the rest of the game, and losing all three ends it.

8e4a04076b6a728a.official: Take on the role of a trainee cop as you tackle the toughest shooting range around. Ready your reflexes and shoot the gangsters while avoiding the innocents. Two different game modes allow you to test your skills against cardboard cutout targets, as they spin round or pop out from cover. A third mode lets you have fun and test your sharpshooting skills by keeping tin cans up in the air.
8e4a04076b6a728a.overview:
Three distinct modes structure this shooting range title, which casts the player as an aspiring agent. Using the Zapper light gun accessory, a single participant aims at targets to progress through the challenges.

Two of the modes present cutout panels that turn around or emerge from cover. The player must quickly distinguish between targets, shooting only the gangsters while avoiding innocent people such as a lady, a professor and a policeman. In the third mode, target practice shifts away from cutouts, requiring the player to keep tin cans suspended in the air by repeatedly shooting them and to guide them onto platforms for points.

8e844d77da01f86a.overview:
American football action unfolds on vertically scrolling fields displayed from a top-down perspective, with the offense always moving up the screen. A 1 Player Game sets the player against the computer, and a 2 Player Game sets two players against each other.

On offense, the ball carrier can run, throw a side pass to the left or right lateral receiver, or throw a forward pass to the forward receiver. Kicks are aimed with an arrow, and a field goal can be attempted when the goal post is in view at the snap. Gaining ten yards in four downs earns a new set of downs. When defending, the player chooses which of two defenders to control and can make flying tackles. Play starts at the high school level and moves up through college, pro, and playoff levels to the Super Bowl level; the 1 Player Game also allows any of these five levels to be chosen.

8e91630bd2a9f2f2.overview:
Levels in this title are structured around completing blocks of twenty lines. The premise involves an archeological expedition unearthing the tomb of Queen Lera-Di'-ty along the Nile River. During play, five distinct shapes of stones descend one by one into a pit. The primary objective is to keep the playing area from completely filling up by maneuvering the falling pieces so they align tightly together. Filling an entire horizontal row makes that line vanish. A preview display reveals which stone will appear next.

Players shift falling pieces left or right and can drop them faster by pressing down. The controller buttons rotate pieces clockwise or counterclockwise. When unwanted blocks disrupt the formation, players can detonate bombs to blast away obstructing stones. Pressing up and the B button together launches a bomb, which is then steered with the directional pad. Every twenty completed lines award five additional bombs, while clearing two lines at once yields one bonus bomb.

8eb6aa7818f1cac8.overview:
Five stages of land, sea, and air combat make up the journey toward the enemy fortress. Controlling a combat helicopter to avenge Joe's brother, the player engages opposing aircraft, tanks, foot soldiers, and other targets to earn points. Standard firing and screen-clearing bombs destroy opposition, and helicopters can refuel on a mother ship.

Eliminating specific enemies reveals a weapon system that changes attributes when fired upon, granting items such as missiles, cannon balls, machine guns, or speed and power increases. Players can also rescue hostages, though freed captives award no points. Between rounds, a mission map displays defeated enemies and rescued personnel. Up to two players can participate simultaneously, with a second player able to drop in at any point.

8ed3cb0046caecbe.overview:
Stopping the crime baron Cain from spreading a deadly new chemical called Nuke is the primary mission facing Detroit's cyborg officer. The title supports one or two participants, with two players taking alternating turns upon losing a life or completing a level.

Controlling the titular law enforcement officer, the player navigates through industrial and corporate environments centered around side-scrolling platforming and shooting mechanics. Progress requires walking, jumping, and shooting or punching while managing the officer's inertia. Along with battling Cain's hostile forces, the player must destroy at least sixty percent of the Nuke on each level and make physical contact to arrest at least sixty percent of designated criminals before facing Cain and the new RoboCop 2 prototype.

8f2f9ba926280edd.official: Double Dragon is one of the most famous arcade-action fighting games ever, and formed the template for many followers to come. Help Billy Lee in his quest to save his kidnapped girlfriend Marian from an evil gang. Use whatever weapons come to hand, or your good old fists and feet, to battle through the city. You can also level-up to unlock new moves.
8f2f9ba926280edd.overview:
Double Dragon is an action fighting game where players battle through the slums, factories and wooded outskirts of a city. Controlling martial artist Billy Lee, the player seeks to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend Marian from the Black Warriors gang and its mysterious Shadow Boss. Combat relies on punches, kicks, and advanced martial arts maneuvers, with the ability to level up to gain additional fighting techniques. Players can also pick up weapons, which include bats, whips, knives, and dynamite, or throw objects such as rocks, boxes, and oil drums.

Progressing through four side-scrolling stages requires clearing waves of thugs, navigating hazards like pits, and defeating bosses such as Abobo before time runs out. In the two-player mode, players challenge each other head to head rather than fighting through the stages together.

8f349b0ed7d31a07.overview:
Chef Peter Pepper must construct giant hamburgers across mazes composed of platforms and ladders while evading hostile food items. To prepare each sandwich, Peter walks across various oversized ingredients, including buns, meat patties, tomatoes, lettuce, and cheese. Walking across these items forces them to drop down onto lower levels and eventually assemble on waiting plates below. A stage concludes successfully once every hamburger on the board has been assembled, and the six screens grow progressively tougher.

The Food Foes, Mr. Hot Dog, Mr. Pickle and Mr. Egg, continuously hunt Peter throughout the maze and speed up if a stage takes too long. Contact with an active adversary costs a life. To defend himself, Peter can shake a limited supply of pepper at nearby foes to briefly immobilize them. Enemies may also be crushed under falling ingredients or carried downward atop dropping burger components. Bonus food items grant extra points alongside additional pepper shots. One or two players can play.

901b7a9b3e8c0256.overview:
Reaching the final boss inside the Dark Castle serves as the ultimate destination for the player across vertically scrolling stages. Controlling a flying dragon, the player maneuvers in all directions across the screen to defeat opposing forces. Offensive capabilities consist of two distinct actions: firing at enemies in the air and firing at targets on the ground. Hazards and enemy contacts deplete vitality and can result in defeat.

Two distinct campaign paths are available depending on performance in the opening stage. Succeeding yields a standard journey controlling a blue dragon through nine worlds, spanning environments such as the Paleozoic Era. Failing the introductory sequence shifts the experience to an alternate, shortened storyline of five areas featuring Prince Lace as a gold dragon. This alternate form withstands twice as many damaging blows, deals increased damage, and can fire continuously from the start.

910ba4505b46a99b.official: The NES version of Pinball was one of the first video game recreations of the classic game, and it's still as crowd-pleasing as ever. Use the flippers to keep the ball in play for as long as possible, and rack up a winning score. There are two difficulty settings, and modes for one- or two-players so you and a friend can battle for the highest score.
910ba4505b46a99b.overview:
Operating the paddles of a virtual table, the player deflects a ball to keep it active and accumulate points. The playfield spans two connected screens representing the upper and lower sections of the machine. Action starts on the bottom screen, where a plunger launches the ball upward. As the ball travels between sections, the player manipulates the corresponding flippers to sustain momentum and prevent the ball from dropping through the gap at the base of the lower screen.

Hitting the ball into a bonus hole transitions play into a separate bonus stage. In this mode, the player moves Mario left and right to rebound the ball over bingo lamps, and matching lamps break away the floor beneath a lady walking above. Catching her yields bonus points, while letting her hit the ground results in a loss. Two difficulty options and two-player competition modes are available.

9112f5b30c8a8d0d.official: Take control of your Solvalou fighter and strike deep behind enemy lines to destroy the Xevious forces! Use missiles against airborne enemies and bombs against ground-based targets, and watch out for the colossal floating fortress. Xevious is considered one of the forefathers of the vertically-scrolling shooter genre. Featuring unique enemies, a variety of environments and many hidden gameplay features, it’s an all-time classic that still gets the pulse racing!
9112f5b30c8a8d0d.overview:
Set across vertically scrolling areas whose borders are marked by forests, the action follows Solvalou fighters flying over Xevious enemy territory. The player operates the Solvalou fighter craft, which navigates forward over varied terrain while targeting hostile threats.

Two distinct offensive armaments allow the craft to confront adversaries. Anti-aircraft missiles attack airborne craft, while a bomb sight in front of the vessel aims surface bombs at ground vehicles and enemy bases, flashing red when it passes over a ground target. Encounters include giant Floating Fortresses, whose weapons ports fire heavily and whose core can be bombed, and Solbak, an enemy information system whose destruction temporarily weakens enemy attacks. Extra fighters are awarded at 20,000 and 60,000 points and for every additional 60,000 points. One or two players can take part.

911fb75ec1f900a5.official: HELP SAVE BLOBOLONIA! Blob (full name Blobert) has come from the distant planet Blobolonia in search of an earth boy to help him save his world! Join him on this fantastic adventure in mysterious caverns beneath the earth searching for treasures, then travel to Blobolonia to battle the evil king.
911fb75ec1f900a5.overview:
David Crane's A Boy and His Blob - Trouble on Blobolonia offers puzzle-platform gameplay. Players guide a young protagonist partnering with an alien companion named Blobert to rescue Blobolonia from an evil emperor. The boy explores underground caverns beneath his city on Earth before journeying to Blobolonia. Progression requires avoiding falling rocks, stalagmites, stalactites, and indestructible Subway Serpents across interconnected screens. The boy can only walk left or right without jumping, and long falls or drowning cost a life.

Blobert follows the boy, altering forms when fed flavored jellybeans; shapes include a ladder, a bridge, and a trampoline, and each flavor's name hints at its shape. Whistling calls Blobert and turns him back into a blob. Subterranean regions contain diamonds and treasures that raise money to buy vitamins at a health food store. These vitamins fuel a VitaBlaster used on Blobolonia. Extra jellybeans and peppermints also rest across the terrain.

913c5eb7d4390d0f.overview:
Earning tournament victory by defeating pairs of computer opponents across five distinct coastal stages serves as the primary pursuit. Following official beach volleyball rules, teams of two exchange the ball using up to three touches per side without any player contacting it consecutively. Points tally exclusively while holding the serve, requiring a margin of two points to settle single games to 15 or three-game sets to 12. Between volleys, players can dispute controversial referee rulings directly, though arguing risks a yellow-card warning or a red-card point deduction.

Actions include underhand, flat, and jump serves alongside defensive digs, bumps, sets, blocks, and spikes. An interactive beach area connects players to practice sessions for bumps, sets, and spikes, as well as a match play option and the main tournament. Up to four participants can compete or cooperate using an adapter, taking control of featured athletes such as Sinjin Smith or Randy Stoklos.

9178fba5cbb412cc.overview:
Four rounds of word puzzle competition structure each game, culminating in a bonus stage for the overall leader. Up to three participants can play alone, against each other, or against computer rivals across three skill levels. When three players compete, the first and third share one controller while the second uses another. On each turn, a player decides to spin the wheel, buy a vowel for 250 dollars, or attempt to solve the puzzle before time runs out.

Spinning determines cash values for correct consonants, though landing on special spaces awards free spins, skips turns, or removes round winnings. The third round functions as a speed-up phase with an automatic wheel spin and direct letter calls. The top earner advances to round four, choosing a prize, selecting five consonants and one vowel, and entering the missing letters within a countdown.

91c61066a9b6b5ed.overview:
Escaping an embassy with a briefcase holding a passport, a bag of money, a key, and secret papers before an opponent escapes or time expires is the primary goal. Opposing operatives explore an arena formed from interconnected rooms arranged on a grid, with higher levels expanding the layout into larger play areas. Searching through furniture yields the necessary items alongside remedies, which can defuse matching hazards but must be retrieved one at a time.

Two spies, controlled by two players or by one player against the computer, navigate this environment while striving to eliminate each other. Operatives engage in hand-to-hand combat when close together or plant any of four kinds of traps inside pieces of furniture and on doors. These mechanisms kill whoever activates them, including the spy who set them, and each demise docks thirty seconds from that character's individual countdown timer.

91eae4e0e59dadd5.overview:
Zombie Nation features side-scrolling shoot 'em up play where players direct a giant floating disembodied head. Sent to the United States to reclaim the samurai sword Shura and free a nation already turned into zombies by the alien Darc Seed, the protagonist confronts hazards such as zeppelins, lava monsters, and snipers. The player attacks by discharging eyeballs and vomit, which eliminate hostile targets and demolish structures. Saving hostages that jump from collapsing buildings enhances the character's firepower.

Every round grants a health meter of eight units, which depletes upon taking damage and is replenished at certain score levels. Rounds conclude if all health is lost or the character gets crushed by the scrolling screen. Players receive several continues, choose between easy and hard settings, and can select their starting point among four areas. After completing each area in sequence, the player must defeat the final adversary, Darc Seed.

9229e5f67a285d72.overview:
Bible Buffet combines board game navigation with real-time action stages for up to four participants. Players take turns spinning an onscreen spinner to advance tokens across twelve food-themed lands toward a finishing circle.
