Spinner outcomes and special board spaces can grant extra movement, inflict turn penalties, open shortcuts, or present three-question Bible quizzes selected from specific categories. Landing on an action square sends the player into an action sequence to collect food and locate the exit.

Inside action screens, players maneuver through areas filled with stationary, walking, and harmful food items. Walking food can be stunned using thrown utensils such as spoons, forks, and knives, or dazed with timed preservative blast barrels before collection. Bonus weight is awarded for quickly gathering multiple stunned items. When all players finish, awards recognize the first finisher, the highest food total, and the most quiz stars.

92aa617d6254a7aa.overview:
Tracks across a nine-race season can be completed in any chosen sequence, although they grow progressively more difficult. This top-view racing title challenges the player to compete against computer-controlled rivals, whose numbers increase along with hazards such as oil slicks as the difficulty rises. Advancing forward requires securing a top-three finish in every event, while completing all nine races advances the player to the next difficulty level with a passcode. Four meters track the car's tires, engine, fuel and body, and the game ends if any of them reaches zero.

Earning prize money from competitions allows racers to visit a shop to purchase improvements, as well as repairs and new cars. Available enhancements include temporary boosts to power and handling, side armor that spins rivals out when the car rams them, and projectiles that fire forward or backward to disable opposing vehicles.

9357e9233f65413e.overview:
A remote-controlled mining robot is guided through subterranean caverns to unearth crystals, blast away terrain, and evade subterranean threats across 100 levels. Navigating dirt, rocks, and expanding pools of mud or lava, the vehicle clears paths by shooting energy blasts or setting explosives gathered from item caches. Boulders can be shoved aside horizontally or dropped onto alien enemies, while certain environmental hazards, such as radioactive stones or hostile creatures, demand cautious maneuvering or heavy demolition.

Completing a level requires gathering a predetermined quota of crystals before the countdown clock expires. Reaching this target reveals a teleportation exit square leading deeper into the planetary crust. Hidden beneath the soil and boulders are power-ups that augment the machine with increased shot range, simultaneous rapid fire, bomb stockpiles, temporary damage shields, and extra lives. Players begin with an allotment of five robots, and the title supports two players.

935aa637ca8fb0ec.overview:
Divided into multiple environments, this platformer follows the hero Comic on a quest across the planet Tambi. The primary goal requires recovering three artifacts: the Crown of the Ages, the Mystical Gems of Lascorbanos, and the Thousand Coins of Tenure.

Controlling the protagonist through side-scrolling areas, the player navigates past hostile creatures. Comic starts with five lives. Health is represented by shield points that deplete upon contact with threats, and shield packs restore them. Comic loses a life if he suffers an attack with depleted shields. Collecting a Blastola Cola lets Comic fire projectiles to eliminate enemies, and each additional can, up to five, allows one more shot in the air at once.

9371fab4f58fa6d6.overview:
The player pilots a stock car from a behind-the-vehicle perspective, steering, accelerating, and braking along banked courses. Designed for a single driver, the campaign follows Cole Trickle through an eight-event circuit across seven distinct tracks, beginning and ending at Daytona Beach. Before each contest, a solo four-lap qualifying session determines starting grid placement. During races, competitors navigate traffic against fifteen opponents, accumulating points based on final finishing rank and laps led to compete for the championship cup.

Driving demands careful conservation of resources, as tire degradation, engine trauma, and gas tank damage reduce performance or disable the vehicle entirely. Entering pit road from the left-hand shoulder allows the player to command crew members to replace tires, repair mechanical issues, and replenish fuel while tracking time lost to passing rivals. Poor performance throughout the season prompts solitary time trials requiring the driver to beat a target benchmark to preserve team sponsorship.

939dcb88fce04f9c.overview:
Protecting Earth from environmental ruin caused by the toxic Lord Contaminous serves as the primary goal of the adventure. The player controls Zen, an alien ninja hired by the Gordons, the galaxy's environmental watchdogs, to stop Contaminous, protect the Earth boy Jeremy and secure the Geocrystal, a gem with the power to save the world. Zen fights with his Photon-Stick.

Four disaster stages can be tackled in any order, mixing side-view and diagonal-view action. Objectives include tapping flowers to revive them from acid rain, rescuing people from a burning oil rig with a fire extinguisher, escaping a factory before a time bomb explodes, and finding the way through a runaway railway maze. In addition to battling figures like Sulfura, Oil Slick, Smogger, and Garbageman, the player tackles a rescue mission, recycling-oriented bonus rounds that create the Recycled Heroes, and further boss stages before confronting Contaminous directly.

942c802c34627c96.overview:
Eight skating events, consisting of four regular levels paired with bonus rounds, form the structure of the game. Courses take place across the suburbs, city streets, beaches, and a park, concluding with the Super Rollerblade Challenge. Players guide an in-line skater along these paths while avoiding road hazards like open manholes, road blocks, animals, and moving obstacles.

The overall goal involves qualifying for and completing the Super Rollerblade Challenge. Advancing to this final event requires collecting at least 5,000 points across the preliminary rounds. Points accumulate by completing levels, executing jumps and half-pipe maneuvers, and finishing an event with time remaining on the clock. Players manage a health meter represented by bandages and begin the competition with three pairs of skates.

944105c6dcc57314.official: Earth – the year 2112. A lone motorcycle warrior is all that stands between invaders and survivors. You are Mach Rider! In the main Fighting Course mode, race through winding highways and take out the enemies using your machine guns or by barging them into obstacles. In Endurance Course, pit your survival skills against the clock, or try Solo Course for an enemy-free ride.
944105c6dcc57314.overview:
Searching for survivors across an invaded Earth in 2112 drives the player onward while destroying hostile forces along winding highways. Steering a four-speed superbike, the player accelerates, shifts gears, and fires built-in machine guns to eliminate obstacles and enemy Quadrunners. Ramming adversaries into track hazards awards bonus points and replenishes depleted ammunition. Well-timed shifts from first through fourth gear reach high speed quickly, whereas remaining in high gear from a standstill impairs acceleration.

Several distinct game modes are available. Fighting Course acts as the main campaign spanning ten sectors. Endurance Course challenges players to cover a specific distance before time runs out, while Solo Course removes enemy vehicles entirely. Additionally, Design mode permits constructing custom tracks to navigate across the available rule sets.

950ebe68e7f74219.official: Donkey Kong has finally been captured by Mario! In this unique role-reversal platformer, you play as DK's son, Junior, and must save your dad from Mario's clutches. Swing and climb your way across vines and chains to grab the keys that unlock Donkey Kong's cage, avoiding nasty critters like Snapjaws and Nitpickers. It's a game all about speed and high scores, so get swinging and rack up those points... but don't forget to rescue DK!
950ebe68e7f74219.overview:
Across several themed stages, the player controls Junior on a quest to rescue his father, Donkey Kong, from Mario's cage. Junior traverses environments by walking, jumping, and grabbing vines or chains to ascend the screen. Holding two vines allows him to climb more rapidly, while holding just one lets him slide down quickly.

Progress requires reaching keys to unlock the cage while avoiding hazards such as Snapjaws, Nitpickers, and Sparks. Players can evade threats by leaping over them, or knock down fruit to defeat foes below. Getting bitten by a Snapjaw, pecked by a Nitpicker, colliding with a Spark, falling from a vine, or letting the bonus timer run out costs a life.

955abe39d0a45dab.overview:
After surviving a car crash that destroys their vehicle, an unseen protagonist enters an old mansion to find their missing sister. Exploration reveals that the estate is haunted, the work of Dracan, a gifted apprentice corrupted by dark powers. The ultimate objective is to overcome the rogue apprentice, locate the sister, and escape.

Navigating this point-and-click adventure occurs through the rooms of the house, a tower, and separate backyard buildings including a greenhouse and a chapel. Progress requires collecting items, unraveling hints from scrolls, diaries and notes, casting spells learned from scrolls, and unlocking restricted areas. Zombies, ghosts and other apparitions must be avoided or defeated. Picking up a ruby is a trap, since carrying it for too many moves proves fatal.

9575ec31c1c658fd.official: In Castlevania II: Simon’s Quest for NES, vampire hunter Simon Belmont must track down and destroy Dracula’s remains in order to save himself from a deadly curse. Castlevania II expands on its predecessor with the addition of new adventure elements and a day and night system – meaning tougher enemies when the sun goes down!
9575ec31c1c658fd.overview:
Controlling the vampire hunter Simon Belmont, the player explores a nonlinear world to find Dracula's split remains and lift a fatal curse. Simon travels between towns, wilderness areas, and five mansions to recover body parts and the Magic Cross, which open the path to the final confrontation at Dracula's ruined castle. Defeated adversaries drop hearts that serve as currency for buying items, weapons, and new whips from merchants, while also raising Simon's experience level.

A recurring day and night cycle alters conditions across the map. Stronger foes appear after dark but drop larger heart rewards, while towns become overrun by zombies. Simon utilizes a primary whip alongside secondary magic weapons, such as holy water that destroys concealed walls or a bouncing diamond projectile. Dracula's recovered body parts also provide practical benefits, including a rib that shields against incoming enemy fire.

9579a2b5a4083420.official: In the year 2029, humanity faces certain extinction. An alien force led by Supreme Commander Vile Malmort is poised to destroy the Earth. Our greatest scientists were assembled to stop this menace. From their laboratory came mankind’s last hope: S.C.A.T., the Special Cybernetic Attack Team! Featuring one or two-player simultaneous action, fly your jetpack-equipped warrior through five challenging stages swarming with enemies.
9579a2b5a4083420.overview:
Stopping an alien invasion led by Supreme Commander Vile Malmort is the central goal. In the year 2029, cyborg soldiers known as the Special Cybernetic Attack Team deploy to save Earth from destruction. Operating solo or in simultaneous two-player action, participants choose between Arnold and Sigourney, who possess identical abilities. Players fly in eight directions through automatically scrolling horizontal and vertical environments across five stages, confronting enemy waves and stage bosses while managing six hit points.

Characters fire their standard gun strictly left or right while supported by two orbiting satellite modules. These pods fire simultaneously with the main weapon and can be locked into desired positions using the A button. Destroying specific item-carrying enemies releases letter icons granting speed enhancements, life recovery, or alternative firearms including a laser, wide beam, and bomb launcher. Depleting all life points ends the run, though unlimited continues remain available.

959fdd32c71735d6.official: Mario and Luigi are called back into action when Bowser and his kids turn the kings of the Mushroom World into animals and steal their royal magic wands. The acclaimed Super Mario Bros. 3 features more Mario action than ever before: fly as Raccoon Mario, swim as Frog Mario, throw fireballs as Fire Mario, and turn into an invincible statue as Tanooki Mario!
959fdd32c71735d6.overview:
Eight distinct kingdoms divided into multiple individual courses structure the journey across an overworld map. Guiding Mario or Luigi, players traverse branching routes that link regular action stages, fortresses, and bonus areas to reach each world's final confrontation. The overarching goal requires recovering stolen magic wands from Bowser's children, restoring transformed rulers, and ultimately rescuing Princess Toadstool from Bowser's castle.

Inside side-scrolling levels, the character runs, jumps, slides down hills, climbs vines, and swims while defeating foes by stomping or throwing items. Multiple suits and power-ups grant special abilities, such as flying as Raccoon Mario, swimming as Frog Mario, launching fireballs as Fire Mario, or turning into an invincible statue using the Tanooki Suit. The game also provides a two-player mode with competitive or cooperative play.

96861646aadc9534.overview:
Fifty-two separate games are collected on this single cartridge. Each comes with a short premise: in Fire Breathers the player fights dragon riders in the midnight skies, Jupiter Scope uses the Star-Zap laser against a growing meteor shower, Ninja Assault sets the player against the Zin-Zan evil ninja tribes, and in Robbie and the Robots Robbie leads his good robots against his evil brother Brainy.

The final entry, The Action Gamemaster, follows a boy who is dragged into the television while playing a video game, becomes one of three Cheetah Men, and must fight off the bad guys from the previous 51 games.

978eb3b632927b65.overview:
Completing rounds across various golfing greens serves as the primary objective for participants. Players can compete on four pre-set courses set in England, Scotland, Japan, and the United States. Utilizing the NES Four Score accessory, up to four players can participate in the simulation.

A dedicated hole-design mode allows users to construct and customize their own eighteen-hole course. The cartridge includes a battery back-up feature, which enables the player to save any custom course they create.

97c67809c952bc25.overview:
Stopping criminal operations, defeating enemy bosses, and defusing planted explosives across three missions form the primary goals of the game. Los Angeles police officers Riggs and Murtaugh combat mercenaries, bank robbers, and a corrupt former officer across locations including an exhibition center, a shopping mall, docks, a freeway, and a construction site. While rescuing hostages, the characters navigate environments by moving along paths, into or out of the screen, and jumping. A resting character regains some energy, and players switch between the partners by moving off the left edge of the display.

Combat involves toggling between bare hands and collected equipment. Riggs relies on kicks, possessing an especially powerful flying kick, whereas Murtaugh punches with greater force and favors firearms. Walking over pick-ups replaces current handheld items with grenades, knives, or packing cases. Extra ammunition arrives through handguns, while bullet-proof vests and energy icons provide defensive support.

97e84b6cbe198710.overview:
Racermate Challenge II functions as a cycling simulation designed for exercise and race preparation. Players operate real bicycles mounted to CompuTrainer bike trainer units, whose handlebar controls connect to the NES through an interface module plugged into both controller ports. As cyclists pedal their bicycles in the physical world, the speed they generate on the trainer drives their progress along the selected course.

During rides, the display tracks performance metrics to evaluate rider speed and endurance. The interface presents data covering travel speed, power output, pedaling cadence, heart rate, and total distance covered. Menus are operated with buttons on the trainer's handlebar control rather than a standard NES controller. Up to two participants can train simultaneously by attaching two trainer units, allowing both riders to race each other on screen.

97f56ee3bcb05429.overview:
Collecting items dropped from above by Olive Oyl constitutes the central goal in this platformer. Controlling Popeye, the player navigates stairs and ladders without the ability to jump, picking up falling objects before they sink into the water at the bottom of the screen. Perils such as the Sea Hag and thrown bottles constantly threaten the sailor during his pursuit.

Brutus continuously chases Popeye between platforms, attacking from above and below. Popeye can punch incoming projectiles to destroy them, but he cannot knock out Brutus without first punching the spinach. Spinach gives Popeye extra power for a while, enabling him to knock Brutus out while also doubling the value of collected items.

98658d5c8e530994.overview:
Spanning a total of 15 stages, this action title presents a quote before each round begins. The player assumes the role of Duke Davis. Characterized as a former punk rocker and martial arts vigilante, he wears sunglasses and a yellow outfit while advancing through urban areas to confront street criminals.

Progression involves patrolling locations such as city parks and railroad yards while defeating various opponents, which include boxers, gorillas, and small adversaries wielding a ball and chain. Duke knows fifteen Force Moves, such as the Bull Ram and the Trip, but only three are available in each stage, and a practice session before the stage reveals which ones.

9866b51b16b503aa.overview:
Maneuvering a motorcycle from an overhead perspective, the player navigates roadways across the United States while competing against rival racers. Progression requires crossing the finish line ahead of a designated number of opponents while steering clear of scattered road hazards. The bike's gasoline runs low during a race, so it must pull into filling stations, where five rivals pass before the rider can go on.

Crashing or running out of gas sends the rider back to the beginning of the course. Periodically, a helicopter drops items onto the track, including extra or high-grade gasoline, a turbocharger, invincibility, bonus points and helper motorcycles that crash rival racers. Placing in the top ten allows players to choose one upgrade in a tune-up shop, selecting between engines and specialized tires. The game supports one player or two players alternating turns.

98691aea357072f9.overview:
Eleven three-dimensional isometric levels comprise the adventure, which supports either a single player or two players participating simultaneously. Controlling the snakes Rattle and Roll, players navigate through obstacles while consuming small round creatures called Nibbley Pibbleys using tongue lashes. Eating these creatures increases a snake's length, especially when consuming matching colors or yellow targets. Once a snake reaches sufficient weight, its tail flashes, signaling that players can jump on a scale to ring a weigh-in bell and open the stage exit.

Various hazards populate each level, including bombs from creature dispensers, sharp objects, deep drops, and sharks that attack lingering swimmers. Enemies can be defeated by tongue strikes or jumping. Sustaining damage strips tail segments, and exhausting all segments or succumbing to environmental threats costs a life. Manhole-style lids reveal items, bonus stage entrances, or foes.

989243c99d6e58c4.overview:
Controlling Mickey Mouse, the player navigates two-dimensional platforming environments while Minnie Mouse follows behind. As the journey unfolds, Minnie occasionally gets kidnapped, and the overarching mission requires rescuing Alice from Alice in Wonderland.

Mickey and Minnie travel across multiple areas: the Fun House, the Ocean, the Woods, the Pirate Ship, and the Castle. Various Disney cartoon and animated film villains serve as bosses throughout the progression.

98ba2353111a0b2c.overview:
Set across eight cylindrical sea towers, the game tasks the player with guiding a character named Julius to the summit of each structure. Julius begins at the bottom of a tower and works upward along exterior ledges, climbing stairs and riding elevators. As the protagonist walks left or right, the cylindrical tower rotates, creating a sense of depth.

Various geometric adversaries obstruct the ascent. Julius can shoot and stun or destroy certain hazards, while others resist all attacks. Contact with an enemy knocks the character off his feet, and tumbling into the water below causes the loss of a life. Reaching a door at the peak triggers a bomb to demolish the tower, after which Julius visits a diamond-studded bonus level to collect gems.

9930cf033982f378.overview: Super Gun is a scrolling shoot-'em-up in which the player pilots an aircraft through stages filled with enemy forces. An opening radio exchange sets up the premise: a pilot called Hawk reports that the plane is being drawn off course by an unknown magnetic force, and when the base orders Hawk to turn back from a forbidden area, Hawk replies that it cannot be done. The screen scrolls automatically while the player shoots down the opposition and collects power-ups along the way. Clearing the final stage leads to a staff credits screen.

995b57f7d2c68a56.overview:
Stages in this shooter take place across an airport seized by extremist guerillas, from an aircraft and its jetway through the ticket counter lobby and airport entrance to the enemy hideout, with a bonus round occurring after every two levels. Players assume the roles of sharpshooters Rad Rex or Manic Jackson, operatives in an anti-terrorist team fighting Eugene Extreme and the Unknown Guerillas. The screen automatically scrolls from left to right while enemies and innocent bystanders emerge from doorways and cover, requiring the use of the NES Zapper to eliminate threats.

Shooting a box in the lower-right area grants items such as ammunition, health, or weapons whenever icons appear inside it. The recurring bonus round is a Hangman-style word puzzle in which the player shoots letters to spell a hidden word. Completing the word before the timer expires awards 100 bonus points for each second remaining, while committing five errors or letting time lapse concludes the bonus event without points.

997ddca52ac72448.overview:
King Graham of Daventry embarks on a journey across the land of Serenia to free his family from the clutches of the evil Mordack and find his vanished castle. Aided by an owl companion named Cedric and powers granted by Cedric's master Crispin, Graham must cross a barren desert, treacherous mountains, and the sea to reach Mordack's island stronghold.

Players navigate this two-dimensional graphic adventure using an icon bar operated with the controller and an on-screen cursor. Individual icons correspond to actions such as walking, talking, inspecting environments or objects, and gathering or using inventory items. Much of the experience focuses on solving puzzles and surviving a dangerous quest. Progress can be recorded with passwords, and up to 20 file saves are kept while the console stays on.

99806081ba58c0a1.overview:
Anglers navigate a boat across a lake to cast lines and reel in catches during tournament matches. The primary goal is to catch numerous black bass during each fishing day, which runs from 6:00 A.M. until a closing time that shifts depending on the date. Fishing begins by picking a spot on the water and casting out a lure with a chosen amount of meter power.

Moving the lure realistically through the water attracts nearby fish. Once a fish bites the bait, the angler works to haul it toward the landing net while using thumbing brakes to control its runs. Winding in a hooked fish too fast sets off a warning sound, and letting it reach the edge of the screen can cut the line. Between casts, players can adjust their strategy by changing lure types and colors based on conditions.

99bba29bd92942f6.overview:
Players guide a continuously bouncing character through 32 island maze levels, steering the figure vertically across each stage. The primary objective involves gathering various colored treasures such as rubies, emeralds, and gold bullion. To pick up an item, the protagonist must match its shade, which is accomplished by passing through attitude converters. Gray stairways serve as exits, and some appear only after all the jewels are collected.

Mazes present hazards like mines, crawling enemies, and traps, alongside helpful elements such as boats for water, ice boots, and hospitals that heal damage. A button press activates hyperactive mode, while passwords allow players to resume progress. The game offers single-player, two-player competitive, and cooperative teamwork modes, as well as an editor for building custom levels.

99c6775ac55cb243.overview:
Set in ancient China during the era depicted in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, this turn-based strategy game tasks players with securing supremacy over the entire nation. Participants select one of six scenarios that establish the starting distribution of warlords, territories, and allegiances across 41 provinces. Rather than following historical outcomes, events unfold based on strategic decisions. Victory occurs once a player conquers every province on the map.

Participants choose which warlord to command or create a New Ruler on vacant land, and up to twelve players can take part. Generals are rated in Intellect, War Ability, and Charm. These attributes govern performance in warfare, province development, recruiting, and alliances, and battles can include personal combat between generals. Advisers offer advice before commands are carried out. Players can reward generals with gold, horses, or writings to raise their loyalty or intellect, since disloyal generals may leave or switch sides.

99f3ca1657ad48f9.overview:
Still screens structure this single-player adventure, interrupted by navigation through mazes and special finger wars contests. Taking place within the Salad Kingdom, the story focuses on a knight named Sir Cucumber, who receives aid from a persimmon companion named Percy. The duo embarks on a quest toward the Zucchini Mountains to rescue Princess Tomato after she is abducted by Minister Pumpkin.

Controlling the protagonist through fixed command buttons displayed across the display borders, the player selects actions to solve puzzles and advance the narrative. Overcoming obstacles requires discovering the proper sequence of instructions. Finger wars duels against opponents, including Minister Pumpkin, begin with a stone, scissors and paper round followed by a pointing round. A password is given for each area cleared.

9abebd837287a38a.overview:
Controlling a prince, the player navigates through Groken Castle to rescue Princess Margarita. Advancement requires solving room-based puzzles by pushing objects such as brick blocks, barrels, candles, and elevator-controlling blocks. To pass through locked doors, the prince must use a key that matches the door's color, and each door opened spends a key.

A single player searches the castle's one hundred rooms to locate the princess, and a map found in the castle shows the prince's current room. Throughout the stronghold, the prince must avoid hazards and hostile creatures, including knights, wizards, bishops, attack cats, fire spirits, and phantom flowers.

9b547db136e4b756.overview:
Elite centers on space trading and combat. Players begin at a space station controlling Commander Jameson aboard a lightly armed Cobra Mk III trading vessel with one hundred credits. Advancing through the open-ended setting involves undertaking activities such as asteroid mining, piracy, commerce, bounty hunting, and missions to earn funds. One objective involves increasing the pilot combat rating until reaching the title rank.

Accumulated money funds vessel upgrades including improved weaponry, expanded cargo space, an extra energy unit, automated docking computers, and fuel scoops. Pilots navigate planetary systems via sublight propulsion and execute hyperdrive jumps across interstellar space, with jump range limited by the fuel aboard. Star systems feature orbiting stations requiring precise manual alignment to enter docking bays unless assisted by computer systems. During hyperdrive travel, hostile Thargoid alien forces can intercept ships in transit, forcing confrontations in witch-space.

9b6d967f493a565e.overview:
Centering on a superhero disfigured by gangsters, this side-scrolling platformer follows the protagonist as he confronts the individuals responsible. Controlling Darkman, the player can jump, kick, and punch through stages played against a timer, and several stages end in a fight with one of Durant's henchmen. The concluding level takes place in a half-constructed skyscraper, where Darkman meets Durant for a final battle.

Between levels, helicopter action sequences require climbing up and down a ladder while avoiding trucks, birds, and bombs. Other interludes involve moving a cursor to photograph a target gangster. More correct photos craft a better mask and award more time to complete the subsequent stage. Taking these pictures allows Darkman to disguise himself as those foes, but the artificial skin disintegrates in light, which limits his time.

9babea1d40007f93.overview:
Mario is Missing! centers on educational exploration and platforming. Bowser has established a base in Antarctica and abducted Mario to prevent interference with his scheme to melt polar ice. Operating as a single-player adventure, the title places the player in control of Luigi, who uses teleportation portals to journey across real-world cities in pursuit of his missing brother.

Progress requires navigating cities to recover stolen cultural treasures by defeating Koopas carrying them. Players converse with local residents to gather clues, track details via an in-game computer, and return the missing artifacts to appropriate information centers by answering questions about them. Luigi also summons Yoshi to remove Pokeys obstructing exit paths back to the castle, eventually confronting a disguised Koopa posing as Bowser and rescuing Mario.

9bc9b891cb8da7f4.overview:
Behind the wheel of a Formula One car, the player steers, accelerates, and brakes across international circuits while competing against twenty-four other drivers. Modes include single-course practice sessions and the full sixteen-round Grand Prix World Championship. Before starting, the player chooses between an automatic transmission or a three-speed manual gearbox shifted via the directional pad, using the tachometer lights to determine the best time to change gears.

In championship mode, each round opens with an uncontested qualifying lap to set the car on the starting grid. During the five-lap races, drivers must maintain an active position limit shown on the dashboard; dropping behind this cutoff results in disqualification. Excessive track excursions or collisions degrade tire grip, requiring a stop in the pit lane where rapid button presses speed up the tire-changing crew. A password system allows progress through the season to be resumed.

9bef1813dbcfa003.overview:
Restoring peace to the land of Argool requires defeating the evil dominator Ligar. Players control a resurrected warrior who travels to confront the tyrant in his flying castle. Success depends on visiting five Indora gods across the realm to gather vital items before reaching the final encounter and opening the Door to Peace.

This single-player platformer equips the warrior with the Diskarmer, a weapon he swings forward at enemies. The hero navigates levels while jumping, ducking, and climbing ropes to evade hazards and dangerous beasts. The weapon can be used while running, crouching, climbing, or in midair to eliminate opposing creatures.

9caa01a2b81ce1f9.overview:
Guiding Tiki the kiwi bird, the player runs, jumps, and fires projectile attacks across multiple stages to rescue captured friends and girlfriend Phee-Phee from Wally Walrus. Starting with a standard bow and arrow, Tiki can acquire alternative armaments such as downward bombs and a wall-piercing laser gun. Balloons can be commandeered to float upward through the air, though spikes and enemy attacks can burst them. Swimming sections require monitoring a limited air supply, where Tiki cannot jump or use standard weapons but can spit water upon surfacing.

The journey spans five distinct worlds containing four levels each. Stages require finding and freeing caged companions to proceed, alongside uncovering hidden rooms, warp zones, and collectible fruit. Magic items offer temporary enhancements, including screen-clearing spells, invulnerability, and freezing adversaries. A time-keeping threat appears if a stage takes too long to finish. The Select button allows choosing between a one-player or two-player game, and three continues are available.

9cdcac614a14e0ae.overview:
Knocking each colored object ball into a pocket using the cue ball serves as the primary objective across sixty different stages. The game blends traditional pocket billiards with concepts from miniature golf, setting each round on pool tables of varying shapes that occasionally feature obstacles. Players can also adjust the surface friction of the table.

A life is deducted if the player sinks the cue ball or fails to pocket an object ball across three consecutive attempts. Clearing a stage yields an extra life, while sinking a ball on every strike awards two extra lives. Ball values depend on their printed numbers multiplied by a rate modifier that rises with each successful consecutive pot and drops back to one upon a miss. More extra lives are awarded when the rate reaches 20, 25, 30, 35 or more. The run concludes once every life is lost. In two-player games and games against the computer, players alternate turns.

9d01730c16c2cfd2.overview:
Reaching the finish line across various obstacle courses before time expires serves as the central goal. Players guide an on-screen runner across five distinct athletic fields: Hurdles, Animal Trail, Dark Tunnel, a log-crossing trial, and a water course. Movement is operated through physical actions on a floor mat peripheral, where running, hopping on single pads, jumping, and crouching direct the runner through hurdles, steep inclines, approaching animals, and floating hazards. A turtle crawling along the bottom of the screen marks the time limit, which adjusts according to the participant's entered age and sex.

Three play formats are available. Training allows individual practice on any single event. Beginner runs through all five fields sequentially. Expert continually loops through the five stages across multiple rounds with increased distances and additional hazards. Completing all five fields in Beginner or Expert leads to a performance evaluation score and certificate.

9d0396286f2c0273.overview:
Defeating reigning world champion Disaster Don serves as the ultimate goal for competitors navigating powerboat races. In single-player mode, played at Easy, Normal or Expert difficulty, the driver goes head-to-head against rivals such as Seasick Sidney, Aquarious Rex, Vicious Vickey, Surfer Bob, Weird Willey, Mangler Mike and Veronica Alabaster before finally facing Disaster Don. Losing two races ends the run, and a two-player mode pits two drivers against each other.

Controlling a powerboat, the player steers primarily from an overhead bird's-eye perspective featuring multidirectional scrolling, though buoy sections shift to a third-person tracking view. Winnings accumulate from legs won, beating course best times, sinking the rival boat, and gathering cash bonuses. These funds pay for repairs and boat component upgrades or cover two-thousand-dollar fines assessed for false starts. Collisions with animals, stationary obstacles, or rival watercraft inflict craft damage.

9d35bccd23f8caf0.overview:
Set during the Warring States Period of feudal Japan, the game tasks players with unifying the country under one rule, either the 17 fiefs of central Japan or all 50 fiefs. Taking control of Oda Nobunaga or other regional daimyos, the participant manages land, builds an economy, and commands armies across the nation. Up to eight players are supported in this strategic contest.

Play unfolds in alternating turns, where strategic map turns represent seasons and tactical battlefield phases represent single days. Leaders allocate critical resources to sustain civil productivity, retain peasant loyalty, and expand military power. Decisions include levying taxes, improving flood defenses, trading through merchants, recruiting troops or ninjas, training forces, arranging political marriages, and spying on rivals. In warfare, victory comes from outlasting an invading force for a month, wiping out an enemy command division, forcing an opposing army to retreat, or starving foes of their supplies.

9d83796d8feba971.overview:
The Legend of Kage features side-scrolling platform action with hack and slash combat. Players control the ninja Kage as he attempts to rescue Princess Kiri from a band of mystical villains led by the warlord Yoshi. Armed with swords and star knives, the hero battles through enemy-filled areas including forests, hidden passageways, fortress walls, and castles.

Completing the quest requires saving the princess three times, which causes the surrounding seasons to shift. Collecting a crystal ball grants the ninja superhuman power, including enhanced speed, and lets him absorb an enemy strike. One or two players can take part.

9d875583dbdf80a0.overview:
Widget is a platform game where the player guides the title character through five stages. The player must first complete Stage 1, after which Stages 2, 3, and 4 can be tackled in any order before entering the final fifth stage. Throughout each stage, Widget runs, jumps, crouches, and shoots enemies while watching meters for remaining life, magic, and time.

Opening the transformation screen allows the player to spend magic points to morph into alternate forms, such as Mouse Widget to navigate narrow passages or Rock Man Widget. Players can also access the Mega Brain to view a map, receive advice, or escape from a stage without spending magic. Defeated enemies and exploration yield items that restore or expand life and magic capacity, increase weapon firing speed and power, grant extra lives, or add points. Secret openings exist within certain walls, and progress can be resumed using continues or six-digit passwords.

9daa4bec3013ae7e.overview:
Falling blocks of various shapes are maneuvered and stacked by the player as they descend onto the play area. The core objective requires arranging these descending pieces to complete continuous horizontal lines. Whenever a complete row forms across the playing field, that line disappears, preventing the accumulated structures from reaching the top of the screen.

Five game-play variations can be selected: a one-player game, a two-player competition, a two-player cooperative game, a match against the computer, and a cooperative game with the computer. In every variation except the one-player game, both sides receive the same shapes in the same order. Each player chooses a starting difficulty level from 0 through 9 and a handicap of 0, 3, 6, 9 or 12 lines already stacked at the start. The pieces fall faster as more lines are cleared, and bonus points for singles, doubles, triples and four-line Tetrises are awarded each time a new difficulty level is reached.

9e31d3d918a352c0.overview:
Campaign matches unfold across medieval England in 1149 as factions contest territorial dominion following the monarch's demise. A single player assumes command of one of four Saxon leaders to battle Norman forces and ultimately crush the three Norman castles to claim the crown. Victory requires managing a prolonged war of attrition by building larger forces than rival factions and launching assaults at favorable moments.

Gameplay involves building armies to conquer hostile territories, clash directly with opposing military forces, and lay siege to or plunder rival fortresses. Players also compete in periodic jousting tournaments to win territory, undertake a mission to rescue a damsel in distress, and seek assistance from Robin Hood.

9e552c628e4e2ab6.overview:
Earning money through simulated slot machine betting serves as the primary objective, with the game rewarding large winnings with erotic images of hostesses. Players choose among three machines, each leading to a different hostess with her own short scenes and comments.

During play, the player wagers on each pull of the machine and tries to build up a profit. Winning a large amount of money in a round displays illustrations of the machine's hostess, partly clothed or nude.

9e65e4d55123612c.overview:
Thwarting the evil organization Cobra and its leader Cobra Commander serves as the ultimate mission, after the villain sets up a secret base on Atlantis to build weapons for conquering the world. The player directs members of the G.I. Joe team across an overhead map to reach Cobra bases. Progress requires traversing sub-stages and infiltrating enemy fortresses, where the player battles troops, finishes secondary objectives like rescuing hostages, and faces Cobra leaders such as Destro.

Controlling General Hawk initially, the player meets additional operatives like Duke and Snake Eyes during the missions, and they join the team. Selected teammates can be swapped via a pause menu, and each has his own specialty. Collecting items and power-ups upgrades character weaponry and capabilities, while finding specific allies lets players radio them during missions to replenish health or munitions.

9f04b8e867aa8569.overview:
Competing across off-road racing courses and specialized automotive contests forms the primary objective for participants. Players steer monster trucks along extended dirt courses while executing varied driving maneuvers, including performing doughnuts and flattening stationary automobiles. Available events also include vehicle-based challenges like automotive tug of war alongside sled-pulling competitions.

Custom courses can be created in the Track Builder mode, which allows participants to construct their own specialized stage for driving. The title supports competition for up to four participants when using four-player adapter accessories.

9f54aafa367247b9.overview:
Destroying the enemy fleet in a 1943 battle off the Midway Islands forms the core objective of the mission. Piloting a P-38, the player targets hostile air and sea forces. With only one life, survival depends on an energy meter that serves as health, which empties slowly over time and from enemy attacks unless replenished.

Controlling the fighter in vertical flight, the pilot fires standard guns, executes defensive loop maneuvers, and can trigger the special attacks Lightning, Cyclone and Tsunami by spending energy. Shooting red planes yields POW items that can be shot to receive energy or alternate weapons, including the Shot Gun, 3-Way Shot, Auto and Super Shell. Before play, points are distributed among offensive power, defensive power, energy level, special weapons and special weapons time limit, and a password lets play resume later.

9f559f83b9b51791.overview:
Divided into several acts, the journey takes the protagonist across multiple global settings, including East Berlin and Greece. Players guide the assassin Golgo 13, also known as Duke Togo, who must eliminate the leader of the DREK group.

The mission begins after an aerial explosion destroys a helicopter near the Statue of Liberty. Because a secret bacteriological weapon called Cassandra-G was aboard and its whereabouts became unknown, the hitman travels between these locations, gathering clues from informants, to complete his contract. Play mixes horizontally scrolling action, first-person shootouts when he is ambushed, air and underwater battles, and first-person action mazes.

9f5891d333ea410c.official: Billy and Jimmy face their toughest challenge yet as they must save Marian from an evil organization in pursuit of the legendary Rosetta Stones. Like other games in the Double Dragon series, you can play through this perilous journey by yourself or with a friend in multiplayer.
9f5891d333ea410c.overview:
Marion has disappeared, and Billy and Jimmy Lee must gather three Sacred Stones scattered across the globe as ransom to get her back. Their journey starts in the United States and continues through China, Japan, and Italy before ending in Egypt. Combat utilizes standard punch and kick inputs, a dash maneuver, a head grab, flying jump kicks, and somersault throws. Two defeated bosses, Chin Seimei and Yagyu Ranzou, join the party as playable allies, allowing players to swap at any time between available fighters. Each martial artist possesses distinct speed, health, and combat moves, alongside a limited supply of a personal backup weapon such as nunchakus, an iron claw, or shurikens. Certain fallen enemy armaments can also be collected.

Each fighter has a single life, and play progresses until the entire party falls. Two participants can fight simultaneously, choosing between modes with or without friendly fire.

9f63cec07fb4b01c.overview:
Guiding a dragon through a maze, the player aims to bite the tails off opposing dragons. The first bite from behind removes a dragon's tail. A tailless dragon is weaker, can be attacked from the front or rear, and turns into a skeleton if bitten again, although it can regain a tail by biting another dragon's tail. Each level has a time limit, and play continues through maze after maze. A Magic Lantern lets the dragon clear Bushy Hedges to reveal bonus items, and a Dragon Egg gives an extra dragon.

Two players can participate together in either a competitive or cooperative format.

9f671090ffd2bb1d.overview:
Players control Leonardo, Raphael, Michaelangelo, or Donatello in beat 'em up action, using signature weapons to combat enemy forces. After Shredder kidnaps April O'Neil and lifts Manhattan into the sky as a floating island, the heroes set out to rescue her and halt his scheme. Moves rely on an attack button and a jump button, and each turtle has a different special attack performed by pressing both buttons together, which consumes energy unless the character is on the final health bar.

Eight levels progress from Ft. Slaughterdale Beach to Manhattan, the Technodrome, Vertigo Point Tower, and Krang's Spaceship. Throughout the stages, heroes confront Foot Soldiers, Mousers, Stone Warriors, and bosses, ending against Super Shredder. Up to two players can participate simultaneously, choosing whether attacks harm each other. Depleting the energy gauge costs a life; players can switch turtles after losing a life and use up to three continues.

9ffc36dfc772e102.overview:
Superman casts the player as the titular hero attempting to protect Metropolis from Lex Luthor and exiled Kryptonian villains. Gameplay divides between a city map and side-scrolling action sequences. Players begin as Clark Kent, jumping and punching enemies, but entering a phone booth with enough power converts him into Superman. Transit options include superflight to landmarks on the city map or riding the subway with a free pass obtained from Jimmy Olsen.

Controlling Superman involves managing a power level that drops each time a super power is used; with too little power Clark cannot become Superman, and the game ends when it reaches zero. Powers include heat vision, super breath, super spin, super flight, and x-ray vision to detect hidden foes. Defeated enemies may leave power crystals that raise the power level, while red or green Kryptonite lowers it. Boss encounters include showdowns against Luthor and the Kryptonian villains.

a00c77c313031662.overview:
MetalMech - Man & Machine is a platform action game where the player battles alien machines across six stages. Taking on the role of pilot Tony Martin, the player operates an armed, three-legged walker to fight through enemy forces. The pilot can also eject from the vehicle to explore narrow spaces on foot, discover hidden gear, and jump across terrain the machine cannot enter. Progress requires shooting targets to uncover icons, retrieving level keys, and finding each area's exit point.

Controlling the machine allows stomping foes, rotating aim, and cycling through specialized weaponry or screen-clearing smart bombs. Inside the cockpit, a status screen tracks gathered inventory, toggles music, or triggers ejection. Health is represented by four indicators that change color as damage accumulates. In the sixth level, the walker is lost, forcing the pilot to navigate a maze using a jetpack and sonic boomer to confront the Alien Queen.

a00db4c89bfd1270.overview:
Earning a shot against the WCW Master serves as the primary goal in single-player competition. To reach this final opponent, a solo participant selects one of twelve wrestlers and battles the eleven other wrestlers twice in one-on-one bouts featuring five-minute time limits. Opponents come in an order chosen by the computer, and beating all eleven once earns the title of WCW Minor Champion before the second round begins. Progress can be preserved with a twelve-letter password. Alternatively, a single-player tag tournament tasks two chosen wrestlers with facing five computer-chosen teams across ten-minute matches to earn points based on match outcomes.

Two participants can also compete directly in Single and Tag formats. Two-player single contests pit individual wrestlers against each other in a best-of-three series restricted to fifteen minutes. The tag option allows opposing players to field teams of two for a best-of-three confrontation under a thirty-minute limit.

a0354fb9c1c29e25.overview:
Wurm features multiple genres across its gameplay modes. The story follows an underground expedition sent after earthquakes strike in 1999. Players direct the crew of an exploration vehicle commanded by Moby, who searches for four earlier vehicles and their lost crews, including Ziggy. Deep below, the crew confronts the Nonmalta Empire, ruled by Sogalz, which holds the King of the Underworld Empire of Dinamur hostage.

Gameplay shifts between horizontally and vertically scrolling shooting sections in the vehicle, which changes between tank, hover, and aerial forms, and first-person cockpit battles against bosses. In cockpit battles, talking to the crew in the right order raises a Possibility Factor that improves the odds of destroying the monster. Moby also leaves the vehicle to explore on foot in side-scrolling areas, using jumps, kicks, and the Starlight Gun against enemies. Energy capsules restore fuel, and the game ends when the life meter is depleted.

a08e6b53f1fa593e.overview:
High school student Astyanax is summoned to the land of Remlia to rescue Princess Rosebud, whom the wizard Blackhorn has imprisoned to steal her magical strength. Accompanied by the guide Cutie, Astyanax journeys across multiple rounds toward the castle where the princess is held.

The player directs Astyanax as he walks, ducks, jumps, strikes with his weapon, and casts magic spells. Striking attacks hit harder when the weapon power gauge is completely full. Smashing stone idols yields various items, including life-replenishing potions, weapon upgrades that advance from an ax to a spear and sword, power supplies that fill the weapon gauge, wings that hasten weapon swings, and extra lives. Astyanax can also unleash three magic spells: Bind to immobilize foes, Blast to harm targets within range, and Bolt to damage every enemy on screen. Energy consumed by these spells recovers between rounds or with Cutie's assistance.

a0b2ec9b44033fc4.overview:
Eleven warp zones structure the mansion exploration alongside point and click sections. Michael searches the house of his missing brother, physicist Dr. Ginn Chaos, whose warp zone experiments have unleashed giant creatures into the corridors.

Players guide Michael through two-dimensional side-scrolling areas, initially armed with a knife. In rooms, a menu provides options to open, get, go, and hit. Throughout the house, Michael collects a pistol, a machine gun, grenades, and energy-restoring vitamins in red, blue, and yellow. Bosses in the warp zones hold the ten parts of the Restored Laser, which Michael gathers in a Parts Bottle. Secret machines invented by Dr. Chaos, including an Ultraspace Sensor, an Air Helmet, Jump Boots, and a Shield Suit, aid him in the warp zones. Only the fully assembled laser can defeat the ultimate monster, Canbarian.

a0bc241936acf199.overview:
Navigating through four island levels while searching for the other castaways forms the central task in this single-player adventure. Taking control of the Skipper, the player explores the terrain accompanied by a computer-controlled Gilligan. Progression requires talking to fellow castaways, gathering objects, and solving puzzles before a level time limit expires. Gilligan can wander off or fall behind, compelling the player to find him on foot or retrieve him with a rope.

Hazards across the island include hostile wildlife, headhunters, and dangerous terrain, all of which reduce the Skipper's life bar upon contact. The Skipper defends against threats using punches or a club. Bosses appear throughout the journey, among them a gorilla and the chief of the headhunters. A password system allows play to resume at a later stage.

a0d60fe16b09d201.overview:
Set in 1990, Rocket Ranger begins as ships from an alien moon descend on Europe and found Greater Leutonia. Led by Colonel Krag, the Leutonians set out to conquer the world and kidnap Dr. Barnstorff and his daughter, Jane. The player is a young American scientist who uses a rocket-powered flying suit and a laser pistol to stop them. Victory requires stealing five rocket parts from secret labs and enough Lunarium fuel to reach the alien moon before the Leutonians conquer the United States.

Gameplay alternates between strategy and action. From a War Room world map, five agents can be assigned to infiltrate countries, start resistance movements, and report the locations of rocket labs and bases. Lunarium must be shared between the rocket pack and the rocket ship. Action sequences include shooting aerial torpedoes and gunners on a zeppelin, battling fighter squadrons, destroying gun emplacements at temple ruins, fistfights with lab guards, and a shootout at the lunar base.

a0f18e729a7ee6be.overview:
Players control the cyborg police officer RoboCop across side-scrolling platform stages to stop an antagonistic corporation. The overarching objective centers on preventing the forced relocation of Detroit citizens intended to clear the way for Delta City.

The single-player adventure unfolds across five distinct levels, including a jetpack flight along the streets of Cadillac Heights to destroy a tank and a final task at the top of the OCP tower, with foes such as the ninja Otomo and ED-209. RoboCop collects limited-use weapons and energy pods, and at the end of each level he can enter a repair laboratory to mend damaged body parts with the repair icons he has found.

a11eec5762a029c9.overview:
Five themed dream realms structure the journey in Kid Klown in Night Mayor World. Players guide Kid Klown through Deadly Meadow, Terrible Toyland, Big Bad Beanstalk, Arctic Wasteland, and Candy World. Across these areas, encounters include specific end-stage opponents such as an overgrown owl, a giant cyclops, and ultimately the villainous magician Night Mayor.

Throughout the adventure, the protagonist carries balloons to navigate hazards and engage opponents. Kid Klown uses these items to strike enemies, bounce upward from the ground, or float across wide gaps. Defeating the boss at the end of a stage leads to a bonus round where the player can aim balloons at moving targets to earn extra life hearts and extra lives.

a2033c3b3d9f54b3.overview:
Set in a small island country under the cruel domination of an evil dictator, the narrative centers on a guerrilla leader and a comrade who secretly land on the shore to fight back. Players guide these fighters through ten areas toward the enemy's Palace, eliminating the boss who controls each area in order to move on.

Throughout the mission, combatants defeat incoming enemy soldiers, gather power-up items that appear when red soldiers are defeated, and take control of tanks. Two players can play simultaneously. The action also requires participants to rescue prisoners who appear in each area; each rescue adds 1,000 points, while accidentally harming a captive costs 500 points.

a2039efb5b5b8d49.overview:
Destroying enemy tanks and helicopters across the battlefield serves as the central objective in Garry Kitchen's Battletank, on a mission to rescue a NATO commanding officer held hostage behind enemy lines. The player takes control of an M1 tank, experiencing the action entirely from a first-person perspective at the driver's station. Ten missions grow more dangerous in turn, adding mine fields and enemy outposts, and later missions end with an attack on a major enemy stronghold. NATO headquarters along the way allow one-time repairs, refueling and rearming.

Offensive operations rely on an integrated arsenal comprising a 150mm cannon, a wire-guided shell, and a .50 caliber machine gun, while a smokescreen provides tactical support. Sustained fire causes the machine gun to overheat, so it works best in short bursts. A map screen speeds travel and shows enemies, mine fields and headquarters, and once five hits light the damage meter, one more hit ends the game.

a2812d80b3057aac.overview:
Athletic competition forms the focus as players guide an athlete through eight events, including the 100-meter dash, long jump, hurdles, javelin throw, skeet shooting, triple jump, archery, and high jump. Running speed in athletic contests is built strictly by repeatedly pressing the A button, while the Control Pad handles the timing and angle of jumps, the javelin release, and shot release in skill-based trials.

Advancement requires matching or beating designated qualifying times, distances, or scores during every event. Fouls count as attempts in the long jump, the hurdles allow only a single heat in which one missed hurdle spells failure, and failing to qualify in any contest immediately ends the game. Sessions can be played solo against the computer or between two players on alternating turns, with selectable novice and expert difficulty settings.

a29461c583ec0390.overview:
Participants guide athletic competitors across a series of cold-weather events centered on high-speed winter action. Five distinct disciplines are featured, consisting of downhill skiing, aerial ski maneuvers, halfpipe snowboarding, inflatable sled racing, and snowball battles. Players can tackle each of these events individually for practice or progress through them sequentially as a complete competition set to earn cumulative scores.

Up to six competitors can participate in the action by taking turns, with play alternating between participants. When a round ends, the next registered player activates either controller to take their turn on the slopes.

a2b4b0fd54028f1b.official: When the royal family is imprisoned inside the Great Pyramid of Evil by the demon Belzebut, it's up to Jack – the only remaining heir – to rescue them. As Mighty Bomb Jack you must jump and glide through treacherous corridors and enemy-infested rooms, collecting bombs and treasures as you go. Jack can increase his abilities by collecting Mighty Coins... but don't be greedy or you'll be punished!
a2b4b0fd54028f1b.overview:
Seventeen rounds, consisting of sixteen regular rounds and one final round, structure this single-player adventure. Controlling Jack, the lone surviving Mighty brother, the player aims to defeat the demon Belzebut and rescue King Pamera and his family. Each round divides into a scrolling passage and a fixed Royal Palace room. Navigating these areas requires jumping, gliding through the air, and gathering bombs along with treasure boxes before the timer expires.

Treasure chests hold rewards such as extra time from Mighty Drinks and Mighty Coins. Consuming coins grants Mighty Power, shifting Jack's suit color to open stubborn orange chests or turn hostile creatures into coins. Collecting too greedily banishes Jack to the Torture Room, where he must dodge enemies until the clock reaches zero to earn release and return to the quest.

a3049fe0daabefe4.overview:
Exploding Fist is a one-on-one martial arts fighting game in which the player takes on a series of opponents. Moves combine the controller's two buttons with the four directions of the directional pad: jump kicks and leg sweeps knock an opponent down, alongside punches, kicks and blocks. Each hit scores a point, and a bout is won with five points or by leading when the timer runs out.

Opponents use more varied tactics as the levels go on, and every fourth level is a three-fighter bout against two opponents at once. One, two or three players can take part, the third through a four-player adapter.

a334d4545d8262de.overview:
Advancing from a national junior youth tournament to the Tecmo Cup, an international junior youth competition, serves as the primary objective for the player. The game adapts association football by blending traditional athletic competition with mechanics derived from role-playing games, giving the on-field athletes distinct skill levels.

Matches depart from standard sports simulations by limiting direct physical control during play. The player steers the dribbler across a field map and, on meeting opponents, directs team members through text commands such as pass, shoot, dribble, tackle, cut and mark. Once these tactical choices are confirmed, the outcomes of the selected actions display on screen as animated sequences. Players gain levels as they play more games, and each command spends a player's GUTS. Passwords allow progress to be continued.

a3763e702f8ae081.overview:
Across a series of rounds, gameplay centers on clearing formations of bricks by bouncing a ball off a paddle-shaped craft called the Vaus. The craft moves horizontally across the bottom of the screen to prevent the ball from dropping off the playfield. While many bricks shatter on contact, others require several strikes to break, and some cannot be destroyed. Eliminating all target blocks allows the player to advance to the next arrangement, culminating in a confrontation against the boss entity DOH on the final stage.

Shattering certain blocks releases power-up capsules that alter mechanics when collected. These items can lengthen the Vaus, equip it with lasers, slow the ball, yield extra lives, or spawn multiple balls. Floating obstacles also drift into the play area and can be struck for additional points.

a385f0bed8d9afd1.overview:
Ten rounds form the structure of this adventure, where players battle to lift a curse placed on a village by the god Shiva. Controlling Master Chu alone or alongside Master Hu in simultaneous two-player play, the player gathers eight harmony symbols scattered across each of the initial seven stages. Finding these objects transports the characters to an encounter with a stage boss, after which discovering a hidden key opens the path forward. In rounds eight and nine, players directly battle bosses to secure keys, leading to round ten's final confrontation with Shiva.

Characters jump using the directional pad while firing shots and wielding defensive weapons to block projectiles. Items provide health restoration, temporary invulnerability, extra lives, and shot enhancements. Continues are available, though continuing in the later rounds sends players back to an earlier round.

a3d132f118c0d955.overview:
Returning the USS Enterprise to the Sigma Iotia system and reversing a rip in space serves as the central goal for the crew. After being thrown into uncharted space, the starship is left stranded with its engines nearly depleted of dilithium. To secure replacement crystals, Captain Kirk heads expeditions to various planet surfaces across multiple levels before the crew can resume its original journey. Hostile vessels are fought from the bridge with phasers and photon torpedoes.

Controlling Kirk, the player selects two additional crew members, such as Spock, McCoy, or specific department specialists, to complete each away mission. Exploration takes the form of a graphic adventure where progressing depends on communicating with local life forms, discovering items, and solving puzzles. Only Kirk and security officers may fire phasers, and violent action is seldom the preferred method for resolving obstacles.

a47f338a88835424.overview:
Guiding a secret operative, the player explores a multi-building fortress to infiltrate security areas and search for codes. Movement through the structure involves accessing security terminals, utilizing a pocket computer to manage gathered data, and taking an express elevator to confront Elvin in his control room.

The layout consists of an eight-tower perimeter surrounding a central tower, containing underground corridors, aerial passages, and rooms where an operative can gather items. Hostile mechanical defenses encounter the player throughout the facility, including sentry units, minebots, pestbots, squatbots, and suicidebots.

a5165565263eaf8b.overview:
Players control four distinct heroes through side-scrolling stages to defeat Ta-Keed, the Prince of Darkness, and defend the kingdom of Forgy. The titular hero Little Samson throws bells and climbs walls and ceilings, the dragon Kikira breathes charged fire and flies briefly, the golem Gamm delivers powerful multi-directional punches and traverses spikes, and the small mouse K.O. fits through narrow spaces, scales surfaces, and drops bombs. The opening four stages serve as individual tutorials, after which the player can swap between all four characters at any moment.

Around twenty stages feature branching paths, hazardous obstacles, and boss battles across linear progression. Collectible items scattered throughout stages include health-replenishing hearts, capacity-increasing crystal orbs, extra lives, and full-recovery potions. Each protagonist maintains an individual health meter while drawing from a shared reserve of lives. Passwords allow progress to be resumed.

a57f873ccb2c8842.overview:
Players lay down pipe pieces from a dispenser onto the playfield to construct a continuous pipeline before a liquid called flooz reaches an open end. The flooz emerges from a designated start piece after a brief delay. Pieces must be played in the order they arrive, though players may overwrite dry segments at the cost of points and a momentary placement delay. The primary goal in each round is to route the flooz through a specified minimum quantity of pipes to proceed.

Higher levels bring faster flooz and longer minimum distances, and add one-way pipes, reservoirs that buy time while they fill, pumps that briefly speed the flow, tunnels to the opposite side of the playfield, and end pieces that double the bonus. Bonuses come from loops where the flooz crosses itself and from filling the entire playfield. The game has 16 levels of four rounds and three play modes for one or two players.

a5ae39359aa5b169.overview:
Defeating Achilles, the head of the enemy forces, is the central mission in this side-scrolling action title. Set in a post-apocalyptic world, the player guides the warrior Trojan through seven different screens of hostile territory. Combat centers on striking adversaries with a sword and deflecting incoming projectiles, like arrows and knives, using a defensive shield that can be held in five directions. Magic balls thrown by an enemy called the Slasher can knock the sword and shield out of the hero's hands.

The quest leads through levels populated by standard foes and boss encounters, including a battle against King Shriek, who swings a chained iron ball. Exploring underground manholes and walls reveals hidden rooms and bonus items, such as hearts that replenish lost strength, super-jump icons for leaping higher, and sword power enhancements. A two-player versus mode allows participants to fight in head-to-head matches.

a5b8e24589539b0b.overview:
Conquest of the Crystal Palace features two-dimensional action platforming gameplay. Players guide the teenage prince Farron on a quest to retake the Crystal Palace from the evil warspirit Zaras. Before setting out across five stages, the player chooses one of three power crystals to boost jump height, expand health capacity, or provide a fireball attack. Farron fights hostiles primarily using a sword, while his guardian dog Zap, who has his own life meter, can be called into play to protect him.

Defeated enemies leave coins that must be collected within five seconds. Money buys herbs, potions, food for Zap, a Dog Whistle, and special weapons such as the Fire Scroll and Boomerang Annihilator from Kim, the shop proprietor, though not every item is sold in each shop. Kim also alerts the player to QNN news bulletins. The Moon Mirror destroys every enemy on screen once per stage.

a636a947acf1ef0b.overview:
Galactic Crusader is a space shooter in which the player captains a living, metamorphic Star Ship that can transform from a huge flying insect into a metallic destroyer. The ship fights through squadron after squadron of alien fortifications on the way to a final confrontation with an all-powerful enemy. Each time the ship takes damage it transforms into a different ship, and it explodes when its metamorphic capabilities run out. A Life Force Generator restores full metamorphic power, and passing through a Star Gate earns an extra ship.

Firing devices are gained by connecting with a Device Carrier and can be attached to the front or rear of the ship or launched as detached firing stations that break up enemy formations. Weapon capsules add pulsar waves, plasma blasts or a corkscrew firing pattern. At the end of each world, a large boss waits, including Cubicus, Gorous, Spirous and the Dragon King.

a66195e11e38bee9.overview:
Waldo aims to reach the Moon, and players assist his journey by locating him across eight stages. In standard picture scenes, such as the train station, forest, fairground, city, and castle, the directional buttons move a search scope across the screen to pinpoint Waldo's position. Choosing an incorrect spot costs time on the countdown clock. On higher difficulty settings, the scope shrinks, environments grow larger and scroll, and Waldo shifts colors. A practice option restricts access to only the first three areas, while the other settings allow progressively less overall time.

Several stages introduce alternate mechanics instead of typical search scenes. A dark cave requires spotting Waldo with a flashlight during brief appearances before guiding him to the exit. Inside the subway level, the player navigates a maze to recover Waldo alongside his glasses while steering clear of the wizard White Beard. The final level requires matching three pictures of Waldo on a slot machine.

a6f98e57ffb45441.overview:
Controlling one of six professional wrestlers, the player competes in matches inside the ring using strikes, running attacks, and bodyslams. Turnbuckle leaps start from the bottom of the ring, and move sets differ somewhat across the roster; two of the wrestlers cannot bodyslam at all. Taking heavy punishment causes a wrestler to turn red with anger, which temporarily boosts attack strength.

Play modes include single exhibitions and tournaments. Exhibitions pit one player against the computer or another participant. In single-player tournaments, the chosen fighter must overcome the other five opponents to earn the championship. Group tournaments allow up to six players across fifteen round-robin bouts, with the most wins deciding the winner and ties broken by the shortest average time to pin opponents.

a868544e22d00eac.overview:
Earning a championship trophy requires winning seven tournament matches of increasing difficulty. Matches are viewed from an elevated angle behind the court, and the view shifts during serves, when the score is shown. Matches take place on clay, grass, or hard court surfaces. Participants select between best-of-three women's matches or best-of-five men's matches, choosing from eight male or eight female characters who possess distinct strengths and weaknesses.

Controlling athletes involves using two buttons to execute a range of tennis shots, including smashes, volleys, slices, and lobs. Front-court actions rely primarily on the A button, whereas the B button governs back-court strokes. Outside the single-player tournament, a two-player mode pits one player against another. After each tournament match won, a password allows players to resume progress from that point.

a899f4f8b7ded48a.overview:
Directing Napoleon Bonaparte across turn-based campaigns, the player oversees military operations and city administration with the ultimate goal of unifying Europe. Play proceeds monthly through four distinct seasons, beginning with officer commands to draft soldiers, buy horses, train troops, adjust supplies, invest in local development, and dispatch forces to invade adjacent cities by land or cities on a shared shoreline by sea. Defeating belligerent nations and winning the people's support advances Napoleon through historical ranks from Commander up to First Consul and Emperor.

Advancing in rank unlocks quarterly government commands to manage broader diplomacy, declare war, forge alliances, trade, and exchange prisoners. Combat occurs across varied topography where commanding officers issue daily field maneuvers to infantry, cavalry, and artillery units, with battles concluding after thirty days if unresolved. Defeat occurs if Napoleon dies or becomes an enemy prisoner.

a8b6829d8d1e17cc.overview:
Taking up the role of Jonathan Harker, the player embarks on a quest to defeat the Prince of Darkness and rescue Mina Murray before she is permanently transformed into a vampire. Across various stages set in woods, castles, and mansions, Harker must traverse hazardous terrain such as nail beds, spike pits, and floating platforms while defeating henchmen, bats, and skeletons under a time limit.

Harker attacks enemies using weapons discovered inside pick-up boxes, including rocks, spinning axes, torches that erupt into flames, and triple rocks. Containers also provide point bonuses, healing items, extra lives, temporary invincibility, and added stage time. Each level culminates in an encounter against Dracula, who attacks in varying incarnations such as a living shadow, a young nobleman, a bat, a wolf beast, or his robed form.

a978de5d5f343eac.overview:
Side-scrolling environments frame the journey across an island following an airplane crash. Taking control of a stranded Marine named Amagon, the player attempts to reach a rescue ship waiting on the other side of the island. Amagon encounters various hostile creatures along the way, using a machine gun to eliminate targets. A single hit from an enemy or its weapon eliminates the standard character.

Collecting a special Mega-key and holding at least 5,000 points allows Amagon to change into a more powerful form called Megagon. This transformed state grants hit points based on accumulated score, earning one point of health per 5,000 points. Rather than firing a machine gun, Megagon attacks with a punch that inflicts eight times more damage. He can also sacrifice one point of health to fire a laser beam that deals twice the damage of his punch.

a98e48a26c104375.overview:
Controlling an astronaut, a single player flies through Fortress Balangool, the headquarters of an invading force, while shooting in opposing directions. The objective is to penetrate Section Z, destroy L-Brain, the Master Control of Balangool, and defeat the Space Soldiers of Balangool. One button fires to the right and the other fires to the left. The route runs through a long series of battle sections that leads to Section Z.

Progressing deeper into the base necessitates finding and destroying power generators to disable security barriers and face the Balangool captains. Incoming enemy attacks drain energy reserves, which also power special transmission shell weapons such as the Megamissile, Flash Bomb and Crush Ball. Players collect various arsenal enhancements, including the multi-directional Flash Buster and protective barrier shields, to defeat the mastermind L-Brain at the climax of Section Z.

aa0f7f60a6cff146.overview:
Licensed by the NFL, this title features the league's AFC and NFC teams and plays drawn from actual NFL offensive and defensive playbook alignments, complete with audibles, penalties, and fumbles. Action on the field is presented from a top-down perspective, switching to a close-up view when a pass approaches a receiver. Beyond calling plays, the player controls the ball carrier or receiver on offense and a selected defender on defense.

Participants can choose from four separate match configurations, including interconference matchups, AFC games, NFC games, and the Super Bowl. Before kickoff, each side picks one of six team packages, which can be improved with up to two upgrades at the cost of extra random penalties and fumbles. Handicap options give one or both players a free upgrade.

aa408f5a6b97c0d7.official: Donkey Kong not only launched the career of Mario, when he was known simply as Jumpman, but also of the eponymous ape who went on to become a hero himself. It also laid the foundation for the ‘platform’ genre – still going strong to this day. This NES version of the arcade classic was a launch title for the console, and is one of the most faithful adaptations of the original.
aa408f5a6b97c0d7.overview:
Multiple stages set on a construction site structure the journey to rescue the captive Pauline from the giant gorilla Donkey Kong. Players control Mario, who must ascend girders, scale ladders, and negotiate moving hazards to reach the top perch.

Progression requires running, climbing, and jumping across gaps while evading tossed barrels, fireballs, and other incoming obstacles. Players can collect bonus items like purses and parasols dropped by Pauline, or wield an invincible hammer power-up to smash objects. Lives are lost by colliding with enemies, falling too far, or letting the stage bonus counter reach zero, with the overarching objective to clear each screen, pull out bolts, and topple the ape.

aab5e0ecc46e575b.overview:
Set across the land of Sindarin, the warrior Kuros must assemble the IronSword to vanquish the evil wizard Malkil, who has assumed elemental forms and waits atop IceFire Mountain. The player guides Kuros through platforming environments by crouching, jumping, striking with a sword, and casting spells.
