Kuros relies on a life meter that depletes from enemy strikes, projectiles, or long falls. Life is replenished with food items, while losing all health depletes a life from a limited pool supported by up to two continues.

Progression spans four elemental domains. In each domain, the player recovers a golden artifact for an Animal King to unlock the next section, then locates a specific magic spell required to harm the elemental boss. Defeating each boss yields a sword fragment. Players gather money to purchase equipment, spells, food, and keys at inns, or gamble coins in a bonus game.

ab0a43bc7c33f0cd.overview:
Guiding the sharpshooter Golgo 13, the player tackles diverse mission segments to thwart the plans of a terrorist syndicate. Action occurs across five distinct display styles, including timed side-scrolling levels where Golgo runs, jumps, kicks, and fires a gun using collectible ammunition. Threats in these scrolling areas include scorpions, dogs, and foes wielding firearms, scythes, boomerangs, and grenades. Stationary timed sequences switch to hand-to-hand combat against key adversaries through punches and kicks.

Additional gameplay modes alter the perspective and objectives. Driving sections place the protagonist inside a Ferrari where shifting gears and hurling grenades at harassing KGB men is required. Navigating first-person mazes involves searching hallways and chambers while shooting armed opponents and locating items such as night-vision infrared scopes. Finally, specialized sniping segments display a rifle view that requires adjusting for wind speed and direction to neutralize distant targets.

ab6f1bbcda6f0c0b.overview:
Faryan rules a New World through an army of death slaves, and the player, as Chief War Wolf, fights through five levels, each protected by one of Faryan's Level Bosses, to destroy him. Powers granted by the Great Spirit let War Wolf punch, jump, and shoot a Power Ray by holding and releasing the punch button. One or two players can take alternating turns.

Controlling the hero, the player navigates through platforming sequences while collecting items. Grabbing a red "W" triggers the transformation into werewolf form, which adds crawling, back-flips, wall climbing, and hand-over-hand ceiling walking. Conversely, a blue "W" reverts a transformed hero toward human form, or costs life points if he is already human. Collecting white Power Bubbles fills an anger gauge; accumulating five while in werewolf form temporarily activates a Super Werewolf state that doubles attack strength and enables higher jumping. Each level has a time limit, and hourglasses add time.

abbddcb7c85a9956.overview:
Burai Fighter tasks the player with shooting robo-mutants, half robot and half living flesh, to stop the Burai's conquest of the universe across seven bases. Controlling an unnamed protagonist equipped with a proton pack, the player floats through two-dimensional space environments. In the side-view levels the screen scrolls in changing directions, requiring the character to avoid getting caught against the screen edges, and a boss waits at the end; in two top-view levels the goal is to destroy the bases. Holding the attack button locks the aiming angle so the player can fire independently of movement. Hidden rooms may contain power-ups.

Beginning with a basic weapon, the protagonist can acquire upgrades such as ring, laser, and missile armaments, and Cobalt Bombs clear the screen of ordinary enemies. Three difficulty settings are available: Eagle, Albatross, and Ace. Higher difficulties feature faster and more aggressive enemies, different adversaries, adjusted bonus multipliers, and alternate endings. Level progression can be resumed using passwords.

abd9923fd2f3ac2b.overview:
Options configured on the set-up screen include card back patterns, color combinations, audio toggles, and two dealing modes that draw either one card or three cards at a time.

A hand-shaped cursor manipulated with the directional pad selects and maneuvers cards across the screen using the A button. Twenty-eight cards form seven tableau columns, each ending in a face-up card, while the remaining deck rests in an upper pack pile. Building sequences requires placing face-up cards onto others in descending numerical order while alternating colors, and only Kings may occupy cleared, vacant columns. The primary goal is moving all cards into four upper foundation piles, starting with an Ace and constructing upward within identical suits. The game concludes whenever the entire deck reaches these foundations or when no legitimate actions remain.

abde6fc87b2d90e0.official: With sharpened blades and a lethal stick, you slash into a rink surrounded by thousands of screaming fans. It's time for full-speed, high-contact hockey, the kind of bone-jarring action played by the pros. The puck is dropped, you take control, center it and... Whoa! Your opponent viciously checks you from behind, making an incredible steal. You charge after him, crushing him against the boards.
abde6fc87b2d90e0.overview:
Contests in this ice hockey title pit two opposing squads against one another on an ice rink, with support for two participants in simultaneous play. Skaters battle for possession of the puck by delivering heavy body checks into the boards, stealing control from opponents, centering passes, and taking slap shots toward the net.

Repeated physical collisions cause tempers to flare and spark bare-knuckle fighting sequences where players exchange high and low punches or block incoming strikes. The loser of a fight is sent to the penalty box, leaving the winning side with a skating manpower advantage. Penalty scenarios also allow direct control of the goaltender to defend against oncoming shots.

ac1215af2a3315f8.overview:
Set amid a hostile jungle combat zone, this single-player military action game tasks the player with surviving enemy encounters across varied environments. The mission begins in a side-scrolling jungle where the operative maneuvers horizontally and vertically while evading trip wires, booby traps, and enemy soldiers. The immediate objective involves locating hidden explosives, detonating a bridge, and searching a village to acquire a torch and tunnel map for subsequent operations.

Subsequent segments introduce different perspectives and objectives. Navigating a subterranean maze switches the action to a first-person shooter format, requiring the player to use their map, collect flares and a compass, and eliminate hostile combatants. Later encounters demand surviving an overnight siege in a bunker by illuminating targets with flares and aiming a crosshair, followed by a timed third-person jungle escape ahead of a napalm strike that culminates in scoring five direct hits on Sergeant Barnes in his foxhole.

ac192342f14b41fe.overview:
Players manage resources to assemble an effective military, cultivate a productive economy for civil and military growth, and maintain peasant respect and loyalty. Most commands are carried out by appointed samurai retainers. The map covers 38 fiefs of feudal Japan, and unifying the country requires conquering all of them, starting from one of two scenarios that begin in 1560 and 1582.

Play progresses through monthly turns on the map. In battle, field warfare allows orders in the morning, afternoon and evening, while siege warfare allows one order per unit each day. Several methods lead to victory in conflict, including eliminating the opposing command unit, compelling adversaries to withdraw, withstanding an attacking army for a month, or extending engagements until enemy supplies run out.

ac2374bd4a5f7c87.overview:
The Mutant Virus: Crisis in a Computer World puts the player in an action scenario centered on a fight inside CPI, the computer system that runs the world's databases, power grids, and traffic signals. The story follows Ron Trainer of the Computer Master Debuggers, who must eradicate a virus that has infected five critical sections of CPI before its Core is destroyed and humanity is plunged back almost to the Stone Age.

Miniaturized inside an armored JetSuit, the player flies through the sectors of each section to contain the infection. The suit's Vaccine Blaster fires three types of charges that turn infected cells blue, and pickups called Counter Measures spread vaccine automatically. The virus spreads across the grid following the rules of Conway's Game of Life, and flying over active virus drains the suit's PowerPack.

ac2b69cf35ece7f0.overview:
Completing memory tests and defusing explosive traps across two distinct games using Side B of the Power Pad constitutes the objective of this release.

Short Order puts the player in a burger shop, requiring them to replicate ingredient sequences ordered by animal patrons. Stepping on paired pad numbers selects meat, cheese, tomato, or lettuce. Modes include preset targets from 10 to 40 ingredients, a 99-item mode for up to five participants, and a two-player alternating duel where competitors build sequences until one makes three errors. In Eggsplode, one to five players protect hens by stepping on nest positions to eliminate bombs planted by foxes before detonation. Defusing steady bombs earns 100 points, while flashing explosives yield 300 points. Play ends if an explosive detonates or after two eggs are stepped on.

ac766a8d99bfd8e9.overview:
Athletes compete in running and jumping contests driven by physical movement on a floor mat accessory. Runners gain maximum speed depending on which specific row of mat buttons is tapped, and lifting feet prior to the start signal results in a false start penalty. Four distinct competitions are available: the 100M dash, the 110M hurdles, the long jump, and the triple jump. Hurdles require timely leaps when white box markers appear along the edge of the course, while jump events measure distance based on approach speed and take-off timing.

Two participants can race simultaneously side by side, or as many as six competitors can take turns. Tournament mode pits a single runner against a sequence of six computer opponents across both track events, where three false starts cause immediate disqualification. An additional Olympic mode allows participants to contest all four disciplines consecutively, with each result converted to a 100-point scale referenced to world track records.

ac9d9f60f68c020c.overview:
Navigating golf courses and sinking the ball while steering clear of environmental obstacles serves as the primary goal. Up to four participants play the game, controlling selected golfers with distinct capabilities. Some golfers offer greater shot distance at the expense of control, while others provide improved accuracy with shorter range. Others maintain balanced performance characteristics across their swings.

Participants compete across courses themed around the United States and Japan. Each location presents specific layouts featuring obstacles such as water hazards, tree clusters, sand traps, and rough terrain. Shots that land out of bounds or in water cost penalty strokes.

acc3b89bcbe3ccc2.overview:
Drivers maneuver off-road trucks around top-view stadium tracks, competing against other racers or computer-controlled vehicles. Up to four participants can compete simultaneously with specific multi-controller adapters. Across a season of Qualification races followed by a Tournament, competitors run eight tracks in both directions, and the first truck to complete four laps wins each race.

Participants begin with three lives and can gain a life by winning or lose one by finishing in fourth place. Players can continue after losing all lives during the initial fourteen qualification races, though accumulated cash resets to zero. Points are awarded based on winnings, while earned prize money allows players to purchase vehicle upgrades such as shocks, tires, top speed, acceleration, or extra nitro boosts.

acc561f57cfd0490.overview:
Guiding Pac-Man through scrolling, three-dimensional mazes, the player must consume every dot and power pill while evading colored ghosts. Contact with a ghost costs a life. Pac-Man can leap into the air to jump over pursuing ghosts and escape danger. One or two players can take turns, and the mazes span the worlds of Block Town, Pac-Man's Park, Sandbox Land and Jungly Steps.

Eating a power pill temporarily makes the ghosts vulnerable, allowing Pac-Man to eat them for bonus points. A green power pill boosts Pac-Man's movement speed, and a red one awards double points. In the more demanding worlds, three new ghosts named Sue, Funky and Spunky join the chase, including Funky, who bounces.

ad14301747e0ae0f.overview:
In this horizontally scrolling shooter, the player directs a living spaceship called Opa-Opa across the eight planets of Fantasy Zone, which the Menons have overrun using stolen money. On each planet, Opa-Opa must destroy every enemy base; a boss then appears and must be beaten to advance to the next planet. The game is for one player, who starts with three ships.

Combat relies on a main gun alongside dropped bombs. Coins collected along the way buy speed parts, stronger guns and special bombs at the parts shop, reached by capturing a SHOP balloon, and prices rise with each purchase. Only one item from each category, Speedup, Weapon 1 and Weapon 2, can be equipped at a time, and a SEL balloon allows switching between items already bought.

ad1e14d08657d99c.overview:
Piloting the Cybernoid ship, the player maneuvers from room to room across three asteroids to battle Zoggian pirates and their ground installations. The objective involves ridding the Federation's storage asteroids of the pirates, who have seized the minerals and gems stored there. Each room contains a time bomb with its own countdown that will detonate if the craft fails to exit before time expires, preceded by pulsating light warnings. Threats include enemy craft, missiles, ground emplacements, and enemies that cannot be destroyed.

Collecting cargo earns bonus points, and the pirates occasionally drop packing cases holding extra weapons. Alongside a default forward blaster, an arsenal of selected auxiliary weapons includes bombs, screen-clearing genocide missiles, temporary defensive shields, bouncing ordnance, and ground-tracking seekers. Special attachments can also be retrieved, including a rear gun and an orbiting CyberMace.

adb1a1a9e853c239.overview:
Taking up arms against evil forces, protagonist Willow Ufgood sets out on a solo quest across an adventure world. Players control Willow as he journeys from place to place, confronting hostile creatures through real-time combat while using an assortment of swords, shields, items, and magical spells.

Defeating opponents yields experience points, allowing the hero to level up his capabilities as the journey progresses. Willow locates all necessary equipment throughout the environment rather than purchasing it through a currency system. Along the way, players can guide Willow inside village homes to speak with residents, who provide helpful guidance alongside additional armaments and magic. Progress is preserved using passwords.

ae2dddda1f90b8f8.overview:
Special forces operative Bart deliberately allows himself to be captured in order to infiltrate a hostile organization, defeat its leadership, and escape. The single-player action game requires fighting past waves of enemy troops across multiple hostile locations, progressing from a prison camp into an industrial area, a jungle, and an enemy communications headquarters.

Controlling Bart, the player attacks foes using punches, kicks, jump-kicks, and back-punches. Defeated adversaries drop weapons such as throwing knives, machine guns, and hand grenades to assist in battle. Additionally, entering side huts or vehicles and eliminating all hostile forces inside rewards power-ups, including bullet-proof vests, brass knuckles that increase punching power, and life extensions.

ae360d56679f1791.overview:
Becoming the undisputed champion of the universe is the primary goal in this boxing title. Players take on the role of Mark Tyler, the undisputed world heavyweight champion, who accepts an invitation from an alien federation to enter an outer space competition.

Matches pit the player against computer-controlled opponents across up to three one-minute rounds. Performance throughout each bout is tracked by a scoring system that monitors punch percentages alongside knockdowns. Between bouts against rivals, players can take part in optional training sessions designed to enhance Tyler's stats before entering the next contest.

ae8684d9075b6665.overview:
Retiring with high status, extensive lands, wealth, and an esteemed reputation serves as the ultimate goal for the sea captain. At setup, players choose a historical era, an allegiance, a family name, and a specialized skill such as fencing, navigation, gunnery, wit and charm, or medicine. The journey involves sailing across the Caribbean, navigating winds, tracking positions with an astrolabe, and following map fragments to locate buried treasure or kidnapped family members.

Captains interact with settlements by docking peacefully, sneaking inside, or launching assaults by land or sea. Within ports, players visit governors to secure missions and titles, recruit crew members in taverns, and trade captured cargo, cannons, food, and vessels with merchants. Dividing the plunder in port sends the crew away, after which players either retire or refit a ship and recruit new men to continue adventuring.

aeb61fd5cf5a5ed7.overview:
Set during a conflict between the Federation and the Empire, the story follows a commando sent to rescue the Federation hero Super Joe, with whom contact has been lost, and to stop the Empire from carrying out a top-secret plan. Players move the commando across an overworld map by helicopter to select connected areas. If intercepted en route by an enemy vehicle, action shifts to an overhead shooting segment where players defeat soldiers, deflect bullets with the swinging arm, and can earn continues.

Main stages feature side-scrolling platforming where the commando cannot jump. Instead, players extend a mechanical grappling arm in several directions to traverse gaps and ascend ledges. After selecting equipment, players search for communications rooms before reaching and destroying the guarded reactor core of each area. Along with standard combat zones, players encounter safe neutral areas, though firing a weapon there triggers hostile alarms.

af24262bc78865b8.overview:
Players engage in the sport of golf, taking into account environmental and physical factors such as the wind and the angle at which the ball is struck. Progress throughout the experience is maintained through the use of a password system.

Three distinct modes are available to select from. Participants can compete in a standard tournament mode, or they can practice their skills across two training modes. The game supports participation for up to four people.

af505b8530b3303e.overview:
Players control a magical fighter who runs, jumps, ducks, and attacks using a sword to avenge the fallen land of Baljing. Holding the attack button unleashes a charged bomb. Vanquishing monsters fills a metamorphosis meter, which allows the warrior to transform into a flying dragon during a jump once the meter is half full. In dragon form, the character hovers and shoots forward across an auto-scrolling screen. This state slowly empties the gauge, and the player can also shift back manually.

Power-up items labeled G, B, and R alter the protagonist's outfit color, dictating the projectile attacks of both forms. Additional items provide healing, accelerate meter filling, or eliminate all on-screen foes. Across six stages, each culminating in a guardian battle, players receive a staff that extends maximum health and fully refills it. The fighter has three lives, and up to three continues are available.

af5ac55d6283b709.overview:
Ultima - Exodus presents a role-playing experience where the player seeks to rid the realm of Sosaria of the villain Exodus. Players create a party of four adventurers by selecting each member's race from five options and job from eleven classes, distributing points across four attributes. Outside of combat, this group travels together across the overworld, delves into dungeons, and explores settlements. Actions in towns include conversing with locals, stealing, bribing, or initiating combat with non-player figures.

Overworld foes appear as figures on the map before contact. Engagements shift play to a tactical grid where participants take turn-based actions. Slain foes grant experience, and audiences with Lord British help characters advance. Defeating Exodus requires gathering four cards at shrines and using them in a specific sequence rather than standard combat.

af7a31a57dd701f5.overview:
Directing Professor Hector, the player operates R.O.B., an external robot, using five trays, five colored blocks, and a pair of hands fitted to the robot's arms. The central objective across activities is having R.O.B. restack the physical blocks to match configurations displayed on the television screen, in as few moves and as little time as possible.

The game can be played four ways. In Direct mode, the player maneuvers Hector directly onto keys that trigger specific physical movements to match the on-screen stack. Memory mode tasks the player with programming a sequence of up to 100 commands to duplicate the target arrangement, which the robot subsequently carries out. Bingo mode also requires recreating the displayed stack of blocks, though color matching is not required; commands are sent by completing rows or columns of keys while the bugs Flipper and Spike interfere. In two-player Bingo, Hector and Professor Vector compete to collect the most blocks within five minutes.

afa359b53e90781e.overview:
Controlling the chipmunk Chip or Dale, players navigate side-scrolling levels by walking, jumping, ducking, and tossing objects. Items including boxes, bolts, and balls can be grabbed and hurled at adversaries and stage bosses. Each enemy hit costs a heart, and losing every heart costs a life, though extra hearts can be earned. The story follows the Rescue Rangers pursuing the escaped criminal Fat Cat, defusing a restaurant bomb and retrieving an ancient urn.

Levels advance in a linear order, except for a set of three late stages that can be tackled in any order. Single-player and two-player cooperative options are included. In cooperative mode, one player controls Chip while the other directs Dale, and partners can pick up and throw each other as weapons.

afc7ce7262cc0303.overview:
Play progresses through a continuously looping sequence of three zones: a bike chase through an obstacle zone, a bike chase across a slippery zone, and a final battle with the Dinosaur Tank across the battery zone. The player steers the rescue bike Gilgitt Petras, throwing enemy Basrah bikes into walls and obstacles or destroying enemies with a laser beam.

While maneuvering through each area, the bike rescues stranded Petras for bonus points and collects Energy Packs that refill its energy; carrying too many Petras drains energy faster, and the bike stops working when its energy reaches zero. In the slippery zone, excessive movement can send the bike sliding into obstacles. Up to two players are supported.

b002d1ebee16a5fd.overview:
Tag Team Wrestling depicts tag-team professional wrestling matches inside a ring. Players control wrestlers who move around the mat to make contact and grapple with their opponents. Once an opponent is grabbed, a move appears on screen; the player cycles through moves with the B button and executes the selected one with the A button. A downed opponent can be pinned for a count of three, and a tired wrestler can run to the corner to tag a partner.

Two teams, the Strong Bads and the Ricky Fighters, square off in these wrestling contests. A single participant can progress through successive title matches to earn increasingly larger trophies, rising from American to European, World, and finally Super Champion. Each of the four featured competitors possesses a distinct attack designed specifically for use against one designated rival. The game supports up to two players.

b012733f6be75e9a.overview:
Players control a bowler aiming to knock down pins across a regulation ten-frame match. Before rolling, the bowler is positioned horizontally at the base of the lane. A swinging indicator establishes the hook angle of the throw, after which a rising meter sets the throwing power. Deliveries can be aligned using the lane pins, arrows, or floor boards to direct the ball toward the strike zone for strikes and spares.

Matches support up to four participants, with players one and three sharing the first controller and players two and four sharing the second. Each participant chooses from four distinct characters featuring specific traits such as left- or right-handed deliveries, enters two-letter initials, and selects a ball weight. Action takes place on one of five differently colored lanes that vary in how much they cause a rolled ball to hook.

b035ec9e2a7fc408.overview:
Winning baseball games and seasons serves as the primary objective while managing and developing a roster. Participants can create custom teams, assign player names, configure leagues, and preserve cumulative statistics through battery save memory. Field action involves pitching fastballs, slow balls, or curveballs, while batters can adjust their position and swing upward by moving forward or downward by moving backward. Defensive controls include diving and jumping catches, climbing the outfield wall to rob home runs, quick throws, and tagging runners out. Games are called if a team leads by ten runs at the end of an inning.

Financial management adds a strategic layer to matches. Victorious clubs earn money based on player prestige ratings, which dictate fan attendance. Earnings allow managers to upgrade existing roster abilities or purchase new athletes across rookie, veteran, and star player tiers.

b0e4bcb63416c32f.overview:
Players control professional wrestlers participating in World Wrestling Federation matches. Action centers on competing in regular bouts, specialized steel cage contests, or tag team showdowns. One or two players can face the computer or each other, choosing from ten WWF wrestlers at three difficulty levels.

Several modes structure the competition. Single matches feature One-on-One options with standard rules alongside steel cage variations. Participants can also enter standard Tag Team bouts. In the single world championship tournament, the player selects one wrestler and aims to defeat all nine other wrestlers to secure the title. In the tag team world championship tournament, two selected wrestlers must defeat four other teams to win the championship.

b0e4d88db0b21db4.overview:
Controlling an individual soccer athlete on a six-member squad, the player guides their athlete across the pitch while issuing passing and shooting commands to teammates. Matches diverge from standard rules by removing offsides and foul penalties entirely. Competitors can repeatedly tackle or slide into opponents until they are knocked down, leaving them out of play until a goal is scored or the half ends. Additionally, athletes can trigger up to five specialized Super Kicks per half by pressing both action buttons simultaneously. After exhausting these shots, walking a specific number of steps before kicking activates a High Power Kick. Field surfaces such as ice, sand, or soil alter how the ball and participants maneuver.

Two gameplay modes are available. Tournament mode tasks one or two participants with selecting from thirteen national teams to defeat computer opponents. Match mode allows play across various surfaces, accommodating up to four participants simultaneously through multi-controller accessories.

b15b298dc37692d0.official: Unique to the classic series, Donkey Kong 3 is a frantic action game starring newcomer Stanley, whose greenhouse has been invaded by the troublesome ape and swarms of angry insects. Armed with a spray can, you must push Donkey Kong up the screen while fending off the swarms of bugs intent on stealing Stanley's precious flowers.
b15b298dc37692d0.overview:
Protecting a greenhouse full of flowers from an ape and encroaching swarms of bugs drives the action. Controlling Stanley the bugman, the player runs and jumps between floors below Donkey Kong, who hangs from overhead vines. Stanley fires bug spray upward at the ape while eliminating Buzzbees, Beespies and other insects. Spraying Donkey Kong repeatedly drives him up to the top of the vines; if he drops to the floor, Stanley loses a life.

Hazards include coconuts thrown by Donkey Kong, darts thrown by Buzzbees, Creepies that descend from the palm trees, and bees that try to carry off the flowers at the bottom of the screen. Spraying Donkey Kong up to a power spray can attached to the vine drops it down for Stanley to collect, helping him fight back until its effect wears off. Each round has a time limit, and guarded flowers earn bonus points. Three rounds repeat in sequence, and one or two players can play.

b183c0952994cadc.overview:
Bill & Ted's Excellent Video Game Adventure functions as an action-adventure game centered on time travel. Following an alert from Rufus that evil future rebels have moved famous people into the wrong periods of history, the protagonists embark on a mission to rescue the stranded historical figures and restore them to their proper eras. The journey aims to repair history and return the duo to San Dimas in time for their first concert.

The player guides Bill and Ted through distinct historical worlds, traveling between them in a time-traveling phone booth paid for with coins. Gameplay involves searching through buildings while conversing with locals to obtain clues. Hostile locals can be avoided or handled using items that distract, scare off, banish or set them dancing, and some can send the duo to jail. To secure cooperation from each historical figure, the player must explore the world to track down hidden items known as historical bait.

b1c2ae757c5ec76f.overview:
Thwarting an alien invasion of Earth serves as the central mission in this side-scrolling action title. Up to two players can participate simultaneously, controlling a red ninja and a blue ninja of the Kawari clan as they confront the alien Inimicus forces.

Players collect four distinct weapons that grant special forms. Picking up a throwing star enables metamorphosis into a tiger with superior speed and jump height alongside limited attack range. The chain and sickle transforms the ninja into an armored scorpion that swims well but moves sluggishly ashore. Equipping a bo allows flight as a hawk unable to attack, while the scarce katana temporarily turns the character into an invincible dragon that flies and defeats foes with single strikes.

b265adba4a6f751f.overview:
The opening portion spans three eras: 1955, 1985, and 2015. Players control Marty McFly as he explores sixteen streets in each time period, seeking thirty misplaced items. Marty must find the remote control that summons the flying time machine, spending nuclear fuel to travel between years. Each time jump leaves behind a clone that follows Marty's every move and must be lured off a platform before it touches him. Streets also offer alleys, movable platforms, and temporary hoverboards. Keys open doors to Object Rooms, where timed minigames guard the items.

Objects must be matched to scrambled names inside Puzzle Rooms reached through manholes or pipes. A wrong choice removes that item from the inventory. Other pipes, manholes, and landmarks contain Bonus Rooms granting junk food, fuel, keys, or extra lives. Some enemies drop items when jumped on, while stars provide firepower until a life is lost. A concluding adventure follows once all thirty are returned.

b3a798ab7f2f237c.overview:
Becoming supreme ruler of the four planet systems of the Epsilon galaxy is the primary objective in Overlord, which requires capturing the alien base in each system and finally defeating the alien leader Rorn. A single player competes against a computer opponent to establish and protect an interconnected empire of colonized worlds within each planet system. Both competitors start with command over a solitary planet, requiring the player to terraform barren worlds with an Atmosphere Processor before establishing settlements.

Sustaining colonies involves balancing vital resources, which requires acquiring farming stations for food, solar satellites for energy, and mining stations to produce fuel for transport ships. Growing populations yield tax revenue sent back to the primary base. For military operations, defensive installations protect friendly worlds, while battle cruisers equipped with missiles and hover tanks launch assaults against rival territories. Taking over an enemy planet requires wiping out its ground defenses, leading up to an assault on the opposing system starbase.

b3d82e2818aea6ca.overview:
Set in a prehistoric world, the story follows a bald cave boy named Bonk on a quest through Dinosaur Land to rescue the captured Moon Princess from King Drool. The tyrannical villain demands to rule the realm, prompting Bonk to use his hard head to battle enemy forces across multiple challenges and bring peace back to the land.

Bonk attacks enemies by striking them with his forehead. Taking damage depletes his reserve of health hearts, which players can replenish by gathering fruits or heart pickups. Consuming pieces of meat temporarily enhances Bonk with stronger abilities, such as performing a midair spin to land on his head and trigger a ground shock wave that damages foes. Smiling Faces collected along the way are tallied after a stage boss is defeated to award heart points.

b3e09c94e33e0293.overview:
The Addams Family: Pugsley's Scavenger Hunt provides side-scrolling platform gameplay. Based on an animated series, the story follows Pugsley after kidnappers capture his family and conceal them inside their own residence. To save them, Pugsley must explore the grounds and mansion interior to defeat large boss monsters and liberate Gomez, Granny, Wednesday, and Uncle Fester. Each rescued relative gathers in the music room and supplies a portion of a tune for Lurch to play on the organ, unlocking a passage to rescue Morticia.

Players navigate through the estate by entering various doors in the Hall of Stairs in any order. Pugsley runs, jumps, crouches, and swims while defeating enemies by leaping onto them. Along the way, players can hit item boxes to receive hints from Thing, uncover hidden paths, operate switch blocks, and collect power-ups including flying beanies and running shoes.

b4856061c9310015.official: Renegade was an influential benchmark in the beat 'em up genre. Step into the shoes of a vigilante who must battle his way through subways, parks, alleyways and parking lots. You can even burn rubber on a motorcycle. Pick up items like a hamburger that restores life, a heart that increases your lives by one, and an item that gives your bike a boost.
b4856061c9310015.overview:
Controlling a vigilante brawler, the player fights through hostile territory using punches, back kicks, jumpkicks, and running attacks. Movement occurs horizontally and vertically through scrolling spaces. Combat options include grabbing opponents by the collar for a shoulder throw, delivering knees to crouching adversaries, and sitting atop fallen foes to unleash grounded punches. A life is lost when the power meter depletes or time expires.

Battles progress through four stages, consisting of a subway platform, a wharf, an alley, and a final maze. Opponents include street punks, outlaw bikers, kung fu females, and blood-hungry hoods. A motorcycle sequence allows players to accelerate, lean, kick, and crash into rival riders. Special powers assist progress, including hamburgers that restore energy, hearts granting an extra life, single-punch knockouts, and turbo speed boosts. Modes support one or two players.

b49e3b3c2a307e9c.overview:
Rescuing Jerry's nephew Tuffy from a trunk in the attic serves as the primary goal. Controlling Jerry, the player begins in the basement and advances upward through the house while avoiding hazards like bees, spiders, and bats. Progression involves navigating platforms, climbing power cords, and finding mouse holes that act as stage exits or lead to cheese-filled bonus areas. Variable jumping allows control over jump heights based on how long the jump button is held.

Jerry defends himself with an unlimited supply of marbles alongside collectible, limited-use items such as a meat cleaver, hammer, bubble gum, or cup of water. Gathering small cheese yields bonus points, while larger wedges replenish health. Extra lives are awarded every 50,000 points. Tom periodically intervenes throughout the stages and must be defeated in the attic.

b59b46aaaa6b382d.official: Prepare to face-off for one of the most faithful sports simulations on the NES. Ice Hockey offers straightforward fun to just jump in and play, either solo or against a friend, yet also requires tactical skills for players who want to fine-tune their team. You can customize each squad member, selecting from three different body types, affecting their offense and defense.
b59b46aaaa6b382d.overview:
Athletes skate across an icy rink as players direct squads of four skaters and a goalkeeper in competitive matches. The primary objective centers on striking a black puck with a stick past the opposing goaltender and across the goal line. Games span three periods of play, opening with two opposing skaters contesting a face-off at center ice. Squad members can enter physical altercations while battling over the puck, after which a player from one of the teams is sent to the penalty box.

Team rosters are customizable across three distinct physical builds that adjust offensive and defensive attributes. Slimmer skaters possess superior speed and face-off capabilities, average members offer balanced performance, and heavier athletes provide enhanced body checking alongside greater shot power. The title supports solo competition against computer opponents or two participants playing directly against one another.

b66538543d3c4c74.overview:
Fifteen cities provide the route structure for the journey, beginning with a drive from Los Angeles to San Francisco before concluding back at the starting city. Throughout these locations, the player operates the vehicle KITT across a series of driving missions, each spanning three cities, to stop an international crime ring while avoiding innocent cars and decoy trucks. A separate Drive mode offers timed driving without enemies.

Before each city, enhancements can be applied to the car to increase its maximum speed along with its shield and fuel capacities, or to add missiles and lasers alongside the standard machine gun. Allies from the Knight Foundation appear on the road in trailers that grant power-ups to the vehicle. Running out of gas or time, or losing the shield, costs a life, and passwords let players resume at a later mission.

b6be14808b32b300.overview:
Twenty-four underwater stages structure the progression of the game, with settings selectable for easy, hard, or stacked configurations. Clusters of colorful spheres drift upward toward the top of the underwater playing area. Players maneuver these rising formations so that four or more matching colored spheres make contact. Upon touching, internal pressure builds up and causes the matched group to burst, freeing up space within the enclosure. If groups accumulate without clearing in time, the playing area completely fills and brings the session to an end.

Irregular alignments leave empty voids known as air pockets, which consume space just like solid spheres. These voids can be eliminated either by sliding pieces into them or by removing spheres below to expose them directly to open water. Clusters occasionally arrive carrying a mystic pearl, which alters adjacent spheres into a single uniform color when positioned strategically.

b7b5fdf2b31c4b8c.overview:
Destroying hostile industrial targets across island territories before an enemy empire can complete a devastating war machine forms the central goal of this shooter. Piloting a combat helicopter deployed from an aircraft carrier, the player targets six enemy factories located on islands across Bungeling Bay while shielding the carrier that serves as a home base.

Opposition mounts steadily from defensive gun turrets, guided missiles, fighter jets, and a battleship. Over time, surviving factories grow stronger and keep producing weapons, making swift demolition essential to prevent escalating counterattacks. One enemy island has a hidden area where the helicopter can land to steal bombs during operations.

b7c0c863084e6924.overview:
Multiple game modes structure this athletic title, including a Training mode for testing skills, a competitive VS. Mode for two players head-to-head, and an Olympic Mode. Across the overall experience, participants take part in fifteen different sporting competitions.

Athletes select a specific nation to represent during Olympic-themed contests against international rivals. Olympic Mode spreads twelve main events across a series of competition days, three events per day, and players must reach qualifying scores or defeat opponents to advance. Two optional events, Hang Gliding and Pistol Shooting, can be played after a day's main competition, and completing a day earns a password.

b82c1234165cd725.overview:
Based on the television series of the same name, the game puts a single player in control of the Airwolf helicopter from a cockpit perspective. The player flies through combat scenarios to confront and shoot down enemy aircraft.

Alongside eliminating opposing aerial targets, the pilot's mission involves locating and rescuing prisoners to complete the operational objectives.

b9116f11828e39d3.overview:
Star Wars features side-scrolling platforming on Tatooine and aboard the Death Star alongside landspeeder, asteroid field and cockpit flight segments.

The player begins as Luke Skywalker, crossing the Tatooine Desert by landspeeder and exploring its caves and Mos Eisley in search of the runaway droid R2-D2, Obi-Wan Kenobi and Han Solo, before rescuing Princess Leia from the Death Star cell block. Luke, Han and Leia can each be controlled, and only Luke can swing a lightsaber. Han and Leia have a single life each, though Obi-Wan can use the Force to revive them, while C-3PO and R2-D2 offer advice and R2-D2 can display Death Star maps. After escaping through the trash compactor and hangar, the player fights waves of TIE fighters as the Millennium Falcon's gunner, then pilots an X-wing against the Death Star, ending with a trench run to hit the exhaust port. The score reflects the percentage of tasks completed.

b9434d2f359f6e46.overview:
Summoned to aid the deceased, bio-exorcist Beetlejuice sets out to drive the living Deetz family from a home so he can earn entry into the afterlife. Players guide the character through multiple locations, including a village, storm drains, the Maitlands' house, an attic maze, and an afterlife waiting room, alongside a penalty level set on Saturn.

Gameplay alternates between side-view and top-view perspectives. Beetlejuice traverses environments, jumps across hazards, and stomps on beetles to restore energy. Defeating enemies and stomping targets yields Help Vouchers, which are spent at Recently Deceased Information Booths to purchase various scares such as Birdman, Skeleton, and Medusa Head. In top-view sections, items can be picked up or dropped while clearing out rooms. Beetlejuice begins with three lives and loses one after three hits, supported by up to three continues.

b9a4542417439619.overview:
Whomp 'Em is a platform action game in which the player guides Soaring Eagle, a young brave who ventures out seeking totems for his magic pouch. He jumps and strikes with his spear, and defeated creatures leave behind magic items such as hearts that heal wounds, potions that add extra lives, and gourds that raise his maximum life force.

Following the completion of an opening stage, players navigate through six additional levels in any order they choose. These levels are themed around elemental motifs, including water and fire environments. Clearing each level awards the player a totem, a special weapon or power such as a flame-shooting wand or a cloud for flying, which is selected with the START button. Only after the first seven worlds are cleared does a final, secret world open.

b9af9efdf490e148.overview:
Single-game exhibitions and a single-player pennant race form the primary ways to play. Choosing the pennant race requires the player to guide a chosen team through a regular season, aiming for at least a 75-55 record to qualify for a best-of-seven championship series. The fictional twelve-team league is split between Eastern and Western circuits, matching the pennant winner against either Los Angeles or New York in the final series.

Participants can adjust starting lineups and batting orders before taking the field. During play, matches feature an unconventional mercy rule ending games after five innings if a nine-run lead is established, and contests cannot exceed twelve innings. Once a batted ball enters play, the camera switches to a perspective along either the first-base or third-base line depending on which club is batting. Individual athletes also feature biorhythms that require monitoring to maintain peak performance on the diamond.

ba5968f14a02f1ad.official: The original NES adventures of Ryu Hayabusa conclude with Ninja Gaiden III: The Ancient Ship of Doom. Falsely accused of murder, Ryu must battle through seven action-packed stages to clear his name. Armed with his trusty sword and ninja powers, Ryu can now grab platforms and pipes to perform swift attacks on enemies from above or below.
ba5968f14a02f1ad.overview:
Clearing the ninja Ryu Hayabusa of a false murder accusation drives the adventure across seven stages. Players control Ryu as he runs, jumps, scales surfaces, and hangs from or climbs atop overhead structures like pipes and ivy. Combat relies on his sword alongside secondary ninja arts fueled by collected power, such as boomerangs, angled fireballs, a surrounding ring of flames, and simultaneous vertical blades. Slashing crystal balls yields medicine to replenish the life meter, ninja power items to restore energy, scrolls to increase maximum power capacity, and a weapon upgrade that expands sword range.

A life is lost if Ryu's life meter empties, the stage timer expires, or he falls into a pit. A boss with an individual life meter awaits at the finish of each act, demanding full depletion to defeat. When all lives expire, players may utilize a limited supply of five continues.

ba8c9990f378b941.overview:
Bump 'n' Jump is a vehicular combat game. A ruthless gang called the Jackals kidnaps the hero's girlfriend during a drive in his car, Popper, and the player must chase the gang's getaway vehicle through city, country, mountain and seaside districts, sixteen courses in all. Enemy cars can be bumped and pushed off the road or crushed by landing on top of them.

The car can jump, for example over an enemy car, but only once it is moving fast enough, and jumping is no longer possible once its power runs out. A warning sign marks danger ahead. Trucks leave sand, cement mixers leave concrete and fuel trucks leave oil in the car's path; sand and concrete destroy the car, while oil makes it slide. Power barrels restore fuel and energy, bonus items give an extra car, and running off the road into the ocean costs a car.

bafe68d5e6bbebb0.overview:
Navigating a submarine through deep sea combat, the player engages in side-scrolling action while attempting to evade or destroy enemy forces and reach the U.S. shore. Cinematic sequences appear throughout the experience. To quietly slip past hostile forces, the submarine can utilize a caterpillar drive. Torpedoes fire horizontally and missiles vertically, while electronic counter-measures draw enemy fire away from the submarine.

Gameplay shifts format during the final stage, which transitions into a platform-style level. Controlling Ramius inside the Red October, the player must locate and defuse bombs planted aboard the submarine before time runs out.

bb625b8df6ddbeb9.overview:
Achieving moral self-improvement and becoming an Avatar stands as the central goal in this single-player adventure. After a fortune-teller presents ethical dilemmas that establish the protagonist's starting profession, the player explores the peaceful land of Britannia to master the Eight Virtues. Progression requires understanding these principles, gathering artifacts, and eventually descending into the Stygian Abyss to reach the Codex of Ultimate Wisdom.

Fulfilling this quest involves traveling across an overworld map, visiting cities, and delving into maze-like dungeons. The player talks with non-player characters to uncover vital information. Standing in each virtue rises or falls according to conduct during dialogue and combat. To attain enlightenment, the traveler must locate specific runes, consult a seer for guidance, and correctly meditate at corresponding shrines.

bb834eb82f0ac531.overview:
Scoring more points than the opposing squad across four three-minute quarters is the primary goal in this full-contact take on two-on-two basketball. Matches feature no fouls or free throws, allowing participants to knock down opponents with punches, execute lunges, and pull down shorts without penalty. A wandering referee occasionally moves onto the floor and may trip up athletes during play.

Contests allow for one or two players, who each pick one character from a roster of eight distinct athletes, such as Tyrone, Vinnie, and Mohawk, while the computer directs their respective teammates. Offense involves shooting, passing, grabbing rebounds, and signaling the automated teammate to pass or shoot. On defense, actions center on jumping, lunging, and punching or stealing the ball. Off-screen athletes are indicated by arrows, and post-game statistics appear following the final quarter.

bbe150f50bd11f5a.overview:
Across 128 cities spread throughout the United States, players must flatten every building to advance to the next location on the map. Up to two players take control of giant mutated creatures, choosing between George the Ape, who excels at climbing, and Lizzie the Lizard, who possesses superior speed. A second participant can join the destruction mid-game by taking control of the remaining monster.

Creatures scale structures, punching walls until the foundations give way and collapse into rubble. While tearing down each city, monsters fend off hostile forces such as soldiers, police cars, tanks, and helicopters. Smashing buildings uncovers consumable foods to replenish lost health, alongside hazardous items like toasters and skulls. Taking excessive damage depletes a creature's life meter, transforming the monster back into a vulnerable human.

bcc8a24ab99f8593.overview:
Rad Racer II is a vehicular racing game set on a cross-country tour. The player drives through courses against a countdown timer to reach the final goal. Each stage features two checkpoints between the start and finish lines. Reaching a checkpoint with remaining seconds adds that spare time to the limit for the subsequent leg. Colliding with roadside objects or other motorists triggers crashes that cost time, but play continues as long as the clock has not expired.

The tour features eight stages, including Key West, Gettysburg, and the Bay Bridge. Controls allow steering, accelerating, braking, and activating turbo acceleration. From a dead stop, charging the boost gauge enables a rapid power start. The dashboard displays remaining time, engine rotations, current progress, speed, and an indicator signaling the direction of upcoming road curves.

bd6797920755a1dc.overview:
Modes of play include a tournament mode and a single game mode. Players select a squad from the seven teams of the Ultimate Basketball League, which feature invented players rated for speed, shooting, and defense.

On the court, the user directs five squad members, directly maneuvering one teammate at a time. The rules enforce violations such as traveling and personal fouls such as charging, and any athlete who accumulates five personal fouls is removed from the match. Because five athletes must remain on the court at all times, disqualified players must immediately be replaced with a substitute from the bench.

bd84b27f752aa568.overview:
Scoring as many points as possible by eliminating every segment of an advancing millipede serves as the primary objective. The player controls an archer lost in an enchanted forest, attacking insect threats with a magic arrow while maneuvering to avoid danger. Supporting two players in alternating turns, gameplay focuses on shooting enemies as they approach from above.

The featured millipede travels back and forth horizontally, descending one row whenever it strikes an obstacle or touches the display edge. Shooting a segment splits the creature into two separate pieces, causing the back section to grow a new head. Once the creature reaches the bottom, it works its way back up within the player's movement area, and touching any enemy costs a life.

bdc9dfed1b03db47.overview:
Piloting the AFX-6502 Zanac starfighter, the player shoots through an armada of alien defenses to destroy the mechanical entity known as the System. This single-player scrolling shooter tasks the pilot with eliminating enemy aircraft, launched rocks, reconnaissance planes, and ground fortresses whose cores must all be destroyed within a time limit while the scrolling stops. Large airborne objects also appear, driving back most standard attacks.

The ship uses a primary rapid-fire cannon alongside a secondary specialty weapon. Boxes that change color as they take hits release power chips that strengthen the cannon, while numbered items cycle through or enhance eight specialty weapons, including directional projectiles and shields. The System's aggressiveness adapts automatically to the player's firing frequency, offensive patterns, and success against fortresses. The game spans twelve areas.

be12cff13a06e0b5.overview:
Contenders attempt to overcome the American Gladiators across a series of athletic events. Five events make up each of four levels. In Joust, the player jumps from pedestal to pedestal, using a pugel stick to knock each opponent off, while Human Cannonball requires precise timing to let go of a swinging rope and slam into a gladiator on his pedestal. Powerball tasks the player with evading gladiators to stuff balls into alternating baskets before time runs out. In Assault, the player dodges tennis balls fired from a bazooka, grabs weapons near the barricades and shoots at a gladiator who tries to shoot them out of the player's hands.

Climbing the Wall requires grabbing handholds with the right and left hands while avoiding obstacles and other gladiators. After all four levels, the Eliminator challenges contestants to jump across I-beams, ride a hand bike, cross conveyor belts and ride a zip-line, dodging flying medicine balls along the way.

be20222704df7d5c.overview:
Competing across a variety of outdoor athletic disciplines forms the central goal of this title. The experience features outdoor sports associated with California, challenging players to test their abilities across multiple physical pastimes. Up to eight participants can join the competition.

Controllable events include activities such as half pipe skateboarding, roller skating, surfing, and BMX riding. Players also take part in flying disk and foot bag challenges. Players can compete in all six events, choose some of them, or practice one event, and trophies are awarded after each event, with a championship trophy after the sixth.

be97bca71e1bf099.overview:
King's Knight provides vertically scrolling shooter gameplay. The story begins after Princess Claire is kidnapped by a Dragon in the Kingdom of Izander. Four heroes take part: the knight Ray Jack, the wizard Kaliva, the monster Barusa, and the thief Toby. Each first clears a stage alone, and in the fifth and final stage the four band together to defeat the evil Dragon and rescue the princess. During each stage, the player navigates upward while destroying or evading onscreen adversaries and hazards.

Throughout the journey, characters collect power-ups to enhance their speed, jumps, weapons, and shields, raising each hero's level as high as twenty. Stages also contain life-increasing pick-ups and harmful life-reducing items, and destroying obstacles such as trees, rocks, and statues can reveal hidden items. Magic elements hidden across the first four stages, including inside a hidden cave, unlock each hero's single-use spell for the final stage. Cleared stages can be replayed to build strength.

bf22e6aff97bb442.overview:
Players take control of soccer teams and attempt to win by outscoring their opponents on the field. Matches adhere to traditional football objectives, challenging each squad to kick more goals into the opposing net than they concede across the match.

Several play configurations are featured, including World Cup, Pro Tournament, Shoot Competition, and Vs. Mode. The World Cup uses 16 national teams and provides a password to continue later, while the Pro Tournament is a single-game elimination event among eight American professional teams. The title accommodates up to two participants. In the World Cup and Pro Tournament, two participants cooperate on the same squad against the computer, while Vs. Mode lets them compete directly against one another.

bf24ceb607e46f38.overview:
Divided into two main titles selectable from the main menu, this compilation features Astro-Grover and Ernie's Magic Shapes. Astro-Grover contains five different counting and arithmetic activities. Players assist Grover with visiting alien creatures called Zips by counting them, matching totals within a moving beam, adding arriving groups together, subtracting departures, and selecting combinations of numbers to match a displayed sum. Completing the required number of correct answers finishes each round, and in several activities correct answers build parts of an onscreen city.

Ernie's Magic Shapes presents six exercises focused on color and shape identification. Ernie acts as a magician who conjures a composite picture overhead and presents individual shapes on a table. The player compares each item with the target illustration, confirming matches or rejecting incorrect shapes to request new ones until the image is fully assembled.

bf4b9f8706814e91.overview:
Missions take place across various selectable sortie areas, including Libya, the H2/H3 Zone, the Iraq-Kuwait Border, the Karbala Region, the Basra Region, Southern Kuwait, and the Baghdad Region. Taking the controls inside the cockpit of an airborne F-15 Strike Eagle fighter, a player handles modern aerial combat operations across multiple challenge levels.

Flight missions challenge the pilot to strike designated primary and secondary ground targets using onboard weapons, supported by defensive flares and chaff. Along the way, the player engages enemy aircraft in combat while monitoring engine damage and fuel consumption. A sortie concludes once the aircraft completes a landing approach to return safely to base, or terminates if the jet crashes or suffers fatal damage.

bf58512dc3bc427d.overview:
Piloting a spaceship over a looping mountainous landscape, the player shoots hostile alien forces to protect residents situated on the ground. An unlimited laser beam fires straight ahead to destroy encroaching spacecraft, while a limited stock of smart bombs eliminates all adversaries visible on the screen. The main objective centers on defending the residents of the planet Ligaras from abduction by Landers and other aliens, and a wave ends once the aliens are destroyed, though some types may be left alone.

A sparkling square gate also appears on the screen, functioning as a warp portal that transports the spaceship to the other side of the planet, where more enemies await. Players start with three ships and five smart bombs. One or two players can take part, with Game A for beginners and Game B for experts.

bffa6183b2cff753.overview:
Exploration in this single-player adventure alternates between traversing the ancient Mayan city of Chichen Itza and investigating individual temples. Moving between landmarks employs an overhead view, while entering a ruin switches the display to a first-person perspective. The objective involves locating a missing archaeologist and seeking the Sun Key artifact.

Inside the ruins, players inspect surroundings, gather items, and solve environmental puzzles using icon-based action commands. Three party members contribute distinct capabilities: the male protagonist performs hands-on tasks, the female companion provides musical talent, and the guide Jose moves heavy objects. Temples also feature turn-based battles against resident demons, where the avatar attacks unarmed or with an equipped sword. Experience grows through defeating hostile creatures and deciphering puzzles throughout the grounds.

c019750cc439810d.overview:
Set within a futuristic outer space atmosphere, the competition centers on futuristic craft battling one another for finishing positions. Competing vessels engage each other directly as they race toward the finish. Starting in the minor leagues of Mercury, the player works up through nine planets, each with different gravity, four races and four laps per race. Beating the clock is essential, and when time nearly runs out the track begins to disintegrate.

Prize money pays for repairs and for better turbocraft. The five models run from the Tomahawk to the Stiletto, each with a built-in weapon, and an extra weapon can be captured in later races. Bonus stars add money, the special weapon or repairs. Craft can jump to cut corners, and invisible roads, warps and bonus levels are hidden along the tracks.

One player races against three computer-controlled craft, while two players compete together against two computer craft on the four races of Mercury.

c03acbd23ae90b05.overview:
Controlling the Count, players move through eight worlds to find a specific number. The target value, called the Number of the Day, is determined by a spinning Number Wheel prior to the search. Progression involves gathering the correct numeral directly or picking up groups of objects whose count matches the specified amount.

Each world requires a minimum number of correct matches and allows only a limited number of wrong ones, tracked as bats; running out of bats restarts the game. Bonus Bolts count as a match, and Bonus Balloons lead to bonus screens with extra counting puzzles.

Movement options are selected at the start of the experience. Players can choose to navigate the environment by running or by continuously hopping.

c03ffd0d5fb5439e.overview:
Single races, full seasons, and practice options structure this Formula One competition. Racing under a name the player enters, the player competes against eleven rival cars of varying ability across the sixteen circuits of the 1992 season, aiming to secure the World Championship. Passwords allow a season to be resumed later.

Controlling a Formula One car, the player navigates circuits in varying weather conditions. Prior to each event, adjustments can be made to components such as the vehicle gearbox, wings, and tires, and an optional qualifying lap decides the starting position. During a race, the player can pull into the pit lane to switch between hard, soft, or wet tires as they wear. In the practice mode, Nigel Mansell appears on screen with driving tips.

c0c3d7c2682dd2e0.overview:
Piloting advanced rescue craft, the player flies continuously forward while adjusting speed and shooting through hostile forces to foil the global scheme of an alien mastermind named Hood. Missions are selected from a world map marked by Doctor Brain, where Hood prepares a power source over a sixty-day deadline. A ship damaged in an attack can take three days to repair, reducing the available campaign time. An onscreen information bar tracks the craft's life points as well as the orbital device configurations in use and available.

Destroying enemy targets produces collectible energy items. These pick-ups include life points, energy points that double or triple primary firepower, and orbital devices that deploy auxiliary firing units alongside the craft. Five firing configurations exist for these orbital units: forward, backward, sideways, diagonally forward, or in a circle around the ship. Two are available from the start, and the other three must be captured. Progress can be resumed using passwords provided during play.

c0c98471130cd09c.overview:
Players control Uncle Fester as he shoots alien invaders to rescue abducted townspeople. The adventure unfolds across three overhead environments: the outside street, underground sewers, and a UFO platform. Entering the sewers through stairways and sewer covers lets Fester reach parts of the street he could not otherwise get to. Seven houses contain members of the Addams Family who give Fester items. His inventory includes keys for entering buildings, bulbs for lighting the sewers, potions, missiles, and TNT. Activating the Noose item summons Lurch, who eliminates every enemy currently visible on the screen. Fester carries both a gun and a whip, which blue pickups strengthen and red pickups weaken.

Fester also enters six buildings that shift the perspective into a three-dimensional hallway crawl. Five structures contain alien bosses. Overcoming each of these bosses replenishes Fester's items and adds a piece to the Clue, a map of where the final Master Alien Boss may be.

c0dea150d9f39127.overview:
Might & Magic - Secret of the Inner Sanctum is a role-playing game that puts players in control of six adventurers. Exploring the world of Varn, the party traverses outdoor landscapes, towns, dungeons, castles, and an Astral Plane. While searching for the secret of the Inner Sanctum, the heroes gather clues from townspeople and complete quests, and the journey involves unmasking a villain disguised as the King.

Players create each character by selecting a race, sex, alignment, and class. Available classes include Knights, Clerics, Robbers, Paladins, Archers, and Sorcerers. Each race has its own abilities and resistances, and attributes such as Might, Endurance, Speed, Accuracy, Personality, Intellect, and Luck shape each character's skills. Alignment also restricts which locations some members can enter and which items they can equip.

c12771e8155b030e.official: The Peaceful Woods were once a safe haven for all gentle creatures... until Wario turned up. Now the place is swarming with monsters, and only Toad can clear up the mess! Wario's Woods is a fast-paced puzzle game in which Toad must line up bombs and enemies into rows of matching colors. Clear enough sections of the forest to go up against the mighty Wario himself!
c12771e8155b030e.overview:
Toad is controlled directly by the player as he moves across the playing field to align falling bombs with colored monsters. In order to reclaim the Peaceful Woods from Wario, players must clear each stage of enemies. A sprite drops colored bombs from above, and Toad arranges bombs and monsters into horizontal, vertical, or diagonal rows of three or more matching colors. Every valid match requires at least one bomb. Toad can carry single items, lift entire stacks, kick objects, and climb up piles to retrieve targets.

Play spaces shrink when Wario appears and causes the ceiling to sink, and completely filling the field traps Toad, ending the game. Some monster types require specific clears, such as diagonal-only matches. A two-player competitive mode enables opponents to send monster stacks to rival fields with consecutive matches.

c15ab051ff066f01.overview:
The player directs the Prince of Midenhall and eventually two fellow descendants of Erdrick, the Prince of Cannock and the Princess of Moonbrooke, to stop the sorcerer Hargon. Beginning the quest alone, the prince recruits his companions while traversing fields, caves, dungeons, towers, and seas. Exploration involves entering towns, speaking and trading with villagers, opening treasure chests, and navigating waters by ship.

Traveling prompts random encounters against groups of enemy monsters. In battle, the player issues combat orders to the heroes to attack, cast spells, use items, parry, or run. Defeating foes awards experience points that raise character levels, boosting attributes and granting new spells to the two companions. Battles also yield gold used to buy weapons and armor. Each party member carries up to eight items in an individual inventory. Progress is preserved by visiting a king, who records the party's deeds in one of three adventure logs stored on the cartridge.

c20a8cc1b2dacb8a.overview:
Challenge of the Dragon is an action game centered on martial arts combat. Players take control of Sir Burkelot, a Dragon Style Master on a mission to rescue his companion, Lady Ninita, who has been abducted by a necromancer. Sir Burkelot traverses ten distinct worlds, starting in a village and advancing through areas such as multi-leveled grasslands, the Big Wall, a forest, and an inner castle. Along the journey, he contends with mind-controlled adversaries including ninjas, samurai, giants, wizards, and skeletons.

Combat relies on a context-sensitive system where pressing the attack button triggers different martial arts techniques depending on proximity to a foe. Techniques include sword strikes, close-range knee strikes, side kicks, a shoulder butt performed during a super run, and a jumping dragon kick. The hero can also cast collected magic potions. Colored potion items restore health, defeat foes, or provide an extra life. Sir Burkelot's remaining vitality and lives are shown on an overhead status bar.

c2383e5cd8670c71.overview:
Players control the giant monsters Godzilla and Mothra to defend Earth against an invading legion from Planet X. Gameplay alternates between navigating a strategic grid and completing side-scrolling action sequences. On each planetary board, called a Ring Field, the player chooses a monster and shifts it across hexagonal spaces, taking turns with the enemy monsters. Moving triggers side-scrolling levels set in environments such as wilderness, volcano, jungle, ruins, sub-space, and Mecha City.

The goal on each board is to advance Godzilla or Mothra to the enemy base rather than to defeat every opposing monster. Moving adjacent to an enemy allows a one-on-one, fighting-game-style duel that ends in a draw after about forty seconds. The boards run from Earth to Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Pluto, Neptune, and finally Planet X, home of Ghidora, king of the enemy monsters.

c3136379fc4e9401.overview:
Guiding a party of up to six custom characters, the player explores a multi-floor underground maze beneath Trebor's castle. Adventurers are created at the Training Grounds by selecting from five races and three alignments, then distributing bonus points to qualify for one of eight professions. The Fighter, Mage, Cleric, and Thief are joined by the Wizard, Samurai, Lord, and Ninja, which demand higher statistics, while spellcasters draw on seven levels of Mage and Cleric spells.

The party navigates ten maze levels displayed from a first-person perspective, each built on a 20-by-20 grid. Hostile encounters pit the team against one or several groups of monsters to gather experience and gold. Pits, spinners, teleporters, and secret doors are among the hazards. The primary objective is to defeat the Great Wizard Werdna and recover the amulet he stole from Trebor.

c31d4984544dfee4.overview:
Three levels of play structure this title, each presenting a series of three shape-matching puzzles. Puzzle pieces drop down a chute one by one. The player guides each piece into its matching silhouette inside the target area and locks it into place. An incorrect attempt produces a buzz and lets the player try again. In the first level, there is no time limit, and pieces do not require flipping.

In levels two and three, pieces may appear reversed and must be flipped vertically or horizontally before being positioned in the puzzle area. These higher levels also introduce a countdown clock, giving six minutes in level two and three minutes in level three. Modes include playing alone, competing against an automated opponent, or taking turns between two human participants. When the timer is active, remaining seconds convert into points at the end of the round.

c387805a48a897fc.overview:
Missions send the player into the Pacific Ocean during World War II, ranging from torpedo and gun practice and historical convoy actions to full war patrols. Operating as a single-player submarine simulation, the experience centers on tracking down and attacking Japanese shipping targets while defending against hostile destroyers.

Controlling a United States submarine, the player chooses when and how to engage hostile vessels, such as surface attacks at night or submerged periscope attacks by day. Time moves quickly while patrolling between engagements, and the time scale can also be sped up during battles until the enemy detects the submarine or a weapon is fired. Operations demand managing navigation, firing weapons, and monitoring damage across separate battle stations.

c3f361c4a1441101.overview:
Guiding the cybernetically enhanced police officer Steve Hermann, the player punches through enemy forces across scrolling stages. Hermann uses his metal fists for close-range combat and to deflect incoming gunfire. Item boxes release coins or alpha and beta letter icons when punched. Collecting coins allows the player to crouch on designated pads to purchase health restoration, offensive upgrades, or extra lives. Gathering three letter icons summons a hovering robotic satellite that fights alongside Hermann and can lift him, and collecting the same letter combination again temporarily turns him into a heavily armored, invincible form.

Set in 2030, the mission requires Hermann to eliminate the rogue military faction Metal Command. The campaign spans seven stages, beginning at Area A. Players can tackle the subsequent five stages in any sequence before unlocking the concluding seventh stage. Unlimited continues are offered if all lives are exhausted.

c3fec0650f170991.overview:
Toxic Crusaders is a side-scrolling action game designed for a single player. The player controls Toxie, a mutated hero who sets out to rescue his girlfriend Yvonne and his captured allies from Dr. Killemoff. Movement spans left, right, and into the foreground or background of each scene. Toxie jumps and strikes enemies or breakable objects using his fists and his mop. Each hit costs him one heart from his eight-heart energy meter and one level of power from his mop gauge. If all hearts run out, one life is lost from his starting pool of two.

Destroying specific items leaves behind food to replenish hearts or toxic waste cans to upgrade the mop across three tiers. At higher ranks, the mop fires projectiles or flies like a returning boomerang. Across six stages, Toxie traverses environments such as city streets, a high school, a factory, a highway on a skateboard, sewers, and Killemoff's headquarters. Every stage concludes with a boss battle.

c408dd19ca49e551.overview:
Demon Sword casts players in a platformer centered on a protagonist named Victar, who sets out to overthrow an evil demon ruling the world. To defeat this entity, Victar journeys through three worlds to reclaim the shattered segments of his blade. Across seven stages, divided into two per world plus a final stage, each stage ends with a creature that must be defeated, and a blade is awarded once both stages of a world are cleared.

Controlling Victar, the player fights enemies using the sword, thrown darts, and magic items such as the Power Beam. Keys open Mystic Gates, which lead to realms that may hold special magic or a warrior that must be defeated. Victar can leap high over opponents and bound across treetops while avoiding environmental hazards like bottomless pits. The player starts with three lives, and a password system lets a game continue.

c41555b61617e52c.official: Test your skills across 18 holes of realistic links action. Golf offers classic stroke play for solo players, while two players can compete in stroke play or match play. Judge the wind direction, check the distance, select a club, adjust your swing and keep your eye on the ball. Now drive it home!
c41555b61617e52c.overview:
Completing eighteen holes of links action with the lowest possible score drives the action in this sports title. Golfers start at the tee of the opening hole and navigate an array of environmental obstacles, including twisting fairways, dense forests, water hazards, and bunkers. During each shot, the player evaluates the distance, determines the direction of the wind, selects an appropriate club, and adjusts the swing to hit the ball.

A single golfer plays stroke play, while two players can compete against one another in either stroke play or match play. Each swing uses a meter: the player starts the backswing, sets the distance with the downswing, and then chooses the point of impact, which decides whether the ball flies straight, slices, or hooks. Shots out of bounds cost two penalty strokes and water hazards cost one, and the grain of the turf affects the roll of putts.

c42fc592821b474b.overview:
The villainous Junkman and his army of junkbots have captured the crash dummy companions Spare Tire, Darryl, and Bumper. Crash dummies Slick and Spin set out to navigate treacherous environments, overcome hostile machines, and rescue their friends.

Controlling a crash dummy equipped with a default Exhaust Gun to stun enemies, players run and jump through four stages: The Crash Test Center, Inside the Big Top, The Docks, and The Junkyard. Throughout these environments, players use bouncy tires, rising sewer bubbles, trampolines, buoys and fishing boats to navigate past hazards such as cannons and swinging wrecking balls. Defeating level bosses, including the Sewer Beast and Junkman himself, frees the captured companions. Various spare parts and tools can be picked up during the journey to assist progress. The game supports both single-player and two-player options.

c457644ccfb93f89.overview:
Stopping the invasion of Solar System #517 by Grax and his gang of Alien Serpentbeasts serves as the core mission in this forward-scrolling third-person adventure. The hero must run, jump across bottomless canyons, and avoid or shoot attacking enemies such as the Menacing Meanies. Progress spans eight separate worlds divided into quadrants, and a timer runs while the player advances.

Because forward movement is continuous, players can speed up, slow down, and move left and right across the path. Columns along the route hold items, most of them helpful, granting laser missiles and temporary invincibility, alongside score-raising Super Stars; some release poisonous Magic Mushrooms instead.
