A Serpentbeast guards the end of every world and takes several hits to defeat, and the most dangerous of Grax's brothers waits in the eighth world. Pressing SELECT switches the display to a 3-D mode for use with 3-D glasses.

c46f20c85e2f3958.overview:
Creatures from throughout the cosmos continuously flood the screen, threatening to shut down the entire system if the room fills completely. Controlling an on-screen transporter, the player picks up, moves, and drops various creatures such as cats, pink elephants, snails, chatter teeth, and martians. The core objective is to align three, four, or more matching creatures in a line to transport them away. When a foot begins tapping, only a short amount of time remains in the wave to clear out extra clusters before moving on to faster rounds with larger creature populations.

Points are earned based on row length, intersecting lines, or simultaneous completions, with end-of-wave bonuses awarded for remaining empty squares or completely clearing the screen. Question marks help by transporting everything around them. Available play options include three difficulty settings as well as single-player, cooperative two-player, and competitive two-player game modes.

c47a01c9b32642ad.overview:
Players guide Buster Bunny across various environments to rescue Babs Bunny from Montana Max. Before each world begins, the player selects an alternate partner from Plucky Duck, Dizzy Devil, or Furrball, switching between characters upon collecting a Toon-A-Round. Each figure offers distinct abilities. Plucky glides briefly and swims efficiently, Dizzy breaks through walls and defeats enemies by spinning, and Furrball scales vertical surfaces. Buster himself jumps higher than the other characters.

Most of the six worlds contain three levels, and the quest ends at Monty's Mansion. Gathering thirty carrots allows players to receive an extra life from Hamton. In the multi-level worlds, the second level finishes in an enclosed space where players must avoid Elmyra to escape, and the third level concludes with a boss battle.

c49a5d7f565646d7.overview:
Battleship adapts the naval combat board game into a video game. The central goal requires the player to destroy the opposing fleet before the computer opponent eliminates the player's vessels. Beyond the standard missile, both combatants possess additional offensive capabilities through a limited supply of special weapons, each carried by a particular ship and lost when that ship sinks.

Structure across the campaign consists of eight levels, each containing five individual confrontations. Progressing through the entire experience requires achieving victory in all 40 encounters. Upon winning each level, the player receives a password to record advancement. As the player rises through the naval ranks, new ships and weapons become available for use in subsequent battles.

c4c139d2c349a513.overview:
CosmoStation Noah carries planetary refugees and requires defense from an armada of Molok Wardriver terrorists. Operating a spaceship from a cockpit perspective, the player traverses a ten-by-ten grid map to wipe out hostile forces before they destroy the station. Movement requires selecting target coordinates and holding a button to charge sector leaps. Upon reaching opposing fleets, the pilot attacks invading craft and their mothership while raising shields to absorb incoming damage.

Warping consumes fuel crystals and the barrier shields drain energy, requiring visits to bases for refueling and repairs. Damaged radar can be fixed at any space station, whereas repairing the laser cannons, defense barrier, or life support system requires returning to CosmoStation Noah. Planets can hold a Star-Bomb or a Super Laser, and a floating monolith carries a HyperDrive engine. The mission fails if the base or life support is destroyed, the ship takes too much damage, energy runs out, or the ship falls into a black hole.

c4d4ff0bd283656c.overview:
Set in the year 5012, the narrative follows Second Lieutenant Nazal, the lone survivor of the World Alive Force, on a mission inside Parasitis, a formless creature that engulfed the planet Abadox and swallowed a hospital ship carrying Princess Maria. Leaving his spacecraft and flying with a power pack, Nazal battles through the interior of the creature to destroy its Core and rescue the captive princess.

Gameplay alternates between horizontal side-scrolling stages and vertical levels that scroll downward in stages two, four, and six. The player shoots creatures such as eyeballs, worms, and skeleton fish, and must destroy Guardian monsters to advance. Power capsules provide upgrades such as a speed boost, orbiting barrier shields, layers of armor, guided missiles, a Laser Gun, and the Tresbeam and Star Beam, which fire in three and five directions. The player starts with three lives, and continuing restarts the current stage with only basic fire power.

c564704993cf79c9.official: Billy and Jimmy Lee, the Double Dragons, are back to avenge the loss of Marian! In their quest to defeat the evil Shadow Warriors, the duo faces nine missions against deadly street gangs, ninjas and huge mutant fighters. Traverse construction sites, alleyways and underwater hideouts filled with traps. Can Billy and Jimmy contend with the enemies and save the world?! This conversion of the arcade smash features simultaneous two-player action.
c564704993cf79c9.overview:
Billy and Jimmy Lee set out to defeat the evil Black Shadow Warriors to avenge Marian, gunned down by the gang. Players guide the brothers through nine stages set across alleyways, a heliport, a helicopter in flight, an undersea base, a forest hideout, and a mansion with a trap-filled dungeon. Story cutscenes featuring text and still images precede each stage. Combat employs directional fighting mechanics, granting full access to Billy and Jimmy's techniques from the start. Alongside standard attacks, their repertoire includes the Spinning Cyclone as well as moves performed from a squatting position, such as the Hyper Uppercut and High Jump Kick.

Matching pairs of enemies confront players, ranging from thugs, muggers and karate choppers to burly bosses, giants and androbots. Fighters can wield dropped weapons, including knives, pipes, chain whips, and grenades. Two participants can play simultaneously, with settings that determine whether attacks hurt a partner, while completing all nine stages requires playing on the hardest difficulty.

c56af43761cb601a.overview:
Operating a combat motorcycle armed with sidecar cannons, the player navigates through vertically scrolling combat zones to stop the terrorist group AATOM, which threatens the world with its own nuclear power plant. Support arrives in the form of a B-7 bomber, whose bombs back up the player's ground vehicle during missions. One player or two players simultaneously can take part.

The cycle starts with only a machine gun, and side cars found in the open or hidden inside obstacles add stronger cannons, each new one replacing the last. The cycle jumps automatically over water pools, inclines and dirt hills, slipping above enemy fire while airborne. Progression carries operatives through the city, the base, the woodland and the fortress, ending at the nuclear power plant. Major encounters involve engaging massive targets such as gunships and submarines.

c5e47c0479f500b8.official: When Princess Lala is kidnapped, Prince Lolo sets off to the rescue. Use your mind and wits to brave a trap-laden castle and rescue Lala! Adventures of Lolo features 50 cunningly designed puzzle rooms. Collect all the heart framers to open the treasure chest in each room. However, monsters are out to stop you, and obstacles block your progress.
c5e47c0479f500b8.overview:
Rescuing the kidnapped Princess Lala from the Great Devil serves as the primary objective of the player. Taking control of Prince Lolo, the player journeys through a haunted fortress containing fifty puzzle rooms divided across ten floors of five. Progression requires gathering all heart framers in a chamber to unlock a treasure chest. Collecting the gem contained within clears the room to proceed forward.

Navigating these rooms requires maneuvering around obstacles, pushing emerald blocks, and neutralizing various creatures possessing distinct behaviors. Although some foes merely impede passage, others defeat Lolo upon contact. Picking up specific heart framers awards magic shots that temporarily transform enemies into eggs. These encased foes can be repositioned, used as rafts to cross water, or shot again to vanish. Certain screens also provide powers to build bridges or smash rocks.

c613c10e32b93dbc.overview:
Guiding a hero from a first-person perspective, the player navigates the realm in real time while fighting hostile creatures. The adventure is set on the island of Grades, where the Overlord Darces the Dark threatens the land over five centuries after being exiled by the warrior Magi. The quest is to find the five Elemental Swords of Magi, secure the sword Tores, and defeat Darces. The world contains the city of Granville, Castle Grades to its north, other towns and villages, and dungeons inhabited by monsters.

In towns, the player buys weapons, armor, food and drink from merchants, and chooses one of five wizards in Granville as a teacher of elemental magic, such as the Wizard of SURA, master of Water Magic. Food and drink are consumed when camping outside towns, and paying for a room at an inn saves progress. Experience from fighting raises the character's level, and the chosen wizard decides when the player deserves a promotion.

c6507f7040a61e7b.overview:
Six international competitors vie for tournament prize money and a championship trophy on professional tennis courts. Matches take place across different court surfaces, including grass at Strawberry Field, clay at Sunbull State Court, and hard court at Doublemint Court. Before play begins, participants select one of six playable athletes, each characterized by personal proficiencies such as net play, ground strokes, volleys, smashes, backhands, or baseline play.

Controlling athletes on the near side of the court, players maneuver using the directional pad while executing serves, forehands, backhands, and overhead smashes with the face buttons. The simulation adheres to standard tennis regulations featuring 15-30-40 game scoring, deuce rules, six-game sets, and seven-point tie-breakers. Modes include single-player matches against computer adversaries or cooperative two-player doubles against a computer team, where partners alternate serve and receiving duties while utilizing the court alleys.

c6e275929764f795.overview:
Stages in this shooter are structured around warp sequences that advance the player across the solar system to free its nine planets, with three Warp Zones between each planet; final victory comes only after the Sun is freed. Challenge Stages offer bonus points, extra ships and booster pods. Controlling a spaceship positioned along the outer edge of the screen, the player maneuvers along a circular boundary while firing inward toward a central point.

Enemy Gyrusian ships gather in formation at the middle of the screen and can destroy the player's ship only by firing or attacking from there. Hazards include the practically indestructible amoeba and indestructible meteors. Bonus Spheres attached to intergalactic mines also appear; destroying the mines and shooting the center of the sphere yields dual cannons, and each destroyed sphere adds a booster pod that allows one firing of the all-encompassing Ultra-Lazonic Phaser, up to seven pods.

c701cffa5315b437.overview:
Reaching the end of a scrolling game board ahead of opposing teams serves as the main goal across one to four teams. Participants advance their markers by rolling a die after completing activities determined by colored spaces. Depending on team size, these challenges consist of arcade mini-games or sketch-and-guess rounds. Mini-games require players to unveil hidden illustrations within a time limit by repelling paint mutants, carrying crates, catching leaping tenants, or gathering energy capsules. Once a mini-game timer concludes, players receive forty-five seconds to spell out the depicted subject.

Teams containing two or more members unlock drawing challenges, where one participant sketches on screen using rotating cursors and preset circle shapes while partners attempt to decipher the word. Some drawing turns trigger an all-play format where every team competes to solve the identical sketch. Additional modes include a practice drawing session and an alternate board game mode designed for use alongside external physical cards.

c7ad19e926809adc.overview:
Completing a series of missions using a roster of mutant heroes is the central goal. The roster features Wolverine, Cyclops, Storm, Colossus, Nightcrawler, and Iceman. Combat entails fighting through each stage toward a boss encounter, occasionally locating items like keys. Once the stage boss falls, the heroes must race back to the starting point before an explosive device detonates.

Controlling the heroes involves distinct capabilities, with some relying on melee attacks while others launch projectiles. Nightcrawler passes through walls at the cost of some energy, while Storm and Iceman hover instead of jumping. Play accommodates one or two participants, providing an artificial intelligence partner during solo sessions. Four main missions, plus a practice mission, lead to a final confrontation against Magneto, accessed via a button combination.

c7dae9170fcd7cbc.overview:
Gemfire presents role-playing strategy gameplay set on the fictional island of Ishmeria. Players select a house across four scenarios sharing the same game board, aiming to rule every province, reunite the six magical gems of the crown Gemfire, and stop the tyrannical King Eselred. Operations are divided between a strategic view and separate combat engagements. Each month the player issues commands to every province under their control, such as recruiting forces, relocating troops, bolstering local economic output, building defenses, or negotiating alliances.

Attacking adjacent lands shifts the action to turn-based battlefield screens where armies field four regular units, composed of cavalry, two infantry units, and archers, plus an optional fifth unit of mercenaries, monsters, or magicians. Troops maneuver across terrain to defeat enemy forces, capture the opposing flag, or outlast the opponent's food supplies. Infantry can erect fences during combat, and the ruler who holds the crown can call on the Fire Dragon in war.

c8486cd1a3595000.overview:
Mechanized Attack is a shooting game where the player infiltrates an island base held by rebel forces reported to include fighting robots. Threats encountered along the way include gunboats, helicopters, frogmen, soldiers throwing grenades or brandishing daggers, attack dogs, and airborne probes. The game supports play using either a standard controller to steer a crosshair or a light gun pointed directly at the screen. After clearing an area, players choose the subsequent path by shooting the character icon representing the desired road.

Combat relies on three main weapons: a firearm, hand grenades, and high-damage rockets that temporarily replace grenades until spent. Shooting item pickups during missions restores ammunition or health, and awards protective gear. Magazines provide forty rounds each, while health items include energy drinks and first-aid kits. Additional collectibles consist of extra lives, temporary illumination flares, bulletproof jackets that halve incoming damage, and a sniper sight that expands the target area.

c85ed147e6da0da5.overview:
Guiding Lieutenant Solid Snake, the player infiltrates hostile territory while avoiding detection by guards and surveillance equipment. Snake begins with a combat knife and handgun, using melee strikes, firearms, and planted explosives across locations such as a jungle, a battleship, a train, and a castle. Raising an alarm brings attacking soldiers, requiring the player to defeat the troops or escape them. Knocking out enemies with punches occasionally yields ammunition or rations. Rescuing hostages and interrogating enemy officers with truth gas increases Snake's rank, expanding his health and carrying limits.

Progression requires finding pass cards to unlock doors and using a transceiver to reach three contacts. Exploration shifts between top-down perspectives and side-scrolling sections where Snake walks, jumps, or crawls. In side-view areas, weapons are limited to a knife, handgun, and plastic explosives, with underwater paths requiring oxygen tanks.

c9348c4e30ef0bc6.overview:
Mario's Time Machine centers on educational platforming. Bowser constructs a time device named the Timulator to plunder important historical artifacts for display within a museum in his castle, altering the timeline and capturing Yoshi. Taking the role of Mario, a single player retrieves these stolen treasures from the museum hub and travels to different eras on Earth to restore each item to its rightful time and location, ultimately seeking to rescue Yoshi.

Presented from a side-scrolling perspective, navigation relies on moving left, right, and jumping. Progress requires learning the historical background of each recovered artifact and the figure linked to it. Once every artifact is returned, Mario must pass a History Test of questions on this knowledge to open the door to Yoshi's prison. A password feature lets players save and resume their progress.

c9a3c9873a859fcb.overview:
The game spans twelve stages. Sent by his boss, Mr. Spacely of Spacely Sprockets, George Jetson sets out to stop Cogswell Cogs from mining ore on Planet M38 and to halt its production. Family members assist George throughout the journey by supplying him with various tools to handle oncoming obstacles.

Controlling George in this side-scrolling environment, players walk and jump, and in several rounds his jet pack boosts his jumps. Stages contain scattered crates and objects that can be collected and thrown at opposing targets. Remote Control Defenses, energized by collected Power Packs, provide further options. Switches trigger unusual effects, such as inverting gravity. Players are also granted an unlimited supply of continues to complete each area.

caae56599689d429.overview:
Arranged as a side-scrolling journey through a series of levels filled with puzzles, the adventure casts the player as Paul, an apprentice magician striving to overthrow the evil wizard Abadon. Traveling across the land, Paul must converse with various individuals, acquire useful items, and gather weapons that shield him or facilitate magic use. Surviving the quest requires ongoing management of Paul's health alongside his food and water reserves, which deplete continuously over time. Defeating Abadon requires the Ultimate Potion, formed from vials of Earth, Air, Fire, and Water.

Progression involves learning magical spells by assembling runes into their magic names, then casting them at a chosen power level at a cost in mana. Solving the problems along the way expands Paul's maximum mana, which sets his magician rating. Progress can be preserved in up to four save positions, though only fifteen saves are allowed per game.

cd5ad84e6bba35c1.overview:
Tecmo Super Bowl simulates American football competition between twenty-eight teams based on real professional rosters. Players take the field using authentic league clubs alongside actual athlete names and specialized attributes drawn from the 1990-1991 campaign. Three specific quarterbacks appear under generic club monikers instead of their personal names.

Each team uses an eight-play playbook of four running and four passing plays, and individual plays can be swapped for substitute patterns. Modes include preseason games, a 17-week regular season leading to the playoffs and the Super Bowl, and a Pro Bowl between AFC and NFC all-stars. A battery saves season results, and the game tracks standings, team rankings and league leaders.

cdd148ebf43ed891.overview:
A party of four adventurers explores an underground dungeon across sixteen levels to slay a serpent. Players assemble their team by generating statistics or choosing a prefabricated group, selecting among warriors, thieves, and magicians. Exploration is viewed through a split screen showing both a first-person perspective and an overhead map of the current level. While navigating the labyrinth, the party battles monsters, collects gold and treasure, and visits shops to purchase gear.

Up to four participants can play cooperatively by dividing control of the party members, with one designated leader directing exploration. Battles occur in a turn-based format where characters attack, cast spells, or attempt to flee. Combatants can perform general physical strikes or target specific body parts to inflict additional damage. Defeating enemies awards experience points to increase attributes.

ce1fd1fcf89d2d63.overview:
Four chapters structure the side-scrolling platform adventure as Bart Simpson travels into a comic book world. Assuming his superhero identity, Bartman, he seeks to rescue his captive idol, Radioactive Man, from the Limbo Zone, a nether-region that revolves around a black hole. The ultimate goal involves defeating villains who stole Radioactive Man's abilities and confronting the mastermind, Brain-O the Magnificent.

The player navigates stages filled with deadly traps and hostile foes, engaging them with kicks and punches. Collecting lightning-bolt icons grants Bartman a supply of Laser Bolts, while Ice Crystals provide freezing Cold Breaths. Every hit drains energy, which can be restored by picking up radiation symbols. Each of the first three chapters concludes with a confrontation against an individual super villain: Swamp Hag, Dr. Crab, and Lava Man.

cf226f0d9486103b.overview:
Rescuing Professor Plum and stopping a world-destroying Doomsday Bomb serves as the primary mission for Bang, the youngest leader of the secret command Saber Tiger. Players navigate Bang across a non-linear map of more than forty numbered routes, choosing a direction at each junction. Along these branching paths, the protagonist moves through environments by running, jumping, and shooting, with the freedom to backtrack to previously visited locations.

Bang starts with a basic handgun, but players can buy weapon upgrades such as the Rolling Star boomerang gun from the Super Shop. After rescuing a hermit, Bang can use up to five special powers fueled by collected Force, including teleporting to routes already visited. Progress requires exploring the terrain, locating the seven enemy leaders and their fortresses, and acquiring items such as Apollo's Sword. Two different endings are possible.

cf517940496d6085.overview:
Taking on the role of 43-year-old boxer George Foreman, the player seeks to become the undisputed world heavyweight champion by claiming the title belts across three boxing circuits. Matches unfold across three rounds, where players attempt to overcome their rivals through skilled offense and defense.

During bouts, boxers can block incoming strikes, dodge attacks in two directions, and execute an assortment of punches, and successful combinations earn Superpunches. Contests can be won in several ways. Knocking an opponent down four times in a fight wins the bout, as does a fallen boxer failing to rise before the count of ten. A technical knockout occurs if a fighter goes down three times within one round. When three rounds conclude without a knockout, judges award the decision based on punches landed, knockdowns, damage and overall command of the rounds. Passwords awarded for each title belt let players resume, and two players can fight single bouts against each other.

cf9b320f493edac5.overview:
Achieving the highest point total across multiple tournament stages is the central goal. Based on the television game show, the competition advances from Quarter-Finals to Semi-Finals and the Final Round via passwords earned by winning players. Participants pick a category and wager from an onscreen board before an answer appears. Contenders then race to buzz in against a timer. The first person to ring in selects the phrasing prompt and spells out the required question using an alphabet and number grid. Correct responses award points, whereas incorrect guesses deduct that amount and let remaining rivals buzz.

Contests feature three phases: Jeopardy, Double Jeopardy with elevated point values and two hidden Daily Doubles, and Final Jeopardy where all contestants with accumulated scores enter wagers and responses. Up to four players can compete in the Quarter-Finals and up to three in the later rounds, with the option of playing against the computer.

cfa1cc0f40cf139b.overview:
Town & Country Surf Designs - Thrilla's Surfari centers on obstacle navigation across various environments. The player controls Thrilla Gorilla on a mission to rescue Barbi Bikini, who has been kidnapped by Wazula as a meal for Imu, the Volcano Master. Progress leads through jungles, rivers, deserts, lava rivers, waterfalls, and the ocean. Thrilla rides a skateboard on land, surfs the rivers and waterfalls, and rides a shark underwater, facing one of Wazula's bosses at the end of each level.

While advancing, the player steers around hazards, leaps over pits, and avoids or lands on hostile creatures such as giraffes, angry warriors, voodoo skulls, giant cobras, scorpions, and electric eels. Collectible items include coconuts, which earn turns at a Shell Game for extra lives, bananas, which restore health, and diamonds, which grant temporary invincibility.

cfbb785f7227e87e.overview:
Building wealth through casino wagering is the focus as participants arrive in Las Vegas. Starting with a 700-dollar bankroll and the chance to build it toward one million dollars, players can gamble their funds across four separate offerings: roulette, blackjack, keno, and slot machines. Up to four people can play, challenging each other or the house. Progress in the Vegas Dream mode can be preserved using lengthy passwords.

Two different modes are available: One Spot, which restricts the experience to gambling alone, and the storyline-driven Vegas Dream mode. In the narrative option, random social encounters occur during play with gamblers seeking side bets, hustlers, strangers with hard-luck stories, and chances for romance. Depending on player responses, these encounters might cost money or later provide financial rewards. Players may also marry, which can bring a cash gift or monetary loss if the partner proves dishonest.

cfea236e0d0fe0e4.overview: The player visits the Caesars Palace casino, starting at the cashier with $1,000 in credit before scrolling around the casino floor to choose a table or machine. Every action uses an on-screen pointer: the A button selects items, places coins and chips, deals cards and pulls slot machine handles, while the B button cancels a bet before play begins. The casino offers video poker, three slot machines (Riches of Rome, Magnificent Sevens and the four-reel progressive Fountains of Fortune), blackjack with splitting, doubling down and insurance, roulette with 0 and 00, and the Big Six Money Wheel. Table games use a chip tray in which the player can make change between chip values, and pressing START shows a check with the current total. Cashing in at the cashier ends the visit with a ride home that depends on the amount taken.

d02b24e4ee8e639b.overview:
Rescuing captured comrades and destroying an enemy vessel, the Toad Magma Tanker, serves as the primary objective across the Aniverse. The player starts by directing Bucky O'Hare, captain of the spaceship Righteous Indignation, who journeys across four distinct planets to free his imprisoned crew. These opening worlds can be tackled in any order, spanning environments filled with hazards such as waterfalls, active volcanoes, slick ice, and laser cannons. Stages contain multiple scenes that scroll both horizontally and vertically, and each stage ends with a boss encounter.

Freed crew members become playable, allowing the player to switch between characters at any time. Each hero utilizes different weapons and special skills, including short flights, wall clinging, high jumps, and a steerable crystal ball. Holding and then releasing the attack button triggers these special abilities, which grow stronger with collectible power-up icons. Extra lives and health can also be collected while battling toad forces.

d04b445ac57cccb3.overview:
Players control the title character, navigating hostile environments while engaging adversaries through direct combat and shooting. Based on the 1987 motion picture, the single-player experience combines elements of side-scrolling brawling with run-and-gun mechanics.

Throughout the adventure, the protagonist advances across stages by confronting opposing threats using hand-to-hand attacks alongside projectile weapons. The overall objective centers on battling through waves of enemies while surviving the hazards found across each area.

d077b282b751a246.overview:
Hostile forces belonging to the Cobra organization have spent decades terrorizing the world, prompting the G.I. Joe team to mount a mission to destroy the menace permanently. Play spans six levels of three sections each, with a boss confronted in every section.

Prior to each mission, General Hawk assigns a team leader, and the player picks two additional operatives from the rest of a roster of Duke, Rock & Roll, Capt. Grid-Iron, Blizzard, and Snake Eyes. Squad members possess distinct ratings for stamina, jumping, hand-to-hand combat, and ranged firepower. Players can swap active operatives during play and switch between close-quarters attacks and weapon mode, which consumes shared ammunition. Operatives can jump, crouch, aim upward, jump through select platforms, and cling to certain walls. Gun symbols hidden in each level or released by defeated foes power up weaponry. Players may also commandeer three enemy vehicles: the high-jumping Cobra Pogo, the flying Cobra Interrogator copter, and the Cobra Buzz Boar.

d0807dad4f79c978.overview:
Finding three magic items and uncovering a conspiracy to restore order to the kingdom of Albareth serves as the primary quest. The monarch has vanished, leaving rival nobles waging petty wars while barbarians and roaming monsters ravage the territory. A single player selects a champion from among a barbarian, knight, or valkyrie to traverse the expansive land.

Exploration leads travelers through forests and mountains to cities, castles and towns such as Treela. Along the journey, useful items can be acquired, including healing potions, teleportation scrolls, and a returning thrown axe. Interacting with local inhabitants provides guidance, and key words learned in conversation open new questions. Taking lodging at an inn provides a password that preserves progress.

d0850075065ecbd1.official: Mike Jones, high-school ace pitcher and part-time adventurer, returns for another escapade: traveling not into space but back in time! This sequel to StarTropics was released only in North America as one of the last Nintendo Entertainment System titles. Mike is transported through history from the Stone Age to the Wild West.
d0850075065ecbd1.overview:
Recovering scattered artifacts known as Tetrads and defeating clones of the evil alien Zoda form the primary goal of the adventure. The single-player narrative follows Mike Jones as he journeys through Earth's history, traveling to eras such as the Stone Age, Ancient Egypt, the Middle Ages, and the Wild West. Along the way, historical and fictional personalities assist Mike as he navigates obstacles, solves puzzles, and confronts various bosses across nine chapters.

Controlling Mike with eight-directional movement and mid-jump steering, the player explores environments while battling adversaries. Health is tracked through a line of hearts, while the upgradable Psychic Shock Wave power grows stronger as progress is made through the quest. In addition to this power, Mike acquires weapons such as Tink's Axe, a dagger, and a katana, and can switch between them during battle.

d088f4b91a03dd6a.official: Based on the classic arcade game, Tecmo Bowl™ puts you in tense American football matches as you take control of one of 12 teams and try to take them all the way to the top! Go head-to-head with a human opponent, or against the computer in action or coaching modes. Plan your plays like a pro, and then make your mark on the field by controlling every pass, block, run and tackle.
d088f4b91a03dd6a.overview:
Guiding a football team to the championship stands as the primary goal in this American football simulation. Players select one of twelve squads featuring nine athletes per side on the field. On offense, the objective is to execute passes, blocks, and running maneuvers while avoiding defenders, whereas defensive play requires evading blockers to tackle ball carriers or intercept passes. Both sides choose from a playbook of four plays before every snap, allowing defenders to collapse the offensive line and cover receivers if they successfully predict the offensive call.

Modes include a single-player progression where victories against computer opponents provide passwords to continue toward the championship. Two participants can also compete directly against each other, either controlling the physical on-field actions directly or solely selecting strategies in coach mode.

d095eab5376c2b7c.overview:
Taking control of the hero Orpheus, the player travels through ancient Greece across side-scrolling environments featuring light platforming and combat. The journey requires fighting through mythological creatures such as the Minotaur, cyclops, and Cerberus to reach Tartarus, defeat Hades in a two-stage encounter, and rescue his lover Helene. A top-down overview displays eight different locations, beginning in Arcadia, where players explore city-states and dungeons in a somewhat non-linear fashion.

Progression involves meeting Greek gods in their temples to receive important items. Beginning with a simple club, Orpheus gathers swords, shields, and other equipment, while ambrosia raises his maximum stamina. Available equipment includes the Staff of Fennel, which can emit the fire of Prometheus at distant enemies, and the Divine Sword, which shoots the power of Argus in a straight line. Players also acquire special items like the Sandals of Hermes and the Harp of Apollo, which lets Orpheus fly on Pegasus when played at the Monolith of the Sun.

d0e5899cf6b756d6.overview:
Destroying the mechanical demon army of the wicked ruler Kull serves as the primary goal of the experience. The player guides a hero armed with a boomerang through an action-oriented quest featuring shooting components. Before each level, the hero uses booster rockets to fly through a long tunnel filled with demons and evil spirits. Throughout the campaign, occult and demonic motifs appear as the hero descends through the gates of Hades to confront Kull.

Progression spans seven distinct stages, each with its own task, such as finding a key, freeing condemned souls, or destroying the Robodemon machine. These environments consist of the levels of Bone, Flesh, Fire, Condemned Souls, Demon's Quarters, Robodemon Factory, and Kull's Palace.

d10e4280b6ca8681.overview:
Players control a pair of wrestlers in tag team matches, trading attacks inside a roped square ring against opposing duos. Maneuvers include punches, jump kicks, backdrops, and throwing an adversary into the ropes to follow up with rebound strikes. As a wrestler takes damage, their power gauge depletes, which slows movement and disables jumping. A weakened competitor can return to the corner to tag their partner, requiring a ten-second wait before another swap can occur. Grabbing a Booster Ball tossed in by the trainer enables the active wrestler to execute their character-specific special technique.

Contests require winning two out of three timed rounds by emptying the opponent's power gauge, or in two-player matches by holding more power when time expires. Venues include standard rings as well as specialized surfaces, such as slippery ice floors or electrified ropes that deliver shocks. The game offers a single-player mode against computer opponents and a two-player option where two participants face one another.

d138aba5eb5c8cf1.overview:
Battling toward a final confrontation in Arcane's lab serves as the ultimate goal for players controlling the DC Comics superhero. Based on the animated television program, the game opens with a sequence recounting Swamp Thing's origin. Players direct the protagonist through side-scrolling environments across the Louisiana swamps and additional territories.

Throughout the journey, the hero punches adversaries and shoots collectible swamp moss projectiles found across the areas. He can also transform into a tree, an apple, a tire, or a flower to reach otherwise inaccessible places, with the flower restoring energy. Progression requires traversing diverse stages such as a toxic dump, a graveyard, and a chemical factory. Over the course of the expedition, Swamp Thing engages several bosses, confronting Dr. Deemo, Weed Killer, and Skin Man before facing Arcane himself.

d18ad8b76f9d0678.overview:
Directing a transforming protagonist called the Guardian, the player battles alien forces to trigger the self-destruction of an encroaching world known as Naju. The mission requires activating ten safety devices inside Naju. Exploration occurs on the surface, termed the Labyrinth, from an overhead perspective in humanoid form. Using a coordinate map, the Guardian navigates interconnected screens and uses keys to open new parts of the Labyrinth, which holds items, weapons, shops and information. Enemy attacks deplete a life meter, ending the game if fully drained.

Interior corridors shift gameplay to shooting sequences in fighter form. Flying through these corridors culminates in boss fights that can activate part of the safety system or yield keys. The Guardian wields a rapid-fire primary shot and secondary arms that consume Power Chips. Blue and Red Lander items raise maximum energy and the Power Chip maximum, while a friendly blue creature in certain rooms provides passwords to save progress.

d1d15eca4bf1732e.overview:
Four distinct activities are selected from the main menu: Astro-Grover, Ernie's Magic Shapes, Letter-Go-Round, and Ernie's Big Splash. Astro-Grover presents five games focusing on mathematics, where the player counts visiting alien Zips, matches quantities inside a moving beam, solves addition or subtraction problems, and selects number combinations to meet target sums.

Ernie's Magic Shapes contains six games centered on visual identification. Ernie displays a shape picture overhead, and the player confirms matching pieces shown on a table or cycles away incorrect shapes until all targets are assembled. In Letter-Go-Round, players adjust the speed of a spinning ferris wheel and drop letters into a slot as they reach a matching zone at the bottom, matching target characters across six levels, progressing from simple case matching to completing three-letter words. Ernie's Big Splash functions as a planning and predicting puzzle activity that can be reset from the controller.

d1defc7a6c6f96f8.overview:
Circuits viewed from an overhead perspective frame the competitive action, with each race requiring drivers to complete five laps. Competitors guide Formula One-style vehicles across tracks that fit entirely on the screen without scrolling. The winner of a race earns advancement to the next course, while computer-controlled opponents contest the remaining positions. Up to two players can compete simultaneously.

Hazards populate the courses as participants progress, including tornadoes and puddles of oil that cause temporary loss of steering control. Drivers can also gather wrenches scattered along the road surface, trading a pair collected during a winning heat to increase top speed, boost acceleration, or improve tire traction.

d22a0c390dfc47c9.overview:
Saving the artificial planetary system IOTA Synthetica from destructive, animated inanimate objects is the primary objective of Commander Gun-Nac. Piloting a spaceship across eight scrolling levels, the player combats hosts of hostile forces. Collecting a wing upgrade enlarges the craft, enabling it to absorb two enemy strikes instead of a single hit while expanding its offensive upgrade limits.

Offensive options include five primary weapons alongside four types of secondary bombs, with up to 20 bombs in stock. Players acquire and improve gear by gathering numbered or lettered icons, as well as Power-Up Chips. Collecting the same weapon number raises that weapon's level, while repeating the same bomb symbol raises the bomb level. Money bags collected during play allow the pilot to buy weapons, fire power and bombs at the Supply Shop between stages.

d290ac95ca512a37.overview:
Guiding a hungry caveman through side-scrolling environments, the player sets out across multiple islands to find dinner. Survival requires avoiding hazards such as pitfalls, traps, and lethal lava or water, as the protagonist cannot swim. Enemies threaten the character, who perishes from a single strike unless carrying stones. These stones can be projected from his club to defeat adversaries, and upgrades such as double stones grant twin-shot capability.

Throughout the journey, players collect bones scattered across levels. These bones serve as currency to purchase ability upgrades, spells, and items at in-game shops. The quest spans four distinct territories: Paradise Island, Monster Island, Terror Island, and Chaos Island, each containing several stages to traverse. Checkpoints exist during runs, but losing every life prevents resuming from the most recent checkpoint.

d2a585ff6febf594.overview:
Stages in this shooter shift between vertically scrolling aerial sections and horizontal side-scrolling areas. Armed with wings of courage and love from Ares, the God of War, two young men set out to save the world from extinction. Up to two players fly simultaneously, firing guns and, during vertical sections, missiles. The game spans five stages, and a dragon appears as a recurring boss. Flying into the whirlpool of a large face leads to a dangerous Minus stage, while destroying certain ground structures opens a whirlpool to a Bonus stage.

Collecting power-up items upgrades offensive strength through multiple tiers, advancing from normal shots to twin lasers, penetration shots, and three-way flame shots. Reaching the final enhancement transforms the warrior into a Firebird, which deals four times normal damage and can withstand two direct hits before its power drops. Hearts award continues, up to a maximum of nine.

d2fbe8b10f762099.official: At Mushroom Kingdom Hospital, nasty viruses are on the loose. It's time to give them a dose of Mario's medicine! In this classic puzzle game, you must eradicate all the viruses in the bottle by spinning and lining up the colored vitamin capsules as they fall. The more lines of viruses you clear, the more points you rack up, scoring huge combos. But beware of side-effects: this game may be addictive!
d2fbe8b10f762099.overview:
Clearing all viruses from a medicine bottle is the primary goal in this falling-block puzzle game set in Mushroom Kingdom Hospital. Mario tosses vitamin capsules into the bottle, where red, yellow, and blue viruses sit. Players manipulate each falling capsule by moving it horizontally and rotating it in ninety-degree increments. Aligning four matching colors of capsule halves and viruses in a row destroys them. Any unsupported capsule pieces drop downward, potentially forming additional matches. The game ends if stacked capsules block the bottle opening.

Players configure starting levels from zero to twenty and choose among three falling speeds. In the competitive two-player mode, participants race to clear their respective bottles first. Clearing two or more rows or columns at once, such as through chain reactions, sends extra capsule pieces into the opponent's bottle, and winning three individual rounds secures the overall victory.

d30e480e7a99b5c3.overview:
Controlling the knight Kuros, the player moves across platforms, jumps, and swings a sword called Brightsword to vanquish enemies. The mission requires traveling through the Kingdom of Elrond to reach Castle IronSpire, defeat the evil wizard Malkil, and rescue the captured princess. Kuros explores forests, caverns filled with ice and lava, and maze-like castle corridors.

Throughout each stage, the player collects colored keys to open matching chests and doors. Acorns, chests, and torches yield treasure, weapons, and magical artifacts, such as throwing weapons, a cloak that hides Kuros from monsters, and boots that enable walking on lava. Collected gems serve to bribe guardians blocking level exits. Bosses enchanted by Malkil wait at stage conclusions. Kuros possesses a life meter that depletes from enemy hits and elapsed time, which meat items can replenish. Losing all lives allows continuing the journey while retaining collected equipment.

d3b0627673e6dea5.overview:
Big Bad Pete has made off with the Number Molds that Numberland needs to make its numbers, and the player guides Disney's Mickey Mouse to recover them. A map leads to five locations: The City, the Number Factory, the Space Research Center, Number City Museum, and Big Bad Pete's Hideout, which opens only after the other four are completed. Each location has two stages, and each stage hides a magic number to collect before Mickey reaches the Phone Booth at its end. The booth leads to a Number Machine, where solving a simple number problem, such as addition, subtraction or number ordering, releases a stolen mold.

Three difficulty settings are available: Normal, Advanced and Super Advanced. In the two harder settings, Mickey collects Bubble Gum and blows bubbles to stop enemies. Only in Super Advanced can Mickey lose a try, and even then he can always continue.

d41e28b1a33b3b67.overview:
Destroying an invading alien force to protect humanity is the mission confronting elite soldiers in the Amazon basin. Thirty years after a cosmic collision near Mayan ruins, players control Special Forces commandos Bill and Lance as they assault the defenses of the entity known as Red Falcon.

Action unfolds across multiple perspectives, including side-scrolling areas, an upward climb up a waterfall, and pseudo-3D environments where the commando shoots and advances toward the background. Throughout eight defense zones, commandos run, jump, and lay down to fire in various directions while destroying flying capsules and pill box sensors to obtain upgraded weaponry. Two players can take on the hostile forces simultaneously, working together as a team.

d430afcb9d0af1a8.overview:
A hand cursor guided by the directional pad lets players place wagers and make standard casino choices against a computer dealer. The objective is to reach 21 points or hold a total closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. Participants bet at least $10.00 each deal and receive two initial face-up cards, while the dealer takes one card face up and one face down. Players can hit, stand, double down on totals of 10 or 11, split identical pairs, buy insurance, or choose to give up before taking extra cards.

Games aim to break the bank by accumulating winnings beyond a chosen table limit. Options allow customization of the number of card decks, starting cash, card back art, and screen color schemes. Matches accommodate one or two participants playing simultaneously with either one shared controller or two individual controllers.

d4a94fd07859485f.overview:
Five distinct areas make up the amusement park setting, with each section featuring a different protagonist. Plucky Duck steers a bumper car, Hamton runs along a moving train, Babs Bunny travels along a rollercoaster, and Furrball evades enemy attacks aboard a log ride. Opponents such as Arnold the Pit Bull, the train's engineer, stand in the way, while various television series characters appear in cameo roles.

Every attraction requires an admission fee paid in tickets. Players collect points across the rides to buy additional tickets, and clearing each of the four main rides awards a gold ticket. Four gold tickets grant admission to the final Fun House Maze stage. Inside this final area, Buster Bunny must avoid multiple hazards before confronting Montana Max, who orchestrated the invitations disguised as a secret admirer.

d4f1650059a01145.overview:
Achieving victory across nine innings or extended competitive play is the central goal. The game follows most of the rules of big-league baseball, displaying balls, strikes, outs, and the score. At bat, players position the hitter, swing, bunt, command baserunners, attempt steals, and introduce pinch-hitters. On defense, pitchers vary speed, steer curveballs, shift position before throwing, or attempt pick-off throws. When balls enter play, fielders pursue the ball, run directly toward bases, or make throws to targeted bases.

Play options include a single-player mode, a competitive two-player mode, and a spectator watch option. A solo player can challenge computer opponents in single matches or across a nine-game season. Two participants can face each other in single games or compete across a best-of-seven series decided when one team secures four victories. Teams have their own player rosters and statistics, and starters require rest between consecutive appearances.

d4fc5610f1355c54.overview:
Several interconnected worldwide locations, beginning with Kazakh and expanding to destinations such as Egypt, China, and Africa, form the journey navigated from a central transport base called the Blue Dragon. The story follows an operative named Hiryu investigating a conspiracy involving a mind-control weapon known as ZAIN. Players progress by gathering plot-related disks and items, acquiring clues, and unlocking previously inaccessible sectors that frequently require backtracking.

Hiryu navigates levels using wall leaps, transport tubes, and a blade known as the Cipher to strike foes or launch charged projectile attacks. Accomplishing mission objectives raises Hiryu's level and grants him more energy, while a separate gauge fuels acquired special techniques. These skills provide offensive options, restore vitality, or instantly teleport Hiryu back to the central base. Passwords allow players to save and resume progress.

d5b039637a231545.overview:
Several gameplay modes organize the matches, including Tournament mode, in which players qualify in eight-ball or nine-ball on the way to a world championship, and Challenge mode, in which one player practices six games and pool skills such as shooting, speed, accuracy, and touch. Players can also select Freestyle mode to make up their own games by arranging balls in a custom rack or placing them anywhere for a trick shot. The simulation covers multiple pocket billiard variations such as eight-ball, nine-ball, three-ball, ten-ball, fifteen-ball, straight pool, rotation, equal offense, and speed pool.

Contestants participate in straightforward virtual pool games either solo or with other people. Through the Party mode, up to eight players can compete together on the same console.

d676ef6f7aa3b042.overview:
Rescuing captured comrades and eliminating alien invaders before time runs out serves as the central mission. Controlling either Ricky or Mary, players navigate alien-infested ships across scrolling environments. A time limit applies to every stage, demanding swift action to locate and liberate the hostages.

Each of the seven ships holds 12 captives, and freeing all of them opens the exit door to the alien leader's room. Defeating the boss and its henchmen allows players to advance to the next ship. The game accommodates up to two players as they battle hostile creatures across the infested vessels.

d67817e44f3a421a.overview:
Players direct a martial artist in a white gi as he battles an adversary in a red gi across two-dimensional matches. Controlled combatants execute various maneuvers to score decisive strikes against either a computer opponent or a second participant. Contests take place in nine different settings in a best-of-three rounds format, and winning a full match rewards the victor with a bonus stage involving knocking down flying objects.

Matches conclude without utilizing standard health gauges or damage bars. Successfully landing an attack finishes an exchange and grants the fighter a full point or a half point, with victory in a thirty-second round awarded to the first participant who accumulates two match points. Defeat against the computer opponent ends the run.

d73a9a1fae739675.overview:
Rescuing alien captives and exterminating the extraterrestrial threat serve as the primary missions throughout the game. Players guide Ripley through the subterranean corridors, vents, and tunnels of the Fiorina 161 penal facility. Maneuvering through each stage involves walking, running, crawling, climbing ladders, and jumping. Every stage requires liberating all remaining prisoners before a countdown timer reaches zero, while searching for item pickups and extra ammunition to maintain survival.

A radar screen helps track captive locations once activated by collecting batteries. Ripley faces aggressive adult aliens, guardian aliens, and face-huggers that latch onto her to drain life energy. An arsenal consisting of a pulse rifle, hand grenades, a grenade launcher, and a flame thrower provides defense, though weapons can overheat if fired continuously without monitoring the gun meter.

d77ed527cf081019.overview:
Guiding a marble across maze-like race courses viewed from an isometric, third-person perspective forms the central objective. The player must steer the marble through these environments and reach the end before a timer runs out.

Tracks feature various surfaces that alter handling alongside hazards and enemy creatures that obstruct progress. After the first race, any time remaining rolls over into the subsequent course alongside an allotment of additional time. Two players can compete against one another, with each participant maintaining an independent clock while striving to earn extra points and time by winning races.

d79be89ff83550ba.overview:
Raid 2020 presents sidescrolling action set during a future drug war in America. Taking the role of a narcotics operative named Shadow, the player works to eliminate street dealers and stop a kingpin named Pit Bull. Shadow carries out missions across futuristic settings, including Technopolis and New L.A., facing gangsters and cyborgs before a final confrontation with Pit Bull.

While advancing on foot, Shadow can move across the terrain and shoot firearms. The primary loop involves defeating hostile targets, gathering money, and securing drugs. The operative can also acquire power-ups that grant various enhancements. Selected stages alter the gameplay by placing the operative inside vehicles such as a boat or a spaceship. These vehicular sequences require the player to navigate past obstacles while still battling enemy craft.

d8a12772ddcb35d6.overview:
Street Cop centers on physical action using the floor-mat Power Pad controller to pursue and arrest criminals across several urban environments. The player directs rookie officer Little Ben by stepping on designated circles to run at varying speeds, turn corners, enter buildings, squat, and swing a baton. Ben investigates stages such as a park, Harlem, warehouses, construction sites, and downtown, following wanted posters to confront cohorts and primary villains before time runs out.

Injuries from culprits or environmental obstacles deplete Ben's power meter. Players can collect and employ stage-specific items, including projectile cans, bombs, food items, mobility drinks, keys, and whistles that summon a police dog to aid in arrests. While standard mat sensors handle movement and baton swings, standard controller buttons can also trigger item use and firearm attacks.

d968a138b19d39da.overview:
The Kingdom of Alefgard faces ruin after the evil Dragonlord steals the balls of light and Princess Gwaelin is taken captive. Controlling a descendant of the hero Erdrick, the player sets out from Tantegel Castle on a mission to defeat the Dragonlord, reclaim the stolen relics, and rescue the princess. Progress requires visiting towns to converse with citizens, purchase weapons, armor, goods, and keys, and rest at inns to restore health and magic.

Exploration spans an overworld and dungeons where enemy strength escalates the farther one travels from the starting castle. Turn-based combat occurs through random encounters against single foes viewed from a first-person perspective. During battles, the hero can fight, use magic, trigger items, or flee to reduce an opponent's hit points to zero. Successful encounters award experience points and gold, which raise statistics and provide funds for better gear.

d9a666f7b122bff2.overview:
Taking control of reporter Henry M. Stanley, the player traverses side-scrolling environments across the Congo. The journey begins in 1870, after Dr. Livingston, an explorer Stanley deeply respects, sets out without him and mysteriously disappears while searching for a lost temple. To find him, the explorer travels through mysterious, uncharted jungle regions, starting at the seaport of Port Harken and following clues and journal pages Livingston left behind.

Throughout the expedition, Stanley comes equipped with a gyrocopter designed to facilitate smooth landings. The underlying quest also connects to the haunted temple of Am-Zutuk, an ancient site whose magic is said to bestow wisdom and power upon whoever looks upon it. Passwords allow play to resume at the start of six of the game's eight levels.

daa1c7263a804920.overview:
Hostile aliens have subdued Earth and placed humanity under the dominion of Babylon, a computer determined to eradicate the human race. To oppose these invaders, defenders construct the transformable machine MagMax and send a pilot into combat. MagMax travels through forests, deserts, seas, and automated cities across a horizontally scrolling field, using warp halls to shift between the surface and underground.

Navigating in eight directions, MagMax uses a beam gun to eliminate opposing machines and obstacles. Gathering additional body parts transforms the machine into a complete robot. Each attached part increases the number of projectiles MagMax can fire and absorbs damage from collisions, causing the added piece to separate and explode rather than ending the turn immediately. Missions culminate in confrontations with Babylon.

daf07341c80a8663.overview:
Professional wrestlers battle inside the ring as players take control of one of ten fictional international competitors. Bouts are won by pinfall or by disqualification after a twenty count outside the ring or a five count on the top rope, and a match undecided after seven minutes is a draw. The announcer Tom Talker delivers text commentary. Each wrestler has a wide range of maneuvers, and inputs trigger varied holds, slams, ground strikes, running blows, and top-rope dives. When certain signature maneuvers land on weakened opponents, brief cutscenes display the impact from a television replay perspective.

Single-player progression tasks the competitor with defeating every rival before facing a non-playable final opponent named Blue King. Before the first bout and after each defeat, button-mashing Muscle Training fills sections of a POWER meter that boost the wrestler's strength. A two-player mode allows participants to select wrestlers for head-to-head matches, featuring an onscreen Biometer that shows which wrestler holds the advantage to attack.

db16f0a5cb05dfa9.overview:
Extinguishing every flame let loose by the wizard Druidle serves as the primary goal across the frozen territory of Coolmint Island. The Queen of the Fairies summons the apprentice wizard Dana to protect the land. Players guide Dana across a grid-based landscape, walking horizontally, scaling single-height blocks, and pushing ice cubes into fires or dropping them from overhead to put out the flames. Dana can also create or remove an ice block beside his feet in the direction he faces; new ice attaches sideways to neighboring objects.

Pipes permit travel between areas, while jars catch fire when a flame sits on top of them. A burning jar cannot be put out and melts any ice placed on it. The campaign contains ten worlds of ten stages each, using passwords to record progress. Completing all one hundred levels provides a code for fifty bonus stages and a sound test. An included stage editor also lets players construct custom puzzles.

db26936868427b5b.overview:
Piloting a weapon-equipped speedboat, the player navigates through twenty-five stages viewed from an isometric perspective. During races, the boat must reach the finish against other boats before time runs out, and bumping into land damages the hull and drains energy. Rival craft can be attacked with guns and missiles, while ramps launch the boat airborne. Hazards include whirlpools and sharks, and numbered pods collected along the way upgrade items such as turbo, firepower, speed, missiles, and a temporary force field.

Stage goals vary across the campaign. Some levels end in battles against sea monsters. Other missions require carrying mines to a disposal area while a guard boat tries to interfere, protecting helpless swimmers from being kidnapped while watching out for space ships, jumping a waterfall, or shooting targets for bonus points.

dbd530e6ca07cc4b.official: Pilot the Vic Viper on a mission to destroy an enormous alien that threatens to devour the galaxy! Classic shoot 'em up Life Force is a spin-off of the seminal Gradius series, featuring six stages that take place inside the gigantic creature, alternating between horizontally and vertically scrolling environments. Collect capsules to gain new weapons and power-ups, and defeat the bosses at the end of each stage.
dbd530e6ca07cc4b.overview:
Guiding the Vic Viper starship, the player flies into a massive alien creature threatening to consume the galaxy. The mission proceeds across six stages that alternate between horizontal and vertical scrolling layouts. Progression requires defeating hostile targets, dodging environmental dangers, and eliminating the powerful boss guarding the end of each area.

Destroying specific adversaries yields red power pods. Collecting these pods advances a power-up selector, and pressing a button activates the highlighted upgrade, such as speed, missiles, lasers, a force field, or helper units called Options that act as extra attackers. A second player can join cooperatively, piloting the RoadBritish Space Destroyer.

dc71dadc3f4eae03.overview:
Agents Max Force and Hitman confront criminal networks by shooting or arresting street offenders and crime bosses, and a second player can join simultaneous play at any time. Both operatives carry an automatic machine gun alongside rocket bombs to eliminate hostile forces throughout their mission.

Assigned to eliminate the illicit organization, these agents seek to bring down Mr. Big and dismantle operations tied to K.W.A.K. Instead of killing every adversary, players can arrest surrendering suspects to secure higher bonus points on the end-of-sector evaluation screen. Progress also involves collecting confiscated cash and contraband dropped by defeated enemies across each stage, alongside color-coded safe cards used to open locked doorways.

dd77dc88d3808079.overview:
Tetris 2 provides puzzle gameplay centered on color coordination. Falling tetromino shapes descend toward the bottom of the play area from the top of the display. Rather than filling complete horizontal rows, the player directs these descending blocks to align their colors with pieces already situated on the game board.

Matching three or more blocks of the same color in a horizontal or vertical line causes those components to vanish from the board. Unlike traditional falling-block mechanics, the squares forming each tetromino are not consistently adjacent to one another, with some pieces joined only diagonally at their corners.

Fixed Blocks placed on the board before play begins restrict movement, and clearing all of them wins the game or advances to the next stage. In the one-player game, erasing a Flash Block removes every block of its color. Players can also compete against a second player or the computer, each choosing individual speed and round settings.

dd89b8e08738243d.overview:
Players control urban commando Kyle Reese, fighting across six levels to travel back in time to 1984 and protect Sarah Connor from The Terminator. On foot, Reese navigates ruined environments and buildings by running, ducking, jumping, and climbing. Depending on the scenario, his defenses include rifles, thrown grenades, baseballs, or unarmed punches and kicks. Driving sequences require maneuvering cars or trucks along roads and city streets, where players must accelerate, brake, dodge cross traffic, and fire weapons to survive pursuit by The Terminator.

A top status bar tracks the score, health, reserve lives, current defense, and a Sarah indicator marked when Reese locates her. Damage reduces the health gauge, which can be replenished through collectible pickups or end-of-stage performance awards. An extra life is granted every 50,000 points up to a limit of six. The ultimate objective culminates in leading The Terminator into an industrial compressor to destroy him.

ddf58f90fa596613.overview:
Taking the wheel in a simulation of the NASCAR circuit, the player drives professional stock cars from an in-car perspective. Before competing, a vehicle is chosen from three available models: a Pontiac Grand Prix, a Ford Thunderbird, or a Chevrolet Lumina. On the track, a crash during a long race sends the car to the pits for repairs at the cost of a lap.

Events can be contested as individual races or as part of a full season championship. In the championship format, drivers compete across four tracks run two times each, totaling eight competitions. A NASCAR point ratings screen follows each race, and race lengths range between 10 miles and 500 miles.

de5e01c6b46aac2c.overview:
Guiding a party of up to six adventurers, the player navigates a subterranean labyrinth to protect the threatened city of Llylgamyn. After the dying curse of the usurper Davalpus brought the castle down during his battle with Prince Alavik, the staff of Gnilda that shielded the city vanished, and the objective centers on recovering it. Obtaining this staff requires assembling the complete set of mystic armor belonging to the Knight of Diamonds, with one item hidden across each tier of the dungeon.

The dungeon has six floors, each laid out on a 20-by-20 grid, and players must thoroughly inspect each level to retrieve every corresponding armor piece to finish the quest. Pits, spinners, teleporters, and secret doors are among the traps that complicate mapping. Expeditions allow saving directly within the dungeon spaces, so a party can quit and later resume from the same spot.

de66c8d971cadb53.overview:
The Miracle Piano Teaching System functions as an educational program designed to instruct users in playing the piano. Using a dedicated electronic keyboard connected to the console along with a standard controller, the software presents a curriculum divided into thirty-six instructional sections. Users begin on a setup screen where they select their age category, which adjusts reading text between child and adult formats, and choose a section to start their study. Chalkboard screens introduce tasks, provide performance commentary, and explain musical concepts.

Instruction encompasses note reading, rhythm, finger positions, and two-handed technique. The program analyzes input to detect errors and supplies targeted exercises. Training tools include visual pointers that advance only upon receiving correct pitches, a rhythm practice option that sounds accurate tones regardless of keys struck, and a metronome. Learners also utilize minigames such as Roboman and a duck-themed Shooting Gallery, alongside a dedicated Practice Room that supports separate hand drills and orchestral accompaniment.

dec09033f68850bd.overview:
Guiding a paperboy or papergirl along a street, the player delivers morning newspapers to subscriber houses situated on both sides of the road. Success requires dodging an assortment of obstacles during the route, such as gargoyles, ghosts and sewer monsters, around unusual properties like mansions, haunted houses and kids' club houses. Two players take alternating turns and complete each day's bonus training course together.

Missing a subscriber's house or breaking its windows makes that house cancel its subscription, while breaking non-subscribers' windows earns bonus points. Good deeds, such as stopping burglars or halting runaway baby strollers, also score points. The game spans three weeks of seven days, and getting through a full week puts the deliverer in the headlines of The Daily Sun and earns a promotion to a new route.

df2609c80e818bb9.overview:
Retrieving the sacred Disks of Mishakal from the ruined city of Xak Tsaroth forms the ultimate goal, requiring a confrontation with the black dragon Khisanth. A single player leads an adventuring party through this fantasy setting within a side-scrolling action format.

The lead character is the only party member that moves and attacks on screen, though fallen heroes leave their bodies behind. Rather than remaining passive reserves, all four front-rank companions can sustain damage from hostile strikes, and heroes can be swapped into the lead position via menu options. Individual adventurers utilize varied abilities based on role-playing statistics, ranging from close combat weaponry and ranged bows to defensive healing spells and offensive wizard magic.

df49cc788fff3688.official: Classic arcade shoot-‘em-up Galaga™ was faithfully recreated for the home in this acclaimed NES version. Galaga™ became an instant classic with its innovative fighter combination system and varied enemy attack patterns. Control your fighter and shoot down the waves of invading aliens; and win bonuses in challenging stages by not missing a single enemy.
df49cc788fff3688.overview:
Piloting a fighter along the bottom edge of the display, the player shoots down waves of invading insect-shaped aliens called Galaga. Enemy craft enter the playfield, assemble into formations, and execute diving attack runs while firing projectiles. Crashing into adversaries or their incoming shots causes the player to lose a life. One or two players can play.

The boss Galaga can project a tractor beam that captures the player's craft. If reserve fighters are available, destroying that captor during an attack frees the trapped vessel, connecting both units side-by-side into a dual fighter that yields doubled offensive firepower. Every third stage is a bonus stage that awards 10,000 extra points if the player destroys every enemy without letting any escape.

df696ce2af90b18c.overview:
Four distinct competitive events are accessed through a central hub neighborhood: the ramp, downhill, slalom, and jump. The single-player game puts the player in control of a skateboarder navigating the streets, using everyday features as ramps to perform aerial maneuvers and earn points.

Points generate additional tickets, which grant entry into the skate parks. While roaming the streets, a timer steadily counts down, warning of a pursuing swarm of killer bees that stops the skater if caught. Successfully reaching an event before the timer expires allows the skater to compete for points, cash, and medals. The accumulated money pays for gear upgrades that enhance skating performance across future challenges.

df96b560b5cd059c.overview:
Baghdad falls under attack by an outer-space devil tribe that abducts the princess and transforms the citizens into stone. Supplied with arrows and a magic carpet by the genie of the lamp, Prince Aladdin flies out to confront the invading forces. The adventure spans four horizontally scrolling levels set primarily in Arabian environments before moving into outer space, without tracking a numerical score.

Controlling Aladdin, the player maneuvers across the screen and shoots arrows while in motion. Advancing to the next area requires clearing groups of goblins before defeating an end-level boss, including a witch, a snake in a flying jar, a giant skull, and giant lips. Defeating enemies can yield collectible items that replenish life, increase carpet speed, award bonuses, or enhance shot power up to five levels. Life and power levels persist between stages, and a magic lamp discovered in the final area grants invincibility and boosts life to eighty.

e060fd43ef58d6e0.overview:
Controlling police officer John McClane from an overhead perspective, the player navigates the floors of the Nakatomi Building to battle terrorists and rescue hostages. McClane starts with bare fists and a pistol holding fifteen rounds. Throughout the skyscraper, the player can acquire other weapons such as a submachine gun, flash grenades, C4 explosives, and a fire axe. Movement between floors occurs via stairways, elevators, an express elevator, or air conditioning vents.

A central objective involves stopping the enemy operation before time runs out, as seven vault locks break one by one before a four-minute final countdown begins; destroying the main computer gains extra time. McClane must balance health and foot condition; sustaining damage drains life, while running or stepping across broken glass depletes a foot meter that slows his walking pace unless treated with med-kits. Consuming soda cans restores health before heading to the thirtieth floor for the final confrontation with Hans.

e0b124ddd8ac7be9.overview:
Trouble begins when the villainous wizard Zaks sends a troll army to destroy the Yolkfolk village and has birds abduct Dizzy's girlfriend, Daisy. To save her from a cloud castle, Dizzy ventures forth to find his scattered friends and help Grand Dizzy, who is badly in need of medicine. Along the way, he meets a cast of characters including the good magician Theodore, Shamus the leprechaun, Prince Clumsy, the Shopkeeper, and Blackheart the Pirate.

Controlling Dizzy, players explore diverse settings such as mines and the sea floor while solving item-delivery puzzles. The protagonist cannot fight enemies directly and must rely on items to get past them. Beyond navigating hazards, players complete action minigames such as mine cart rides and a barrel trip down a river, operate lifts, solve sliding puzzles for extra lives, and collect 100 stars distributed throughout the map to enter the castle and fulfill the quest.

e0d4463066d9985d.overview:
Rescuing kidnapped weapons scientists and defeating S.C.U.M. Lord on an island fortress drive the four distinct missions. The player directs James Bond Jr. across side-scrolling environments, running, jumping, climbing ladders, and moving through doorways. In the first two missions, progress requires solving mini-games, aligning color grids on missile computer terminals and then cracking combination locks on safes, before locating the exit. Leaving through that exit ultimately demands eliminating the final boss of each level.

James relies on a gun alongside special equipment selected through an inventory. Available tools include underwater scuba gear equipped with bubble attacks, a flight jetpack, a defensive shield used as a battering ram, and a werewolf potion that boosts jump height while granting hand-to-hand strikes. Pickups replenish weapon supplies, restore health, award extra lives, and grant extra time against the stage timer.

e144020f37416f80.overview:
Pro Wrestling depicts competitive one-on-one wrestling matches between chosen participants. Players select from six distinct wrestlers, each possessing an individual move set. Combat options include punches, kicks, running strikes, and turnbuckle leaps. Competitors can also lock up to perform maneuvers such as body slams and piledrivers. Once an opponent is downed on the mat, the attacking wrestler can pull them back up to sustain an assault or initiate a pin.

An in-ring referee counts pinfalls once he runs over and lies on the mat, giving pinned wrestlers a chance to escape before reaching three. Wrestlers may also exit the ring, but they must return before the referee completes a twenty-count to avoid losing via count-out. Single-player bouts feature a five-minute time limit, and a draw counts as a loss for the player. Two-player matches are two-out-of-three falls with no time limit.

e1487d23800aa2c2.overview:
Operating a specialized vehicle equipped with a missile launcher, the player drives across hostile territory to recover a stolen PK430 fighter aircraft. Progress requires moving through five environments consisting of mountains, bridges, prairies, cities, and airfields. The vehicle can speed up, slow down, shoot, and jump over terrain hazards such as falling rocks, cliffs, and landmines. The distance jumped depends directly on current driving speed, allowing longer leaps when accelerated.

Opposing forces include soldiers, flame throwers, jeeps, armored cars, tanks, trucks, and helicopters launching homing missiles. Falling power barrels provide timed or persistent three-way shot upgrades as well as extra vehicles. Scattered ammunition boxes and drum cans can be safely run over, whereas hitting landmines, rocks, or enemy fire destroys the vehicle. The game offers single-player and two-player options and concludes when three vehicles are lost.

e16d48f1d703b51c.overview:
Achieving the highest score across six athletic challenges forms the primary goal in this competition. Players participate in contests set against backdrops of Italian and Greek landmarks, such as the Roman Coliseum and the Leaning Tower of Pisa. Up to two players can compete, either tackling individual contests or playing through the entire series of events.

The roster includes a sack race where lagging participants receive a push from Woodstock, as well as a boot throwing match, a pogo barrier hop, and an overboard gondola duel. Contenders also balance a stack of pizzas across a finish line and attempt the river jump, a pole vaulting event that requires precise running and pole planting to clear the water.

e1a3d949b9bf258b.overview:
Taking control of the titular protagonist, the player experiences events that loosely track the storyline of the feature film. The adventure is structured as a two-dimensional, side-scrolling platformer.

Throughout the journey, the player guides the main character through various side-scrolling environments, navigating the terrain according to the premise established by the motion picture.

e239709320fca149.overview:
Athletic robotic avatars take the field under player direction in a futuristic adaptation of American football set in 2022. Teams execute run, pass, or option plays on offense from computer-selected choices, while in advanced games defenders first choose short, medium, or long yardage coverage.

An explosive ball heats up with each down of a series, from cool to warm, hot, and critical.
