Reaching the defusion line at midfield or scoring a touchdown defuses it; if the offense fails to do so on the play after the ball turns critical, the ball explodes, usually destroying a robot, and possession passes to the other team. Robots wear down from repeated hits, and a quarterback who begins to smoke can be replaced. Cash earned by defusing the ball or scoring pays for these replacements. One player can face the computer, while two can play head-to-head or together on the same team.

e2824a71c7410632.overview:
Collecting secret documents from specially marked rooms and escaping to a waiting getaway car is the primary mission. Controlling the secret agent Otto, the player infiltrates a multistory building from the roof and descends toward the ground level. Hostile agents constantly emerge from closed doorways to fire upon Otto, who can return fire with a pistol or eliminate foes with close-range jump kicks.

Navigating between floors requires riding elevators, taking escalators, or jumping across open shafts. Players can also crush enemies beneath moving lifts or drop overhead light fixtures onto them. Otto loses a life when shot, when he falls down an elevator shaft, or when he is crushed by an elevator. In the two-player game, players take turns, switching after a mistake.

e2b26560d326cc62.overview:
Twin Cobra provides vertically scrolling shooter gameplay for a single player.

Taking control of an attack helicopter, the player navigates constantly moving environments to destroy military vehicles such as tanks, battleships, and artillery. Hostile forces fire projectiles, and being hit by enemy fire results in the loss of a life. The helicopter attacks using standard shots alongside destructive bombs. Destroying transportation helicopters, bombers, or barges sometimes releases colored saucers that switch between four distinct weapon types. Other items scattered throughout the areas provide extra bombs, firepower boosts, score stars, and extra lives.

e311f33f98a4461f.overview:
A fisherman competing in tournaments is controlled by the player to hook and reel in trophy catches within an allotted time. To win each round, participants must land the largest blue marlin of the fishing day. Other species can also be hooked, including black marlin, striped marlin, swordfish, sailfish, tuna, barracuda, dorado, and sharks, though some of them earn no points. The overall competition spans four tournament rounds, beginning in Florida before proceeding to three distinct stages set in Hawaii.

Battles with fish raise dilemmas that require direct responses, such as a smoking reel, while the player manages drag and reeling to tire the fish without snapping the line. Engaging in these encounters allows three distinct attributes to improve: Muscle Power by catching many fish, Body Strength to battle targets longer, and Skill to handle dilemmas effectively.

e3be0290f198fcee.overview:
Thunder & Lightning is a block-breaking action game. Players control Mr. Chin, moving horizontally to deflect the Demoe Ball with a stick and smash through the 30 Walls of Regret. Striking flying saucers, airplanes, and submarines uncovers power-up items that drop into the playfield. Available enhancements include extending the paddle stick, catching and releasing the ball, launching missiles, slowing ball speed, enlarging the ball, granting extra lives, or dividing the sphere into multiple projectiles.

Various creatures appear during stages, such as an octopus that latches onto the stick and slows movement, turtles that turn into extra blocks, and the Thunderwarrior, whose lightning bolts can briefly paralyze Mr. Chin. The title offers three play configurations: a single-player game, a two-player alternating mode with separate scores and screens, and a two-player simultaneous option where both participants share the screen and their scores are totaled together.

e437dbafa7e20dd7.overview:
Rescuing Princess Eleanor and defeating Morbius requires gathering six pieces of the Staff of Demnos. Controlling the wizard Shadax from an isometric perspective, the player traverses a non-linear network of more than 250 rooms inside the fortress of Kâstleröck. Shadax can jump, lift, and drop objects to solve puzzles, navigate hazards like floor spikes, and evade hostile creatures. Boots found along the way increase jumping height, while hovering crystal balls and movable blocks serve as platforms to cross dangerous areas.

Potions stored in beakers can freeze time, grant temporary invincibility, eliminate moving objects, or reveal invisible items. Progress through the stronghold also involves detonating bombs, passing through portals, and finding magic keys. Scattered blue hats provide extra lives, while coins allow continuing from a specific room. A map screen tracks discovered rooms and exits alongside an inventory displaying completion statistics.

e455d60550150a93.overview:
Controlling biblical figures, players lift and carry objects across sidescrolling stages in three separate games based on Old Testament stories. In Noah's Ark, the protagonist must gather food and animals to transport them into the vessel. Restless creatures can be calmed with their favorite food, while uncooperative tree snakes mean friendlier snakes must be found elsewhere. Stone tablets bearing Bible quotes give Noah clues and strength.

In Baby Moses, the player directs the mother of Moses to carry her infant son safely to the river while evading soldiers and hazards. In David and Goliath, players initially guide David to gather sheep while stunning predatory bears and lions with acorns, as scorpions and charging mountain goats block the way. David must then defeat Goliath's shield bearer before facing Goliath, who can fall to a single well-placed shot from David's sling.

e49cb745370065a4.overview:
Across five distinct chapters, diverse adventurers set out on personal journeys that ultimately converge to save the world from monsters led by Necrosaro. The first four chapters provide backstories for the royal soldier Ragner, Princess Alena, the arms merchant Taloon, and the sisters Mara and Nara. The fifth chapter unites these companions under the Hero, who can be male or female.

Players navigate an overland map featuring day and night cycles, utilizing a ship and a hot air balloon. Once acquired, a wagon allows players to choose active combatants. During battles in the final chapter, the player directs the Hero directly while the other members follow one of six strategies, such as Offensive, Defensive, or Save MP. Players also search for hidden items, gather medals to trade for rare weapons, visit casinos, and save progress at Houses of Healing.

e4aa19e0fd2800b5.overview:
Capturing a division pennant by achieving 70 victories in a 130-game regular season and then winning four games in the Super Series serves as the primary goal. Baseball competition features twelve teams divided evenly into Eastern and Western divisions. Matches are viewed from behind the pitcher toward home plate and include an overhead map of the diamond to monitor runners. Gameplay requires batting, pitching, fielding, and baserunning. A slaughter rule ends contests early if a club leads by nine or more runs in the bottom of an inning, while games remaining tied after 18 innings conclude as draws.

Players inspect static athlete attributes, rearrange starting lineups, and swap bench players or relief pitchers. During play, a performance system awards white stars for successful actions and black stars for blunders, directly influencing current batting and pitching capabilities. Modes include single-player regular seasons using passwords, exhibition matches for one player or two competing opponents, and an automated watch format.

e5673075301b0c84.overview:
The Krion Conquest is a side-scrolling action-adventure game. Set during an invasion by the robotic Krion Empire in 1999, the narrative follows Francesca, a witch who uses magic to repel the onslaught. The player guides Francesca through five rounds of hostile bases, each with three stages and a boss, to halt the Krion Empire's global offensive.

Controlling the protagonist, players can crouch to avoid attacks, aim projectiles straight up, and charge shots. Francesca swaps among six magic powers, each distinguished by a different outfit color. These magic abilities include a standard red blast, a pink Fire-Bird strike that clears the screen at the cost of life, a blue freezing shot, a green ricocheting ball, an orange protective shield, and a purple broom.

e580f51b06217b10.overview:
Toki provides run and gun platforming gameplay. Controlling the warrior Toki, transformed into a monkey by the sorcerer Vookimedlo, the player journeys across diverse environments to rescue his abducted girlfriend, Miho, and regain his human form. Toki remains vulnerable to enemy attacks, but he can defend himself by firing projectiles from his mouth to defeat hostile creatures and overcome obstacles.

Progress involves navigating timed stages that conclude with boss encounters. Along the way, players can gather items to assist their advance, including weapon power-ups, protective headgear, jumping boosts, clocks to replenish remaining time, keys to open locked rooms, extra lives, and point items.

e5bcb8838f567f48.overview:
The Jungle Book tasks players with guiding Mowgli, a wolf-reared boy traveling toward a human village, through a side-scrolling platformer format for a single participant. Threatened by the hunting tiger Shere Khan, Mowgli confronts hostile jungle wildlife across various levels. Progression involves navigating environments by running, jumping, and climbing vines while avoiding or attacking enemies.

Mowgli defends himself using projectile weaponry, beginning with bananas and acquiring alternatives like double power bananas, boomerang bananas, a pea shooter, and invulnerability masks. Some levels are completed by collecting a required number of gems, while others end with a boss that awakens only after all the gems have been collected and must then be defeated.

e5de4656729ffa37.overview:
Set within the World Wrestling Federation, wrestlers contend to earn the WWF Champion belt or claim the King of the Ring title. Players select from eleven combatants, featuring ten professional wrestlers alongside a customizable athlete whose name and performance ratings can be adjusted. Every competitor shares identical maneuvers, such as dropkicks, stomps, body slams, punches, kicks, suplexes, throws, elbow drops, and an attack launched from the turnbuckle, though individuals differ in their stamina, speed, and strength statistics.

Several modes structure the competitions. In the signature single-elimination tournament, eight participants fight across brackets to win the crown. Alternatively, a contender can challenge the entire lineup through consecutive solo bouts to secure the championship. Exhibition matches permit one or two participants to compete in either singles contests or tag-team showdowns.

e6e010824dad945d.overview:
Matches take place as standalone basketball contests without tournament play, displaying court action from a side-scrolling perspective. The game carries the name of Magic Johnson. On the court, a blue team and a red team face off in single games of four quarters, with extra quarters played to break a tie. A 24-second shot clock, back-court violations, team fouls, and free throws are part of the rules.

Contests support one-player and two-player options, as well as simultaneous competition for up to four participants. Four-player games use either the NES Four Score or NES Satellite accessory. In one-player games, the computer team's skill is set at one of five levels from Rookie to Professional. Winning teams earn salary raises and bonuses, and a list of high salaries is kept until the console is powered down.

e719d71881096345.overview:
Home Alone centers on adventure gameplay based on the premise of the film. The story follows Kevin McCallister after his family leaves the house and he is left home alone, while Marv and Harry, known as the Wet Bandits, take an interest in the family's valuables.

The player must keep Kevin from being captured by the two burglars for 20 minutes, until the police arrive, while moving through the house, the basement and the tree house. Household items such as soup cans, nails, paint cans and chandeliers serve as traps that delay the intruders, and Kevin can carry up to three traps at a time. Secret hiding places let him dodge the bandits temporarily.

e788ae1dff1b8687.overview:
Piloting an F-14 fighter jet from a first-person cockpit perspective, the player engages enemy forces in aerial combat across four combat levels. Combat involves using unlimited cannon rounds alongside a chosen type of missile to shoot down hostile targets and dodge incoming fire. In addition to initial dogfights, subsequent missions require destroying an enemy aircraft carrier, an inland fortress, and a killer satellite space base. The single-player campaign begins with an allotment of three aircraft, and losing all planes ends the game.

Onscreen instruments track flight data, including radar, altitude, air speed, damage, and fuel. To prevent running out of fuel during the longer sorties, the pilot can summon an airborne tanker once per stage after the first level to align with a fuel boom. Successfully finishing each mission requires landing the jet on a carrier deck.

e82f63d59b896c4c.overview:
Rollerball simulates the play of a pinball machine. Players engage with a continuous table surface that spans four vertically connected screens, giving the playfield a height comparable to two standard real-world tables.

The setting depicts various views of the New York City skyline across the central portions of the table, including representations of the Empire State Building, the lower cityscape, and the Statue of Liberty. The topmost bonus screen features clouds and a blimp, while the lowest screen depicts an ocean backdrop. The game includes two modes of play: the multi-screen Skyscraper mode accommodates one to four participants, while Match Play provides a two-player contest between elephant and donkey sides.

e84d90fefb92f2b6.overview:
Rescuing a kidnapped teammate named Gadget and defeating the villainous Fat Cat forms the central goal of this platforming adventure. Players start out searching for a missing kitten before working through a series of zones to reach the antagonist's casino and ultimate hideout. In each side-scrolling stage, the chipmunk protagonists traverse environments by walking, jumping, ducking, and collecting objects such as crates and balls to toss at adversaries and end-level bosses. Each hero starts with three hearts and loses one with every hit.

Assistance arrives from fellow Rescue Rangers during the journey. Monterey Jack helps find secret doors and pathways, Zipper keeps the heroes from harm when he flies ahead, and Gadget leaves inventions and clues. In addition to a single-player mode, the adventure offers cooperative two-player gameplay, with one player as Chip and the other as Dale.

e868400409c70876.overview:
Piloting a fighter plane known as the Super Ace, the player shoots down opposing planes across vertically scrolling air battles. The game takes place in the Pacific Theater of World War II, tasking the pilot with reaching Tokyo to destroy the remaining enemy aircraft. A single incoming projectile or midair collision destroys the craft and costs one life.

Evasive maneuvers include a designated loop button, which lets the aircraft temporarily loop out of harm's way to avoid hazards. Players collect various power-ups during flight, such as an upgrade providing two smaller escort fighters in a wingman formation. Two players are supported in alternating turns.

e88de987a5b79833.overview:
A party of assembled adventurers explores the fictional city of Skara Brae to defeat the evil sorcerer Mangar. The antagonist has turned the town into a world of winter and filled its streets, sewers, and dungeons with hostile monsters. Players guide up to six party members through maze-like environments, solving puzzles and locating key quest items.

Turn-based combat yields experience points, which raise character levels, and gold, which buys better armor and weaponry. The roster can include varied character classes like bards, who perform songs that grant group benefits, and spellcasters capable of acquiring advanced magical arts. Progression relies on building character power to survive increasingly dangerous foes and conquer multi-level dungeon mazes.

e8bb5be4ada0b982.overview:
Applying colors and patterns to prehistoric creatures serves as the primary task for the player, who chooses one of sixteen dinosaur pictures to color. Each palette offers three colors, and the remaining choices are patterns made from those colors. Pressing the Select button cycles through the different palettes, and changing the palette also changes the coloring of the dinosaur.

Two coloring modes dictate how the coloring process works. In freehand mode, the player moves a cursor to any section of the dinosaur, whereas in point-to-point mode the computer selects each section automatically and the cursor jumps to the next fillable area. Switching modes requires starting the dinosaur over. The game is aimed at children ages three to six.

e8dc8c0441c54d09.overview:
Adventure Island 3 presents side-scrolling platform gameplay where the player controls Master Higgins across eight islands to rescue Jeannie Jungle from alien captors. Master Higgins runs, jumps, swims, and throws weapons along a two-dimensional plane. A constantly depleting timer functions as an energy bar, requiring players to collect fruit, milk, or meat to stay alive. Hitting or jumping on eggs, including hidden ones, reveals energy items, weapons, keys to secret areas, or harmful eggplants that drain energy faster.

Five kinds of dinosaur companions also wait inside eggs, granting abilities such as flight, rapid swimming, ice traction, or lava traversal. Taking a hit while riding costs the player the dinosaur. Before starting a stage, an item select screen allows the player to bring into the area up to one stored dinosaur companion, one axe or boomerang, and one invincibility crystal.

e91bb35c7a95388c.overview:
Ten areas form the structure of this single-player shooter, guiding secret agent Albatross through a rescue mission in the underground headquarters of a conspiratorial group. Operating as part of the Rolling Thunder secret police organization, the protagonist infiltrates enemy territory to rescue fellow agent Leila from a criminal organization named the Evil Society.

Controlling Albatross across multi-level floors and stairs, the player leaps over obstacles, takes cover behind crates, and enters doorways to hide from hostile forces. Albatross defends himself with a standard handgun and can acquire a continuous-firing machine gun, replenishing ammunition by accessing marked supply doors. Enemies include ninjas, creatures such as human-faced bats, color-coded Hooded Thugs, and the Evil Society leader Mabu at the final showdown.

e958d5556bdcc873.overview:
Mickey's Safari in Letterland presents side-scrolling educational action starring Mickey Mouse. The game focuses on basic literacy skills and alphabet recognition for young learners.

Throughout the journey, players travel with Mickey across various environments, ranging from the Yukon to the Caribbean. The core objective tasks players with searching for letter tablets, with digitized speech accompanying the gameplay.

e95d3557fa60baca.overview:
Players control a young boy named Nemo as he journeys through two-dimensional, side-scrolling levels set within his surreal dreams. Moving across environments from left to right as well as vertically, the player searches for keys scattered across each area. These keys unlock the door at the exit, allowing Nemo to progress toward rescuing the good King of Slumberland from the wicked King of Nightmares.

While exploring, Nemo can feed candy to specific animals like frogs, gorillas, or moles to ride them and gain their special skills. Certain animal abilities are required to clear stages and bypass obstacles amidst constantly appearing enemies. Additionally, several creatures feature lifebars that differ from Nemo's, occasionally granting extra health to help endure hazards.

e9f4c9d1b7c66c6a.official: The original Excitebike combines high-octane thrills and hair-raising stunts in a masterpiece of simple yet effective design from the early days of the NES. Speed solo across perilous obstacle courses or face off against rival bikes in white-knuckle races against the clock. Speed and stability are key, as you must keep your bike level on the landings, to avoid eating dirt.
e9f4c9d1b7c66c6a.overview:
Excitebike features side-scrolling motocross racing on obstacle courses. Players control a motorcyclist aiming to qualify for championship events by placing third or better in preliminary heats. Movement involves shifting across lanes, regular acceleration, and activating a turbo boost for extra speed. Excessive turbo usage overheats the engine, requiring an immobile cooldown unless the racer drives over cooling track arrows. Over jumps, riders must balance midair to land evenly on both wheels; uneven landings slow the bike or cause a crash. Courses feature ramps and mud patches, and running through mud or off the track reduces speed.

Two primary racing options are provided: Selection A features solo time trials, while Selection B adds computer-controlled opponents. A separate Design Mode lets players construct custom courses utilizing nineteen different hurdles and then race on them.

e9fe69c87a9ab118.overview:
Fox's Peter Pan & the Pirates - The Revenge of Captain Hook is a side-scrolling action platformer. The player guides Peter Pan across Neverland to eliminate all of Captain Hook's crew and ultimately force Captain Hook to walk his own gangplank. Peter can walk, duck, jump, and take flight in any direction as long as flight energy remains on his meter. Enemies are attacked by thrusting Peter's sword forward, which can push opponents backwards and knock them off cliffs for bonus points. Tapping select cannonball piles sends them rolling into oncoming adversaries.

Advancing to subsequent stages requires finding and defeating every pirate tracked on the counter. Peter starts each level with three lives alongside an energy gauge. Enemy fire, hand-to-hand combat, and flying into obstructions deplete energy, while losing all energy or falling into a deadly trap costs a life. Touching treasure chests and Tinkerbell restores health, while finding food replenishes flight power.

ea81de1a6d901d8d.overview:
Set in New York City, the story follows Frank Castle, a former Marine and police investigator operating as the vigilante anti-hero known as the Punisher. Viewed from an over-the-shoulder third-person perspective, this rail shooter tasks the player with guiding the titular character through various city locations to eliminate hostile thugs.

Throughout the stages, the player encounters multiple supervillain bosses, including Hitman, Jigsaw, Colonel Kliegg, Sijo, Assassin, and ultimately the Kingpin. Players can collect power-ups by shooting them on screen. Available items provide extra shells, First Aid for health, Kevlar Vests that enlarge the energy gauge, and extra lives, alongside grenades and heavier weapons such as an Assault Rifle and a Rocket Launcher.

eb0e5f318e84e931.overview:
Basketball athletes compete across a full court as players aim to score points through jump shots and slam dunks. Certain areas on the court serve as high-percentage spots that make scoring three-pointers far more consistent. During specific scoring attempts, the view transitions to a close-up visual sequence showing an athlete attempting a dunk, though dunk attempts can still occasionally miss.

Matches consist of four quarters, configurable to lengths of five, ten, twenty, or thirty minutes. Participants select from four balanced teams: Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, and New York. A single player faces a computer-controlled Boston team at one of three difficulty levels. Alternatively, two players can compete directly against each other.

eb3955503b404a5e.overview:
Navigating neighborhood streets to save stranded pets and people serves as the focus of this emergency rescue title. Players take control of a fire truck dispatched from a station house, driving through intersecting paths toward designated destinations. Once the truck arrives at a building marked by flashing text, the display changes to show stranded individuals at windows or an animal stuck in a tree. The player then aligns the fire truck ladder directly beneath them and signals them to climb down, completing the rescue when nobody remains.

Four distinct difficulty tiers structure the experience. Initial stages present single- and double-screen mazes featuring one house each and no time constraints. Subsequent tiers introduce scrolling multi-screen layouts with two separate rescue sites per maze, a fifty-second countdown clock, and hidden flashing keys that must be collected across the streets before approaching each scene.

ebdd748cd488c4ac.overview:
Guiding the Cheetahmen to defeat Dr. Morbis and his creations forms the primary goal of this title. At the start, Dr. Morbis creates the Ape-Man to oppose the group. Dr. Morbis also appears directly as the boss at the end of the Apollo levels.

The game contains six levels. Players control Apollo, Hercules, and Aries in turn, switching to the next of the Cheetahmen after defeating the boss at the end of every second level. Hercules faces the Ape-Man, and the game cannot be continued after the Ape-Man is defeated; because of this bug, the two Aries levels are normally unreachable.

ec0d4ebf6d2fcecd.official: The epic series The Legend of Zelda began here, with the heroic Link on a hazardous journey through the fantastic world of Hyrule. Using your sword, your shield and your wits, retrieve the eight fragments of the Triforce and save Princess Zelda. This groundbreaking game introduced innovative ideas that are still present in Zelda games more than 25 years later.
ec0d4ebf6d2fcecd.overview:
Guiding the boy Link from a top-down perspective, the player traverses Hyrule to recover eight fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom and rescue Princess Zelda from Ganon. Link starts carrying a small shield and can obtain a sword inside a cave. As players explore the outdoor overworld, they uncover secrets concealed behind walls, under bushes, and beneath gravestones. Hidden caves contain merchants, information, and items such as heart containers to expand the life meter, magic rings to reduce damage, and rubies to purchase equipment.

Players enter eight underground labyrinths to locate the fragments and acquire tools like a boomerang and a teleporting whistle. Navigating these dungeons involves defeating hostile monsters and pushing blocks to open passages. Gathering all eight fragments opens a ninth dungeon where players confront Ganon. Completing the main adventure unlocks a Second Quest that provides different dungeon locations, harder-to-find shops, and increased difficulty.

ec54ed32302aaeb2.overview:
Completing as many levels as possible before running out of chances serves as the primary goal. Players control Joshua through a tile-based environment, racing against a stage timer to collect required amounts of gold, silver, brass, and iron alongside five question items before reaching the level exit. Trumpet blasts called toots eliminate obstacles and dispatch select hostiles such as Hittite citizens, while falling objects crush resilient threats like Amorite soldiers. Destroying barriers, including wall pieces, idols, and specific representations of sin, opens paths and can uncover hidden questions.

Across one hundred levels, twenty of which hide bonus exits to bonus levels, progression involves pushing and dropping falling objects around immovable barriers. Each stage ends with five multiple-choice questions about the book of Joshua; each correct answer earns a Bible, every ten Bibles grant an extra chance, and play moves on after all five are answered. Four-letter passwords allow players to return to specific levels.

ed0a1a5ca7cf4041.official: Released in the early days of the NES, Clu Clu Land is a unique and fast-paced action-maze game. Maneuver Bubbles around the stages by grabbing posts with her outstretched hands and swinging in your chosen direction. To win, explore the whole maze to uncover all of the gold bars. But beware! Spiky sea urchins can pop Bubbles if she touches them. Luckily, Bubbles can defend herself with an electric wave to stun her enemies.
ed0a1a5ca7cf4041.overview:
Clu Clu Land presents action and maze puzzle play set in an underground mystery maze. The player directs Bubbles in a search for the gold bars that the evil Sea Urchin has hidden. Because Bubbles finds it hard to turn freely, navigation requires grabbing turn posts scattered across the maze to swing in a chosen direction, or bouncing off walls. Each stage is cleared once all bars are revealed, which form various pattern shapes. From the twenty-second scene onward, passing over a gold bar twice covers it again.

Hazards include black holes and hostile Sea Urchins. Bubbles loses a life by touching a Sea Urchin, falling into a black hole, or running out of time. To defend herself, Bubbles emits an electric shock wave that stuns enemies, allowing her to crush them against the outer wall for points. The title supports solo play or simultaneous two-player mode.

ed219a1b03be92e3.overview:
Controlling a police officer from an overhead perspective, the player drives through town to maintain law and order. Duties involve patrolling five different precincts for a week at a time. Each successive day grants a longer shift time limit and allows access to an expanded patrol sector. The primary goal is navigating the streets to locate and pursue lawbreakers, including speeders, robbers, and public enemies, while avoiding harm to innocent bystanders. A map screen shows where suspects are; speeders are arrested by chasing them with the siren, while robbers and public enemies must be blocked in until they surrender.

The game ends if the player totals their vehicle, shoots a civilian, or accumulates five warnings. At the end of each shift, merit points can be spent on repairs, ammunition, and upgrades such as better steering, brakes, acceleration, and top speed.

ed8bc89c9cd44bf5.official: A year after the events of Mega Man 3, the world is still at peace. However, mysterious scientist Dr. Cossack announces his plan to eliminate Mega Man and prove himself to be the greatest robot designer of all time. It's up to Mega Man to save the day once again! Mega Man 4 provides even more fiendish platform-action gameplay and eight new robot masters to defeat.
ed8bc89c9cd44bf5.overview:
Defeating the eight robots that Dr. Cossack has sent to destroy Mega Man is the main goal confronting the player. Controlling Mega Man, the player navigates eight stages selected in any sequence. The character runs, jumps, slides, shoots, and climbs past obstacles and enemies before facing a Robot Master at the conclusion of every stage. Conquering each boss adds that Robot Master's signature weapon to the player's arsenal. Eliminating all eight Robot Masters unlocks two separate sets of linear stages needed to finish the game.

Mega Man utilizes an upgraded arm cannon that charges energy to unleash larger and more damaging blasts. Traversal support comes from the dog Rush, who transforms into three modes, alongside hidden adaptors found within stages. At designated points in certain levels, Dr. Light's robotic suitcase Flip-Top tosses Mega Man a power-up item.

ee8b884dec3b2c5c.official: In the distant kingdom of Angel Land the cruel goddess Medusa has stolen the three sacred treasures and has imprisoned the Goddess of Light, Palutena. Only you, Kid Icarus, will be able to recover the treasures, destroy Medusa and rescue Palutena from captivity. During your adventure you will traverse eerie ruins, in which you'll find weapons and valuable remedies. These will be essential if you want to win the fight against Medusa's army.
ee8b884dec3b2c5c.overview:
Four stages structure the adventure across Angel Land, guiding players through the Underworld, Overworld, Skyworld, and the Palace in the Sky. Controlling the angel Pit, the player aims to defeat Medusa and rescue Palutena. The first three stages feature three unidirectional levels followed by a labyrinthine fortress. Pit ascends vertically in the Underworld and Skyworld, advances horizontally across the Overworld, and searches fortress rooms to defeat gatekeeper bosses. Securing three sacred treasures from these bosses opens the fourth stage, which plays as a scrolling shooter.

Pit attacks monsters with a bow and arrows. Slain foes drop hearts used as currency in shops and black markets. Entering doors reveals rooms such as hot springs that restore health and god chambers that boost arrow strength. Single-use mallets free petrified Centurions to aid in boss battles, and sufficient points increase Pit's health bar between levels.

eea66f7bcc90d114.official: Renowned as one of the most challenging platform games of all time, Ghosts'n Goblins pits brave knight Arthur on a hair-raising journey to rescue his beloved princess from her supernatural captors. Arm yourself with weapons such as the Javelin, Dagger or Axe, then battle your way through six monster-infested stages until the final confrontation with the Devil himself! But beware the Devil's tricks! The princess may be further away than you think...
eea66f7bcc90d114.overview:
Seven guarded gates structure the journey to rescue the Princess and confront the Devil. The player controls a knight on his quest against supernatural captors. The Knight must defeat various adversaries, including zombies, ravens, flying knights, unicorns, and dragons, while racing against a set time limit for each level.

Taking two hits costs the Knight a life, sending the player back to a checkpoint or the beginning of the stage. Players can collect bonus points, extra suits of armor, and alternative weapons like the javelin, sword, and axe. Certain weapons cannot harm specific bosses. Conquering the Devil requires navigating through the stages a second time to view the final ending.

ef55073037f94c42.overview:
Athletes aim to win across four Olympic-inspired track and field competitions: the 100-meter dash, 110-meter hurdles, long jump, and triple jump. Controlled via the floor mat accessory, runners dash and leap to propel their on-screen athletes. Maximum running speed depends on which row of mat buttons is used, and lifting feet prior to the signal triggers a false start. The dash pits racers against each other, whereas the hurdle race requires leaps when white box markers appear. In both jumping events, participants sprint and jump to record distance, with the triple jump requiring three separate leaps.

Tournament mode tasks a single competitor with defeating six computer rivals in both running events, where three false starts result in disqualification. Another mode, The Olympics, lets participants contest all four events consecutively, measuring performances against 1982 Guinness track records. Up to two players can compete simultaneously, or up to six can take turns.

ef63df6bcbc7e13d.overview:
KlashBall depicts a futuristic sports competition combining aspects of soccer, basketball, and hockey in an enclosed arena. Two opposing squads try to score into each other's goals, with victory awarded to the side with the highest score at match end. An active participant controls one outfield athlete at a time, throwing the ball directly or tossing it upward for midair catches. The arena features bounce domes that repel the ball in formations that change each match, plus side holes that warp the ball across the field without losing momentum. Physical aggression reduces opponent stamina to slow their movement.

Contenders select one of three teams, each rated for power, skill, and stamina. A single player faces the computer in knockout or league play, while two players compete against each other in knockout or single-round matches. Floor power tiles can freeze or slow opponents, restore stamina, or grant the ball, while collected coins purchase stat increases between rounds.

ef8ccb38760604f5.official: Haggar, Guy and Cody are back to rescue Haggar's kidnapped daughter and clean up the streets of Metro City! Mighty Final Fight takes the concept of the original arcade version but shrinks the characters to mini proportions, and beefs up the gameplay with the addition of an experience system to level up characters' abilities. Unlike other versions, you can play as each of the three main characters.
ef8ccb38760604f5.overview:
Players control one of three fighters—Cody, Guy, or Haggar—brawling through street environments to rescue Mayor Haggar's kidnapped daughter from the Mad Gear Gang. Each protagonist features distinct fighting styles, from martial arts to professional wrestling, and can obtain specific weapons including a knife, shurikens, or an oversized mallet. Defeating enemies awards experience points based on the finishing technique used. Earning enough points advances the character across six skill levels, which raises maximum vitality and unlocks a character-specific special attack at the fourth level.

The single-player adventure spans five stages along with bonus rounds, culminating in an encounter with the gang's leader in cyborg form. Along the path, players can collect items that restore lost health, grant extra lives, or provide additional continues after experiencing a game over.

f01fe9436ca7b509.overview:
Bugs Bunny faces envious friends who try to stall his journey toward his 50th birthday party. Taking control of Bugs in this side-scrolling platformer, players advance through levels to reach the celebration. Bugs wields a hammer that can break blocks and eliminate the contraptions the other Looney Tune characters have unleashed, and striking one end of a seesaw launches him higher than a normal jump. Boulder wells lead to secret passageways. While traversing stages, he can pick up carrots and collect hearts left behind by Fireball contraptions to restore health.

Many levels culminate in encounters against familiar cartoon adversaries. Completing a level grants access to a Bonus Bingo round, where more collected carrots mean more chances to win additional lives.

f15382be46e474c5.overview:
Divided into several levels that each depict a distinct locale and consist of multiple screens, this single-player adventure puts players in control of the warrior Armakuni. After being transported to twentieth-century New York City, he must locate and defeat the evil shogun Kunitoki. Movement takes place from an isometric perspective, enabling the ninja to jump forward and travel diagonally while seeking items essential for progress.

Hostile opponents patrol the environments equipped with ninja weapons or bare fists. The protagonist can defend himself by punching, kicking, or wielding found armaments such as a staff, nunchukas, a sword, and throwing stars. Throughout the journey, players collect useful items such as keys, bottles, and a map, while consuming discovered hamburgers grants additional lives.

f1762c9f40e6e45a.overview:
From a headquarters on the dark side of the moon, Ronnie the Super Rat radiates Earth with a powerful Pest Beam that drives its bugs wild and leads a takeover. To stop this invasion, world leaders recruit Kernel Kleanup to eradicate the swarming creatures across houses, hotels, warehouses, swamps, and even the moon.

The player navigates the Kernel across eight stages, jumping and striking enemies with a hammer. Eliminating every pest on a stage allows progression to the next area, culminating in an encounter with Ronnie on the moon. The Kernel starts with five lives and five hearts, losing a heart when damaged by pests and sacrificing a life once all health is depleted. Additional hearts hidden throughout stages restore life points, while a key card must be acquired to open the door to Ronnie's control room.

f17df83a3e714c9f.overview:
Ring King centers on boxing matches inside the ring. Controlling a rookie fighter, the player seeks to advance from an initial debut to the rank of world champion, climbing through the Rookie, US, and World divisions. During bouts, boxers deliver multiple types of punches, perform defensive maneuvers, and execute special attacks. Throwing punches that fail to connect depletes stamina. Whenever knocked to the canvas, rapidly pressing the punch and defense buttons together allows the boxer to regain power.

Three attributes govern fighter performance: punch, stamina, and speed. Success in the ring awards power points that can be allocated to upgrade these stats and build stronger athletes. Progress can be preserved using a password system, and two participants can compete directly in a head-to-head mode.

f1c9c4723190d6be.overview:
Riding a bicycle along a suburban street, the player throws newspapers to customer houses. Deliveries must reach a subscriber's paperbox or front porch while dodging hazards such as cars, tires, and skateboarders. Crashing into hazards costs a life, and the player must collect extra bundles along the way to refill a limited paper supply. Damaging non-subscriber houses and targeting select obstacles yields bonus score.

Subscribers cancel their subscriptions if they fail to receive an issue or if their property is damaged. Reaching the end of the neighborhood leads to a timed training course containing jump ramps and targets. A daily report then shows any canceled subscriptions, and a player who performs well continues to the next day's route, aiming to complete a full week. Losing every subscriber also ends the game.

f1eb29dd1c7b2b29.official: In NES classic Wrecking Crew, Mario and Luigi swap their plumber’s caps for hard hats as they take on the role of demolition engineers! One or two players must demolish every obstacle in each enemy-infested level, while working out the most destructive route through the networks of ladders and scaffolds.
f1eb29dd1c7b2b29.overview:
Working as demolition engineers in hard hats, Mario and Luigi take on the task of clearing out enemy-infested building sites. One or two players navigate multi-tiered networks of ladders and scaffolding to smash every target object with a heavy mallet.

The inability to jump requires players to carefully plan routes through each environment, as demolishing ladders or walls in the wrong order can leave remaining targets inaccessible. Along with indestructible drums and obstacles, levels contain dynamite that can blast several walls at once, doors into which monsters can be herded, and a disruptive foreman named Spike who attempts to knock the worker downward. Touching foes or stray fireballs costs a life, while getting covered by a drum forces the player to start over.

f22944452be3259a.official: It's the bottom of the ninth. You're at the plate. Here comes the pitch. You swing... It's a smash deep into center-field! A home run! In the NES classic Baseball, you control every action. The swing of the bat. The speed of the pitch. The hits, the steals, the double plays. Pit your skills against the computer or challenge a friend. All it's missing is the smell of hot dogs!
f22944452be3259a.overview:
Baseball simulates the sport of baseball on the diamond. Each participant selects from six available squads, which differ only by the color of their uniforms. The primary objective is to score more runs than the opposing side. Matches can be played alone against a computer-controlled adversary or competitively with two players.

Participants take command of every on-field action during a game. Responsibilities include setting the velocity of thrown pitches and timing the swing of the bat. Players also direct base running to execute steals, hit balls into play, and coordinate fielding maneuvers such as double plays.

f28821df0114eb6c.overview:
Five stages structure this platforming adventure, sending the hero through Gotham City, the AXIS Chemical Factory, the Underground Conduit, the Laboratory Ruins, and the Cathedral. Controlling the DC Comics character Batman, the player traverses these side-scrolling stages while contending with various minions, such as Deadshot, Heatwave, K.G. Beast, Maxiezeus, Nightslayer, and Shakedown.

Navigating environments relies on a wall jump maneuver to scale vertical surfaces. Batman always has his punch, and he can also use three optional weapons, the Spear Gun, Batarang, and Dirk, which consume pellets as ammunition. Encounters culminate in boss battles against foes like Killer Moth, the Machine Intelligence System, the Electrocutioner, the Dual-Container Alarm, Firebug, and the Joker.

f39421a126f3b93c.overview:
Bringing justice to the gold-rush town of Hicksville requires hunting down a band of gold-stealing outlaws across six stages, ending with Wingate at Fort Wingate. As Billie Bob, the player navigates an automatically scrolling vertical environment set in a mining town during the gold rush era. The character fires toward the left, straight ahead, or right using the B button, both buttons together, or the A button. Hazards include incoming enemy fire and direct contact with foes. Each stage's boss can only be fought after Billie Bob finds or buys a Wanted Poster.

The General Store sells the Shotgun, Machinegun, Magnum and Napalm Bomb, and a horse can also be purchased. Boots enhance Billie Bob's walking speed and rifles extend attack range, while picking up a skull reduces the stored boots and guns. Riding a horse provides defensive protection, while a Yashichi grants an extra life. Money bags supply bonus points during this single-player journey.

f3955370fe7ecc99.overview:
Mascots known as Da Boys compete across multiple skateboarding and surfing events. Street Skate Session places players in control of Joe Cool or Tiki Man as they navigate a timed obstacle course on a skateboard. Controlling speed and steering with the directional pad, players can jump, kick to speed up, leap while holding the board, hop barriers as the board rolls underneath, grind railings, and launch off ramps. Crashes cost life symbols, while completing a course awards bonus points for the remaining time.

Big Wave Encounter shifts the objective to survival as Kool Kat or Thrilla Gorilla surf a large wave. Surfers steer around hazards, leap off the wave crest, and collect bananas until reaching the beach to complete the round. Colliding with fish, seagulls, or pier supports costs life symbols. The third mode, Wood and Water Rage, alternates rounds between skateboarding and surfing with a chosen pair of characters.

f3a140c16012c4e4.overview:
Players ride a bike across set courses, racing against the clock alone or against each other in a two-player game. In one-player mode there are five worlds, each with six possible courses to choose from plus a bonus level at the end, and the player starts with three lives. In two-player mode, player 1 picks three courses from a selection of twelve, and the player with the lowest overall time wins.

Courses fall into level types such as the countryside, a park and a construction site, and each obstacle calls for its own approach: some must be ridden slowly, others jumped or used as ramps. The rider can jump, pull a wheelie or lower the front wheel, and should land with the front wheel raised. A Turbo button helps escape hazards such as the eggs dropped by Free-Range, and coins collected along the way add bonus points.

f3ff0c50c05aa5d4.overview:
Set across side-scrolling stages in Neverland, the journey follows Peter Pan on an adventure to recover his kidnapped children from Captain Hook.

The player controls Peter Pan as he traverses the land to rescue his family. Progress through the adventure ultimately culminates in a final sword confrontation against Captain Hook.

f4b7d8d31c5bbfee.overview:
Advancing through a series of action levels based on the motion picture serves as the main goal of the game. Players control movie hero Jack Slater as he pursues the villain Benedict across both fictional and real-world environments. The adventure spans seven scenes, including one titled The Car Chase, in which Slater must stop Benedict's motorcade, and a stage depicting Danny Madigan's interpretation of the Shakespeare play Hamlet.

Slater walks, crouches, jumps, and kicks hostile forces across side-scrolling areas such as school rooftops, chapels, and theater interiors. The protagonist starts with five lives and can collect heart pick-ups to replenish lost health. One later scene pits Slater against Death.

f4d57c83d8b3af0f.overview:
Achieving checkmate against the opposing king represents the ultimate objective for players in this board game adaptation. Matches follow the established rules of traditional chess, allowing participants to compete against computer-controlled artificial intelligence or another person in two-player contests.

Controlling standard chess pieces, players execute maneuvers across the board. Whenever an attacking piece captures an enemy unit, both pieces move to the Battle Zone, where an animated combat scene shows the victorious unit fighting and defeating its target. A two-dimensional board setting skips these battles for quicker play.

f4ddb0f1a02f823e.overview:
Six playfield levels structure this pinball title, retaining the same table layout while introducing hazards across stages. The view tracks the ball along the table while a split screen keeps the flippers in view at all times. Participants accumulate points by striking targets and progressing across the planets of the Solar System from Pluto to the Sun. Reaching designated planets lights extra balls. Players can illuminate a grid to lift a visor, lock two balls, and trigger a multiball sequence offering doubled point values.

Shooting the solar ramp while a ball is locked collects the Solar Value and advances the table to subsequent levels that add hostile creatures. Later stages feature a monster that tries to eat the ball, flying enemies that drop flipper-damaging missiles or carry the ball off, and snakes in the lower slots. Players free trapped balls by shaking the virtual cabinet. Furthermore, progress transforms the ball from a sphere into faster triangular and cubic forms.

f4de2a91acb2eb30.overview:
Gameplay cycles through several kinds of action stages, boss encounters and a bomb disposal puzzle, with each stage type recurring in different settings. The player controls Ultimate Stuntman in pursuit of Doctor Evil. In the pursuit stages, the protagonist chases the villain using various vehicles, including dune buggies, cars, or gliders, and microlight stages take the chase into the air. Street combat stages shift to on-foot combat, arming the protagonist with a firearm to battle robot hoods while collecting the keys that unlock the forcefield around Doctor Evil's base.

Climbing stages require maneuvering the character up the outside of a building while aiming a target to shoot hoods and dodging hazards. Once inside the base, players must defuse a bomb before its timer sets it off. Moving a pointer across the triggering device de-solders microchips, some of which must be passed more than once, requiring precise navigation to clear the puzzle and proceed.

f64ce816453d826d.overview:
Chiller is a shooting game playable with a standard controller or a light gun. The player controls an adventurer seeking to release trapped spirits and halt an army of the undead by locating and destroying hidden evil talismans across a castle and its grounds. The primary objective requires shooting spirits, ghosts, and monsters to empty the Monster Meter before the timer runs out.

Gameplay spans four main levels, beginning in a graveyard and moving through a castle hallway, a basement, and an inner sanctum. Each level contains eight secret talismans that players can reveal and shoot. Destroying all thirty-two talismans unlocks a hidden level on a hill overlooking the graveyard, where players must shoot fleeing spirits before three escape. One or two participants can play, using either controllers or light guns, with individual scores tracked.

f6d29afbd7ddad33.overview:
Solid Snake infiltrates the fortified state of Outer Heaven, avoiding enemy detection from an overhead perspective across flip-screen areas. The rookie special forces operative must rescue captured hostages and neutralize a nuclear-armed bipedal mecha known as Metal Gear. Snake begins without armaments and collects gear across five fortified strongholds of one to three floors each. Weapons including handguns and rocket launchers, alongside items like rations, key cards, and a gas mask, help him progress through locked sectors and combat mercenary bosses.

Guards follow set routes and trigger alert states upon spotting Snake or detecting noise. Cameras and unsuppressed gunfire also raise alerts, and alerted guards summon reinforcements until Snake defeats them or flees to another screen. Rescuing hostages raises Snake's star rank, boosting his maximum health and ammunition capacity. Throughout the operation, a radio transceiver allows communication with Commander South and resistance contacts across designated frequencies.

f6e88113b5f64cf7.overview:
Seven levels, each divided into four scenes, structure this single-player action title. Renegade fights through the city to rescue his kidnapped brother, Matt, who is being held by the crime kingpin Mr. Big at a location called the Pig Pen.

Advancing through each scene requires beating all opposing gang members, while clearing a level demands conquering a gang leader. Renegade employs martial arts strikes such as punches, side kicks, foot sweeps, and flying kicks to battle hostile groups. Players can also pick up weapons like garbage cans, baseball bats, and fire extinguishers. Sustaining enemy attacks lowers Renegade's strength indicator, which can cause the game to end if depleted, though finishing levels or picking up dropped heart icons restores lost energy. One continue option is available once the second level begins.

f76f1779454a8a98.overview:
Set inside a casino where the toughest gamblers play, the action follows the Casino Kid, who starts with $500 and aims to build it to $1 million by beating eight poker players and eight blackjack dealers. Each win adds the opponent's money to the player's total, and each successive rival has more skill and money. Reaching $1 million earns a match against the Casino King at his mansion.

Contests within the venue feature two gambling activities: blackjack and five-card draw poker. Finding competitors requires navigating the casino floor, where opponents must be challenged in the right order; a wrong opponent will not play, though the opponent after next points the way to the right table. Tourists and Bunny Girls on the floor give hints about opponents and where to find them. Passwords save progress.

f79c8ddedbf0b580.overview:
Finding and pairing hidden matching toys on an on-screen grid constitutes the main goal for participants. Players begin by spelling out their names and choosing one of three difficulty tiers. Level 1 features a grid of twelve boxes with six hidden pairs, Level 2 offers sixteen boxes with eight pairs, and Level 3 contains twenty boxes with ten pairs. Across three consecutive rounds, a participant moves a cursor over numbered boxes and opens two selections per attempt.

Revealing two identical toys awards points based on the order of the find, displays portions of a large background toy, and grants another turn. Non-matching selections sound a buzz and pass play to the opponent. The participant who uncovers the final match receives three hundred bonus points and finishes the round. Matches can be played solo, against an automated computer opponent, or competitively between two players who alternate turns.

f7cc35a736ffd780.overview:
Clearing an enclosed maze of every pellet provides the primary objective for the player. Guiding the titular character, the player earns points by consuming pellets while maneuvering away from four colored ghosts. Any physical contact with a pursuing ghost results in the loss of a life.

Larger items known as Power Pellets temporarily change the ghosts' color, allowing the player to consume them for additional points. Bonus fruits also appear twice per maze to supply extra score. Advancing through the mazes elevates the overall gameplay speed, while the vulnerability window granted by Power Pellets steadily shortens. Two players can take turns, with the second player controlling Pac-Man.

f7f6d714c7758f67.overview:
Directing a downhill skier, the player navigates through competitive slalom runs to cross the finish line before time expires. The game features twenty-four tracks divided evenly across three mountains: Snowy Hill, Steep Peak, and Mt. Nasty. As racers descend, they must weave around flags to maintain momentum, since passing on the incorrect side triggers a snowplow that decreases speed. Hazards such as trees, snowmen, sledders, and other competitors must be avoided or cleared with a running jump, as collisions cause tumbles and sometimes falls that cost time.

Terrain features include moguls that launch the skier airborne, causing a slight loss of velocity upon landing. Mid-air freestyle maneuvers yield bonus points, though improper execution causes the racer to crash. Concluding each run, overall scores combine remaining time with trick bonuses. This solo bonus converts into seconds of skiing without the other skiers at the start of the next run.

f845ee19cbe21f5b.overview:
Across vertically scrolling levels that conclude at landing runways, players pilot a P-40 fighter against opposing armies. The primary mission entails destroying an array of enemy airplanes, tanks, battleships, and artillery while dodging hostile shots and obstacles. Up to two players are supported, and the game spans five levels, each completed on reaching the next airfield.

Offensive capabilities include forward-firing machine guns alongside a limited supply of bombs that can sometimes knock out waves of enemy bullets. Some destroyed ground targets leave a "B" symbol that adds a bomb, while shooting down a formation of eight red aircraft produces an "S" symbol that raises firepower. Downing a formation of eight yellow planes awards bonus points, and an extra aircraft is earned every 50,000 points. Losing a P-40 forfeits the firepower collected with it.

f85a689b4ff7a5e5.overview:
Guiding Kid Kool across platforming courses forms the central action as players work to collect seven herbs to heal the ailing King Voldam. One herb is won in each round by defeating the boss of its third stage. During the adventure, the hero can carry a small furry companion named Wicky. Throwing this creature allows the character to defeat opposing enemies encountered along the path.

A running game clock tracks the quest, and the sky shifts from day to night, with one hour of real play time equal to a full day. Multiple outcomes conclude the quest depending on how swiftly the mission is finished. Taking over three hours causes the monarch to perish, while quicker completions earn better endings.

f91a8bfc25bd267f.overview:
Ridding the world of the archfiend Baramos and defeating the true villain Zoma forms the primary objective of this adventure. Taking control of the sixteen-year-old child of the warrior Ortega, the player chooses either a male or female protagonist in the starting town of Aliahan. The player forms an adventuring party by recruiting up to three companions to explore castles, towns, ruins, and caves across an open world modeled after Earth's geography.

Progression follows traditional role-playing systems, where characters equip items and gain experience points through turn-based combat to level up. The party travels by foot, acquires a sailing ship, and revives the bird Ramia to fly to the castle of Baramos. A day and night cycle dictates the availability of specific quests, characters, and items. Throughout the journey, the player searches for keys to unlock doors and gathers mystical artifacts to reach final confrontations.

f93163a51f4a671c.overview:
Bee 52 is a side-scrolling shooter. Players direct an insect named Bee 52 through areas set in a garden, a swamp and the inside of a house, collecting nectar from flowers to keep the Really Nice Honey company in business. After visiting three flowers, the bee must return to the hive, where the nectar becomes honey; a full honey pot completes the stage, and later stages require more nectar.

Bee 52 flies in all directions, firing a spit attack and using his sting. Ants try to steal honey from the hive and must be stung or thrown out, and other enemies include a grasshopper named Günthar and flytraps. Shooting the Pick-up Carrier or searching hidden holes yields pick-ups such as a smart bomb, a three-way shot, a shield, a Super-Sting and the sidekick Junior, who adds firepower and guards Bee 52; all pick-ups are lost with a life. A second player can take part as Bee 53.

f97f05a4f8747d81.overview:
Stage selection divides the adventure into an initial set of three areas, followed by another trio of selectable stages before a final showdown with Steelbeak. Players guide the superhero Darkwing Duck across St. Canard on a mission from S.H.U.S.H. to halt a crime wave organized by F.O.W.L. The objective requires subduing six of its agents: Megavolt, Bushroot, The Liquidator, Quackerjack, Moliarty, and Wolfduck.

Controlling the caped protagonist involves platform navigation and dispatching foes using a Gas Gun. Darkwing starts with a standard weapon, but players can discover special ammunition types, including Thunder, Heavy, and Arrow gases. These alternate ammunition types consume varying amounts of supplies, and carrying is restricted to one special gas at a time. The Select button toggles between regular and special ammo, while pressing Up raises Darkwing's cape to deflect incoming enemy projectiles.

f997fe34edf1d998.overview:
Forcing opposing participants into bankruptcy serves as the ultimate goal for players competing on the virtual board. Up to eight players participate, selecting pieces that include a hat, wheelbarrow, iron, horse, car, shoe, thimble, or dog.

Participants navigate around the spaces to buy as much real estate as possible. Upon securing ownership of properties, players can build houses and hotels across them to charge opponents rent when they land on those locations. The title automates standard physical procedures while reproducing traditional board game mechanics.

fa12a61eb787bf83.official: Pac-Man needs no introduction – it’s one of the most popular video games ever made! Move Pac-Man through the mazes, avoiding ghosts and eating all the pellets. Beware though: each of the ghosts behaves differently! When Pac-Man chomps a power pellet, he becomes invincible, and is able to eat the blue ghosts. The more ghosts Pac-Man eats in a row, the higher the score. Don’t forget to eat the bonus fruit, too!
fa12a61eb787bf83.overview:
Levels in this action game take place within an enclosed maze where the objective is to consume every pellet scattered along the corridors. Players guide the title character through the pathways while evading four pursuing colored ghosts, each driven by distinct behavioral patterns. Losing a life occurs whenever a ghost contacts the character, and exhausting all lives concludes the run.

Power pellets located near the maze corners temporarily turn the ghosts blue and vulnerable. Chomping these weakened pursuers yields bonus points, with consecutive captures awarding escalating values. Bonus fruit appears twice in each maze near the center of the area, and its value rises in later mazes. Warp tunnels on the sides let the title character cross directly to the opposite edge of the maze.

fa456d852372173e.official: The world lies shrouded in darkness. The winds die... The sea rages... The earth decays... But the people believe in a prophecy, patiently awaiting its fulfillment. “When darkness veils the earth, four Warriors of Light shall come...” After a long journey, four young travelers did at last appear... ...and in the hand of each was clutched a crystal.
fa456d852372173e.overview:
Final Fantasy is a role-playing game where players control four Light Warriors seeking to restore the light of four darkened Orbs. Play begins by assembling a four-person party from six classes: Fighter, Thief, Black Belt, Red Mage, White Mage, and Black Mage. Characters explore towns, dungeons, and an overworld map, initially traveling on foot before gaining access to a ship, canoe, and airship. Towns offer information, items, and equipment, while dungeons feature treasure chests and boss encounters.

Encountering enemies triggers turn-based, menu-driven combat where players select commands including Fight, Magic, Drink, Item, and Run. Defeating monsters yields money and experience points, allowing characters to raise their attributes and advance in level. Later in the journey, characters can undergo a class change that expands equipment and magic capabilities. Staying at an inn restores the party's hit points and magic and saves the game to the cartridge's battery.

fa701601d39819ef.overview:
Rescuing a kidnapped sister from an evil circus serves as the ultimate goal in this single-player, side-scrolling action journey. The player guides a boy named Tim through diverse circus-themed stages after a sinister figure named Mr. Magic abducts his sibling Judy. Progress requires traversing each area, battling hostile creatures, and overcoming stage bosses before a final showdown against Mr. Magic.

Tim fights by punching and kicking. Defeating groups of enemies yields cake and hamburgers that restore his heart-shaped power meter, along with circus items such as hammers, soccer balls, yo-yos, and bombs to use as weapons, and blocks to stand on. A key is taken from the enemy in each scene cleared. Hidden entrances lead to carnival games, including leaping a bear over flames, driving a car around boulders, throwing balls at Rodan-shaped targets, and making Godzilla exercise.

fade44d9c76173af.overview:
Rescuing captured prisoners of war and destroying an enemy base serve as the ultimate mission for soldiers fighting deep behind hostile lines. Advancing to the right through six stages, players dodge incoming attacks and eliminate hostile forces. A stage concludes when the operative destroys the boss waiting at the end.

Operatives initially defend themselves using only a combat knife. Eliminating particular soldiers allows players to acquire captured power-up weaponry, including three-round bazookas, hand grenades, pistols with unlimited shots for a limited duration, and temporary invincibility shields. The game accommodates solo play or two participants competing simultaneously for the highest point total.

fb20d9562088cfa6.overview:
Armed with the Zapper light gun, the player shoots environmental hazards and enemies to protect a crawling infant named Boomer, who has wandered off into the woods. The child travels automatically from the left side of the screen toward the right across scrolling stages, and the goal is to guide him home to his mother. Threats to the infant include spiders, snakes, ravens, devils and ghosts, as well as cliffs, rivers and empty graves. Targets react to gunfire in various ways, such as clouds that turn into ice bridges over chasms when hit. A milk gauge at the top of the screen must be kept up by shooting milk bottles, some of them hidden.

Gold nuggets left unshot are collected by Boomer, and enough of them earn an extra life, and shooting valve handles on pipes decides which opening Boomer exits through. Later areas include caves with runaway mine carts and volcanic caverns.

fbc69cdaf7c14199.overview:
Rooms throughout a perilous fantasy fortress form the interconnected setting of this point-and-click adventure. Assuming the role of the last of the Line of Kings, sent by the wizard Lakmir, the player ventures into Castle Shadowgate to stop the Warlock Lord before he raises the Behemoth. Navigation relies on interacting with surroundings, managing equipment, and assembling the Staff of Ages. A built-in hint system offers clues when any are available.

Survival depends heavily on solving room puzzles while keeping an active light source. Because lit torches exist in limited quantities, they impose a constant time limit; when the light runs out, the hero stumbles to a fatal fall. Players collect tools such as a sling and a sword to defeat specific foes. Incorrect actions and traps routinely trigger sudden deaths, after which the player can resume from the previous room. Three save files are available.

fbd7caadaf77c2b1.overview:
One or two players control Nick and Tom, the Snow Brothers, who climb floor by floor through King Scorch's Ice Commandos to rescue the kidnapped Frost Princesses. Throwing snow at an enemy packs it into a huge snowball, which can then be pushed and rolled to smash every foe in its path; a buried enemy breaks free if it is left too long.

Some defeated foes drop jars of hot sauce whose powers last until a life is lost: red adds running and jumping speed, blue produces larger globs of snow, and green throws snow farther. Other jars turn a brother into an invincible flying giant or warp him to a treasure room for bonus letters. Every tenth floor is a boss round followed by a slot-machine bonus round, and spelling SNOW earns an extra life.

fbf9426155adf3b8.overview:
Players manipulate supplied shapes on a playing board to construct closed loops. Each piece consists of a single square or a combination of multiple squares, with each unit containing a straight line or a ninety-degree corner. The primary objective is to arrange these elements so they connect into complete circuits. Once a loop is finished, all segments forming that pathway disappear from the field.

Pieces are moved around the board, rotated and dropped into place against a timer, and an occasional starburst piece called a gopher clears any incomplete loop it is placed on. Game A and Game B score completed loops, with bonus rounds in Game B, while Game C shows loops with pieces removed that must be rebuilt, giving a password after every five screens. Two players can play Game A simultaneously or take turns in Game B.

fcb6a0ef3a20c19b.official: For more than 25 years, the Super Mario series has conquered the charts and won the hearts of fans the world over. Now you can discover - or rediscover - the original game that made Mario a household name. Run and jump with Mario or Luigi through caves and castles, down pipes and across platforms, and face off against Bowser to rescue your beloved Princess Peach.
fcb6a0ef3a20c19b.overview:
Rescuing Princess Toadstool from Bowser is the central objective as players traverse the Mushroom Kingdom across eight distinct worlds, each divided into four stages. Controlling Mario, or Luigi in a two-player mode, the player navigates side-scrolling environments, leaping over chasms and evading enemy hazards to reach an end-level flagpole. Environments feature caves, castles, pipes, and underwater stages. Across these levels, hitting marked or hidden blocks from beneath reveals coins or assistive items.

Stomping defeats standard adversaries like Goombas or sends Koopa shells sliding into other foes. The Magic Mushroom doubles the character's size and enables brick smashing, while the Fire Flower grants projectile attacks, and the Starman provides brief invincibility. Gathering one hundred coins or green 1-Up Mushrooms awards extra lives. Every fourth stage concludes inside a castle, challenging players to overcome Bowser, or an impostor in his likeness, over a pit of lava.

fd2a8520314fb183.overview:
Finding the exit across a series of top-down mazes serves as the primary goal while battling monsters and gathering treasure. Players guide a fantasy adventurer through each level, alone or with a second player, navigating labyrinthine corridors and locating items that restore health, unlock locked doors, add to the treasure count, or destroy enemies visible on the screen.

Opponents like ghosts, demons, grunts, lobbers, and sorcerers emerge from destructible monster generators, alongside a draining adversary called Death that shots cannot harm. A character's health depletes from hostile strikes and enemy contact, and the game ends whenever the power level reaches zero.

fd3c19b0339bf2b3.overview:
Infiltrating an underground nuclear missile complex and defeating the enemy leader guides the mission after terrorists take control of the installation. Viewed from an overhead perspective, players advance into the facility using a firearm with limitless ammunition along with a restricted stock of grenades.

Keys dropped by red terrorists open lockers encountered throughout the base, revealing weapons, ammunition, or fragments of the Heavy Barrel, a superweapon reassembled after gathering six individual pieces. Once formed, it fires super-powerful blasts for ninety-nine seconds, after which another can be assembled. Other firearms include a laser gun, a pellet gun and a flame thrower. The complex is divided into six defense perimeters sealed by blast doors, ahead of the Launch Authority Security Area. Up to two players can participate.

fd4884c98d9412eb.overview:
Eight stages spread across three levels make up the journey, taking players through Mexico, France, and Germany. Guiding Indiana Jones through side-scrolling platform stages, the player confronts conflicts during the Mexican Civil War and World War I. Indiana starts with only his whip and must overcome hostile forces, ultimately defeating a boss enemy at the conclusion of each stage.

Breaking open wooden crates reveals gold, various items, and alternative armaments such as guns, knives, grenades, and dynamite. Picking up a new weapon replaces the current one. Shield items and weapons double as Indiana's health: each time an enemy strikes him, he loses his shield item first and then his weapon. Stripped of both, Indiana defends himself using only bare fists, and receiving another hit costs a life.

fd7523b5ec5769e4.official: In a remote region of China, wise martial arts teacher Juan is attacked, and robbed of his precious scrolls. When his apprentice Ryuhi learns that the gang responsible is taking part in the World Tournament of Contact Sports, he vows to avenge his master and retrieve the scrolls. Flying Dragon: The Secret Scroll is a mix of platforming and fighting action.
fd7523b5ec5769e4.overview:
Players control a martial artist named Ryuhi, battling enemies across side-scrolling platform environments and within one-on-one fighting rings. Set in China, the storyline follows Ryuhi as he enters the World Tournament of Contact Sports to confront the Tusk Soldiers, who attacked his teacher Juan and stole the Secret Scrolls of Hiryu-no Ken.

Gameplay alternates between two formats. Journey sections require the player to navigate horizontal stages, defeat Tusk Soldiers and Tusk Beasts, collect labels to open a locked door, and claim the Cosmic Ball inside. Tournament stages shift into ring-based duels where players attack or defend the points shown by a red mark on each fighter's body; some opponents are disguised Tusk Soldiers. Recovering all six Secret Scrolls raises Ryuhi's Hiryu-no Ken to its highest level, which he needs to defeat the Tusk Soldiers' leader, Dargon. Completing the Mandara Seal with the scrolls, Cosmic Balls, and other items seals the Tusk Soldiers' evil power and reveals their last mystery.

fda4fd839497634d.official: In Spring Hill City, rival school gangs clash in pursuit of pride. The high-living Hillers have challenged the blue-collar Southsiders to a no-holds-barred series of street sports, and you must lead your team to victory! In Crash'n the Boys Street Challenge, compete for medals in various events including 400 Meter Hurdles, Hammer Throw and Swimming, but with a street-based twist like racing across rooftops and hand-to-hand combat.
fda4fd839497634d.overview:
Leading a team to overall victory by amassing medals serves as the main goal across a sequence of rule-free athletic contests. Players choose from four available squads, competing alongside an additional computer-controlled faction called Team Thornley. Each faction contains five distinct athletes with varying attributes and proficiencies. Prior to entering events, earned medals can be spent at a shopping mall to obtain character power-ups, balancing immediate performance boosts against the total medal tally needed to secure the final win.

Contests are split into two categories: individual tests and head-to-head showdowns. In Hammer-Throw Golf and the Skyline Scramble across rooftops, participants take turns, and results are ranked by fewest shots or by fastest time and most buildings cleared. The four hundred meter hurdles, swimming, and fighting scenes use a bracket of heats, with the leading contestant facing Team Thornley in a final heat for top placement. Up to four participants can join the competition using two controllers by alternating turns.

fdafaa5c95e86168.overview:
Defeating the hostile P'Radikus empire requires the player to assault enemy outposts and ultimately destroy the home planet P'Radikus. Piloting a star fighter, the player navigates space by thrusting, stopping forward motion, and rotating clockwise or counterclockwise. Spaceflight features combat against enemy ships alongside planetary landings to destroy defensive outposts and active gun turrets. Ship durability is represented by color and blink speed, changing from green when healthy to yellow when damaged and flashing red upon severe injury. Running out of fuel ends the game.

Action mode handles flight and firing primary cannons or secondary equipment such as homing missiles, stationary mines, cloaking systems, and shockwaves. Computer mode operates control panels for warping between star systems, displaying planet sector maps, and targeting planets. Destroying enemy craft and freeing alien worlds yields credits to purchase items such as armor, shields, fuel, and faster drives. Only a weapon called the Thunderbolt is said to penetrate the home planet's defense shields.

fde81fc5af055819.overview:
Players compete across five cities to defeat five opponents in pocket billiards. The game features four distinct challenges: eight-ball, nine-ball, rotation, and the 14-1 rack game. Tour matches are played as nine-ball, and each match is won by taking two out of three games.

Alongside competitive matches, players can watch trick shots or hone their skills in a dedicated practice mode. The title accommodates up to two players and includes a password feature to save progress across the tour.

fe019a7da7fb7ecd.overview:
Arranged as a side-scrolling, nonlinear cave maze, the environment requires players to navigate subterranean caverns set in the Andes Mountains. Controlling Pitfall Harry, the player seeks to locate the Raj diamond, rescue his niece Rhonda, free Quickclaw the Lion, and return to the entrance.
