Achieving this escape requires gathering items to restore Rhonda from stone, liberate Quickclaw, and secure a photograph of the Underground Kingdom that provides directions to the starting point.

Harry navigates hazards using three starting lives, which are lost upon touching adversaries or environmental dangers. The player moves, climbs, swims upward, jumps, and shoots enemies with a gun. Defeating hostiles and gathering items awards points, with extra lives earned at designated score thresholds. Hidden items, accessible only during certain jumps, include objects granting invulnerability, extra pistols, and crystal balls marked with playing card suits that unlock rock doors.

fe052f7f6b4b41dc.overview:
Players guide the characters Bif or Jet down vertically scrolling waterways while floating in inner tubes. Progressing down each stream requires steering clear of obstacles, including sharp objects, while seeking to reach the end of the river. To aid their descent, players can gather cans along the way and fling them at shoreline enemies, which scare away or freeze when hit.

Scoring opportunities appear throughout the rivers in the form of gates to navigate and collectible treasure chests. Reaching the end whirlpool of each waterway leads to a transition screen before advancing along dozens of varied rivers, including Martian canals and prehistoric swamps. A second player can participate competitively by taking alternating turns, or cooperate by splitting controls in a special mode.

fe4043430276177b.official: Hop on your board and take part in five extreme skate events! The Downhill events include a normal Race and the dangerous Jam, a wild ride through the back alleys of town. Points are all that matter in Freestyle, so hit the ramp and perform as many tricks as you can. In Highjump, try to jump as high as you can. Can you earn a place in the hall of fame?
fe4043430276177b.overview:
Skateboarders ride across five distinct competitive events, aiming to accumulate points or defeat opponents. The lineup features two downhill courses: a standard race and the downhill jam, which navigates town alleyways. Half-pipe challenges include freestyle, where players perform stunts to gather points, and the high jump, which focuses on attaining maximum vertical height.

Participants can also engage in the joust, an event in a drained swimming pool where the skater holding a stick tries to whack the defending opponent, with the two trading roles as they ride. Contests can be tackled alone or head-to-head against another participant, with support for up to eight players taking turns sequentially across the roster of events.

fe622610cd889b35.overview:
Magic Darts simulates traditional dart games for up to four participants. Competitors select from a roster of characters, input three initials, and choose light, medium, or heavy dart weights. Executing a shot requires adjusting the starting position, stopping an indicator to choose the dart curve, and timing moving gauges to set the aiming angle and throwing power. Upon release, throws display through both two-dimensional and three-dimensional views.

Six game modes are available. The 301, 501, and 701 modes challenge players to reduce their starting total to zero without busting, using customizable rules that dictate whether matches require standard or double-ring hits to open and close. Count Up awards victory to the highest score across eight sets of darts, Round the Clock requires hitting numbers one through ten in consecutive sequence, and Half It penalizes failures on assigned board targets by halving point totals.

ffa61d9f7bfb1d60.overview:
Players control a chosen fantasy hero—the Warrior, Valkyrie, Wizard, or Elf—as they navigate a top-down maze to locate exits. The gameplay centers on exploring labyrinthine dungeon floors, battling hostile creatures, and avoiding hazards. Up to four participants can join the action simultaneously with the NES Four Score or NES Satellite adapter, and new players can join a game already in progress.

Dungeon levels present numerous hazards and obstacles, such as acid puddles, stun tiles, invisible barriers, and misleading fake exits. Some walls crumble when shot, while randomly appearing treasure rooms challenge heroes to collect valuables before time expires. Combat encounters include massive dragons requiring repeated attacks and an adversary called "It", whose touch curses a hero to attract all surrounding enemies until transferred to another adventurer or removed by exiting the stage.

ffcce36b7ccbec82.overview:
Nine missions structure the campaign, presenting players with multiple pathway options to either confront or bypass enemy forces across simulated 3D landscapes. The first seven missions each contain three goals, while the eighth contains two and the final mission contains one. As a fighter pilot commanding a fictional F-14VTS aircraft, the player maneuvers through overhead isometric scrolling environments to repel an extraterrestrial invasion.

Hostile invaders have established four ground installations to siphon energy from Earth toward an alien space station capable of vaporizing the planet. The pilot must navigate mountainous terrain, eliminate alien units, and ultimately demolish the ground bases along with the space station. Mission duties include dropping critical provisions to scientists building a Neutron Cannon in underground caverns, rescuing two scientists, engaging in dogfights, and docking with the pilot's own space station to buy weapons.
